rustfs_kernel.Properties.policy_variable.statement:
/-- Variable resolution computes the ordered, bounded substitution specification. -/
theorem policy_variable_resolution_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (text : Slice U8)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h : awsvars.resolve_aws_variables ctx text=ok out) :
    out.val.map (fun v => nats v.val)=ExpandVariables (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) 0 (nats text.val) := by
  apply Verified.RustfsAwsResolution.depth_ok ctx text 0#usize out
  exact h

/-- The explicit nesting-depth entry point computes the same bounded specification. -/
theorem policy_variable_depth_resolution_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (text : Slice U8) (depth : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h : awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx text depth=ok out) :
    out.val.map (fun v => nats v.val)=ExpandVariables (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) depth.val (nats text.val) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsResolution.depth_ok ctx text depth out h

/-- A balanced placeholder is replaced by the ordered alternatives of its resolved values. -/
theorem policy_variable_balanced_replacement_spec (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List U8) (start pos closing : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] start (some pos))
    (hc : ClosingTail (nats (text.drop (pos+2))) 1=(closing,0))
    (pre post : Slice U8) (values : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (offset : Usize)
    (hp : pre.val=text.take pos) (hs : post.val=text.drop (pos+closing+3))
    (ho : offset.val=pos)
    (hr : PlaceholderAlternatives inner c ((nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take closing)
      ((36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take (closing+3))=
        values.val.map (fun value => nats value.val))
    (results : Slice awsvars.Pending) (idx : Usize) (new out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (hi : idx.val ≤ results.val.length)
    (hw : awsvars.wrap_all pre values post offset=ok new)
    (hsplice : awsvars.splice results idx new.slice=ok out) :
    out.val.take idx.val=results.val.take idx.val ∧
      (out.val.drop idx.val).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner c)=
        ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) start ++
          (results.val.drop (idx.val+1)).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner c) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.wrapped_scan_ok inner c text start pos closing hf hc pre post values offset hp hs ho hr results idx new out hi hw hsplice

/-- An empty resolved value removes the placeholder and resumes at its prefix position. -/
theorem policy_variable_empty_replacement_spec (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List U8) (start pos closing : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] start (some pos))
    (hc : ClosingTail (nats (text.drop (pos+2))) 1=(closing,0))
    (pre post : Slice U8) (offset : Usize)
    (hp : pre.val=text.take pos) (hs : post.val=text.drop (pos+closing+3))
    (ho : offset.val=pos)
    (hr : PlaceholderAlternatives inner c ((nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take closing)
      ((36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take (closing+3))=[[]])
    (results : Slice awsvars.Pending) (idx : Usize) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (new out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (hi : idx.val ≤ results.val.length)
    (hconcat : bytes.concat pre post=ok v)
    (hpush : (alloc.vec.Vec.new awsvars.Pending).push {text:=v,resume:=offset}=ok new)
    (hsplice : awsvars.splice results idx new.slice=ok out) :
    out.val.take idx.val=results.val.take idx.val ∧
      (out.val.drop idx.val).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner c)=
        ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) start ++
          (results.val.drop (idx.val+1)).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner c) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.empty_scan_ok inner c text start pos closing hf hc pre post offset hp hs ho hr results idx v new out hi hconcat hpush hsplice

/-- Replacement values combine with suffix alternatives in replacement-major order.
Inserted bytes remain literal during the current pass. -/
theorem policy_variable_wrapped_alternatives_spec
    (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (ctx : Spec.AwsValueContext)
    (pre post : Slice U8) (values : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (offset : Usize)
    (hout : offset.val=pre.val.length) (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (h : awsvars.wrap_all pre values post offset=ok out) :
    out.val.flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner ctx) =
      values.val.flatMap (fun value => (Spec.ExpansionPass inner ctx (Spec.nats post.val)).map
        (fun suffix => Spec.nats pre.val ++ Spec.nats value.val ++ suffix)) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.wrap_meaning_ok inner ctx pre post values offset hout out h

/-- Splicing substitutes the selected pending entry and preserves the surrounding alternatives. -/
theorem policy_variable_spliced_alternatives_spec
    (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (ctx : Spec.AwsValueContext)
    (inputs replacements : Slice awsvars.Pending) (idx : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (hi : idx.val ≤ inputs.val.length)
    (h : awsvars.splice inputs idx replacements=ok out) :
    out.val.take idx.val=inputs.val.take idx.val ∧
      (out.val.drop idx.val).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner ctx) =
        replacements.val.flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner ctx) ++
          (inputs.val.drop (idx.val+1)).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner ctx) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.splice_meaning_ok inner ctx inputs replacements idx out hi h

/-- Bounded expansion rounds concatenate alternatives and retain first occurrences.
The single-pass premise supplies the per-input expansion semantics. -/
theorem policy_variable_rounds_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (pass : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (hn : ∀ text, pass text ≠ [])
    (hs : ∀ (text : Slice U8) (result : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)),
      awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx text depth=ok result →
        Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts result.val=pass (Spec.nats text.val))
    (inputs : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (iteration : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h : awsvars.fixpoint ctx inputs iteration depth=ok out) :
    Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts out.val =
      Spec.ExpansionRounds pass (10-iteration.val) (Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts inputs.val) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.fixpoint_ok ctx depth pass hn hs inputs iteration out h

/-- A substitution pass preserves every byte when there is no placeholder introducer. -/
theorem policy_variable_literal_pass_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (text : Slice U8)
    (depth : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (hm : Spec.HasPlaceholder (Spec.nats text.val)=false)
    (h : awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx text depth=ok out) :
    out.val.map (fun v => Spec.nats v.val)=
      Spec.ExpansionPass (Spec.ExpandVariables (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (depth.val+1))
        (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (Spec.nats text.val) := by
  rw [Spec.expansion_literal _ _ _ hm]
  exact Verified.RustfsAwsScan.single_pass_literal_ok ctx text depth hm out h

/-- A scan with no placeholder in its remaining suffix preserves every pending text. -/
theorem policy_variable_scan_literal_suffix_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext)
    (inputs : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i start depth : Usize) (entry : awsvars.Pending)
    (hp : inputs.val[i.val]?=some entry)
    (hm : Spec.HasPlaceholder (Spec.nats (entry.text.val.drop start.val))=false)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.scan ctx inputs i start depth=ok out) :
    out=(inputs,false) ∧
      Spec.ResumeAlternatives (Spec.ExpandVariables (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (depth.val+1))
        (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (Spec.nats entry.text.val) start.val=[Spec.nats entry.text.val] := by
  refine ⟨Verified.RustfsAwsScan.scan_suffix_literal_ok ctx inputs i start depth entry hp hm out h, ?_⟩
  apply Spec.resume_literal
  simpa only [Spec.nats,List.map_drop] using hm

/-- An unbalanced first placeholder ends the scan and remains literal. -/
theorem policy_variable_unbalanced_scan_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext)
    (inputs : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i start depth : Usize) (entry : awsvars.Pending) (pos : Nat)
    (hp : inputs.val[i.val]?=some entry)
    (hf : Spec.FirstOccurrence entry.text.val [36#u8,123#u8] start.val (some pos))
    (hb : (Spec.ClosingAt (Spec.nats entry.text.val) (pos+2) 1).2 ≠ 0)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.scan ctx inputs i start depth=ok out) :
    out=(inputs,false) ∧
      Spec.ResumeAlternatives (Spec.ExpandVariables (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (depth.val+1))
        (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (Spec.nats entry.text.val) start.val=[Spec.nats entry.text.val] :=
  ⟨Verified.RustfsAwsScan.scan_unbalanced_ok ctx inputs i start depth entry pos hp hf hb out h,
    Verified.RustfsAwsScan.resume_unbalanced _ _ entry.text.val start.val pos hf hb⟩

/-- Collecting single-pass alternatives preserves input and alternative order.
The change flag records whether any input has alternatives other than itself. -/
theorem policy_variable_pass_collection_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (pass : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (hn : ∀ text, pass text ≠ [])
    (hs : ∀ (text : Slice U8) (result : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)),
      awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx text depth=ok result →
        Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts result.val=pass (Spec.nats text.val))
    (inputs : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (offset : Usize)
    (acc : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (changed : Bool)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.pass_all ctx inputs offset acc changed depth=ok out) :
    Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts out.1.val = Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts acc.val ++
      ((Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts (inputs.val.drop offset.val)).flatMap pass) ∧
    out.2 = (changed || (Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts (inputs.val.drop offset.val)).any
      (fun text => decide (pass text ≠ [text]))) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.pass_all_ok ctx depth pass hn hs inputs offset acc changed out h

/-- Reaching nesting depth ten leaves the input as its sole expansion. -/
theorem policy_variable_depth_cap_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (text : Slice U8)
    (depth : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (hd : 10 ≤ depth.val)
    (h : awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx text depth=ok out) :
    out.val.map (fun v => Spec.nats v.val)=
      Spec.ExpandVariables (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) depth.val (Spec.nats text.val) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsResolution.depth_cap_ok ctx text depth out hd h

/-- The KMS-only action test quantifies over every action, including the empty list. -/
theorem statement_kms_actions_spec (actions : Slice acts.Action) (b : Bool)
    (h : stmts.all_kms actions = ok b) : b=true ↔ ∀ a ∈ actions.val, a.family=.Kms :=

rustfs_kernel.Properties.statement_princ.statement:
/-- Principal matching is existential over AWS and service wildcard patterns. -/
theorem statement_principal_match_spec (p : stmts.Principal) (account : Slice U8)
    (b : Bool) (h : stmts.principal_is_match p account = ok b) :
    b=true ↔ Spec.PrincipalMatches (p.aws.val.map (fun v => Spec.nats v.val))
      (p.service.val.map (fun v => Spec.nats v.val)) (Spec.nats account.val) := by
  rw [Verified.RustfsPrincipal.principal_ok p account b h]
  unfold Spec.PrincipalMatches
  rw [←List.map_append]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨pat,hp,hm⟩
    exact ⟨Spec.nats pat.val,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨pat,hp,rfl⟩,hm⟩
  · rintro ⟨pat,hp,hm⟩
    obtain ⟨source,hs,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp
    exact ⟨source,hs,hm⟩

/-- Replacing a pending entry preserves exactly the prefix and suffix around it. -/
theorem policy_variable_splice_spec (xs replacements : Slice awsvars.Pending) (idx : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (h : awsvars.splice xs idx replacements = ok out) :
    out.val = xs.val.take idx.val ++ replacements.val ++ xs.val.drop (idx.val+1) :=

rustfs_kernel.Properties.resolution_term.statement:
/-- Variable resolution terminates when no value it substitutes contains a
variable reference: it returns, or fails, but does not diverge. It can fail:
each `${aws:userid}` yields one result per claim value, so the results can
outgrow `Usize.max` (in Rust, a capacity-overflow panic or out of memory). -/
theorem resolution_terminates (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (p : Slice U8) (hv : PlainValues ctx) :
    (∃ r, awsvars.resolve_aws_variables ctx p = ok r) ∨
      ∃ err, awsvars.resolve_aws_variables ctx p = fail err := by
  apply rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsResolutionTerminates.resolution_terminates <;> assumption

pub fn has_any_key_in(&self, values: &HashMap<String, Vec<String>>) -> bool {
        use Condition::*;
        match self {
            StringEquals(s)
            | StringNotEquals(s)
            | StringEqualsIgnoreCase(s)
            | StringNotEqualsIgnoreCase(s)
            | StringLike(s)
            | StringNotLike(s)
            | ArnLike(s)
            | ArnNotLike(s)
            | ArnEquals(s)
            | ArnNotEquals(s) => s.key_names().any(|k| values.contains_key(k.as_str())),
            BinaryEquals(s) => s.key_names().any(|k| values.contains_key(k.as_str())),
            IpAddress(s) | NotIpAddress(s) => s.key_names().any(|k| values.contains_key(k.as_str())),
            Null(s) | Bool(s) => s.key_names().any(|k| values.contains_key(k.as_str())),
            NumericEquals(s)
            | NumericNotEquals(s)
            | NumericLessThan(s)
            | NumericLessThanEquals(s)
            | NumericGreaterThan(s)
            | NumericGreaterThanIfExists(s)
            | NumericGreaterThanEquals(s) => s.key_names().any(|k| values.contains_key(k.as_str())),
            DateEquals(s)
            | DateNotEquals(s)
            | DateLessThan(s)
            | DateLessThanEquals(s)
            | DateGreaterThan(s)
            | DateGreaterThanEquals(s) => s.key_names().any(|k| values.contains_key(k.as_str())),

    }

/-- An explicit Deny that applies refuses the request, whatever else the
policy allows. -/
theorem explicit_deny_wins (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (st : stmts.Statement) (hm : st ∈ sts.val) (hd : st.effect = .Deny)
    (hs : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok false) :
    policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e ≠ ok true := by
  apply rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsExplicitDeny.explicit_deny_wins <;> assumption

/-- Unless the caller owns the resource or only denials are checked, an
allowed request has an Allow statement that applies. -/
theorem allow_needs_allow_statement (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (h : policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e = ok true) (ho : a.is_owner = false) (hd : a.deny_only = false) :
    ∃ st ∈ sts.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧ stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true := by
  apply rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsAllowNeedsStatement.allow_needs_allow_statement <;> assumption

/-- An owner is allowed unless a Deny applies. -/
theorem owner_allowed_unless_denied (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (ho : a.is_owner = true)
    (hd : ∀ st ∈ sts.val, st.effect = .Deny → stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true) :
    policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e = ok true := by
  apply rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsOwner.owner_allowed_unless_denied <;> assumption

/-- With `deny_only`, Allow statements play no part: a request no Deny

theorem deny_only_ignores_allows (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (ho : a.deny_only = true)
    (hd : ∀ st ∈ sts.val, st.effect = .Deny → stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true) :
    policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e = ok true := by

/-- Force-delete is granted only by an Allow statement that names it:

    (h : policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e = ok true) (ho : a.is_owner = false) (hd : a.deny_only = false)

  apply rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.force_delete_needs_explicit_grant <;> assumption

/-- Resolution terminates for every context, including substituted placeholder text. -/
theorem variable_substitution_terminates (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (p : Slice U8) (depth : Usize) :
    Finishes (awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx p depth) (fun _ => True) := by
  exact depth_fin ctx p depth

/-- Every scan either preserves the work list or strictly decreases its remaining-work score. -/
theorem variable_scan_progress (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize) (p : awsvars.Pending)
    (hp : results.val[i.val]? = some p) (start : Usize) (hs : p.resume.val ≤ start.val) :
    Finishes (awsvars.scan ctx results i start depth) (ScanPost results i) := by
  exact scan_fin ctx depth (fun s d _ => depth_fin ctx s d) results i p hp start hs

theorem variable_pass_from_terminates (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize) :
    Finishes (awsvars.pass_from ctx results i depth) (fun _ => True) := by
  exact pass_from_fin ctx depth (fun s d _ => depth_fin ctx s d) results i

theorem variable_single_pass_terminates (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (p : Slice U8) (depth : Usize) :
    Finishes (awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx p depth) (fun _ => True) := by
  exact single_fin ctx depth (fun s d _ => depth_fin ctx s d) p

/-- Iterating through an input list cannot diverge. -/
theorem variable_pass_all_terminates (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (results : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (k : Usize)
    (acc : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (changed : Bool) :
    Finishes (awsvars.pass_all ctx results k acc changed depth) (fun _ => True) := by
  exact pass_all_fin ctx depth (fun s d _ => depth_fin ctx s d) results k acc changed

/-- Repeated substitution terminates at every initial iteration and nesting depth. -/
theorem variable_fixpoint_terminates (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (results : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (iteration : Usize) :
    Finishes (awsvars.fixpoint ctx results iteration depth) (fun _ => True) := by
  exact fixpoint_fin ctx depth (fun s d _ => depth_fin ctx s d) results iteration

theorem metadata_policy_decision (p : manage.Policy) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env) (b : Bool)

    (b = true ↔
      (∀ st ∈ p.statements.val, st.effect = .Deny → manage.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true) ∧
      (a.deny_only = true ∨ a.is_owner = true ∨
        ∃ st ∈ p.statements.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧ manage.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true)) :=
  Verified.RustfsManagementDecisions.decision_ok p a e b h

    (b = true ↔
      (∀ st ∈ p.statements.val, st.effect = .Deny → manage.bp_statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true) ∧
      (a.is_owner = true ∨
        ∃ st ∈ p.statements.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧ manage.bp_statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true)) :=
  Verified.RustfsManagementDecisions.bucket_decision_ok p a e b h

/-- Table structure: keys are unique and outputs are valid Unicode scalars. -/
theorem unicode_singleton_table_structure :
    (LowerSingletonEntries.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    (∀ r ∈ LowerSingletonEntries,
      r.1 < 0x110000 ∧ r.2.1 < 0x110000 ∧ r.2.2.1 < 0x110000 ∧
      (r.2.1 < 0xD800 ∨ 0xDFFF < r.2.1) ∧
      (r.2.2.1 < 0xD800 ∨ 0xDFFF < r.2.2.1)) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ LowerSingletonEntries,
      r.2.2.2 = 1 ∨ (r.1 = 304 ∧ r.2.1 = 105 ∧ r.2.2.1 = 775 ∧ r.2.2.2 = 2)) :=
  ⟨Verified.RustfsUnicodeStructure.singleton_keys_distinct,
   Verified.RustfsUnicodeStructure.singleton_scalar_bounds,
   Verified.RustfsUnicodeStructure.singleton_expansion_shape⟩

    ∀ r ∈ LowerRangeEntries,

      (r.2.2.2 < 0 → (-r.2.2.2).toNat ≤ r.1) ∧
      LowerRangeValue r.1 r < 0x110000 ∧ LowerRangeValue r.2.1 r < 0x110000 ∧

/-- Principal matching is existential over AWS and service wildcard patterns. -/
theorem statement_principal_match_spec (p : stmts.Principal) (account : Slice U8)

    b=true ↔ Spec.PrincipalMatches (p.aws.val.map (fun v => Spec.nats v.val))

    exact ⟨Spec.nats pat.val,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨pat,hp,rfl⟩,hm⟩
  · rintro ⟨pat,hp,hm⟩

    exact ⟨source,hs,hm⟩

/-- Collecting single-pass alternatives preserves input and alternative order.
The change flag records whether any input has alternatives other than itself. -/
theorem policy_variable_pass_collection_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (pass : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (hn : ∀ text, pass text ≠ [])
    (hs : ∀ (text : Slice U8) (result : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)),
      awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx text depth=ok result →
        Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts result.val=pass (Spec.nats text.val))
    (inputs : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (offset : Usize)
    (acc : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (changed : Bool)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.pass_all ctx inputs offset acc changed depth=ok out) :
    Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts out.1.val = Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts acc.val ++
      ((Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts (inputs.val.drop offset.val)).flatMap pass) ∧
    out.2 = (changed || (Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts (inputs.val.drop offset.val)).any
      (fun text => decide (pass text ≠ [text]))) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.pass_all_ok ctx depth pass hn hs inputs offset acc changed out h

/-- Reaching nesting depth ten leaves the input as its sole expansion. -/
theorem policy_variable_depth_cap_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (text : Slice U8)
    (depth : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (hd : 10 ≤ depth.val)
    (h : awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx text depth=ok out) :
    out.val.map (fun v => Spec.nats v.val)=
      Spec.ExpandVariables (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) depth.val (Spec.nats text.val) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsResolution.depth_cap_ok ctx text depth out hd h

/-- Bounded expansion rounds concatenate alternatives and retain first occurrences.
The single-pass premise supplies the per-input expansion semantics. -/
theorem policy_variable_rounds_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (pass : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (hn : ∀ text, pass text ≠ [])
    (hs : ∀ (text : Slice U8) (result : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)),
      awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx text depth=ok result →
        Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts result.val=pass (Spec.nats text.val))
    (inputs : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (iteration : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h : awsvars.fixpoint ctx inputs iteration depth=ok out) :
    Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts out.val =
      Spec.ExpansionRounds pass (10-iteration.val) (Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.texts inputs.val) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsPasses.fixpoint_ok ctx depth pass hn hs inputs iteration out h

/-- A substitution pass preserves every byte when there is no placeholder introducer. -/
theorem policy_variable_literal_pass_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (text : Slice U8)
    (depth : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (hm : Spec.HasPlaceholder (Spec.nats text.val)=false)
    (h : awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx text depth=ok out) :
    out.val.map (fun v => Spec.nats v.val)=
      Spec.ExpansionPass (Spec.ExpandVariables (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (depth.val+1))
        (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (Spec.nats text.val) := by
  rw [Spec.expansion_literal _ _ _ hm]
  exact Verified.RustfsAwsScan.single_pass_literal_ok ctx text depth hm out h

/-- A scan with no placeholder in its remaining suffix preserves every pending text. -/
theorem policy_variable_scan_literal_suffix_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext)
    (inputs : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i start depth : Usize) (entry : awsvars.Pending)
    (hp : inputs.val[i.val]?=some entry)
    (hm : Spec.HasPlaceholder (Spec.nats (entry.text.val.drop start.val))=false)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.scan ctx inputs i start depth=ok out) :
    out=(inputs,false) ∧
      Spec.ResumeAlternatives (Spec.ExpandVariables (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (depth.val+1))
        (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (Spec.nats entry.text.val) start.val=[Spec.nats entry.text.val] := by
  refine ⟨Verified.RustfsAwsScan.scan_suffix_literal_ok ctx inputs i start depth entry hp hm out h, ?_⟩
  apply Spec.resume_literal
  simpa only [Spec.nats,List.map_drop] using hm

/-- An unbalanced first placeholder ends the scan and remains literal. -/
theorem policy_variable_unbalanced_scan_spec (ctx : awsvars.VarContext)
    (inputs : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i start depth : Usize) (entry : awsvars.Pending) (pos : Nat)
    (hp : inputs.val[i.val]?=some entry)
    (hf : Spec.FirstOccurrence entry.text.val [36#u8,123#u8] start.val (some pos))
    (hb : (Spec.ClosingAt (Spec.nats entry.text.val) (pos+2) 1).2 ≠ 0)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.scan ctx inputs i start depth=ok out) :
    out=(inputs,false) ∧
      Spec.ResumeAlternatives (Spec.ExpandVariables (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (depth.val+1))
        (Verified.RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (Spec.nats entry.text.val) start.val=[Spec.nats entry.text.val] :=
  ⟨Verified.RustfsAwsScan.scan_unbalanced_ok ctx inputs i start depth entry pos hp hf hb out h,
    Verified.RustfsAwsScan.resume_unbalanced _ _ entry.text.val start.val pos hf hb⟩

/-- Replacement values combine with suffix alternatives in replacement-major order.
Inserted bytes remain literal during the current pass. -/
theorem policy_variable_wrapped_alternatives_spec
    (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (ctx : Spec.AwsValueContext)
    (pre post : Slice U8) (values : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (offset : Usize)
    (hout : offset.val=pre.val.length) (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (h : awsvars.wrap_all pre values post offset=ok out) :
    out.val.flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner ctx) =
      values.val.flatMap (fun value => (Spec.ExpansionPass inner ctx (Spec.nats post.val)).map
        (fun suffix => Spec.nats pre.val ++ Spec.nats value.val ++ suffix)) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.wrap_meaning_ok inner ctx pre post values offset hout out h

/-- Splicing substitutes the selected pending entry and preserves the surrounding alternatives. -/
theorem policy_variable_spliced_alternatives_spec
    (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (ctx : Spec.AwsValueContext)
    (inputs replacements : Slice awsvars.Pending) (idx : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (hi : idx.val ≤ inputs.val.length)
    (h : awsvars.splice inputs idx replacements=ok out) :
    out.val.take idx.val=inputs.val.take idx.val ∧
      (out.val.drop idx.val).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner ctx) =
        replacements.val.flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner ctx) ++
          (inputs.val.drop (idx.val+1)).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner ctx) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.splice_meaning_ok inner ctx inputs replacements idx out hi h

/-- A balanced placeholder is replaced by the ordered alternatives of its resolved values. -/
theorem policy_variable_balanced_replacement_spec (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List U8) (start pos closing : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] start (some pos))
    (hc : ClosingTail (nats (text.drop (pos+2))) 1=(closing,0))
    (pre post : Slice U8) (values : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (offset : Usize)
    (hp : pre.val=text.take pos) (hs : post.val=text.drop (pos+closing+3))
    (ho : offset.val=pos)
    (hr : PlaceholderAlternatives inner c ((nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take closing)
      ((36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take (closing+3))=
        values.val.map (fun value => nats value.val))
    (results : Slice awsvars.Pending) (idx : Usize) (new out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (hi : idx.val ≤ results.val.length)
    (hw : awsvars.wrap_all pre values post offset=ok new)
    (hsplice : awsvars.splice results idx new.slice=ok out) :
    out.val.take idx.val=results.val.take idx.val ∧
      (out.val.drop idx.val).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner c)=
        ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) start ++
          (results.val.drop (idx.val+1)).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner c) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.wrapped_scan_ok inner c text start pos closing hf hc pre post values offset hp hs ho hr results idx new out hi hw hsplice

/-- An empty resolved value removes the placeholder and resumes at its prefix position. -/
theorem policy_variable_empty_replacement_spec (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List U8) (start pos closing : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] start (some pos))
    (hc : ClosingTail (nats (text.drop (pos+2))) 1=(closing,0))
    (pre post : Slice U8) (offset : Usize)
    (hp : pre.val=text.take pos) (hs : post.val=text.drop (pos+closing+3))
    (ho : offset.val=pos)
    (hr : PlaceholderAlternatives inner c ((nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take closing)
      ((36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take (closing+3))=[[]])
    (results : Slice awsvars.Pending) (idx : Usize) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (new out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (hi : idx.val ≤ results.val.length)
    (hconcat : bytes.concat pre post=ok v)
    (hpush : (alloc.vec.Vec.new awsvars.Pending).push {text:=v,resume:=offset}=ok new)
    (hsplice : awsvars.splice results idx new.slice=ok out) :
    out.val.take idx.val=results.val.take idx.val ∧
      (out.val.drop idx.val).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner c)=
        ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) start ++
          (results.val.drop (idx.val+1)).flatMap (Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.pendingMeaning inner c) :=
  Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning.empty_scan_ok inner c text start pos closing hf hc pre post offset hp hs ho hr results idx v new out hi hconcat hpush hsplice

import RustfsKernel
import H5iAppLib
/-!
# rustfs policy evaluation: the spec

From rustfs's `crates/policy` at e870a6d and the AWS IAM rules it follows.
Statements about a whole policy take a single statement's verdict from the
extracted `statement_is_allowed`; the matchers have their own theorems.
-/
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std rustfs_kernel

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec

/-- A byte string as numbers. -/
def nats (v : List U8) : List Nat := v.map (·.val)

/-- The UTF-8 bytes of a literal. -/
def lit (s : String) : List Nat := s.toUTF8.toList.map (·.toNat)

/-- `pattern` matches `name`: `*` any run of bytes, `?` exactly one. -/
def globSpec : List Nat → List Nat → Bool
  | [], n => n = []
  | 42 :: p, n => globSpec p n || match n with
    | [] => false
    | _ :: n' => globSpec (42 :: p) n'
  | 63 :: p, n => match n with
    | [] => false
    | _ :: n' => globSpec p n'
  | c :: p, n => match n with
    | [] => false
    | x :: n' => c = x && globSpec p n'
termination_by p n => p.length + n.length

/-- One of the two force-delete actions, which `s3:*` does not grant. -/
def IsForceDelete (a : acts.Action) : Prop :=
  a.family = .S3 ∧ (nats a.name.val = lit "s3:ForceDeleteBucket" ∨ nats a.name.val = lit "s3:ForceDeleteObject")

/-- The prefix of a family's action names. -/
def familyPrefix : acts.Family → List Nat
  | .S3 => lit "s3:"
  | .Admin => lit "admin:"
  | .Sts => lit "sts:"
  | .Kms => lit "kms:"
  | .None => []

/-- An action upstream's `Action::try_from` can produce. Upstream actions are an
enum per family, so a name carries its family's prefix and has no `*` or `?`
except in the family wildcard (`s3:*`, `admin:*`, ...; a bare `*` parses as
`s3:*`), and `Action::None` has the empty name. The port's `(family, name)`
pairs are wider, e.g. `(Admin, "*")`. -/
def UpstreamAction (x : acts.Action) : Prop :=
  (x.family = .None → x.name.val = []) ∧ familyPrefix x.family <+: nats x.name.val ∧
  (nats x.name.val = familyPrefix x.family ++ lit "*" ∨ (42 ∉ nats x.name.val ∧ 63 ∉ nats x.name.val))

/-- A cleaned path: `.`, or `/`-separated segments that are neither empty
nor `.`, after an optional leading `/`. -/
def CleanShape (c : List Nat) : Prop :=
  c = lit "." ∨ c = lit "/" ∨
    ∀ seg ∈ (if c.head? = some 47 then c.tail else c).splitOn 47, seg ≠ [] ∧ seg ≠ lit "."

/-- The decimal value of a nonempty digit string. -/
def digitsVal : List Nat → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | ds => if ds.all (fun d => 48 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 57) then some (ds.foldl (fun acc d => 10 * acc + (d - 48)) 0) else none

/-- `str::parse::<i64>()`: an optional `+` or `-`, then digits, in range. -/
def parseI64Spec (s : List Nat) : Option Int :=
  let (neg, ds) := match s with
    | 45 :: r => (true, r)
    | 43 :: r => (false, r)
    | r => (false, r)
  match digitsVal ds with
  | none => none
  | some v =>
    let x : Int := if neg then -(v : Int) else v
    if -(2 ^ 63 : Int) ≤ x ∧ x < 2 ^ 63 then some x else none

/-- `s` contains no variable reference `${`. -/
def NoVarRef (s : List U8) : Prop := ¬ (lit "${").IsInfix (nats s)

/-- Every value the resolver can substitute is free of `${`. -/
def PlainValues (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) : Prop :=
  NoVarRef ctx.username.val ∧ NoVarRef ctx.account.val ∧ NoVarRef ctx.now_rfc3339.val ∧
  NoVarRef ctx.now_epoch.val ∧
  (∀ l, ctx.claims.sub = some l → ∀ v ∈ l.val, NoVarRef v.val) ∧
  (∀ l, ctx.claims.parent = some l → ∀ v ∈ l.val, NoVarRef v.val)

end rustfs_kernel.Spec

def ByteOccurrence (s p : List U8) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  k + p.length ≤ s.length ∧ ∀ j < p.length, s[k+j]? = p[j]?
/-- The first literal occurrence at or after the requested offset. Absence
means that no such occurrence exists. An empty pattern occurs at each
position up to and including the end of the input. -/
def FirstOccurrence (s p : List U8) (offset : Nat) : Option Nat → Prop
  | none => ∀ k, offset ≤ k → ¬ ByteOccurrence s p k
  | some j => offset ≤ j ∧ ByteOccurrence s p j ∧ ∀ k, offset ≤ k → k < j → ¬ ByteOccurrence s p k
/-- Wrap each replacement in the surrounding bytes and resume scanning after
its inserted bytes. Results preserve the replacement-list order. -/
def WrappedValues (pre : List U8) (values : List (List U8)) (post : List U8) (offset : Nat) :
    List (List U8 × Nat) := values.map (fun v => (pre++v++post,offset+v.length))
/-- First-occurrence duplicate removal, preserving the order of distinct texts. -/
def UniqueBytes (values : List (List U8)) : List (List U8) :=
  values.foldl (fun acc text => if text ∈ acc then acc else acc++[text]) []
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecAwsResolution.code:
import SpecAwsValues
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Whether a byte list contains the two-byte placeholder introducer. -/
def HasPlaceholder : List Nat → Bool
  | [] => false
  | 36 :: 123 :: _ => true
  | _ :: rest => HasPlaceholder rest
/-- Retain each text's first occurrence in expansion order. -/
def DistinctTexts (texts : List (List Nat)) : List (List Nat) :=
  texts.foldl (fun acc text => if text ∈ acc then acc else acc++[text]) []
/-- One left-to-right substitution pass. Inserted bytes are retained literally
for this pass. Unresolved and unbalanced placeholders are retained; a present
empty value list removes its placeholder. Nested placeholder bodies expand
as text, rather than becoming a fresh variable name in this pass. -/
def ExpansionPass (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext) :
    List Nat → List (List Nat)
  | [] => [[]]
  | 36 :: 123 :: rest =>
    let (closing,balance) := ClosingTail rest 1
    if balance ≠ 0 then [36 :: 123 :: rest]
    else
      let bodyBytes := rest.take closing
      let literal := (36 :: 123 :: rest).take (closing+3)
      let replacements := if HasPlaceholder bodyBytes then
          let expanded := inner bodyBytes
          if expanded=[] ∨ expanded=[bodyBytes] then [literal] else expanded
        else match AwsValues c bodyBytes with
          | none => [literal]
          | some [] => [[]]
          | some values => values
      replacements.flatMap (fun replacement =>
        (ExpansionPass inner c (rest.drop (closing+1))).map (replacement++·))
  | byte :: rest => (ExpansionPass inner c rest).map (byte::·)
termination_by text => text.length
decreasing_by all_goals simp_wf <;> omega
/-- A bounded sequence of substitution rounds. Every round removes duplicates,
including the final round in which every text expands to itself. -/
def ExpansionRounds (pass : List Nat → List (List Nat)) : Nat → List (List Nat) → List (List Nat)
  | 0, texts => texts
  | rounds+1, texts =>
    let next := DistinctTexts (texts.flatMap pass)
    if texts.any (fun previous => decide (pass previous ≠ [previous])) then
      ExpansionRounds pass rounds next
    else next
/-- Expansion performs at most ten passes at each of ten nesting levels.
Each pass forms ordered Cartesian alternatives, then retains first occurrences.
A pass with unchanged alternatives ends iteration after deduplication. -/
def ExpandVariables (c : AwsValueContext) (depth : Nat) (text : List Nat) :
    List (List Nat) :=
  if depth ≥ 10 then [text]
  else ExpansionRounds (ExpansionPass (ExpandVariables c (depth+1)) c) 10 [text]
termination_by 10-depth
decreasing_by omega
/-- Alternatives remaining after an already scanned prefix. -/
def ResumeAlternatives (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List Nat) (resume : Nat) : List (List Nat) :=
  (ExpansionPass inner c (text.drop resume)).map (text.take resume ++ ·)
/-- Alternatives inserted for a balanced placeholder. -/
def PlaceholderAlternatives (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (body literal : List Nat) : List (List Nat) :=
  if HasPlaceholder body then
    let expanded := inner body
    if expanded=[] ∨ expanded=[body] then [literal] else expanded
  else match AwsValues c body with
    | none => [literal]
    | some [] => [[]]
    | some values => values

end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecAwsValues.code:
import SpecKernel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Resolver inputs represented only as byte lists and presence flags. -/
structure AwsValueContext where
  username : List Nat
  account : List Nat
  sub : Option (List (List Nat))
  parent : Option (List (List Nat))
  hasParent : Bool
  hasRoleArn : Bool
  hasSaPolicy : Bool
  currentTime : List Nat
  epochTime : List Nat
/-- A present subject list takes priority over parent, including an empty list. -/
def AwsUserIds (c : AwsValueContext) : Option (List (List Nat)) :=
  c.sub.orElse (fun _ => c.parent)
def AwsPrincipalType (c : AwsValueContext) : List Nat :=
  if c.hasRoleArn then lit "AssumedRole"
  else if c.hasParent && c.hasSaPolicy then lit "ServiceAccount" else lit "User"
/-- The policy resolver exposes these seven names. SecureTransport is the
literal false; all other names, including Region and SourceIp, are absent. -/
def AwsValue (c : AwsValueContext) (needle : List Nat) : Option (List Nat) :=
  if needle = lit "aws:username" then some c.username
  else if needle = lit "aws:userid" then (AwsUserIds c).bind List.getLast?
  else if needle = lit "aws:PrincipalType" then some (AwsPrincipalType c)
  else if needle = lit "aws:SecureTransport" then some (lit "false")
  else if needle = lit "aws:CurrentTime" then some c.currentTime
  else if needle = lit "aws:EpochTime" then some c.epochTime
  else if needle = lit "aws:AccountId" then some c.account
  else none
/-- User IDs retain every selected claim value; other resolved names expose
one value. An empty selected user-ID list remains present and empty. -/
def AwsValues (c : AwsValueContext) (needle : List Nat) : Option (List (List Nat)) :=
  if needle = lit "aws:userid" then AwsUserIds c
  else (AwsValue c needle).map (fun v => [v])

/-- Scan balanced braces from the start of a byte list. The offset points at
 the closing brace when the balance becomes zero, or past the list when no
 closing brace is found. Every opening and closing brace affects the balance. -/
def ClosingTail : List Nat → Nat → Nat × Nat
  | xs,b => if b=0 then (0,0) else
    match xs with
    | [] => (0,b)
    | x::rest =>
      let next := if x=123 then b+1 else if x=125 then b-1 else b
      if next=0 then (0,0)
      else let result := ClosingTail rest next
           (result.1+1,result.2)
def ClosingAt (s : List Nat) (offset balance : Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  let result := ClosingTail (s.drop offset) balance
  (offset+result.1,result.2)

end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecBucketStatement.code:
import SpecStatements
import SpecResource
import SpecFunctions
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
def DenyEffect : stmts.Effect → Bool
  | .Allow => false
  | .Deny => true
/-- A prefix-key reference selects bucket-only matching for listing actions. -/
noncomputable def StatementResource (f : condfuncs.Functions) (action : acts.Action)
    (bucket object : List U8) : List Nat := by
  classical
  exact nats (RequestResource action bucket object (decide (FunctionsReference f (BytesOfNats (lit "s3:prefix")))))
/-- Bucket policies reject a nonempty all-KMS action set, require a principal
and action match, and apply both resource sets. Empty resource sets impose no
resource restriction; this path does not use the identity-policy resource skips. -/
noncomputable def BucketStatementReaches (st : stmts.BPStatement) (args : stmts.BucketPolicyArgs) : Prop := by
  classical
  exact ¬ (st.actions.val≠[] ∧ ∀ a ∈ st.actions.val, a.family=.Kms) ∧
  PrincipalMatches (st.principal.aws.val.map (fun x=>nats x.val))
    (st.principal.service.val.map (fun x=>nats x.val)) (nats args.account.val) ∧
  StatementActionCoverage (DenyEffect st.effect) st.actions.val st.not_actions.val args.action ∧
  (st.resources.val=[] ∨ ResourceSetHolds none (RequestValueLists args.conditions.val)
    (st.resources.val.map ResourceText) (StatementResource st.conditions args.action args.bucket.val args.object.val)) ∧
  (st.not_resources.val=[] ∨ ¬ResourceSetHolds none (RequestValueLists args.conditions.val)
    (st.not_resources.val.map ResourceText) (StatementResource st.conditions args.action args.bucket.val args.object.val))
/-- Allow returns the conjunction; Deny returns its complement. -/
def EffectAllows (effect : stmts.Effect) (satisfied : Prop) : Prop :=
  match effect with | .Allow => satisfied | .Deny => ¬satisfied
noncomputable def BucketStatementAllowed (st : stmts.BPStatement) (args : stmts.BucketPolicyArgs)
    (ips : List (List U8 × Option condfuncs.IpAddr)) : Prop :=
  EffectAllows st.effect (BucketStatementReaches st args ∧
    FunctionsHold none (RequestValueLists args.conditions.val) ips st.conditions)
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecClaims.code:
import SpecKernel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std rustfs_kernel
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Exact claim lookup selects the first entry with the requested byte name. -/
def FirstNamedClaim (table : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
    (needle : List U8) (index : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ hi : index < table.length, table[index].1.val = needle ∧
    ∀ j (hj : j < index), table[j]'(by omega) |>.1.val ≠ needle

def ClaimLookupResult (table : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
    (needle : List U8) : Option Usize → Prop
  | some index => FirstNamedClaim table needle index.val
  | none => ∀ e ∈ table, e.1.val ≠ needle
end rustfs_kernel.Spec
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Existing-object tag keys have either a bare or s3-qualified name,
with an optional slash-delimited suffix. -/
def ExistingTagKey (key : List Nat) : Prop :=
  key = lit "ExistingObjectTag" ∨ key = lit "s3:ExistingObjectTag" ∨
  lit "ExistingObjectTag/" <+: key ∨ lit "s3:ExistingObjectTag/" <+: key
end rustfs_kernel.Spec
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- A matching object key occurs anywhere in the JSON tree. Scalar values
contribute no keys, and array elements contribute their nested object keys. -/
inductive ExistingTagUse : claims.Value → Prop
  | object_key (entries : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
      (e : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value) :
      e ∈ entries.val → ExistingTagKey (nats e.1.val) → ExistingTagUse (.Object entries)
  | object_value (entries : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
      (e : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value) :
      e ∈ entries.val → ExistingTagUse e.2 → ExistingTagUse (.Object entries)
  | array_value (entries : alloc.vec.Vec claims.Value) (v : claims.Value) :
      v ∈ entries.val → ExistingTagUse v → ExistingTagUse (.Array entries)
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Every extracted policy token contains at least one byte. -/
def NonemptyClaimTokens (vs : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ vs, v.val ≠ []

/-- Claims expose strings directly or through an array; other JSON types do
not supply policy strings. -/
def ClaimStringContainer : claims.Value → Prop
  | .String _ | .Array _ => True
  | _ => False
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecCommonSubstitution.code:
import SpecSubstitution
import SpecOperators
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Interpret each natural number as a byte, modulo 256. -/
def ByteOfNat (n : Nat) : U8 := UScalar.ofNatCore (n % 256) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide))
def BytesOfNats (ns : List Nat) : List U8 := ns.map ByteOfNat
/-- The ordered common-key table is data, independent of the lookup helper. -/
def CommonByteEntries : List (List U8 × List U8) :=
  commonKeyEntries.map (fun e => (BytesOfNats e.1,BytesOfNats e.2))
/-- The first request value supplies a replacement only when it is nonempty. -/
def CommonReplacement (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) (keyName : List U8) :
    Option (List U8) :=
  ((ConditionValues values keyName).bind List.head?).filter (fun text => !text.isEmpty)
def ApplyCommonEntry (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8)))
    (pattern : List U8) (entry : List U8 × List U8) : List U8 :=
  match CommonReplacement values entry.1 with
  | none => pattern
  | some text => ReplaceBytes pattern entry.2 text
/-- Resource substitution visits every common key in table order. -/
def SubstituteCommon (pattern : List U8) (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) : List U8 :=
  CommonByteEntries.foldl (ApplyCommonEntry values) pattern
/-- String substitution selects the first eligible common key in table order.
Selection is independent of whether that key's placeholder occurs in the text. -/
def SubstituteFirstCommonFrom (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8)))
    (pattern : List U8) : List (List U8 × List U8) → List U8
  | [] => pattern
  | entry :: rest =>
    match CommonReplacement values entry.1 with
    | some text => ReplaceBytes pattern entry.2 text
    | none => SubstituteFirstCommonFrom values pattern rest
def SubstituteFirstCommon (pattern : List U8) (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) : List U8 :=
  SubstituteFirstCommonFrom values pattern CommonByteEntries
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecCondData.code:
import SpecKernel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std rustfs_kernel

deriving instance DecidableEq for conddata.Op

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec

/-- STANDARD base64 encodes six-bit indices using ASCII upper/lower letters,
digits, plus and slash. Padding is not an alphabet symbol. -/
def Base64Symbol (c i : Nat) : Prop :=
  (i < 26 ∧ c = 65 + i) ∨
  (26 ≤ i ∧ i < 52 ∧ c = 97 + (i - 26)) ∨
  (52 ≤ i ∧ i < 62 ∧ c = 48 + (i - 52)) ∨
  (i = 62 ∧ c = 43) ∨ (i = 63 ∧ c = 47)

/-- Request keys use the base name, followed by a slash and variable suffix when present. -/
def LookupName (k : condfuncs.Key) : List U8 :=
  match k.variable with
  | none => k.name.val
  | some v => k.name.val ++ [47#u8] ++ v.val

/-- The request key names associated with a condition, in entry order. -/
def ConditionLookupNames (c : conddata.Condition) : List (List U8) :=
  match c.data with
  | .Str f => f.entries.val.map (fun e => LookupName e.key)
  | .Addr f => f.entries.val.map (fun e => LookupName e.key)
  | .Boolean f => f.entries.val.map (fun e => LookupName e.key)
  | .Num f => f.entries.val.map (fun e => LookupName e.key)
  | .Date f => f.entries.val.map (fun e => LookupName e.key)
  | .Binary f => f.entries.val.map (fun e => LookupName e.key)

def RequestHasConditionKey (c : conddata.Condition)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))) : Prop :=
  ∃ needle ∈ ConditionLookupNames c, ∃ entry ∈ values.val, entry.1.val = needle

/-- Canonical condition operator spellings used in policy keys. -/
def OpSpelling : conddata.Op → String
  | .StringEquals => "StringEquals"
  | .StringNotEquals => "StringNotEquals"
  | .StringEqualsIgnoreCase => "StringEqualsIgnoreCase"
  | .StringNotEqualsIgnoreCase => "StringNotEqualsIgnoreCase"
  | .StringLike => "StringLike"
  | .StringNotLike => "StringNotLike"
  | .ArnLike => "ArnLike"
  | .ArnNotLike => "ArnNotLike"
  | .ArnEquals => "ArnEquals"
  | .ArnNotEquals => "ArnNotEquals"
  | .BinaryEquals => "BinaryEquals"
  | .IpAddress => "IpAddress"
  | .NotIpAddress => "NotIpAddress"
  | .Null => "Null"
  | .Boolean => "Bool"
  | .NumericEquals => "NumericEquals"
  | .NumericNotEquals => "NumericNotEquals"
  | .NumericLessThan => "NumericLessThan"
  | .NumericLessThanEquals => "NumericLessThanEquals"
  | .NumericGreaterThan => "NumericGreaterThan"
  | .NumericGreaterThanIfExists => "NumericGreaterThanIfExists"
  | .NumericGreaterThanEquals => "NumericGreaterThanEquals"
  | .DateEquals => "DateEquals"
  | .DateNotEquals => "DateNotEquals"
  | .DateLessThan => "DateLessThan"
  | .DateLessThanEquals => "DateLessThanEquals"
  | .DateGreaterThan => "DateGreaterThan"
  | .DateGreaterThanEquals => "DateGreaterThanEquals"
/-- Nested wrappers retain one literal IfExists suffix per wrapper. -/
def ConditionKeyName (c : conddata.Condition) : List Nat :=
  lit (OpSpelling c.op) ++ (List.replicate c.wrappers.val (lit "IfExists")).flatten



def SameKey (a b : condfuncs.Key) : Prop :=
  a.key_name.val = b.key_name.val ∧ a.name.val = b.name.val ∧
    a.variable.map (·.val) = b.variable.map (·.val)

def SameStringSet (a b : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) : Prop :=
  (∀ x ∈ a.val, ∃ y ∈ b.val, y.val = x.val) ∧
  (∀ y ∈ b.val, ∃ x ∈ a.val, x.val = y.val)

def SameStringEntry (p : conddata.FuncKeyValue (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) ×
    conddata.FuncKeyValue (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))) : Prop :=
  SameKey p.1.key p.2.key ∧ SameStringSet p.1.values p.2.values

def SameStringCondition (a b : conddata.InnerFunc (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))) : Prop :=
  a.entries.val.length = b.entries.val.length ∧
    ∀ p ∈ a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val, SameStringEntry p

def SameNumberEntry (p : conddata.FuncKeyValue I64 × conddata.FuncKeyValue I64) : Prop :=
  SameKey p.1.key p.2.key ∧ p.1.values = p.2.values

def SameNumberCondition (a b : conddata.InnerFunc I64) : Prop :=
  a.entries.val.length = b.entries.val.length ∧
    ∀ p ∈ a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val, SameNumberEntry p

def SameDateEntry (p : conddata.FuncKeyValue conddata.DateFuncValue × conddata.FuncKeyValue conddata.DateFuncValue) : Prop :=
  SameKey p.1.key p.2.key ∧ p.1.values.unix_nanos = p.2.values.unix_nanos

def SameDateCondition (a b : conddata.InnerFunc conddata.DateFuncValue) : Prop :=
  a.entries.val.length = b.entries.val.length ∧
    ∀ p ∈ a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val, SameDateEntry p


def SameBinaryEntry (p : conddata.FuncKeyValue conddata.BinaryFuncValue ×
    conddata.FuncKeyValue conddata.BinaryFuncValue) : Prop :=
  SameKey p.1.key p.2.key ∧ p.1.values.decoded.val = p.2.values.decoded.val

def SameBinaryCondition (a b : conddata.InnerFunc conddata.BinaryFuncValue) : Prop :=
  a.entries.val.length = b.entries.val.length ∧
    ∀ p ∈ a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val, SameBinaryEntry p


def SameBoolEntry (p : conddata.FuncKeyValue Bool × conddata.FuncKeyValue Bool) : Prop :=
  SameKey p.1.key p.2.key ∧ p.1.values = p.2.values

def SameBoolCondition (a b : conddata.InnerFunc Bool) : Prop :=
  a.entries.val.length = b.entries.val.length ∧
    ∀ p ∈ a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val, SameBoolEntry p

def SameAddrEntry (p : conddata.FuncKeyValue (alloc.vec.Vec (condfuncs.IpAddr × U8)) ×
    conddata.FuncKeyValue (alloc.vec.Vec (condfuncs.IpAddr × U8))) : Prop :=
  SameKey p.1.key p.2.key ∧ p.1.values.val = p.2.values.val

def SameAddrCondition (a b : conddata.InnerFunc (alloc.vec.Vec (condfuncs.IpAddr × U8))) : Prop :=
  a.entries.val.length = b.entries.val.length ∧
    ∀ p ∈ a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val, SameAddrEntry p

def SameConditionData : conddata.Data → conddata.Data → Prop
  | .Str a, .Str b => SameStringCondition a b
  | .Addr a, .Addr b => SameAddrCondition a b
  | .Boolean a, .Boolean b => SameBoolCondition a b
  | .Num a, .Num b => SameNumberCondition a b
  | .Date a, .Date b => SameDateCondition a b
  | .Binary a, .Binary b => SameBinaryCondition a b
  | _, _ => False

/-- Equality preserves operator, wrapper depth and ordered data semantics. -/
def SameCondition (a b : conddata.Condition) : Prop :=
  a.op = b.op ∧ a.wrappers = b.wrappers ∧ SameConditionData a.data b.data

/-- Every source condition has equivalent contents in the target group. -/
def ConditionGroupCovered (a b : List conddata.Condition) : Prop :=
  ∀ c ∈ a, ∃ d ∈ b, SameCondition d c
/-- Group comparison retains quantifier boundaries and occurrence counts. -/
def ConditionGroupsMatch (a b : conddata.Functions) : Prop :=
  a.for_any_value.val.length = b.for_any_value.val.length ∧
  a.for_all_values.val.length = b.for_all_values.val.length ∧
  a.for_normal.val.length = b.for_normal.val.length ∧
  ConditionGroupCovered a.for_any_value.val b.for_any_value.val ∧
  ConditionGroupCovered a.for_all_values.val b.for_all_values.val ∧
  ConditionGroupCovered a.for_normal.val b.for_normal.val

/-- Table characterization: projection onto the legacy string operator family. -/
def StringOpProjection : conddata.Op → condfuncs.StrOp
  | .StringNotEquals => .StringNotEquals
  | .StringEqualsIgnoreCase => .StringEqualsIgnoreCase
  | .StringNotEqualsIgnoreCase => .StringNotEqualsIgnoreCase
  | .StringLike => .StringLike
  | .StringNotLike => .StringNotLike
  | .ArnLike => .ArnLike
  | .ArnNotLike => .ArnNotLike
  | .ArnEquals => .ArnEquals
  | .ArnNotEquals => .ArnNotEquals
  | _ => .StringEquals

/-- Table characterization: projection onto the legacy numeric operator family. -/
def NumberOpProjection : conddata.Op → condfuncs.NumOp
  | .NumericNotEquals => .Ne
  | .NumericLessThan => .Lt
  | .NumericLessThanEquals => .Le
  | .NumericGreaterThan => .Gt
  | .NumericGreaterThanIfExists | .NumericGreaterThanEquals => .Ge
  | _ => .Eq

/-- Matching views preserve typed entries and expose date/binary key presence. -/
def MatchingViewContents (c : conddata.Condition) (d : condfuncs.Cond) : Prop :=
  match c.data, d with
  | .Str f, .Str op es => op = StringOpProjection c.op ∧
      es.val = f.entries.val.map (fun e => (e.key, e.values))
  | .Addr f, .Ip neg es => neg = decide (c.op = .NotIpAddress) ∧
      es.val = f.entries.val.map (fun e => (e.key, e.values))
  | .Boolean f, .Null es => c.op = .Null ∧
      es.val = f.entries.val.map (fun e => (e.key, e.values))
  | .Boolean f, .Bool es => c.op ≠ .Null ∧
      es.val = f.entries.val.map (fun e => (e.key, e.values))
  | .Num f, .Num op flag es => op = NumberOpProjection c.op ∧
      flag = decide (c.op = .NumericGreaterThanIfExists) ∧
      es.val = f.entries.val.map (fun e => (e.key, e.values))
  | .Date f, .Null es => es.val = f.entries.val.map (fun e => (e.key, false))
  | .Binary f, .Null es => es.val = f.entries.val.map (fun e => (e.key, false))
  | _, _ => False

def MatchingView (c : conddata.Condition) (v : condfuncs.Condition) : Prop :=
  (v.if_exists = true ↔ 0 < c.wrappers.val) ∧ MatchingViewContents c v.cond

/-- View sequences preserve length, order and each condition's typed contents. -/
def MatchingViews (cs : List conddata.Condition) (vs : List condfuncs.Condition) : Prop :=
  List.Forall₂ MatchingView cs vs
/-- The base key exposes IfExists when a wrapper is present. -/
def ConditionBaseKeyName (c : conddata.Condition) : List Nat :=
  if 0 < c.wrappers.val then lit "IfExists" else lit (OpSpelling c.op)

/-- Standard Base64 byte packing from four six-bit symbols. -/
def Base64Bytes (a b c d : BitVec 8) : List (BitVec 8) :=
  [(a <<< 2) ||| (b >>> 4), (b <<< 4) ||| (c >>> 2), (c <<< 6) ||| d]

/-- An unpadded sequence of complete three-byte/four-symbol blocks. -/
inductive Base64Blocks : List Nat → List (BitVec 8) → Prop
  | empty : Base64Blocks [] []
  | append {es ds : _} {x y z w : Nat} {a b c d : BitVec 8} :
      Base64Blocks es ds → Base64Symbol x a.toNat → Base64Symbol y b.toNat →
      Base64Symbol z c.toNat → Base64Symbol w d.toNat →
      Base64Blocks (es ++ [x, y, z, w]) (ds ++ Base64Bytes a b c d)

/-- Canonical padded Base64: complete blocks followed by at most one padded block. -/
inductive Base64Encoding : List Nat → List (BitVec 8) → Prop
  | complete {es ds : _} : Base64Blocks es ds → Base64Encoding es ds
  | one {es ds : _} {x y : Nat} {a b : BitVec 8} :
      Base64Blocks es ds → Base64Symbol x a.toNat → Base64Symbol y b.toNat →
      b &&& 15 = 0 → Base64Encoding (es ++ [x, y, 61, 61])
        (ds ++ [(a <<< 2) ||| (b >>> 4)])
  | two {es ds : _} {x y z : Nat} {a b c : BitVec 8} :
      Base64Blocks es ds → Base64Symbol x a.toNat → Base64Symbol y b.toNat →
      Base64Symbol z c.toNat → c &&& 3 = 0 →
      Base64Encoding (es ++ [x, y, z, 61])
        (ds ++ [(a <<< 2) ||| (b >>> 4), (b <<< 4) ||| (c >>> 2)])
/-- Each binary condition value is paired with its canonical encoded input. -/
def BinaryValueEncoding (e d : alloc.vec.Vec U8) : Prop :=
  Base64Encoding (nats e.val) (d.val.map (·.bv))

/-- A request value has a canonical Base64 decoding. -/
def ValidBinaryRequest (e : alloc.vec.Vec U8) : Prop :=
  ∃ ds, Base64Encoding (nats e.val) ds

/-- A request value decodes to one of the expected byte strings. -/
def MatchingBinaryRequest (f : conddata.BinaryFuncValue) (e : alloc.vec.Vec U8) : Prop :=
  ∃ d ∈ f.decoded.val, Base64Encoding (nats e.val) (d.val.map (·.bv))

/-- Each binary condition entry has named request data, all valid, including a match. -/
def BinaryEntrySatisfied
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (e : conddata.FuncKeyValue conddata.BinaryFuncValue) : Prop :=
  ∃ kv ∈ values.val, kv.1.val = LookupName e.key ∧
    (∀ req ∈ kv.2.val, ValidBinaryRequest req) ∧
    ∃ req ∈ kv.2.val, MatchingBinaryRequest e.values req
/-- Accepted binary conditions either use their missing-key wrapper or satisfy every entry. -/
def BinaryConditionSafe
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (c : conddata.Condition) : Prop :=
  match c.data with
  | .Binary f => (0 < c.wrappers.val ∧ ¬ RequestHasConditionKey c values) ∨
      ∀ e ∈ f.entries.val, BinaryEntrySatisfied values e
  | _ => True
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

import SpecOperators
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Operator keys, retaining their list order and repetitions. -/
def OperatorKeys : condfuncs.Cond → List condfuncs.Key
  | .Str _ f => f.val.map Prod.fst
  | .Ip _ f => f.val.map Prod.fst
  | .Null f => f.val.map Prod.fst
  | .Bool f => f.val.map Prod.fst
  | .Num _ _ f => f.val.map Prod.fst
/-- Presence depends on the key, including when its request value list is empty. -/
def OperatorKeyPresent (c : condfuncs.Cond)
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) : Prop :=
  ∃ key ∈ OperatorKeys c, ∃ entry ∈ values, entry.1 = LookupName key
/-- Resource selection examines the full condition key names in all three groups. -/
def OperatorReferences (c : condfuncs.Cond) (needle : List U8) : Prop :=
  ∃ key ∈ OperatorKeys c, key.key_name.val=needle
def FunctionsReference (f : condfuncs.Functions) (needle : List U8) : Prop :=
  ∃ c ∈ f.for_any_value.val ++ f.for_all_values.val ++ f.for_normal.val,
    OperatorReferences c.cond needle
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecDate.code:
import SpecOperators
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Decimal interpretation rejects every non-digit, including bytes outside ASCII. -/
def DecimalAcc : List Nat → Int → Option Int
  | [], n => some n
  | b::bs, n => if 48≤b ∧ b≤57 then DecimalAcc bs (10*n + (b: Int)-48) else none
def DateDigits (s : List Nat) (start count : Nat) : Option Int :=
  if start+count≤s.length then DecimalAcc ((s.drop start).take count) 0 else none
/-- Gregorian month lengths, with the century and four-century leap rules. -/
def MonthDays (year month : Int) : Int :=
  if month=2 then if year.tmod 4=0 ∧ (year.tmod 100≠0 ∨ year.tmod 400=0) then 29 else 28
  else if month∈[4,6,9,11] then 30 else 31
/-- Days from the Unix epoch, using proleptic Gregorian dates. -/
def CivilDays (year month day : Int) : Int :=
  let y := if month≤2 then year-1 else year
  let era := (if 0≤y then y else y-399).tdiv 400
  let yoe := y-era*400
  let m := if 2<month then month-3 else month+9
  era*146097 + yoe*365 + yoe.tdiv 4 - yoe.tdiv 100 +
    (153*m+2).tdiv 5 + day-1-719468
/-- UTC nanoseconds of an instant. -/
def InstantNanos (utc nano : Int) : Int := utc*1000000000+nano
/-- Calendar fields use Gregorian month lengths. -/
def DateCalendar (s : List Nat) : Option (Int × Int × Int) := do
  let y ← DateDigits s 0 4
  let m ← DateDigits s 5 2
  let d ← DateDigits s 8 2
  if 1≤m ∧ m≤12 ∧ 1≤d ∧ d≤MonthDays y m then some (y,m,d) else none
def DateTimeFields (s : List Nat) : Option (Int × Int × Int) := do
  let h ← DateDigits s 11 2
  let m ← DateDigits s 14 2
  let sec ← DateDigits s 17 2
  if h≤23 ∧ m≤59 ∧ sec≤60 then some (h,m,sec) else none
/-- Fractional digits beyond the ninth are consumed with zero weight. -/
def FractionAcc : List Nat → Int → Int → Int × Nat
  | [], n, _ => (n,0)
  | b::bs, n, weight =>
    if 48≤b ∧ b≤57 then
      let r := FractionAcc bs (n+((b:Int)-48)*weight) (weight.tdiv 10)
      (r.1,r.2+1)
    else (n,0)
def DateFraction (s : List Nat) : Option (Int × Nat) :=
  if s[19]?=some 46 then
    let r := FractionAcc (s.drop 20) 0 100000000
    if r.2=0 then none else some (r.1,20+r.2)
  else some (0,19)
def DateOffset (s : List Nat) (i : Nat) : Option Int := do
  let b ← s[i]?
  if b=90 ∨ b=122 then if i+1=s.length then some 0 else none
  else if i+6=s.length ∧ (b=43 ∨ b=45) ∧ s[i+3]?=some 58 then
    let h ← DateDigits s (i+1) 2
    let m ← DateDigits s (i+4) 2
    if h≤23 ∧ m≤59 then some (if b=45 then -(h*3600+m*60) else h*3600+m*60) else none
  else none
def LeapSecondValid (utc localDay year month day : Int) : Prop :=
  let rem := (utc.tmod 86400+86400).tmod 86400
  let utcDay := (utc-rem).tdiv 86400
  rem=86399 ∧ ((utcDay=localDay ∧ day=MonthDays year month) ∨
    (utcDay=localDay-1 ∧ day=1) ∨ (utcDay=localDay+1 ∧ day=MonthDays year month-1))
instance (utc localDay year month day : Int) : Decidable (LeapSecondValid utc localDay year month day) := by
  unfold LeapSecondValid
  infer_instance
/-- Date input checks separators at 4, 7, 13, and 16; position 10 is unrestricted.
The second 60 selects the last nanosecond of an accepted month-boundary second. -/
def ParseInstant (s : List Nat) : Option Int := do
  if s.length<20 ∨ s[4]?≠some 45 ∨ s[7]?≠some 45 ∨ s[13]?≠some 58 ∨ s[16]?≠some 58 then none
  else
    let (y,m,d) ← DateCalendar s
    let (h,min,sec) ← DateTimeFields s
    let (nano,i) ← DateFraction s
    let off ← DateOffset s i
    let day := CivilDays y m d
    let utc := day*86400+h*3600+min*60+(if sec=60 then 59 else sec)-off
    if sec=60 then
      if LeapSecondValid utc day y m d then some (InstantNanos utc 999999999) else none
    else some (InstantNanos utc nano)
/-- Every date entry compares its expected instant with the parsed first request
value. Missing, empty, and unparseable request values fail that entry. -/
def DateConditionsHold (entries : List (condfuncs.Key × Int)) (op : conddata.Op)
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ entries, ∃ text instant, FirstConditionValue values e.1=some text ∧
    ParseInstant (nats text)=some instant ∧ DateComparison op instant e.2
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

absorbs the remaining text, or every byte of the text agrees with the pattern. -/
def PatternPrefix (p t : List U8) : Prop :=
  ∃ k, k ≤ p.length ∧ k ≤ t.length ∧
    (∀ j < k, p[j]? = some (63#u8) ∨ p[j]? = t[j]?) ∧

import SpecStringPolicies
import SpecConditionKeys
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
def StringFlags : condfuncs.StrOp → Bool × Bool × Bool
  | .StringEquals | .ArnEquals => (false,false,false)
  | .StringNotEquals | .ArnNotEquals => (false,false,true)
  | .StringEqualsIgnoreCase => (true,false,false)
  | .StringNotEqualsIgnoreCase => (true,false,true)
  | .StringLike | .ArnLike => (false,true,false)
  | .StringNotLike | .ArnNotLike => (false,true,true)
/-- Operator meanings over request lists and numeric address prefixes. IP negation
complements the ordered address decision across all entries. -/
def OperatorHolds (ctx : Option AwsValueContext)
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8)))
    (ips : List (List U8 × Option condfuncs.IpAddr)) (q : condfuncs.Quantifier) :
    condfuncs.Cond → Prop
  | .Str op fs => ∀ e ∈ fs.val, StringEntryHolds ctx values e.1 (e.2.val.map (fun v => nats v.val))
      q (StringFlags op).1 (StringFlags op).2.1 (StringFlags op).2.2
  | .Ip neg fs => (if neg then !(AddressConditions ips values (fs.val.map (fun e => (e.1,e.2.val))))
      else AddressConditions ips values (fs.val.map (fun e => (e.1,e.2.val))))=true
  | .Null fs => NullConditions fs.val values
  | .Bool fs => BoolConditions fs.val values
  | .Num op ie fs => NumericConditions op ie values (fs.val.map (fun e => (e.1,e.2.val)))
/-- IfExists accepts immediately when none of the operator's keys is present.
When at least one key is present, the entire operator is evaluated. -/
def ConditionHolds (ctx : Option AwsValueContext)
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8)))
    (ips : List (List U8 × Option condfuncs.IpAddr)) (q : condfuncs.Quantifier)
    (c : condfuncs.Condition) : Prop :=
  (c.if_exists=true ∧ ¬OperatorKeyPresent c.cond values) ∨ OperatorHolds ctx values ips q c.cond
/-- All three condition groups must hold, with their respective value quantifiers. -/
def FunctionsHold (ctx : Option AwsValueContext)
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8)))
    (ips : List (List U8 × Option condfuncs.IpAddr)) (f : condfuncs.Functions) : Prop :=
  (∀ c ∈ f.for_any_value.val, ConditionHolds ctx values ips .ForAnyValue c) ∧
  (∀ c ∈ f.for_all_values.val, ConditionHolds ctx values ips .ForAllValues c) ∧
  (∀ c ∈ f.for_normal.val, ConditionHolds ctx values ips .None c)
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecIdentityStatement.code:
import SpecBucketStatement
import SpecKmsStatement
import SpecStatementContext
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Identity statements first require action coverage. A positive KMS action
selects KMS key scoping. Other actions require a resource entry unless a
positive Admin or STS action is present. STS skips resource matching; Admin
skips it except for requests naming a table-scoped Admin operation. -/
noncomputable def StatementReaches (ctx : Option AwsValueContext) (st : stmts.Statement) (args : stmts.Args) : Prop :=
  StatementActionCoverage (DenyEffect st.effect) st.actions.val st.not_actions.val args.action ∧
  ((∃ a ∈ st.actions.val, a.family=.Kms) ∧ KmsScopeHolds ctx st args ∨
   (¬∃ a ∈ st.actions.val, a.family=.Kms) ∧
    (st.resources.val≠[] ∨ st.not_resources.val≠[] ∨
      (∃ a ∈ st.actions.val, a.family=.Admin) ∨ (∃ a ∈ st.actions.val, a.family=.Sts)) ∧
    (SkipResourceMatch st.actions.val args.action ∨
      ((st.resources.val=[] ∨ ResourceSetHolds ctx (RequestValueLists args.conditions.val)
        (st.resources.val.map ResourceText) (StatementResource st.conditions args.action args.bucket.val args.object.val)) ∧
       (st.not_resources.val=[] ∨ ¬ResourceSetHolds ctx (RequestValueLists args.conditions.val)
        (st.not_resources.val.map ResourceText) (StatementResource st.conditions args.action args.bucket.val args.object.val)))))
/-- Identity Allow returns matching and condition satisfaction; Deny returns
their complement. The resolver's data is fixed by the request and environment. -/
noncomputable def StatementAllowed (st : stmts.Statement) (args : stmts.Args) (env : condfuncs.Env) : Prop :=
  EffectAllows st.effect (StatementReaches (some (PolicyContext args env)) st args ∧
    FunctionsHold (some (PolicyContext args env)) (RequestValueLists args.conditions.val)
      (env.ips.val.map (fun e=>(e.1.val,e.2))) st.conditions)

end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecKernel.code:
import Spec
/-!
# rustfs policy engine: specs for the ported kernel beyond evaluation

Reference definitions for the kernel modules added by the full port of
`crates/policy/src/policy/` (built-in policies, validation, condition data, ...).
-/
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std rustfs_kernel

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec

/-- The actions the built-in `readonly` policy names (`policy.rs` `DEFAULT_POLICIES`). -/
def readonlyNames : List (List Nat) :=
  [lit "s3:GetBucketLocation", lit "s3:GetObject", lit "s3:GetBucketQuota", lit "sts:AssumeRole"]

/-- The actions the built-in `writeonly` policy names (`policy.rs` `DEFAULT_POLICIES`). -/
def writeonlyNames : List (List Nat) :=
  [lit "s3:PutObject", lit "sts:AssumeRole"]

/-- The actions the built-in `diagnostics` policy names (`policy.rs` `DEFAULT_POLICIES`). -/
def diagnosticsNames : List (List Nat) :=
  [lit "admin:Profiling", lit "admin:ServerTrace", lit "admin:ConsoleLog", lit "admin:ServerInfo", lit "admin:TopLocksInfo", lit "admin:OBDInfo", lit "admin:Prometheus", lit "admin:BandwidthMonitor", lit "sts:AssumeRole"]

/-- The actions the built-in `KMSKeyAdministrator` policy names (`policy.rs` `DEFAULT_POLICIES`). -/
def kmsAdministratorNames : List (List Nat) :=
  [lit "kms:DescribeKey", lit "kms:ListKeys", lit "kms:EnableKey", lit "kms:DisableKey", lit "kms:RotateKey", lit "kms:DeleteKey", lit "sts:AssumeRole"]

/-- The actions the built-in `KMSKeyUser` policy names (`policy.rs` `DEFAULT_POLICIES`). -/
def kmsUserNames : List (List Nat) :=
  [lit "kms:GenerateDataKey", lit "kms:Decrypt", lit "kms:DescribeKey", lit "sts:AssumeRole"]

/-- The actions the built-in `KMSAuditor` policy names (`policy.rs` `DEFAULT_POLICIES`). -/
def kmsAuditorNames : List (List Nat) :=
  [lit "kms:DescribeKey", lit "kms:ListKeys", lit "sts:AssumeRole"]

/-- The built-in policies that name their actions exactly (no wildcard), each
with the actions it names. `readwrite` and `consoleAdmin` grant `s3:*`,
`admin:*` and `kms:*` and are not listed. -/
def builtinOnly : List (List Nat × List (List Nat)) :=
  [(lit "readonly", readonlyNames), (lit "writeonly", writeonlyNames), (lit "diagnostics", diagnosticsNames), (lit "KMSKeyAdministrator", kmsAdministratorNames), (lit "KMSKeyUser", kmsUserNames), (lit "KMSAuditor", kmsAuditorNames)]

/-! ## Validation (`valids`): `policy/{statement,resource,principal}.rs` `is_valid` -/

/-- A KMS resource pattern `Resource::is_valid` accepts: `*`, `key/<id>` with
no further `/`, or `alias/<name>`; neither may contain a backslash. -/
def kmsResourceOK (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p = lit "*" ∨
  (lit "key/" <+: p ∧ 4 < p.length ∧ 47 ∉ p.drop 4 ∧ 92 ∉ p) ∨
  (lit "alias/" <+: p ∧ 6 < p.length ∧ 92 ∉ p)

/-- `Resource::is_valid`: an S3 pattern is nonempty and does not start with
`/`; a KMS pattern is `kmsResourceOK`. -/
def resourceOK : rsrc.Resource → Prop
  | .S3 p => p.val ≠ [] ∧ (nats p.val).head? ≠ some 47
  | .Kms p => kmsResourceOK (nats p.val)

def isKmsResource : rsrc.Resource → Prop
  | .S3 _ => False
  | .Kms _ => True

/-- The actions all belong to family `f` (entries of no family aside), and at
least one does. -/
def UniformFamily (l : List acts.Action) (f : acts.Family) : Prop :=
  f ≠ .None ∧ (∃ a ∈ l, a.family = f) ∧ ∀ a ∈ l, a.family = f ∨ a.family = .None

/-- A statement selects exactly one action list; positive actions have one
family, empty resource selections require Admin/Sts/Kms actions, and KMS
resources require positive KMS actions. Every selected resource is valid. -/
def StatementOK (st : stmts.Statement) : Prop :=
  (st.actions.val ≠ [] ↔ st.not_actions.val = []) ∧
  (st.not_actions.val = [] → ∃ f, UniformFamily st.actions.val f) ∧
  (st.resources.val = [] → st.not_resources.val = [] →
    ∃ f, (f = .Admin ∨ f = .Sts ∨ f = .Kms) ∧ UniformFamily st.actions.val f ∧ st.not_actions.val = []) ∧
  (st.resources.val = [] ∨ st.not_resources.val = []) ∧
  ((∃ r ∈ st.resources.val ++ st.not_resources.val, isKmsResource r) →
    UniformFamily st.actions.val .Kms ∧ st.not_actions.val = []) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ st.resources.val ++ st.not_resources.val, resourceOK r)

/-- What `BPStatement::is_valid` accepts. -/
def BPStatementOK (st : stmts.BPStatement) : Prop :=
  (st.principal.aws.val ≠ [] ∨ st.principal.service.val ≠ []) ∧
  (st.actions.val ≠ [] ↔ st.not_actions.val = []) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ st.actions.val ++ st.not_actions.val, a.family ≠ .Kms) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ st.resources.val ++ st.not_resources.val, ¬ isKmsResource r) ∧
  (st.resources.val ≠ [] ↔ st.not_resources.val = []) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ st.resources.val ++ st.not_resources.val, resourceOK r)

/-- Positive action matching combines wildcard names with the explicit-grant
requirement for the two force-delete actions. -/
def ActionGrantMatches (pattern requested : acts.Action) : Prop :=
  globSpec (nats pattern.name.val) (nats requested.name.val) = true ∧
  ¬ (pattern.family = .S3 ∧ nats pattern.name.val = lit "s3:*" ∧ IsForceDelete requested)

/-- A set grants an action through a matching entry or the version-read
compatibility rule. -/
def ActionSetGrantMatches (entries : List acts.Action) (requested : acts.Action) : Prop :=
  ∃ pattern ∈ entries, ActionGrantMatches pattern requested ∨
    (pattern.family = .S3 ∧ nats pattern.name.val = lit "s3:GetObjectVersion" ∧
     requested.family = .S3 ∧ nats requested.name.val = lit "s3:GetObject")

end rustfs_kernel.Spec

/-- Backup and restore with an explicit resource set select the Deny effect.
Other KMS requests accept empty filtered sets or an empty object; otherwise
only KMS-tagged patterns are tested against key/ followed by the object. -/
noncomputable def KmsScopeHolds (ctx : Option AwsValueContext) (st : stmts.Statement) (args : stmts.Args) : Prop := by
  classical
  exact if args.action.family=.Kms ∧ nats args.action.name.val ∈ [lit "kms:Backup",lit "kms:Restore"] ∧
      (st.resources.val≠[] ∨ st.not_resources.val≠[]) then st.effect=.Deny
  else (KmsResources st.resources.val=[] ∧ KmsResources st.not_resources.val=[]) ∨ args.object.val=[] ∨
    ((KmsResources st.resources.val=[] ∨ ResourceSetHolds ctx (RequestValueLists args.conditions.val)
      ((KmsResources st.resources.val).map ResourceText) (lit "key/" ++ nats args.object.val)) ∧
      ¬ResourceSetHolds ctx (RequestValueLists args.conditions.val)
        ((KmsResources st.not_resources.val).map ResourceText) (lit "key/" ++ nats args.object.val))
end rustfs_kernel.Spec
