import SpecCondData

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Validation depends on action/resource fields, independently of metadata and conditions. -/
def MetadataStatementOK (st : manage.Statement) : Prop :=
  StatementOK { effect := st.effect, actions := st.actions, not_actions := st.not_actions, resources := st.resources, not_resources := st.not_resources, conditions := {for_any_value := alloc.vec.Vec.new _, for_all_values := alloc.vec.Vec.new _, for_normal := alloc.vec.Vec.new _} }
def MetadataBPStatementOK (st : manage.BPStatement) : Prop :=
  BPStatementOK { effect := st.effect, principal := st.principal, actions := st.actions, not_actions := st.not_actions, resources := st.resources, not_resources := st.not_resources, conditions := {for_any_value := alloc.vec.Vec.new _, for_all_values := alloc.vec.Vec.new _, for_normal := alloc.vec.Vec.new _} }
def MetadataPolicyOK (p : manage.Policy) : Prop :=
  (p.version.val = [] ∨ nats p.version.val = lit "2012-10-17") ∧
  ∀ st ∈ p.statements.val, MetadataStatementOK st
def MetadataBucketPolicyOK (p : manage.BucketPolicy) : Prop :=
  (p.version.val = [] ∨ nats p.version.val = lit "2012-10-17") ∧
  ∀ st ∈ p.statements.val, MetadataBPStatementOK st
/-- SID-independent equality of the semantic statement fields. -/
def MetadataStatementEquivalent (a b : manage.Statement) : Prop :=
  a.effect = b.effect ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ a.actions.val ↔ x ∈ b.actions.val) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ a.not_actions.val ↔ x ∈ b.not_actions.val) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ a.resources.val ↔ x ∈ b.resources.val) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ a.not_resources.val ↔ x ∈ b.not_resources.val) ∧
  ConditionGroupsMatch a.conditions b.conditions
/-- An entry explicitly names the existing-object-tag request key. -/
def InnerUsesExistingTag {T : Type} (f : conddata.InnerFunc T) : Prop :=
  ∃ e ∈ f.entries.val, nats e.key.key_name.val = lit "s3:ExistingObjectTag"
def ConditionUsesExistingTag (c : conddata.Condition) : Prop :=
  match c.data with
  | .Str f => InnerUsesExistingTag f
  | .Addr f => InnerUsesExistingTag f
  | .Boolean f => InnerUsesExistingTag f
  | .Num f => InnerUsesExistingTag f
  | .Date f => InnerUsesExistingTag f
  | .Binary f => InnerUsesExistingTag f
/-- A tag-reading condition survives later replacement by the same operator spelling. -/
def ActiveTagConditions (cs : List conddata.Condition) : Prop :=
  ∃ i, ∃ hi : i < cs.length, ConditionUsesExistingTag cs[i] ∧
    ∀ j, i < j → ∀ hj : j < cs.length, ConditionKeyName cs[i] ≠ ConditionKeyName cs[j]
def FunctionsUseExistingTag (f : conddata.Functions) : Prop :=
  ActiveTagConditions f.for_all_values.val ∨ ActiveTagConditions f.for_any_value.val ∨
    ActiveTagConditions f.for_normal.val

/-- Retain unmarked positions in their original order, including their statement IDs. -/
def RetainStatements (ss : List manage.Statement) (removed : List Nat) : List manage.Statement :=
  ((ss.zipIdx).filter (fun e => !decide (e.2 ∈ removed))).map Prod.fst
/-- A later position has the same semantic fields as an earlier statement. -/
def DuplicatePair (ss : List manage.Statement) (j k : Usize) : Prop :=
  j.val < k.val ∧ ∃ hj : j.val < ss.length, ∃ hk : k.val < ss.length,
    MetadataStatementEquivalent ss[j.val] ss[k.val]
/-- Marks have an earlier, unmarked representative among the processed positions. -/
def MarkedThrough (ss : List manage.Statement) (limit : Nat) (ds : List Usize) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, k ∈ ds ↔ ∃ j, j.val < limit ∧ j ∉ ds ∧ DuplicatePair ss j k
/-- Ordered selection with an earlier retained representative for exactly the removed positions. -/
def DeduplicatedStatements (ss out : List manage.Statement) : Prop :=
  ∃ ds : List Usize, MarkedThrough ss ss.length ds ∧
    out = RetainStatements ss (ds.map (fun k => k.val))
/-- The version of the first policy that supplies one, or empty when none does. -/
def FirstPolicyVersion : List manage.Policy → List U8
  | [] => []
  | p :: ps => if p.version.val = [] then FirstPolicyVersion ps else p.version.val
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecOperators.code:
import SpecKeyTables
import SpecCondData
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std rustfs_kernel
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Numeric comparisons use the mathematical signed integer values. -/
def NumericComparison : condfuncs.NumOp → Int → Int → Prop
  | .Eq, a, b => a = b
  | .Ne, a, b => a ≠ b
  | .Lt, a, b => a < b
  | .Le, a, b => a ≤ b
  | .Gt, a, b => b < a
  | .Ge, a, b => b ≤ a
/-- Null tests value-list emptiness, including a missing key as an empty list. -/
def NullComparison (wantNull : Bool) (count : Nat) : Prop :=
  if wantNull then count = 0 else count ≠ 0
/-- CIDR membership compares the numeric prefix of addresses in the same family.
Prefixes at least the address width compare the whole address. -/
def NumericPrefix (width pref network address : Nat) : Prop :=
  network / 2 ^ (width - min pref width) = address / 2 ^ (width - min pref width)
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Ordered request lookup selects the first entry with this exact byte name. -/
def ConditionValues (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) (needle : List U8) :
    Option (List (List U8)) :=
  ((values.find? (fun e => decide (e.1 = needle))).map Prod.snd)

def RequestValueLists
    (values : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))) :
    List (List U8 × List (List U8)) :=
  values.map (fun e => (e.1.val, e.2.val.map (·.val)))

def FirstConditionValue (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) (key : condfuncs.Key) :
    Option (List U8) :=
  (ConditionValues values (LookupName key)).bind List.head?

def NullConditions (funcs : List (condfuncs.Key × Bool))
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ funcs, NullComparison e.2 ((ConditionValues values (LookupName e.1)).getD []).length
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Bool requires the first request value to spell exactly `true` or `false`. -/
def BoolConditions (funcs : List (condfuncs.Key × Bool))
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ funcs, (FirstConditionValue values e.1).map nats =
    some (if e.2 then lit "true" else lit "false")

/-- Numeric evaluation is ordered. A missing first value terminates evaluation
with `ifExists`, even when later entries are present. Malformed decimal text
or a failed comparison terminates with false. -/
def NumericConditions (op : condfuncs.NumOp) (ifExists : Bool)
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) : List (condfuncs.Key × Int) → Prop
  | [] => True
  | (key, bound) :: rest =>
    match FirstConditionValue values key with
    | none => ifExists = true
    | some text => ∃ number, parseI64Spec (nats text) = some number ∧
        NumericComparison op number bound ∧ NumericConditions op ifExists values rest

/-- CIDR membership requires an address of the same family. -/
def IpPrefix : condfuncs.IpAddr → Nat → condfuncs.IpAddr → Prop
  | .V4 network, pref, .V4 address => NumericPrefix 32 pref network.val address.val
  | .V6 network, pref, .V6 address => NumericPrefix 128 pref network.val address.val
  | _, _, _ => False
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- A request byte string matches at least one glob candidate. -/
def AnyStringLike (patterns : List (List U8)) (value : List U8) : Prop :=
  ∃ p ∈ patterns, globSpec (nats p) (nats value) = true
/-- Quantified string matching negates each match before taking the requested
quantifier. The unquantified case ignores the inner negation flag; its caller
applies negation to the aggregate match. -/
def StringMatchHolds (q : condfuncs.Quantifier) (negate matched : Bool) : Bool :=
  match q with
  | .None => matched
  | _ => matched != negate
/-- One quantified value decides universal failure or existential success. -/
def LikeStep (q : condfuncs.Quantifier) (negate matched : Bool) : Option Bool :=
  match q with
  | .ForAllValues => if StringMatchHolds q negate matched then none else some false
  | _ => if StringMatchHolds q negate matched then some true else none
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Date comparisons operate on UTC instants in nanoseconds. Other operators
have no date interpretation and return false. -/
def DateComparison : conddata.Op → Int → Int → Prop
  | .DateEquals, a, b => a = b
  | .DateNotEquals, a, b => a ≠ b
  | .DateLessThan, a, b => a < b
  | .DateLessThanEquals, a, b => a ≤ b
  | .DateGreaterThan, a, b => b < a
  | .DateGreaterThanEquals, a, b => b ≤ a
  | _, _, _ => False
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Address parsing is supplied by the environment's ordered text/address table.
The first exact-name entry wins, including an explicit parse failure. -/
def ParsedAddress (table : List (List U8 × Option condfuncs.IpAddr)) (text : List U8) :
    Option condfuncs.IpAddr :=
  (table.find? (fun e => decide (e.1 = text))).bind Prod.snd
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- A network list denotes the union of its same-family numeric prefixes. -/
def AnyNetwork (networks : List (condfuncs.IpAddr × U8)) (address : condfuncs.IpAddr) : Prop :=
  ∃ entry ∈ networks, IpPrefix entry.1 entry.2.val address
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Per-value negation applies only to explicit quantifiers. -/
def LikeValue (q : condfuncs.Quantifier) (negate : Bool)
    (patterns : List (List U8)) (value : List U8) : Prop :=
  match q with
  | .None => AnyStringLike patterns value
  | _ => if negate then ¬ AnyStringLike patterns value else AnyStringLike patterns value
/-- Universal matching accepts an empty request list; the other forms require
at least one matching request value. -/
def QuantifiedLike (q : condfuncs.Quantifier) (negate : Bool)
    (patterns requests : List (List U8)) : Prop :=
  match q with
  | .ForAllValues => ∀ value ∈ requests, LikeValue q negate patterns value
  | _ => ∃ value ∈ requests, LikeValue q negate patterns value
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
/-- Ordered address evaluation stops at the first invalid address or matching
numeric prefix. Valid addresses outside all prefixes leave evaluation pending. -/
noncomputable def AddressDecision (table : List (List U8 × Option condfuncs.IpAddr))
    (networks : List (condfuncs.IpAddr × U8)) : List (List U8) → Option Bool
  | [] => none
  | text :: rest =>
    match ParsedAddress table text with
    | none => some false
    | some ip => if AnyNetwork networks ip then some true else AddressDecision table networks rest
/-- Keys are considered in order. The first key with an invalid address or a
matching prefix decides the result; absent and empty keys do not decide. -/
noncomputable def AddressConditions (table : List (List U8 × Option condfuncs.IpAddr))
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) :
    List (condfuncs.Key × List (condfuncs.IpAddr × U8)) → Bool
  | [] => false
  | (key,networks) :: rest =>
    match AddressDecision table networks ((ConditionValues values (LookupName key)).getD []) with
    | some b => b
    | none => AddressConditions table values rest

end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Equality uses ASCII case conversion when requested. With no quantifier,
negation is applied by the outer string operator, rather than per value. -/
def EqualityValue (q : condfuncs.Quantifier) (ignoreCase negate : Bool)
    (candidates : List (List Nat)) (text : List Nat) : Bool :=
  let hit := decide ((if ignoreCase then text.map asciiLower else text) ∈ candidates)
  match q with | .None => hit | _ => hit ^^ negate

def EqualityDecision (q : condfuncs.Quantifier) (ignoreCase negate : Bool)
    (candidates : List (List Nat)) (requests : List (List Nat)) : Bool :=
  match q with
  | .ForAllValues => requests.all (EqualityValue q ignoreCase negate candidates)
  | _ => requests.any (EqualityValue q ignoreCase negate candidates)
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

SpecPath.code:
import SpecKernel

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Search backward to the nearest slash, stopping at the barrier lower bound. -/
def PreviousSlash (text : List Nat) (floor : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => if n+1 ≤ floor ∨ text[n+1]?=some 47 then n+1 else PreviousSlash text floor n
/-- Parent traversal preserves the barrier prefix of relative parent components. -/
def ParentPath (root : Bool) (barrier : Nat) (out : List Nat) : List Nat × Nat :=
  if out.length > barrier then (out.take (PreviousSlash out barrier (out.length-1)),barrier)
  else if root then (out,barrier)
  else let extended := out ++ (if out=[] then [] else [47]) ++ [46,46]
       (extended,extended.length)
/-- Normalize remaining path components, retaining bytes within ordinary components. -/
def NormalizeTail (root : Bool) (barrier : Nat) (out : List Nat) : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => out
  | 47::rest => NormalizeTail root barrier out rest
  | [46] => out
  | 46::47::rest => NormalizeTail root barrier out (47::rest)
  | [46,46] => (ParentPath root barrier out).1
  | 46::46::47::rest =>
    let parent := ParentPath root barrier out
    NormalizeTail root parent.2 parent.1 (47::rest)
  | c::rest => NormalizeTail root barrier
      (out ++ (if out.length=(if root then 1 else 0) then [] else [47]) ++
        (c::rest.takeWhile (fun x => x != 47)))
      (rest.dropWhile (fun x => x != 47))
termination_by input => input.length
decreasing_by
  all_goals simp_wf
  all_goals first | omega | exact List.length_dropWhile_le _ _
/-- Absolute paths retain their leading slash; an empty normalized path is a dot. -/
def NormalizedPath (path : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  let root := decide (path.head?=some 47)
  let out := NormalizeTail root (if root then 1 else 0) (if root then [47] else [])
    (if root then path.drop 1 else path)
  out
/-- The empty normalized path is represented by a single dot byte. -/
def CleanPath (path : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  let out := NormalizedPath path
  if out=[] then [46] else out
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

import SpecPath
import SpecStringPolicies
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Resource patterns visit every common key in table order when values are present. -/
def ResourcePattern (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) (pattern : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  if values=[] then pattern else nats (SubstituteCommon (BytesOfNats pattern) values)
/-- Both resource tags compare their stored pattern with the whole normalized name.
A normalized single dot is rejected. Literal equality is accepted before glob matching. -/
def ResourcePatternHolds (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8)))
    (pattern requested : List Nat) : Prop :=
  let cp := CleanPath requested
  let resolved := ResourcePattern values pattern
  cp≠[46] ∧ (cp=resolved ∨ globSpec resolved cp=true)
/-- Context expansion supplies alternatives before common-key substitution. -/
def ResourceHolds (ctx : Option AwsValueContext) (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8)))
    (pattern requested : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ alternative ∈ ResolvedPolicy ctx pattern, ResourcePatternHolds values alternative requested
/-- A resource set matches exactly when one stored pattern matches. -/
def ResourceSetHolds (ctx : Option AwsValueContext) (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8)))
    (patterns : List (List Nat)) (requested : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ pattern ∈ patterns, ResourceHolds ctx values pattern requested
/-- The S3 and KMS tags retain the same stored byte-pattern representation. -/
def ResourceText : rsrc.Resource → List Nat
  | .S3 text => nats text.val
  | .Kms text => nats text.val
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

import SpecKernel

/-- Deny uses ordinary glob matching; Allow applies the explicit force-delete rule. -/
def EffectActionMatches (deny : Bool) (pattern requested : acts.Action) : Prop :=
  if deny then globSpec (nats pattern.name.val) (nats requested.name.val) = true
  else ActionGrantMatches pattern requested
/-- Version-read compatibility applies for both effects. -/
def EffectActionSetMatches (deny : Bool) (entries : List acts.Action) (requested : acts.Action) : Prop :=
  ∃ pattern ∈ entries, EffectActionMatches deny pattern requested ∨
    (pattern.family = .S3 ∧ nats pattern.name.val = lit "s3:GetObjectVersion" ∧
     requested.family = .S3 ∧ nats requested.name.val = lit "s3:GetObject")
/-- NotAction exclusion uses Deny matching. With an empty positive set,
Allow still requires an explicit force-delete grant. -/
def StatementActionCoverage (deny : Bool) (actions excluded : List acts.Action)
    (requested : acts.Action) : Prop :=
  ¬ EffectActionSetMatches true excluded requested ∧
    (if actions = [] then deny = true ∨ ¬ IsForceDelete requested
     else EffectActionSetMatches deny actions requested)
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- These three S3 listing actions can select the bucket-only resource. -/
def ListBucketAction (a : acts.Action) : Prop :=
  a.family = .S3 ∧ nats a.name.val ∈
    [lit "s3:ListBucket",lit "s3:ListBucketVersions",lit "s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads"]
/-- The request resource always separates bucket and object with one slash at
this boundary. Existing slashes in the object are retained. Bucket-only
listing and empty objects produce a trailing slash. -/
noncomputable def RequestResource (a : acts.Action) (bucket object : List U8)
    (bucketOnly : Bool) : List U8 := by
  classical
  exact if (ListBucketAction a ∧ bucketOnly=true) ∨ object=[] then bucket++[47#u8]
    else bucket ++ (if object.head?=some 47#u8 then [] else [47#u8]) ++ object

namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Principal wildcard matching. At the end of the input, a question mark
succeeds immediately, including when more pattern bytes follow it. -/
def simpleGlobSpec : List Nat → List Nat → Bool
  | [], n => n = []
  | 42 :: p, n => simpleGlobSpec p n || match n with
    | [] => false
    | _ :: n' => simpleGlobSpec (42 :: p) n'
  | 63 :: p, n => match n with
    | [] => true
    | _ :: n' => simpleGlobSpec p n'
  | c :: p, n => match n with
    | [] => false
    | x :: n' => c = x && simpleGlobSpec p n'
termination_by p n => p.length + n.length
end rustfs_kernel.Spec
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- AWS and service principal patterns share the same account-name matcher. -/
def PrincipalMatches (aws service : List (List Nat)) (account : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ pattern ∈ aws ++ service, simpleGlobSpec pattern account = true

import SpecCommonSubstitution
import SpecAwsResolution
import SpecOperators
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Resolve context variables before common-key substitution. Without a context,
the policy text supplies its sole alternative. -/
def ResolvedPolicy (ctx : Option AwsValueContext) (text : List Nat) : List (List Nat) :=
  match ctx with | none => [text] | some c => ExpandVariables c 0 text
/-- String candidates use the first eligible common-key replacement and then
ASCII lowercase conversion when requested. Alternative order is retained. -/
def PolicyValueTransform (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8)))
    (ignoreCase : Bool) (text : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  let replaced := nats (SubstituteFirstCommon (BytesOfNats text) values)
  if ignoreCase then replaced.map asciiLower else replaced

def PolicyCandidates (ctx : Option AwsValueContext) (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8)))
    (ignoreCase : Bool) (policy : List (List Nat)) : List (List Nat) :=
  (policy.flatMap (ResolvedPolicy ctx)).map (PolicyValueTransform values ignoreCase)
/-- Missing request keys supply an empty value list. Universal matching accepts
that list; existential matching rejects it. -/
def StringEqualityEval (ctx : Option AwsValueContext)
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) (key : condfuncs.Key)
    (policy : List (List Nat)) (q : condfuncs.Quantifier) (ignoreCase negate : Bool) : Bool :=
  EqualityDecision q ignoreCase negate (PolicyCandidates ctx values ignoreCase policy)
    (((ConditionValues values (LookupName key)).getD []).map nats)
def StringLikeEval (ctx : Option AwsValueContext)
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) (key : condfuncs.Key)
    (policy : List (List Nat)) (q : condfuncs.Quantifier) (negate : Bool) : Prop :=
  QuantifiedLike q negate ((PolicyCandidates ctx values false policy).map BytesOfNats)
    ((ConditionValues values (LookupName key)).getD [])
/-- Unquantified negation complements the whole existential result. Quantified
negation applies within each request-value comparison. -/
def StringEntryHolds (ctx : Option AwsValueContext)
    (values : List (List U8 × List (List U8))) (key : condfuncs.Key)
    (policy : List (List Nat)) (q : condfuncs.Quantifier) (ignoreCase like negate : Bool) : Prop :=
  let innerNeg := match q with | .None => false | _ => negate
  let matched := if like then StringLikeEval ctx values key policy q innerNeg
    else StringEqualityEval ctx values key policy q ignoreCase innerNeg=true
  match q with | .None => if negate then ¬matched else matched | _ => matched
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

import SpecKernel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace rustfs_kernel.Spec
/-- Left-to-right non-overlapping literal replacement. An empty search string
leaves the input unchanged. Replacement bytes are not searched again. -/
def ReplaceSuffix (s search replacement : List U8) (offset : Nat) : List U8 :=
  if hi : offset < s.length then
    if hp : 0 < search.length ∧ search <+: s.drop offset then
      replacement ++ ReplaceSuffix s search replacement (offset+search.length)
    else s[offset] :: ReplaceSuffix s search replacement (offset+1)
  else []
termination_by s.length-offset

def ReplaceBytes (s search replacement : List U8) : List U8 :=
  ReplaceSuffix s search replacement 0
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

/-- Scalar encoding expressed as numeric UTF-8 octets. The branches also
specify the arithmetic behavior for inputs outside the Unicode scalar range. -/
def EncodeScalar (cp : Nat) : List Nat :=
  if cp < 128 then [cp % 256]
  else if cp < 2048 then
    [(192 ||| (cp >>> 6)) % 256, (128 ||| (cp &&& 63)) % 256]
  else if cp < 65536 then
    [(224 ||| (cp >>> 12)) % 256, (128 ||| ((cp >>> 6) &&& 63)) % 256,
     (128 ||| (cp &&& 63)) % 256]
  else
    [(240 ||| (cp >>> 18)) % 256, (128 ||| ((cp >>> 12) &&& 63)) % 256,
     (128 ||| ((cp >>> 6) &&& 63)) % 256, (128 ||| (cp &&& 63)) % 256]
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

/-- Numeric decoding at a byte offset, with unavailable input represented by
zero. Successful extracted calls establish that all consumed bytes exist. -/
def DecodeScalar (bytes : List Nat) (offset : Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  let a := (bytes[offset]?).getD 0
  let b := ((bytes[offset+1]?).getD 0) &&& 63
  let c := ((bytes[offset+2]?).getD 0) &&& 63
  let d := ((bytes[offset+3]?).getD 0) &&& 63
  if a < 128 then (a,offset+1)
  else if a < 224 then (((a &&& 31) <<< 6) ||| b,offset+2)
  else if a < 240 then (((a &&& 15) <<< 12) ||| (b <<< 6) ||| c,offset+3)
  else (((a &&& 7) <<< 18) ||| (b <<< 12) ||| (c <<< 6) ||| d,offset+4)
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

/-- Every decoded unit consumes one to four octets. -/
theorem decodeScalar_advances (bytes : List Nat) (offset : Nat) :

  dsimp only
  split_ifs <;> simp only [Prod.snd] <;> omega

def LowerScalarBytes (cp : Nat) : List Nat :=
  let image := LowercaseScalar cp
  EncodeScalar image.1 ++ if image.2.2 = 2 then EncodeScalar image.2.1 else []

The byte offset advances according to the numeric UTF-8 decoder. -/
def LowerSuffix (bytes : List Nat) (offset : Nat) : List Nat :=
  if h : offset < bytes.length then
    let unit := DecodeScalar bytes offset
    LowerScalarBytes unit.1 ++ LowerSuffix bytes unit.2
  else []
termination_by bytes.length - offset
decreasing_by
  have := decodeScalar_advances bytes offset
  omega

    (offset,unit.1,unit.2) :: ScalarSpans bytes unit.2
  else []

including whitespace, are retained byte for byte. An all-whitespace input
retains the empty byte list. -/

  let retained := (ScalarSpans bytes 0).filter (fun span => span.2.1 ∉ UnicodeWhitespace)
  match retained.head?, retained.getLast? with
  | some first, some last => (bytes.take last.2.2).drop first.1
  | _, _ => []

def ExtendBounds (limit : Nat) (bounds : Nat × Nat) (span : ScalarSpan) : Nat × Nat :=
  (if bounds.1 = limit then span.1 else bounds.1, span.2.2)

def SpanBounds (limit : Nat) (bounds : Nat × Nat) (spans : List ScalarSpan) : Nat × Nat :=
  (spans.filter (fun span => span.2.1 ∉ UnicodeWhitespace)).foldl (ExtendBounds limit) bounds

theorem bounds_fold (limit first last : Nat) (spans : List ScalarSpan)
    (h : ∀ span ∈ spans, span.1 < limit) :
    spans.foldl (ExtendBounds limit) (first,last) =
      match spans.head?,spans.getLast? with
      | some a,some b => (if first=limit then a.1 else first,b.2.2)
      | _,_ => (first,last) := by
  induction spans generalizing first last with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a spans ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih _ _ (by intro s hs; exact h s (by simp [hs]))]
    have ha : a.1 < limit := h a (by simp)
    cases spans with
    | nil => simp [ExtendBounds]
    | cons b rest =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, List.getLast?_cons, ExtendBounds]
      by_cases hf : first = limit
      · simp [hf, show a.1 ≠ limit by omega]
      · simp [hf]

theorem spans_start_lt (bytes : List Nat) (offset : Nat) :
    ∀ span ∈ ScalarSpans bytes offset, span.1 < bytes.length := by
  rw [ScalarSpans]
  split
  · rename_i h
    intro span hs
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at hs
    rcases hs with rfl | hs
    · exact h
    · exact spans_start_lt bytes _ span hs
  · simp
termination_by bytes.length - offset
decreasing_by
  have := decodeScalar_advances bytes offset
  omega

theorem spanBounds_cons (limit : Nat) (bounds : Nat × Nat) (span : ScalarSpan)
    (rest : List ScalarSpan) :
    SpanBounds limit bounds (span :: rest) =
      if span.2.1 ∈ UnicodeWhitespace then SpanBounds limit bounds rest
      else SpanBounds limit (ExtendBounds limit bounds span) rest := by
  by_cases h : span.2.1 ∈ UnicodeWhitespace
  · simp [SpanBounds,h]
  · simp [SpanBounds,h]

    unfold actsets.member_loop.body at hr
    simp only [action_eq_law, bind_ok] at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok ha1
      exact .inl ⟨hlt, by rw [he]; simpa using hc_1, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok ha1
      refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩

      simpa [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults.lit_GOV, rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults.lit_GO] using rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.lift_slice hs1
    rw [hl] at h1; rw [hr] at h2
    exact .inl ⟨hlt, by rw [he]; exact .inr ⟨(h1.1 hc_2).1, (h1.1 hc_2).2,

    have h2 := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.is_s3_ok _ _ _ hb2

      simpa [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults.lit_GOV, rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults.lit_GO] using rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.lift_slice hs1
    rw [hl] at h2

theorem effect_eq_allow (eff : stmts.Effect) (b : Bool)

    eff = .Allow := by

theorem mem_of_index_usize {α : Type} (sl : Slice α) (i : Usize) (x : α)

  unfold Slice.index_usize at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · simp only [ok.injEq] at h
    subst h
    rename_i heq
    exact List.mem_of_getElem? heq

theorem usize_add_one (x i2 : Usize) (h : x + 1#usize = ok i2) : i2.val = x.val + 1 := by
  have heq := UScalar.add_equiv x 1#usize
  rw [h] at heq
  exact heq.2.1

theorem some_allow_step_done (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (x : Usize) (y : Bool)
    (hr : policies.some_allow_loop.body sts a e x = ok (.done y)) :
    y = true → ∃ st ∈ sts.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧ stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true := by
  unfold policies.some_allow_loop.body at hr
  dsimp only at hr
  split at hr
  · rename_i h_lt
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
    split at hr
    · rename_i hb_true
      obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
      split at hr
      · rename_i hb1_true
        simp only [ok.injEq, ControlFlow.done.injEq] at hr; subst hr
        intro _

        rw [hb1_true] at hb1

        simp only [ok.injEq] at hr; cases hr
    · obtain ⟨i2, _, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
      simp only [ok.injEq] at hr; cases hr
  · simp only [ok.injEq, ControlFlow.done.injEq] at hr; subst hr
    intro h; contradiction

theorem some_allow_step_cont (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (x x' : Usize)
    (hr : policies.some_allow_loop.body sts a e x = ok (.cont x')) :
    x'.val ≤ sts.val.length ∧ sts.val.length - x'.val < sts.val.length - x.val := by
  unfold policies.some_allow_loop.body at hr
  dsimp only at hr
  split at hr
  · rename_i h_lt
    have : x.val < sts.val.length := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
    split at hr
    · rename_i hb_true
      obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
      split at hr
      · rename_i hb1_true
        simp only [ok.injEq] at hr; cases hr
      · obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
        simp only [ok.injEq, ControlFlow.cont.injEq] at hr; subst hr
        have hi2_val := usize_add_one x i2 hi2
        omega
    · obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
      simp only [ok.injEq, ControlFlow.cont.injEq] at hr; subst hr
      have hi2_val := usize_add_one x i2 hi2
      omega
  · simp only [ok.injEq] at hr; cases hr

theorem allow_needs_allow_statement (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (h : policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e = ok true) (ho : a.is_owner = false) (hd : a.deny_only = false) :
    ∃ st ∈ sts.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧ stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true := by
  unfold policies.policy_is_allowed at h
  obtain ⟨b, _, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  split at h
  · simp only [hd, ho, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h
    unfold policies.some_allow policies.some_allow_loop at h
    refine (loop_ok
      (fun i1 => policies.some_allow_loop.body sts a e i1)
      (fun i => i.val ≤ sts.val.length)
      (fun y => y = true → ∃ st ∈ sts.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧ stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true)
      (fun i => sts.val.length - i.val)
      ?_
      0#usize
      true
      (by simp)
      h) rfl
    intro x r _ hr
    cases r with
    | done y => exact some_allow_step_done sts a e x y hr
    | cont x' => exact some_allow_step_cont sts a e x x' hr
  · simp only [ok.injEq] at h; contradiction

theorem closing_zero (s : List Nat) (pos : Nat) : ClosingAt s pos 0 = (pos,0) := by
  cases h : s.drop pos <;> simp [ClosingAt,h,ClosingTail]
theorem closing_past (s : List Nat) (pos b : Nat) (h : s.length ≤ pos) :
    ClosingAt s pos b = (pos,b) := by
  by_cases hb : b=0 <;> simp [ClosingAt,List.drop_of_length_le h,ClosingTail,hb]
theorem closing_step (s : List Nat) (pos b x : Nat) (hp : pos < s.length)
    (hx : s[pos]=x) (hb : b≠0) :
    ClosingAt s pos b =
      let next := if x=123 then b+1 else if x=125 then b-1 else b
      if next=0 then (pos,0) else ClosingAt s (pos+1) next := by
  unfold ClosingAt
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hp,hx]
  by_cases h123 : x=123 <;> by_cases h125 : x=125
  all_goals simp_all [ClosingTail,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_left_comm,Nat.add_assoc]
  split <;> simp_all [Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_left_comm,Nat.add_assoc]

theorem closing_ok (s : Slice U8) (start : Usize) (out : Usize × Usize)
    (h : awsvars.closing s start = ok out) :
    (out.1.val,out.2.val) = ClosingAt (nats s.val) start.val 1 := by
  unfold awsvars.closing awsvars.closing_loop at h
  let target := ClosingAt (nats s.val) start.val 1
  change (out.1.val,out.2.val)=target
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : Usize × Usize => ClosingAt (nats s.val) x.2.val x.1.val=target)
    (fun out => (out.1.val,out.2.val)=target)
    (fun x => (s.val.length-x.2.val)*2 + if x.1.val=0 then 0 else 1)
    ?_ _ out (by rfl) h
  rintro ⟨balance,pos⟩ r hi hr
  unfold awsvars.closing_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  all_goals
    simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] at hi ⊢
  case isTrue.isFalse =>
    have hb : balance.val=0 := by scalar_tac
    simpa only [hb,closing_zero] using hi
  case isFalse =>
    have hp : (nats s.val).length ≤ pos.val := by simp only [nats,List.length_map]; scalar_tac
    simpa only [closing_past _ _ _ hp] using hi
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨hlt,hx⟩ := slice_index_ok hi1
    have hpx : (nats s.val)[pos.val]'(by simp [nats]; exact hlt) = i1.val := by
      simp only [nats,List.getElem_map,hx]
    have hb : balance.val ≠ 0 := by scalar_tac
    have hs := closing_step (nats s.val) pos.val balance.val i1.val (by simpa [nats] using hlt) hpx hb
    have hn : brace1.val = if i1.val=123 then balance.val+1 else if i1.val=125 then balance.val-1 else balance.val := by
      simp only [u8_eq_iff,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hbrace1
      split at hbrace1
      · rename_i he
        simpa [he,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using add_ok_val hbrace1
      · rename_i he
        split at hbrace1
        · rename_i he2
          simpa [he,he2,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using (sub_ok_val hbrace1).1
        · rename_i he2
          have heq := Result.ok.inj hbrace1
          subst brace1
          simp only [he,he2,ite_false]
    rw [← hn] at hs
    rw [hs] at hi
  case isTrue.isTrue.isTrue =>
    have hb1 : brace1.val≠0 := by scalar_tac
    simp only [hb1,ite_false] at hi
    have he := add_ok_val hend1
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · simpa only [show end1.val=pos.val+1 by scalar_tac] using hi
    · simp only [hb,hb1,ite_false]
      scalar_tac
  case isTrue.isTrue.isFalse =>
    have hb1 : brace1.val=0 := by scalar_tac
    simp only [hb1,ite_true] at hi
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · simpa only [hb1,closing_zero] using hi

theorem depth_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (text : Slice U8) (depth : Usize)

  | _ n ih =>

    · have hlt : depth.val<10 := by omega
      let inner := ExpandVariables (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (depth.val+1)

 theorem balanced_layout (text : Slice U8) (pos start ending balance next : Usize)
    (body pre post : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (ha : start.val=pos.val+2) (hb : balance.val=0)
    (hc : awsvars.closing text start=ok (ending,balance))
    (hv : bytes.slice text start ending=ok body)
    (hp : bytes.slice text 0#usize pos=ok pre)
    (hn : next.val=ending.val+1)
    (hs : bytes.slice text next text.len=ok post)
    (hpos : pos.val+2 ≤ text.val.length) :
    ∃ closing,
      ClosingTail (nats (text.val.drop (pos.val+2))) 1=(closing,0) ∧
      ending.val=pos.val+2+closing ∧
      nats body.val=(nats (text.val.drop (pos.val+2))).take closing ∧
      pre.val=text.val.take pos.val ∧
      post.val=text.val.drop (pos.val+closing+3) ∧
      ending.val<text.val.length := by
  have he := RustfsAwsClosing.closing_ok text start (ending,balance) hc
  rw [ha,hb] at he
  simp only [ClosingAt,nats] at he
  rw [←List.map_drop] at he
  cases ht : ClosingTail (List.map (fun x : U8 => x.val) (text.val.drop (pos.val+2))) 1 with
  | mk closing bal =>
    rw [ht] at he
    have he' := Prod.mk.inj he
    have hbal : bal=0 := he'.2.symm
    subst bal
    have hend : ending.val=pos.val+2+closing := he'.1
    have hbnd := (closing_tail_bound (nats (text.val.drop (pos.val+2))) 1).2 (by omega)
    change ClosingTail (nats (text.val.drop (pos.val+2))) 1=(closing,0) at ht
    rw [ht] at hbnd

      simpa only [nats,List.length_map] using hbnd rfl
    have hending : ending.val<text.val.length := by simp only [List.length_drop] at hcl; omega
    refine ⟨closing,ht,hend,?_,?_,?_,hending⟩
    · have hv' := RustfsBytes.slice_ok text start ending body hv
      rw [hv',ha,hend]
      simp only [nats,List.map_drop,List.map_take]
      rw [List.drop_take]
      congr 1
      omega
    · have hp' := RustfsBytes.slice_ok text 0#usize pos pre hp
      simpa using hp'
    · have hs' := RustfsBytes.slice_ok text next text.len post hs
      rw [Slice.len_val,Slice.length,List.take_length,hn,hend] at hs'
      have heq : pos.val+2+closing+1=pos.val+closing+3 := by omega
      simpa only [heq] using hs'

import Verified.RustfsAwsCollections
import SpecAwsResolution
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsAwsPasses
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
def texts (xs : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) : List (List Nat) := xs.map (fun v => nats v.val)
theorem pass_all_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (pass : List Nat → List (List Nat))
    (hn : ∀ text, pass text ≠ [])
    (hs : ∀ (text : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)),
      awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx text depth = ok out → texts out.val=pass (nats text.val))
    (results : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (k : Usize)
    (acc : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (changed : Bool)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.pass_all ctx results k acc changed depth=ok out) :
    texts out.1.val = texts acc.val ++ ((texts (results.val.drop k.val)).flatMap pass) ∧
      out.2 = (changed || (texts (results.val.drop k.val)).any (fun text => decide (pass text ≠ [text]))) := by
  induction hm : results.val.length+1-k.val using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing k acc changed with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [awsvars.pass_all] at h
    h5i_invert h
    · have hk : results.val.length ≤ k.val := by scalar_tac
      simp [List.drop_of_length_le hk,texts]
    · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hv
      have hp := hs _ _ hresolved
      simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hp
      have hnon : texts resolved.val ≠ [] := by rw [hp]; exact hn _
      have hd : differs = decide (pass (nats v.val) ≠ [nats v.val]) := by
        rw [←hp]
        h5i_invert hdiffers
        · have hlen : 1 < resolved.val.length := by scalar_tac
          have hne : texts resolved.val ≠ [nats v.val] := by
            intro hh
            have hh' := congrArg List.length hh
            simp [texts] at hh'
            omega
          simp [hne]
        · obtain ⟨hiv,hve⟩ := vec_index_ok hv1
          have hlen : resolved.val.length=1 := by scalar_tac
          have hx : resolved.val=[v1] := by
            apply List.ext_getElem?
            intro j
            by_cases hj : j=0
            · subst j
              rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show 0 < resolved.val.length by omega)]
              simpa using congrArg some hve
            · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega),List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp; omega)]
          have hb' := RustfsForceDelete.bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hb
          simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hb'
          have hh : nats v1.val=nats v.val ↔ v1.val=v.val :=
            ⟨RustfsForceDelete.nats_inj,congrArg nats⟩
          apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
          simp [texts,hx,hh,←hb']
        · have hlen : resolved.val.length=0 := by scalar_tac
          have hx : resolved.val=[] := List.eq_nil_iff_length_eq_zero.mpr hlen
          simp [hx,texts] at hnon
      have ha := RustfsAwsCollections.extend_ok _ _ _ hacc1
      simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at ha
      have hadd : i2.val=k.val+1 := by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac
      have hd1 : differs1 = (changed || differs) := by
        cases changed <;> simpa using (Result.ok.inj hdiffers1).symm
      have hi := ih (results.val.length+1-i2.val) (by omega) i2 acc1 differs1 h rfl
      have hdrop : results.val.drop k.val = v :: results.val.drop (k.val+1) := by
        rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt]
        rw [he]
      simp only [hdrop,texts,List.map_cons,List.flatMap_cons,List.any_cons]
      rw [ha] at hi
      simp only [texts,List.map_append,hadd] at hi
      dsimp only [texts] at hp
      rw [hp] at hi
      rw [hd1,hd] at hi
      simpa only [List.append_assoc,Bool.or_assoc] using hi
theorem unique_nats (xs : List (List U8)) :
    (UniqueBytes xs).map nats=DistinctTexts (xs.map nats) := by
  unfold UniqueBytes DistinctTexts
  rw [List.foldl_map]
  symm
  apply List.foldl_hom (List.map nats) (init := ([] : List (List U8)))
    (g₁ := fun acc text => if text ∈ acc then acc else acc++[text])
    (g₂ := fun acc text => if nats text ∈ acc then acc else acc++[nats text])
  intro acc value
  have hm : nats value ∈ acc.map nats ↔ value ∈ acc := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨other,ho,he⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
      have he' := RustfsForceDelete.nats_inj he
      simpa only [he'] using ho
    · intro h; exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨value,h,rfl⟩
  simp only [hm]
  split <;> simp_all
theorem fixpoint_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (pass : List Nat → List (List Nat))
    (hn : ∀ text, pass text ≠ [])
    (hs : ∀ (text : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)),
      awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx text depth=ok out → texts out.val=pass (nats text.val))
    (results : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (iteration : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h : awsvars.fixpoint ctx results iteration depth=ok out) :
    texts out.val=ExpansionRounds pass (10-iteration.val) (texts results.val) := by
  induction hm : 10-iteration.val using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing iteration results with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [awsvars.fixpoint] at h
    h5i_invert h
    · have hi : 10 ≤ iteration.val := by scalar_tac
      have hz : n=0 := by omega
      simp [hz,ExpansionRounds]
    · rcases x with ⟨new,changed⟩
      change (do
        let results1 ← awsvars.dedup (alloc.vec.Vec.deref new)
        if changed then do
          let i ← iteration + 1#usize
          awsvars.fixpoint ctx results1 i depth
        else ok results1) = ok out at h
      have hp := pass_all_ok ctx depth pass hn hs _ _ _ _ _ hx
      simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd,RustfsForceDelete.deref_val,
        UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,List.drop_zero,Bool.false_or] at hp
      have hempty : texts (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec U8)).val=[] := rfl
      rw [hempty,List.nil_append] at hp
      have hlt : iteration.val < 10 := by scalar_tac
      have hnround : n= (10-(iteration.val+1))+1 := by omega
      rw [hnround,ExpansionRounds]
      rw [←hp.2]
      obtain ⟨next,hnext,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.mp h
      have hd := RustfsAwsCollections.dedup_ok _ _ hnext
      simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hd
      have hd' : texts next.val = DistinctTexts ((texts results.val).flatMap pass) := by
        have hmap : texts next.val=(next.val.map (·.val)).map nats := by simp [texts,List.map_map]
        rw [hmap,hd,unique_nats]
        congr 1
        simpa only [texts,List.map_map,Function.comp_def] using hp.1
      cases changed with
      | false =>
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false] at h ⊢
        have he := Result.ok.inj h
        subst next
        exact hd'
      | true =>
        simp only [ite_true] at h ⊢
        obtain ⟨i,hi,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.mp h
        have hv : i.val=iteration.val+1 := by have := add_ok_val hi; scalar_tac
        have hh := ih (10-i.val) (by omega) next i h rfl
        simpa only [hv,hd'] using hh
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsAwsPasses

theorem depth_cap_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (text : Slice U8) (depth : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (hd : 10 ≤ depth.val)
    (h : awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx text depth = ok out) :
    out.val.map (fun v => nats v.val) = ExpandVariables (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) depth.val (nats text.val) := by

import Verified.RustfsAwsClosing
import Verified.RustfsExpansionModel
import Verified.RustfsFindExact
import Verified.RustfsAwsCollections
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsAwsScan
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
 theorem no_marker_occurrence (text : List U8) (h : HasPlaceholder (nats text)=false)
    (k : Nat) : ¬ ByteOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] k := by
  intro ho
  apply (placeholder_false_iff _).mp h k
  constructor
  · have he := ho.2 0 (by simp)
    have hm := congrArg (Option.map (fun x : U8 => x.val)) he
    simpa [nats,List.getElem?_map] using hm
  · have he := ho.2 1 (by simp)
    have hm := congrArg (Option.map (fun x : U8 => x.val)) he
    simpa [nats,List.getElem?_map] using hm

 theorem scan_literal_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (i start depth : Usize) (p : awsvars.Pending)
    (hp : results.val[i.val]?=some p) (hm : HasPlaceholder (nats p.text.val)=false)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.scan ctx results i start depth = ok out) : out=(results,false) := by
  rw [awsvars.scan] at h
  obtain ⟨entry,he,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hi := vec_index_slice_ok_get? he
  rw [hp] at hi
  have heq : entry=p := (Option.some.inj hi).symm
  subst entry
  simp only [u8vec_clone,bind_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨marker,hmarker,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hmarkerVal : marker.val=[36#u8,123#u8] := by
    simp only [lift,Result.ok.injEq] at hmarker
    subst marker
    rfl
  obtain ⟨position,hposition,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hf := RustfsFindExact.find_ok _ _ _ _ hposition
  simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val,hmarkerVal] at hf
  cases position with
  | none => exact (Result.ok.inj h).symm
  | some pos =>
    exact False.elim (no_marker_occurrence _ hm pos.val hf.2.1)
theorem pass_from_literal_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (i depth : Usize)
    (hm : ∀ p ∈ results.val, HasPlaceholder (nats p.text.val)=false)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (h : awsvars.pass_from ctx results i depth = ok out) : out=results := by
  induction hn : results.val.length+1-i.val using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [awsvars.pass_from] at h
    split at h
    · exact (Result.ok.inj h).symm
    · obtain ⟨entry,he,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      have hp := vec_index_slice_ok_get? he
      have hmem : entry ∈ results.val := List.mem_of_getElem? hp
      obtain ⟨scanned,hs,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      have hscan := scan_literal_ok ctx results i entry.resume depth entry hp (hm entry hmem) scanned hs
      subst scanned
      change (do
        let next ← i + 1#usize
        awsvars.pass_from ctx results next depth) = ok out at h
      obtain ⟨next,hnxt,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      have hadd := add_ok_val hnxt
      have hlt : i.val < results.val.length := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hp).1
      exact ih (results.val.length+1-next.val) (by scalar_tac) next h rfl

 theorem single_pass_literal_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (text : Slice U8) (depth : Usize)
    (hm : HasPlaceholder (nats text.val)=false)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h : awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx text depth = ok out) :
    out.val.map (fun v => nats v.val)=[nats text.val] := by
  rw [awsvars.resolve_single_pass] at h
  obtain ⟨copied,hcopied,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have ht : copied.val=text.val := by
    have hw : alloc.slice.Slice.to_vec core.clone.CloneU8 text ⦃ fun v => v.val=text.val ⦄ := by
      step*
      simp_all [alloc.vec.Vec.val]
    have hc := post_of_ok hw hcopied
    exact hc
  obtain ⟨pending,hpending,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hp := RustfsBytes.push_ok hpending
  change pending.val=[{text:=copied,resume:=0#usize}] at hp
  obtain ⟨resolved,hresolved,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hr := pass_from_literal_ok ctx pending 0#usize depth (by
    intro p hmem
    rw [hp] at hmem
    simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hmem
    subst p
    simpa only [ht] using hm) resolved hresolved
  subst resolved
  have ho := RustfsAwsCollections.texts_ok _ _ h
  simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val,hp,List.map_cons,List.map_nil] at ho
  rw [ho]
  simp [ht]
theorem marker_occurrence_iff (text : List U8) (k : Nat) :
    ByteOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] k ↔
      (nats text)[k]?=some 36 ∧ (nats text)[k+1]?=some 123 := by
  constructor
  · intro ho
    constructor
    · have hm := congrArg (Option.map (fun x : U8 => x.val)) (ho.2 0 (by simp))
      simpa [nats,List.getElem?_map] using hm
    · have hm := congrArg (Option.map (fun x : U8 => x.val)) (ho.2 1 (by simp))
      simpa [nats,List.getElem?_map] using hm
  · rintro ⟨ha,hb⟩
    have hex : ∀ (j v : Nat) (byte : U8), byte.val=v →
        (nats text)[j]?=some v → text[j]?=some byte := by
      intro j v byte hv he
      simp only [nats,List.getElem?_map] at he
      cases hx : text[j]? with
      | none => simp [hx] at he
      | some x =>
        simp only [hx,Option.map_some,Option.some.injEq] at he
        have hxv : x=byte := (u8_eq_iff x byte).mpr (he.trans hv.symm)
        simpa only [hxv]
    have hxa := hex k 36 36#u8 rfl ha
    have hxb := hex (k+1) 123 123#u8 rfl hb
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · have hlt := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hxb).1
      simp only [List.length_cons,List.length_nil]
      omega
    · intro j hj
      simp only [List.length_cons,List.length_nil] at hj
      have hj : j=0 ∨ j=1 := by omega
      rcases hj with rfl | rfl
      · simpa using hxa
      · simpa using hxb
theorem first_marker_prefix (text : List U8) (pos : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] 0 (some pos)) :
    HasPlaceholder (nats (text.take pos))=false := by
  apply (placeholder_false_iff _).mpr
  intro k hk
  have hka : k < (text.take pos).length := by
    have ht := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hk.1).1
    simpa [nats] using ht
  have hkb : k+1 < (text.take pos).length := by
    have ht := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hk.2).1
    simpa [nats] using ht
  simp only [List.length_take] at hka hkb
  have hkp : k < pos := lt_of_lt_of_le hka (Nat.min_le_left _ _)
  have hkbp : k+1 < pos := lt_of_lt_of_le hkb (Nat.min_le_left _ _)
  apply hf.2.2 k (by omega) hkp
  apply (marker_occurrence_iff text k).mpr
  simpa [nats,List.getElem?_map,List.getElem?_take,hkp,hkbp] using hk

 theorem first_marker_split (text : List U8) (pos : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] 0 (some pos)) :
    nats text = nats (text.take pos) ++ 36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2)) := by
  have hp : pos+2 ≤ text.length := by simpa using hf.2.1.1
  have ha := (marker_occurrence_iff text pos).mp hf.2.1
  have hlt : pos < (nats text).length := by simpa [nats] using (show pos<text.length by omega)
  have hlt1 : pos+1 < (nats text).length := by simpa [nats] using (show pos+1<text.length by omega)
  have hxa : (nats text)[pos]=36 := by simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] using ha.1
  have hxb : (nats text)[pos+1]=123 := by simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt1] using ha.2
  have hd : (nats text).drop pos=36::123::(nats text).drop (pos+2) := by
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt,hxa,List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt1,hxb]
  conv_lhs => rw [←List.take_append_drop pos (nats text),hd]
  simp [nats,List.map_take,List.map_drop]
theorem marker_drop_iff (text : List U8) (offset k : Nat) :
    ByteOccurrence (text.drop offset) [36#u8,123#u8] k ↔
      ByteOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] (offset+k) := by
  unfold ByteOccurrence
  simp only [List.length_drop,List.length_cons,List.length_nil,List.getElem?_drop]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hb,hv⟩
    refine ⟨by omega,?_⟩
    intro j hj
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_left_comm] using hv j hj
  · rintro ⟨hb,hv⟩
    refine ⟨by omega,?_⟩
    intro j hj
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_left_comm] using hv j hj

 theorem first_marker_drop (text : List U8) (offset pos : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] offset (some pos)) :
    FirstOccurrence (text.drop offset) [36#u8,123#u8] 0 (some (pos-offset)) := by
  refine ⟨by omega,?_,?_⟩
  · apply (marker_drop_iff text offset (pos-offset)).mpr
    simpa only [Nat.add_sub_of_le hf.1] using hf.2.1
  · intro k hk hp ho
    apply hf.2.2 (offset+k) (by omega) (by omega)
    exact (marker_drop_iff text offset k).mp ho

 theorem no_marker_drop (text : List U8) (offset : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] offset none) :
    HasPlaceholder (nats (text.drop offset))=false := by
  apply (placeholder_false_iff _).mpr
  intro k hk
  apply hf (offset+k) (by omega)
  apply (marker_drop_iff text offset k).mp
  exact (marker_occurrence_iff (text.drop offset) k).mpr hk
 theorem scan_suffix_literal_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (i start depth : Usize) (p : awsvars.Pending)
    (hp : results.val[i.val]?=some p) (hm : HasPlaceholder (nats (p.text.val.drop start.val))=false)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.scan ctx results i start depth = ok out) : out=(results,false) := by
  rw [awsvars.scan] at h
  obtain ⟨entry,he,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hi := vec_index_slice_ok_get? he
  rw [hp] at hi
  have heq : entry=p := (Option.some.inj hi).symm
  subst entry
  simp only [u8vec_clone,bind_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨marker,hmarker,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hmarkerVal : marker.val=[36#u8,123#u8] := by
    simp only [lift,Result.ok.injEq] at hmarker
    subst marker
    rfl
  obtain ⟨position,hposition,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hf := RustfsFindExact.find_ok _ _ _ _ hposition
  simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val,hmarkerVal] at hf
  cases position with
  | none => exact (Result.ok.inj h).symm
  | some pos =>
    have hd := first_marker_drop _ _ _ hf
    exact False.elim (no_marker_occurrence _ hm _ hd.2.1)
 theorem resume_first_marker (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List U8) (offset pos : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] offset (some pos)) :
    ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) offset =
      (ExpansionPass inner c (36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2)))).map
        (fun suffix => nats (text.take pos) ++ suffix) := by
  have hd := first_marker_drop text offset pos hf
  have hs := first_marker_split (text.drop offset) (pos-offset) hd
  have hn := first_marker_prefix (text.drop offset) (pos-offset) hd
  have hoffset : offset ≤ pos := hf.1
  have he : offset+(pos-offset)=pos := by omega
  have he2 : offset+(pos-offset+2)=pos+2 := by omega
  have hs' : (nats text).drop offset = nats ((text.drop offset).take (pos-offset)) ++
      36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2)) := by
    simpa only [nats,List.map_drop,List.drop_drop,he2] using hs
  unfold ResumeAlternatives
  rw [hs',expansion_pre inner c _ _ hn]
  simp only [List.map_map,Function.comp_def]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro suffix _
  have hp : text.take offset ++ (text.drop offset).take (pos-offset)=text.take pos := by
    rw [←List.take_add,he]
  have hpn : (nats text).take offset ++ nats ((text.drop offset).take (pos-offset)) =
      nats (text.take pos) := by
    simpa only [nats,List.map_append,List.map_take] using congrArg nats hp
  simpa only [←List.append_assoc,hpn]
 theorem scan_unbalanced_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (i start depth : Usize) (p : awsvars.Pending) (pos : Nat)
    (hp : results.val[i.val]?=some p)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence p.text.val [36#u8,123#u8] start.val (some pos))
    (hb : (ClosingAt (nats p.text.val) (pos+2) 1).2 ≠ 0)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.scan ctx results i start depth = ok out) : out=(results,false) := by
  rw [awsvars.scan] at h
  obtain ⟨entry,he,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hi := vec_index_slice_ok_get? he
  rw [hp] at hi
  have heq : entry=p := (Option.some.inj hi).symm
  subst entry
  simp only [u8vec_clone,bind_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨marker,hmarker,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hmarkerVal : marker.val=[36#u8,123#u8] := by
    simp only [lift,Result.ok.injEq] at hmarker
    subst marker
    rfl
  obtain ⟨position,hposition,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hfound := RustfsFindExact.find_ok _ _ _ _ hposition
  simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val,hmarkerVal] at hfound
  cases position with
  | none => exact False.elim (hfound pos hf.1 hf.2.1)
  | some found =>
    have hpos : found.val=pos := by
      have he := RustfsFindExact.first_unique _ _ _ _ _ hfound hf
      exact Option.some.inj he
    obtain ⟨bodyStart,hbodyStart,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    have hs := add_ok_val hbodyStart
    obtain ⟨closing,hclosing,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    rcases closing with ⟨ending,balance⟩
    have hc := RustfsAwsClosing.closing_ok _ _ _ hclosing
    simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hc
    have hsval : bodyStart.val=pos+2 := by scalar_tac
    rw [hsval] at hc
    have hbalance : balance.val ≠ 0 := by
      have he := congrArg Prod.snd hc
      change balance.val=(ClosingAt (nats p.text.val) (pos+2) 1).2 at he
      rw [he]
      exact hb
    have htest : (balance != 0#usize) = true := by scalar_tac
    change (if balance != 0#usize then ok (results,false) else _) = ok out at h
    simp only [htest,↓reduceIte,Result.ok.injEq] at h
    exact h.symm
 theorem marker_split (text : List U8) (pos : Nat)
    (ho : ByteOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] pos) :
    nats text = nats (text.take pos) ++ 36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2)) := by
  have hp : pos+2 ≤ text.length := by simpa using ho.1
  have ha := (marker_occurrence_iff text pos).mp ho
  have hlt : pos < (nats text).length := by simpa [nats] using (show pos<text.length by omega)
  have hlt1 : pos+1 < (nats text).length := by simpa [nats] using (show pos+1<text.length by omega)
  have hxa : (nats text)[pos]=36 := by simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] using ha.1
  have hxb : (nats text)[pos+1]=123 := by simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt1] using ha.2
  have hd : (nats text).drop pos=36::123::(nats text).drop (pos+2) := by
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt,hxa,List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt1,hxb]
  conv_lhs => rw [←List.take_append_drop pos (nats text),hd]
  simp [nats,List.map_take,List.map_drop]
theorem resume_unbalanced (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List U8) (offset pos : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] offset (some pos))
    (hb : (ClosingAt (nats text) (pos+2) 1).2 ≠ 0) :
    ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) offset=[nats text] := by
  rw [resume_first_marker inner c text offset pos hf]
  cases hc : ClosingTail (nats (text.drop (pos+2))) 1 with
  | mk closing balance =>
    have hbalance : balance ≠ 0 := by
      have hc' := hc
      simp only [nats,List.map_drop] at hc'
      simpa only [ClosingAt,nats,List.map_drop,hc',Prod.snd] using hb
    simp only [ExpansionPass,hc,hbalance,ne_eq,not_false_eq_true,ite_true,List.map_cons,List.map_nil]
    rw [←marker_split text pos hf.2.1]
 theorem resume_skip_literal_prefix (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List U8) (offset pos : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] offset (some pos)) :
    ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) offset=ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) pos := by
  have hs : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] pos (some pos) :=
    ⟨Nat.le_refl _,hf.2.1,fun k hk hp _ => by omega⟩
  rw [resume_first_marker inner c text offset pos hf,resume_first_marker inner c text pos pos hs]
theorem resume_skip_placeholder (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List U8) (offset pos closing : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] offset (some pos))
    (hc : ClosingTail (nats (text.drop (pos+2))) 1=(closing,0))
    (hr : PlaceholderAlternatives inner c ((nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take closing)
      ((36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take (closing+3))=
      [(36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take (closing+3)]) :
    ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) offset =
      ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) (pos+closing+3) := by
  rw [resume_skip_literal_prefix inner c text offset pos hf]
  have hp : (nats (text.take pos)).length=pos := by
    have hb := hf.2.1.1
    simp only [List.length_cons,List.length_nil] at hb
    simp only [nats,List.length_map,List.length_take]
    omega
  have hs := marker_split text pos hf.2.1
  have he := resume_keep_placeholder inner c (nats (text.take pos))
    (nats (text.drop (pos+2))) closing hc hr
  rw [←hs,hp] at he
  exact he
 theorem resume_balanced (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List U8) (offset pos closing : Nat)
    (hf : FirstOccurrence text [36#u8,123#u8] offset (some pos))
    (hc : ClosingTail (nats (text.drop (pos+2))) 1=(closing,0)) :
    ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats text) offset =
      (PlaceholderAlternatives inner c ((nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take closing)
        ((36::123::nats (text.drop (pos+2))).take (closing+3))).flatMap
          (fun replacement => (ExpansionPass inner c (nats (text.drop (pos+closing+3)))).map
            (fun suffix => nats (text.take pos) ++ replacement ++ suffix)) := by
  rw [resume_first_marker inner c text offset pos hf,expansion_marker inner c _ closing hc]
  simp only [List.map_flatMap,List.map_map,Function.comp_def,List.append_assoc]
  have he : (nats (text.drop (pos+2))).drop (closing+1)=nats (text.drop (pos+closing+3)) := by
    simp only [nats,List.map_drop,List.drop_drop]
    have hn : pos+2+(closing+1)=pos+closing+3 := by omega
    rw [hn]
  rw [he]
 theorem contains_marker_ok (text marker : Slice U8) (b : Bool)
    (hm : marker.val=[36#u8,123#u8]) (h : bytes.contains text marker=ok b) :
    b=HasPlaceholder (nats text.val) := by
  have hc := RustfsBytes.contains_ok text marker b h
  rw [hm] at hc
  have hn : b=false ↔ HasPlaceholder (nats text.val)=false := by
    rw [placeholder_false_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hb k hk
      have ho := (marker_occurrence_iff text.val k).mpr hk
      have ht := hc.mpr ⟨k,ho⟩
      simp [hb] at ht
    · intro hn
      cases hb : b with
      | false => rfl
      | true =>
        obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := hc.mp hb
        exact False.elim (hn k ((marker_occurrence_iff text.val k).mp hk))
  cases b <;> cases hh : HasPlaceholder (nats text.val) <;> simp_all
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsAwsScan

import Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning
import Verified.RustfsAwsLayout
import Verified.RustfsResolutionTerminates
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning
@[simp] theorem slice_val {α : Type} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) : v.slice.val=v.val := by
  rw [←RustfsResolutionTerminates.deref_eq]
  exact RustfsForceDelete.deref_val v
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
 theorem wrap_length_ok (pre post : Slice U8) (values : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (offset : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (h : awsvars.wrap_all pre values post offset=ok out) :
    out.val.length=values.val.length := by
  have hw := RustfsAwsCollections.wrap_ok pre post values offset out h
  have hl := congrArg List.length hw
  simpa only [List.length_map,WrappedValues] using hl
def ScanMeaning (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize) (p : awsvars.Pending) (start : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Bool) : Prop :=
  out.1.val.take i.val=results.val.take i.val ∧
    if out.2 then
      (out.1.val.drop i.val).flatMap (pendingMeaning inner c)=
        ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats p.text.val) start.val ++
          (results.val.drop (i.val+1)).flatMap (pendingMeaning inner c)
    else out.1=results ∧ ResumeAlternatives inner c (nats p.text.val) start.val=[nats p.text.val]
 theorem scan_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat))
    (hs : ∀ (text : Slice U8) (d : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)),
      d.val=depth.val+1 → awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx text d=ok out →
        out.val.map (fun value => nats value.val)=inner (nats text.val))
    (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize) (p : awsvars.Pending)
    (hp : results.val[i.val]?=some p) (start : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Bool)
    (h : awsvars.scan ctx results i start depth=ok out) :
    ScanMeaning inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) results i p start out := by
  induction hn : p.text.val.length+1-start.val using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing start with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [awsvars.scan] at h
    simp only [RustfsResolutionTerminates.deref_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨entry,he,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    have hi := vec_index_slice_ok_get? he
    rw [hp] at hi
    have heq : entry=p := (Option.some.inj hi).symm
    subst entry
    simp only [u8vec_clone,bind_ok,RustfsResolutionTerminates.deref_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨marker,hmarker,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    have hmarkerVal : marker.val=[36#u8,123#u8] := by
      simp only [lift,Result.ok.injEq] at hmarker
      subst marker
      rfl
    obtain ⟨position,hposition,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    have hf := RustfsFindExact.find_ok _ _ _ _ hposition
    simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val,slice_val,hmarkerVal] at hf
    cases position with
    | none =>
      have heq := (Result.ok.inj h).symm
      subst out
      simp only [ScanMeaning,Prod.fst,Prod.snd,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,true_and]
      apply resume_literal
      simpa only [nats,List.map_drop] using RustfsAwsScan.no_marker_drop p.text.val start.val hf
    | some pos =>
      obtain ⟨bodyStart,hbodyStart,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      have ha : bodyStart.val=pos.val+2 := by have := add_ok_val hbodyStart; scalar_tac
      obtain ⟨closing,hclosing,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      rcases closing with ⟨ending,balance⟩
      change (if balance != 0#usize then ok (results,false) else _) = ok out at h
      by_cases hb : (balance != 0#usize)=true
      · simp only [hb,↓reduceIte] at h
        have heq := (Result.ok.inj h).symm
        subst out
        simp only [ScanMeaning,Prod.fst,Prod.snd,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,true_and]
        apply RustfsAwsScan.resume_unbalanced inner _ p.text.val start.val pos.val hf
        have hc := RustfsAwsClosing.closing_ok _ _ _ hclosing
        simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val,ha] at hc
        have hc' := congrArg Prod.snd hc
        change balance.val=(ClosingAt (nats p.text.val) (pos.val+2) 1).2 at hc'
        rw [←hc']
        scalar_tac
      · simp only [hb,↓reduceIte] at h
        have hb0 : balance.val=0 := by scalar_tac
        obtain ⟨body,hbody,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
        obtain ⟨pre,hpre,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
        obtain ⟨next,hnext,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
        have hnxt : next.val=ending.val+1 := by have := add_ok_val hnext; scalar_tac
        obtain ⟨post,hpost,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
        have hbound : pos.val+2≤p.text.val.length := by simpa using hf.2.1.1
        obtain ⟨closing,hclose,hend,hbodyval,hpreval,hpostval,hendbound⟩ :=
          RustfsAwsLayout.balanced_layout p.text.slice pos bodyStart ending balance next
            body pre post ha hb0 hclosing hbody hpre hnxt hpost (by simpa using hbound)
        simp only [slice_val] at hclose hend hbodyval hpreval hpostval hendbound
        obtain ⟨marker2,hmarker2,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
        obtain ⟨nested,hnested,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
        have hmarker2Val : marker2.val=[36#u8,123#u8] := by
          simp only [lift,Result.ok.injEq] at hmarker2
          subst marker2
          rfl
        have hnestedVal := RustfsAwsScan.contains_marker_ok body.slice marker2 nested hmarker2Val hnested
        simp only [slice_val] at hnestedVal
        have hskip
            (hr : PlaceholderAlternatives inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx)
              ((nats (p.text.val.drop (pos.val+2))).take closing)
              ((36::123::nats (p.text.val.drop (pos.val+2))).take (closing+3))=
                [(36::123::nats (p.text.val.drop (pos.val+2))).take (closing+3)])
            (hscan : awsvars.scan ctx results i next depth=ok out) :
            ScanMeaning inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) results i p start out := by
          have hdecrease : p.text.val.length+1-next.val<n := by
            have hstart : start.val ≤ pos.val := hf.1
            have hnextBound : next.val ≤ p.text.val.length := by omega
            have hnextGt : start.val < next.val := by omega
            omega
          have hrec := ih _ hdecrease next hscan rfl
          have hresume := RustfsAwsScan.resume_skip_placeholder inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx)
            p.text.val start.val pos.val closing hf hclose hr
          have hnextval : next.val=pos.val+closing+3 := by omega
          simpa only [ScanMeaning,hnextval,←hresume] using hrec
        have hfinish (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
            (new final : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
            (hr : PlaceholderAlternatives inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx)
              ((nats (p.text.val.drop (pos.val+2))).take closing)
              ((36::123::nats (p.text.val.drop (pos.val+2))).take (closing+3))=
                values.val.map (fun value => nats value.val))
            (hw : awsvars.wrap_all pre.slice values.slice post.slice pos=ok new)
            (hsplice : awsvars.splice results.slice i new.slice=ok final) :
            ScanMeaning inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) results i p start (final,true) := by
          have hi : i.val≤results.val.length := by
            have := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hp |>.1
            omega
          exact wrapped_scan_ok inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) p.text.val start.val pos.val closing
            hf hclose pre.slice post.slice values.slice pos hpreval hpostval rfl hr
            results.slice i new final hi hw hsplice
        h5i_invert h
        all_goals
          try
            have hdepth : i4.val=depth.val+1 := by
              have hd := add_ok_val hi4
              scalar_tac
            have hinner := hs body.slice i4 inner_1 hdepth hinner_1
            simp only [slice_val] at hinner
            have hnest : HasPlaceholder (nats body.val)=true := hnestedVal.symm.trans hc
          try
            have hlength : inner_1.val.length=1 := by scalar_tac
            have hvget := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hv
            have hsingle : inner_1.val=[v] := by
              obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlength
              simpa [hq] using hvget
            have heq := RustfsVariableResolve.equal_nats _ _ _ hb1
            simp only [slice_val] at heq
        case isTrue.isTrue.isTrue =>
          have hlength : inner_1.val.length=1 := by
            have hl := congrArg UScalar.val hc_1
            simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.len,Slice.len_val,Slice.length,slice_val,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,Usize.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hl
          have hvget := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hv
          have hsingle : inner_1.val=[v] := by
            obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlength
            simpa [hq] using hvget
          have heq := RustfsVariableResolve.equal_nats _ _ _ hb1
          simp only [slice_val] at heq
          apply hskip ?_ h
          have hsame := heq.mp hc_2
          rw [hsingle] at hinner
          simp only [List.map_cons,List.map_nil,hsame] at hinner
          rw [←hbodyval]
          simp [PlaceholderAlternatives,hnest,←hinner]
        all_goals
          try
            have hwraplen := wrap_length_ok pre.slice post.slice _ pos new hnew
            simp only [slice_val] at hwraplen
        case isTrue.isTrue.isFalse.isTrue =>
          apply hfinish inner_1 new v1 ?_ hnew hv1
          rw [←hbodyval]
          have hnonnil : inner (nats body.val)≠[] := by rw [←hinner,hsingle]; simp
          have hneq : inner (nats body.val)≠[nats body.val] := by
            rw [←hinner,hsingle]
            intro he
            simp only [List.map_cons,List.map_nil,List.cons.injEq,and_true] at he
            exact hc_2 (heq.mpr he)
          simp only [PlaceholderAlternatives,hnest,ite_true,hnonnil,hneq,or_self,ite_false]
          exact hinner.symm
        case isTrue.isTrue.isFalse.isFalse =>
          have hz : new.val.length=0 := by scalar_tac
          rw [hsingle] at hwraplen
          simp only [List.length_cons,List.length_nil] at hwraplen
          omega
        case isTrue.isFalse.isTrue =>
          apply hfinish inner_1 new v1 ?_ hnew hv1
          rw [←hbodyval]
          have hnonnil : inner (nats body.val)≠[] := by
            intro he
            have hnil := List.map_eq_nil_iff.mp (hinner.trans he)
            rw [hnil] at hwraplen
            simp only [List.length_nil] at hwraplen
            scalar_tac
          have hneq : inner (nats body.val)≠[nats body.val] := by
            intro he
            have hl := congrArg List.length (hinner.trans he)
            simp only [List.length_map,List.length_cons,List.length_nil] at hl
            apply hc_1
            scalar_tac
          simp only [PlaceholderAlternatives,hnest,ite_true,hnonnil,hneq,or_self,ite_false]
          exact hinner.symm
        case isTrue.isFalse.isFalse =>
          have hz : new.val.length=0 := by scalar_tac
          have hnil : inner_1.val=[] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega)
          have hinnernil : inner (nats body.val)=[] := by rw [←hinner,hnil]; rfl
          apply hskip ?_ h
          rw [←hbodyval]
          simp [PlaceholderAlternatives,hnest,hinnernil]
        case h_1 =>
          apply hskip ?_ h
          have hm := RustfsAwsValues.multiple_ok ctx body.slice none ho1
          simp only [slice_val,Option.map_none] at hm
          have hnot : HasPlaceholder (nats body.val)=false := hnestedVal.symm.trans (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hc)
          rw [←hbodyval]
          simp [PlaceholderAlternatives,hnot,←hm]
        case h_2.isTrue =>
          apply hfinish l new v1 ?_ hnew hv1
          have hm := RustfsAwsValues.multiple_ok ctx body.slice (some l) ho1
          simp only [slice_val,Option.map_some] at hm
          have hnot : HasPlaceholder (nats body.val)=false := hnestedVal.symm.trans (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hc)
          rw [←hbodyval]
          cases hl : l.val with
          | nil =>
            have hz : l.val.length=0 := by rw [hl]; rfl
            scalar_tac
          | cons value rest =>
            simp only [hl,List.map_cons] at hm ⊢
            simp [PlaceholderAlternatives,hnot,←hm]
        case h_2.isFalse =>
          have hz : l.val.length=0 := by scalar_tac
          have hnil := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hz
          have hm := RustfsAwsValues.multiple_ok ctx body.slice (some l) ho1
          simp only [slice_val,Option.map_some,hnil,List.map_nil] at hm
          have hnot : HasPlaceholder (nats body.val)=false := hnestedVal.symm.trans (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hc)
          have hr : PlaceholderAlternatives inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx)
              ((nats (p.text.val.drop (pos.val+2))).take closing)
              ((36::123::nats (p.text.val.drop (pos.val+2))).take (closing+3))=[[]] := by
            rw [←hbodyval]
            simp [PlaceholderAlternatives,hnot,←hm]
          have hii : i.val≤results.val.length := by
            have := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hp |>.1
            omega
          exact empty_scan_ok inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) p.text.val start.val pos.val closing
            hf hclose pre.slice post.slice pos hpreval hpostval rfl hr
            results.slice i v_1 new v1 hii hv_1 hnew hv1

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsAwsMeaning

import Verified.RustfsAwsScanMeaning
import Verified.RustfsAwsPassMeaning
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsAwsPassMeaning
open RustfsAwsMeaning RustfsResolutionTerminates
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
 theorem pass_from_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat))
    (hs : ∀ (text : Slice U8) (d : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)),
      d.val=depth.val+1 → awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx text d=ok out →
        out.val.map (fun value => nats value.val)=inner (nats text.val))
    (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)
    (h : awsvars.pass_from ctx results i depth=ok out) :
    pendingTexts out.val=passMeaning inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) results.val i.val := by
  induction hn : score (results.val.drop i.val) using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing results i with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [awsvars.pass_from] at h
    by_cases hi : i ≥ results.len
    · simp only [hi,↓reduceIte] at h
      have heq := (Result.ok.inj h).symm
      subst out
      have hb : results.val.length ≤ i.val := by scalar_tac
      simp [passMeaning,List.take_of_length_le hb,List.drop_of_length_le hb]
    · simp only [hi,↓reduceIte] at h
      obtain ⟨p,hp,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      have hpi := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hp
      obtain ⟨scanned,hscan,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h

      have hmeaning := scan_ok ctx depth inner hs results i p hpi p.resume (updated,modified) hscan
      have hscore := scan_post_ok ctx depth results i p hpi p.resume (by omega) (updated,modified) hscan
      cases modified with

        have hless : score (updated.val.drop i.val)<n := by
          simpa only [ScanPost,Prod.fst,Prod.snd,Bool.true_eq,ite_true,hn] using hscore
        have hout := ih _ hless updated i h rfl
        rw [hout]
        apply pass_meaning_replace
        · exact hmeaning.1
        · have hh := hmeaning.2
          change (updated.val.drop i.val).flatMap (pendingMeaning inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx))=
            pendingMeaning inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) p ++
              (results.val.drop (i.val+1)).flatMap (pendingMeaning inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx)) at hh
          have hib := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hpi |>.1
          have hpe : results.val[i.val]=p := by simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hib] using hpi
          rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hib,hpe,List.flatMap_cons]
          exact hh
      | false =>
        have hh := hmeaning.2
        change updated=results ∧ pendingMeaning inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) p=[nats p.text.val] at hh
        rcases hh with ⟨heq,hm⟩
        subst updated
        change (do let next ← i+1#usize; awsvars.pass_from ctx results next depth)=ok out at h
        obtain ⟨next,hnext,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
        have hnxt : next.val=i.val+1 := by have := add_ok_val hnext; scalar_tac
        have hless : score (results.val.drop next.val)<n := by

        rw [hout,hnxt]

theorem single_pass_ok (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat))

    (h : awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx text depth=ok out) :
    out.val.map (fun v => nats v.val)=ExpansionPass inner (RustfsAwsValues.context ctx) (nats text.val) := by

  obtain ⟨copied,hcopied,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have ht := RustfsCleanCanonical.to_vec_ok text copied hcopied
  obtain ⟨pending,hpending,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hp := RustfsBytes.push_ok hpending
  change pending.val=[{text:=copied,resume:=0#usize}] at hp
  obtain ⟨resolved,hresolved,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hr := pass_from_ok ctx depth inner hs pending 0#usize resolved hresolved
  have ho := RustfsAwsCollections.texts_ok _ _ h
  simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at ho
  rw [ho,List.map_map]
  change pendingTexts resolved.val=_
  rw [hr]
  simp [passMeaning,pendingTexts,hp,pendingMeaning,ResumeAlternatives,ht]

theorem decode_sound (encoded : Slice U8) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)

theorem forall₂_snoc {A B : Type} {R : A → B → Prop} {xs : List A} {ys : List B}

theorem from_values_ok (es : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (v : conddata.BinaryFuncValue)
    (h : conddata.binary_from_encoded_values es = ok (.Ok v)) :
    v.encoded = es ∧ List.Forall₂ BinaryValueEncoding es.val v.decoded.val := by

      (fun r => ∀ w, r = core.result.Result.Ok w →
        w.encoded = es ∧ List.Forall₂ BinaryValueEncoding es.val w.decoded.val)
      (fun x => es.val.length - x.2.val) ?_ _ (.Ok v)

    unfold conddata.binary_from_encoded_values_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · have hd := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBase64.decode_sound _ _ hr_1
      simp only [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hd

theorem match_sound (f : conddata.BinaryFuncValue) (requests : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
