    b = true → (∀ e ∈ requests.val, ValidBinaryRequest e) ∧
      ∃ e ∈ requests.val, MatchingBinaryRequest f e := by
  unfold conddata.binary_key_matches conddata.binary_key_matches_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : Bool × Usize => x.2.val ≤ requests.val.length ∧
      (∀ e ∈ requests.val.take x.2.val, ValidBinaryRequest e) ∧
      (x.1 = true → ∃ e ∈ requests.val.take x.2.val, MatchingBinaryRequest f e))
    (fun r => r = true → (∀ e ∈ requests.val, ValidBinaryRequest e) ∧
      ∃ e ∈ requests.val, MatchingBinaryRequest f e)
    (fun x => requests.val.length - x.2.val) ?_ _ b
    ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp⟩ h
  rintro ⟨matched,i⟩ r ⟨hi,hvalid,hmatched⟩ hr
  unfold conddata.binary_key_matches_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hv
    have hd := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBase64.decode_sound _ _ hr_1
    simp only [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hd
    have hm := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCondData.member_ok _ _ _ hb_1
    simp only [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hm
    have hadd := add_ok_val hi2
    have ht : requests.val.take i2.val = requests.val.take i.val ++ [v] := by
      rw [show i2.val = i.val + 1 by scalar_tac, List.take_add_one,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt, he]
      rfl
    refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
    · rw [ht]
      intro e hem
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hem
      rcases hem with hem | rfl
      · exact hvalid e hem
      · exact ⟨_, hd⟩
    · intro hyes
      rw [ht]
      by_cases hb : b_1 = true
      · obtain ⟨y, hym, hye⟩ := hm.1 hb
        refine ⟨v, by simp, y, hym, ?_⟩
        rw [hye]
        exact hd
      · have heq : matched = matched1 := by simpa [hb] using hmatched1
        have hmtrue : matched = true := heq.trans hyes
        obtain ⟨e, hem, heyes⟩ := hmatched hmtrue
        exact ⟨e, List.mem_append_left _ hem, heyes⟩
  · intro hfalse; cases hfalse
  · intro hyes
    have he : requests.val.take i.val = requests.val := List.take_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)
    rw [he] at hvalid hmatched
    exact ⟨hvalid, hmatched hyes⟩

theorem effect_eq_allow_iff (e : stmts.Effect) :
    stmts.Effect.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqEffect.eq e .Allow = ok true ↔ e = .Allow := by
  unfold stmts.Effect.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqEffect.eq

    (e : condfuncs.Env) (he : st.effect = .Allow)

    stmts.bp_reaches_condition_eval st a = ok true := by

  rcases h with ⟨b, hb, h⟩
  cases b
  · simp [stmts.effect_is_allowed, he] at h
  · exact hb

  unfold stmts.bp_reaches_condition_eval at h

  have heq := UScalar.add_equiv i 1#usize
  rw [h] at heq
  simp only [Result.match.ok] at heq
  exact heq.2.1

@[reducible] def step_prop (sts : Slice stmts.BPStatement) (a : stmts.BucketPolicyArgs) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (i : Usize) (r : ControlFlow Usize Bool) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | .done y => y = true → ∃ st ∈ sts.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧
      stmts.principal_is_match st.principal a.account.deref = ok true ∧
      stmts.bp_statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true

    (e : condfuncs.Env) (i : Usize) (r : ControlFlow Usize Bool) (_hi : i.val ≤ sts.val.length)

      omega
    · have hb_allow : b.effect = .Allow := (effect_eq_allow_iff b.effect).mp hb1
      simp only [ite_true] at hr
      rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at hr
      obtain ⟨b2, hb2, hr⟩ := hr
      cases b2
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false] at hr
        rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at hr
        obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hr⟩ := hr

        subst hr_inj
        have hi2_val : i2.val = i.val + 1 := usize_add_one_val i i2 hi2
        dsimp [step_prop]
        omega
      · simp only [ite_true] at hr
        have hr_inj : r = .done true := by simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hr; exact hr.symm
        subst hr_inj
        dsimp [step_prop]

def PrefAt (s p : List U8) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  k + p.length ≤ s.length ∧ ∀ j < p.length, s[k + j]? = p[j]?

theorem push_ok {α} {v w : alloc.vec.Vec α} {x : α} (h : alloc.vec.Vec.push v x = ok w) :
    w.val = v.val ++ [x] := by
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.push at h
  dsimp only at h
  split at h
  · simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h; subst h; simp [alloc.vec.Vec.from_val]
  · simp at h

theorem starts_with_at_loop_ok (s p : Slice U8) (f : Usize) (hl : f.val + p.val.length ≤ s.val.length)
    (i : Usize) (r : Bool)
    (hi : ∀ j < i.val, s.val[f.val + j]? = p.val[j]?) (h : bytes.starts_with_at_loop s f p i = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ ∀ j < p.val.length, s.val[f.val + j]? = p.val[j]?) := by
  unfold bytes.starts_with_at_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => ∀ j < i.val, s.val[f.val + j]? = p.val[j]?)
    (fun r => r = true ↔ ∀ j < p.val.length, s.val[f.val + j]? = p.val[j]?)
    (fun i : Usize => p.val.length - i.val) ?_ i r hi h
  intro x r hx hr
  unfold bytes.starts_with_at_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have h0 := add_ok_val hi2
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok hi3
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := slice_index_ok hi4
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, not_forall]
    refine ⟨x.val, by scalar_tac, ?_⟩
    rw [← h0, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h3, h2, h4]
    simp only [Option.some.injEq]
    intro he; simp_all
  · have h0 := add_ok_val hi2
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok hi3
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := slice_index_ok hi4
    have := add_ok_val hi5
    simp only
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
    by_cases hjx : j < x.val
    · exact hx j hjx
    · have : j = x.val := by scalar_tac
      subst this
      have : i3 = i4 := (u8_eq_iff _ _).2 (by simpa using hc_1)
      rw [← h0, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h3, h2, h4, this]
  · simp only [true_iff]
    intro j hj
    exact hx j (by scalar_tac)

theorem starts_with_at_ok (s p : Slice U8) (f : Usize) (r : Bool)
    (h : bytes.starts_with_at s f p = ok r) : (r = true ↔ PrefAt s.val p.val f.val) := by
  unfold bytes.starts_with_at at h
  unfold PrefAt
  h5i_invert h
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, not_and]
    intro h; scalar_tac
  · have := sub_ok_val hi2
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, not_and]
    intro h; scalar_tac
  · have := sub_ok_val hi2
    have hl : f.val + p.val.length ≤ s.val.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [starts_with_at_loop_ok s p f hl _ r (by simp) h]
    simp [hl]

theorem starts_with_ok (s p : Slice U8) (r : Bool)
    (h : bytes.starts_with s p = ok r) : (r = true ↔ PrefAt s.val p.val 0) := by
  unfold bytes.starts_with at h
  exact starts_with_at_ok s p 0#usize r h

theorem not_prefAt_short {s p : List U8} {k : Nat} (h : s.length < k + p.length) : ¬ PrefAt s p k :=
  fun ⟨h1, _⟩ => by omega

theorem find_from_ok (s p : Slice U8) (f : Usize) (o : Option Usize)
    (h : bytes.find_from s f p = ok o) :
    (∀ j, o = some j → PrefAt s.val p.val j.val) ∧
    (o = none → ∀ k, f.val ≤ k → ¬ PrefAt s.val p.val k) := by
  unfold bytes.find_from bytes.find_from_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => ∀ k, f.val ≤ k → k < i.val → ¬ PrefAt s.val p.val k)
    (fun o => (∀ j, o = some j → PrefAt s.val p.val j.val) ∧
      (o = none → ∀ k, f.val ≤ k → ¬ PrefAt s.val p.val k))
    (fun i : Usize => s.val.length + 1 - i.val) ?_ f o (fun k h1 h2 => by omega) h
  intro x r hx hr
  unfold bytes.find_from_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have := sub_ok_val hi3
    have hb := starts_with_at_ok s p x b hb
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, by simp⟩
    cases Option.some.inj hj
    exact hb.1 hc_2
  · have := sub_ok_val hi3
    have hb := starts_with_at_ok s p x b hb
    have := add_ok_val hi5
    refine ⟨fun k h1 h2 => ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
    by_cases hk : k < x.val
    · exact hx k h1 hk
    · have : k = x.val := by scalar_tac
      subst this
      intro hp; simp_all
  · have := sub_ok_val hi3
    refine ⟨by simp, fun _ k h1 => ?_⟩
    by_cases hk : k < x.val
    · exact hx k h1 hk
    · exact not_prefAt_short (by scalar_tac)
  · refine ⟨by simp, fun _ k h1 => ?_⟩
    by_cases hk : k < x.val
    · exact hx k h1 hk
    · exact not_prefAt_short (by scalar_tac)

theorem contains_ok (s p : Slice U8) (r : Bool) (h : bytes.contains s p = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ ∃ k, PrefAt s.val p.val k) := by
  unfold bytes.contains at h
  obtain ⟨o, ho, h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 h
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := find_from_ok s p 0#usize o ho
  cases o with
  | some j =>
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h; subst h
    simp only [true_iff]
    exact ⟨_, h1 _ rfl⟩
  | none =>
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h; subst h
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, not_exists]
    intro k
    exact h2 rfl k (by simp)

theorem slice_ok (s : Slice U8) (a b : Usize) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : bytes.slice s a b = ok v) : v.val = (s.val.take b.val).drop a.val := by
  unfold bytes.slice bytes.slice_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize =>
      x.1.val = (s.val.take x.2.val).drop a.val ∧ a.val ≤ x.2.val ∧ (x.2.val ≤ b.val ∨ x.2.val = a.val))
    (fun v : alloc.vec.Vec U8 => v.val = (s.val.take b.val).drop a.val)
    (fun x => b.val + 1 - x.2.val) ?_ _ v ⟨by simp, le_refl _, Or.inr rfl⟩ h
  rintro ⟨out, i⟩ r ⟨hx1, hx2, hx3⟩ hr
  simp only at hx1 hx2 hx3
  unfold bytes.slice_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok hi1
    have hp := push_ok hout1
    have := add_ok_val hi2
    simp only
    refine ⟨⟨?_, by scalar_tac, Or.inl (by scalar_tac)⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
    rw [hp, hx1, show i2.val = i.val + 1 by scalar_tac, List.take_add_one, List.drop_append_of_le_length
      (by simp; omega), List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1, h2]
    rfl
  · simp only
    rw [hx1]
    rcases hx3 with h3 | h3
    · rw [show i.val = b.val by scalar_tac]
    · have : b.val ≤ a.val := by scalar_tac
      rw [h3, List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by simp only [List.length_take]; omega)]
      exact (List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by simp only [List.length_take]; omega)).symm

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBytes

import SpecClaims
import Verified.RustfsForceDelete
import Verified.RustfsCleanCanonical
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete (bytes_eq_ok deref_val)

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimLookup

theorem find_ok (table : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
    (needle : Slice U8) (o : Option Usize) (h : claims.find table needle = ok o) :
    ClaimLookupResult table.val needle.val o := by
  unfold claims.find claims.find_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ table.val.length ∧
      ∀ e ∈ table.val.take i.val, e.1.val ≠ needle.val)
    (ClaimLookupResult table.val needle.val) (fun i => table.val.length - i.val)
    ?_ _ o ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ h
  rintro i r ⟨hi,hn⟩ hr
  unfold claims.find_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨v,value⟩
    change (do
      let b ← bytes.eq v.deref needle
      if b then ok (ControlFlow.done (some i))
      else
        let j ← i + 1#usize
        ok (ControlFlow.cont j)) = ok r at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hx
      have hb := bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption)
      rw [deref_val] at hb
      change FirstNamedClaim table.val needle.val i.val
      refine ⟨hlt, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [he]; exact hb.1 hc_1
      · intro j hj
        exact hn _ (List.mem_take_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨j,by omega,rfl⟩)
    · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hx
      have hb := bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption)
      rw [deref_val] at hb
      have hjv := add_ok_val hj
      refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
      have hji : j.val = i.val + 1 := by scalar_tac
      rw [hji, List.take_add_one, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt]
      intro e helem
      simp only [Option.toList_some, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at helem
      rcases helem with hh | rfl
      · exact hn e hh
      · rw [he]; exact fun hh => hc_1 (hb.2 hh)
  · change ∀ e ∈ table.val, e.1.val ≠ needle.val
    have hle : table.val.length ≤ i.val := by scalar_tac
    simpa only [List.take_of_length_le hle] using hn
theorem role_arn_sound (table : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
    (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (h : claims.get_role_arn table = ok (some v)) :
    ∃ i : Usize, ∃ hi : i.val < table.val.length,
      FirstNamedClaim table.val table.val[i.val].1.val i.val ∧
      nats table.val[i.val].1.val = lit "roleArn" ∧
      table.val[i.val].2 = claims.Value.String v := by
  unfold claims.get_role_arn at h
  h5i_invert h
  have hsl : nats s.val = lit "roleArn" :=
    by rw [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.lift_slice hs]; decide +kernel
  clear hs
  rcases x with ⟨key,value⟩
  change (match (generalizing := false) value with
    | .Null => ok none
    | .Bool _ => ok none
    | .Number _ => ok none
    | .String s1 => do
      let v1 ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 s1
      ok (some v1)
    | .Array _ => ok none
    | .Object _ => ok none) = ok (some v) at h
  cases value
  all_goals h5i_invert h
  have hc := post_of_ok (CloneLaw.vec_clone_spec core.clone.CloneU8 _) hv1
  have hclone : _ = v := hc.symm.trans (Option.some.inj h)
  obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hx
  have hf := find_ok table s (some val) ho
  change FirstNamedClaim table.val s.val val.val at hf
  rcases hf with ⟨_,hkey,hfirst⟩
  refine ⟨val,hlt,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact ⟨hlt,rfl,by simpa only [hkey] using hfirst⟩
  · rw [hkey]; exact hsl
  · rw [he]; simpa only using congrArg claims.Value.String hclone
theorem service_policy_name_ok (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : claims.iam_policy_claim_name_sa = ok v) : nats v.val = lit "sa-policy" := by
  unfold claims.iam_policy_claim_name_sa at h
  h5i_invert h
  rw [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCleanCanonical.to_vec_ok _ _ h]
  rw [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.lift_slice hs]
  decide +kernel

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimLookup

import Verified.RustfsClaimTokens
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimPath

theorem path_preserved (path : Slice U8) (second : Bool) (left right : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : claims.split_path path second = ok (left,right)) :
    left.val ++ right.val = path.val := by
  unfold claims.split_path at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  · rw [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCleanCanonical.to_vec_ok _ _ hv]
    simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new,alloc.vec.Vec.from_val]
  · rw [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCleanCanonical.to_vec_ok _ _ hv]
    simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new,alloc.vec.Vec.from_val]
  all_goals
    rw [slice_ok _ _ _ _ hv,slice_ok _ _ _ _ hv1]
    have hz : (0#usize).val = 0 := by decide +kernel
    simp only [hz,List.drop_zero,Slice.len_val,List.take_length,List.take_append_drop]

import Verified.RustfsClaimUnique
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBytes (push_ok)
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete (deref_val)
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimStrings

theorem append_ok (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (v : claims.Value)
    (result : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (ho : NonemptyClaimTokens out.val)
    (h : claims.append_string_values out v = ok result) : NonemptyClaimTokens result.val := by
  unfold claims.append_string_values at h
  cases v <;> h5i_invert h
  all_goals try exact ho
  have hp := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimTokens.split_nonempty _ _ hparts
  unfold claims.append_string_values_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Usize =>
    NonemptyClaimTokens x.1.val) (fun out => NonemptyClaimTokens out.val)
    (fun x => parts.val.length-x.2.val) ?_ _ result ho h
  rintro ⟨out,i⟩ r ho hr
  unfold claims.append_string_values_loop.body at hr
  simp only [u8vec_clone] at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hv1
    have hh := hp v1 (he ▸ List.getElem_mem hlt)
    have hadd := add_ok_val hi2
    refine ⟨?_,by scalar_tac⟩
    have hp := push_ok hout1
    intro x hx
    rw [hp,List.mem_append,List.mem_singleton] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | rfl
    · exact ho x hx
    · exact hh
  · exact ho
theorem array_ok (array : alloc.vec.Vec claims.Value)
    (out result : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (i : Usize)
    (ho : NonemptyClaimTokens out.val)
    (h : claims.value_strings_loop array out i = ok result) : NonemptyClaimTokens result.val := by
  unfold claims.value_strings_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Usize =>
    NonemptyClaimTokens x.1.val) (fun out => NonemptyClaimTokens out.val)
    (fun x => array.val.length-x.2.val) ?_ _ result ho h
  rintro ⟨out,i⟩ r ho hr
  unfold claims.value_strings_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have hadd := add_ok_val hi2
    exact ⟨append_ok _ _ _ ho hout1,by scalar_tac⟩
  · exact ho

theorem value_ok (v : claims.Value) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (b : Bool)
    (h : claims.value_strings v = ok (out,b)) :
    NonemptyClaimTokens out.val ∧ (b = true ↔ ClaimStringContainer v) := by
  unfold claims.value_strings at h
  cases v <;> h5i_invert h
  all_goals rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  case Null | Bool | Number | Object =>
    exact ⟨by simp [NonemptyClaimTokens,alloc.vec.Vec.new,alloc.vec.Vec.from_val],by simp [ClaimStringContainer]⟩
  case String =>
    exact ⟨append_ok _ _ _ (by simp [NonemptyClaimTokens]) hout_1,by simp [ClaimStringContainer]⟩
  case Array =>
    exact ⟨array_ok _ _ _ _ (by simp [NonemptyClaimTokens]) hout_1,by simp [ClaimStringContainer]⟩

theorem lookup_nonempty (table : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
    (needle : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (b : Bool)
    (h : claims.lookup_strings table needle = ok (out,b)) : NonemptyClaimTokens out.val := by
  unfold claims.lookup_strings at h
  h5i_invert h
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    simp [NonemptyClaimTokens,alloc.vec.Vec.new,alloc.vec.Vec.from_val]
  · rcases x_1 with ⟨key,value⟩
    exact (value_ok value out b h).1
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    simp [NonemptyClaimTokens,alloc.vec.Vec.new,alloc.vec.Vec.from_val]
theorem get_values_ok (table : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
    (needle : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (b : Bool)
    (h : claims.get_values_from_claims table needle = ok (out,b)) :
    NonemptyClaimTokens out.val ∧ out.val.Nodup := by
  unfold claims.get_values_from_claims at h
  h5i_invert h
  rcases x with ⟨values,present⟩
  change (do
    let v ← claims.unique_values values.deref
    ok (v,present)) = ok (out,b) at h
  h5i_invert h
  rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  have hn := lookup_nonempty table needle values present hx
  have hu := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimUnique.unique_ok _ _ hv
  rw [deref_val] at hu
  exact ⟨fun x hx => hn x ((hu.2 x).1 hx),hu.1⟩
theorem policies_ok (table : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
    (needle : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (b : Bool)
    (h : claims.get_policies_from_claims table needle = ok (out,b)) :
    NonemptyClaimTokens out.val ∧ out.val.Nodup := get_values_ok table needle out b h

theorem args_ok (table : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
    (needle : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (b : Bool)
    (h : claims.args_get_policies table needle = ok (out,b)) :
    NonemptyClaimTokens out.val ∧ out.val.Nodup := policies_ok table needle out b h

theorem exact_nonempty (table : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value))
    (needle : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (b : Bool)
    (h : claims.values_from_claims table needle = ok (out,b)) : NonemptyClaimTokens out.val := by
  unfold claims.values_from_claims at h
  h5i_invert h
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    simp [NonemptyClaimTokens,alloc.vec.Vec.new,alloc.vec.Vec.from_val]
  · rcases x with ⟨key,value⟩
    exact (value_ok value out b h).1
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimStrings

theorem tag_key_ok (key : Slice U8) (b : Bool)
    (h : claims.is_existing_object_tag_condition_key key = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ ExistingTagKey (nats key.val)) := by
  unfold claims.is_existing_object_tag_condition_key at h

    have he := bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hb_1

import Verified.RustfsClaimLookup
import Verified.RustfsBytes
import Verified.RustfsCondData
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBytes (push_ok)
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimTokens


theorem push_nonempty (out out1 : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (part : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ho : NonemptyClaimTokens out.val)
    (h : (if part.len != 0#usize then alloc.vec.Vec.push out part else ok out) = ok out1) :
    NonemptyClaimTokens out1.val := by
  h5i_invert h
  · have hp := push_ok h
    intro p hm
    rw [hp] at hm
    simp only [List.mem_append,List.mem_singleton] at hm
    rcases hm with hm | rfl
    · exact ho p hm
    · intro hz
      have hzlen : p.val.length = 0 := by rw [hz]; rfl
      scalar_tac
  · exact ho

theorem split_nonempty (s : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h : claims.split_values s = ok out) : NonemptyClaimTokens out.val := by
  unfold claims.split_values claims.split_values_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Usize × Usize =>

  unfold claims.split_values_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨out1,start1⟩
    change (do
      let j ← i + 1#usize
      ok (ControlFlow.cont (out1,start1,j))) = ok r at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    have hadd := add_ok_val hj
    refine ⟨?_,by scalar_tac⟩
    h5i_invert hx
    all_goals
      rcases hx with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      dsimp only
    · exact push_nonempty out out2 part ho hout2
    · exact push_nonempty out out2 part ho hout2
    · exact ho
  · exact ho
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimTokens

import SpecClaims
import Verified.RustfsForceDelete
import Verified.RustfsBytes
import Verified.RustfsClaimTags
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBytes
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete (deref_val)
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimTree
theorem listN_size {α : Type} [SizeOf α] {n : Nat} (l : Aeneas.Data.ListN.ListN α n) :
    sizeOf l.toList ≤ sizeOf l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [Aeneas.Data.ListN.ListN.toList, List.nil.sizeOf_spec,
      Aeneas.Data.ListN.ListN.nil.sizeOf_spec]; omega
  | cons x l ih =>
    simp only [Aeneas.Data.ListN.ListN.toList, List.cons.sizeOf_spec,
      Aeneas.Data.ListN.ListN.cons.sizeOf_spec]
    omega

theorem slice_size {α : Type} [SizeOf α] (s : Slice α) : sizeOf s.val < sizeOf s := by
  cases s with | mk n l h =>
    have hl := listN_size l
    simp only [Slice.val, Slice.mk.sizeOf_spec]
    omega

theorem array_size (es : alloc.vec.Vec claims.Value) : sizeOf es.val < sizeOf (claims.Value.Array es) := by
  cases es with | mk sl =>
    have hs := slice_size sl
    simp only [claims.Value.Array.sizeOf_spec, alloc.vec.Vec.mk.sizeOf_spec, alloc.vec.Vec.val]
    omega

theorem object_size (es : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value)) :
    sizeOf es.val < sizeOf (claims.Value.Object es) := by
  cases es with | mk sl =>
    have hs := slice_size sl
    simp only [claims.Value.Object.sizeOf_spec, alloc.vec.Vec.mk.sizeOf_spec, alloc.vec.Vec.val]
    omega

theorem child_array_size (es : Slice claims.Value) (i : Nat) (hlt : i < es.val.length) :
    sizeOf es.val[i] < sizeOf (es.val.drop i) := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt]
  simp only [List.cons.sizeOf_spec]
  omega

theorem child_object_size (es : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value)) (i : Nat) (hlt : i < es.val.length) :
    sizeOf es.val[i].2 < sizeOf (es.val.drop i) := by
  have hp : sizeOf es.val[i].2 < sizeOf es.val[i] := by
    generalize es.val[i] = p
    rcases p with ⟨key,v⟩
    simp only [Prod.mk.sizeOf_spec]
    omega
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt]
  simp only [List.cons.sizeOf_spec]
  omega

theorem tail_size {α : Type} [SizeOf α] (es : Slice α) (i : Nat) (hlt : i < es.val.length) :
    sizeOf (es.val.drop (i+1)) < sizeOf (es.val.drop i) := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt]
  simp only [List.cons.sizeOf_spec]
  omega


theorem array_use_iff (es : alloc.vec.Vec claims.Value) :
    ExistingTagUse (.Array es) ↔ ∃ v ∈ es.val, ExistingTagUse v := by
  constructor
  · intro h; cases h with | array_value _ v hv ht => exact ⟨v,hv,ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨v,hv,ht⟩; exact .array_value es v hv ht

theorem object_use_iff (es : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value)) :
    ExistingTagUse (.Object es) ↔
      ∃ e ∈ es.val, ExistingTagKey (nats e.1.val) ∨ ExistingTagUse e.2 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | object_key _ e he ht => exact ⟨e,he,.inl ht⟩
    | object_value _ e he ht => exact ⟨e,he,.inr ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨e,he,ht | ht⟩
    · exact .object_key es e he ht
    · exact .object_value es e he ht

def ObjectTagUse (es : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value)) : Prop :=
  ∃ e ∈ es, ExistingTagKey (nats e.1.val) ∨ ExistingTagUse e.2

def ArrayTagUse (es : List claims.Value) : Prop := ∃ v ∈ es, ExistingTagUse v

theorem all_ok (n : Nat) :
    (∀ v : claims.Value, sizeOf v ≤ n → ∀ b,
      claims.value_uses_existing_object_tag v = ok b → (b = true ↔ ExistingTagUse v)) ∧
    (∀ (es : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × claims.Value)) (i : Usize),
      sizeOf (es.val.drop i.val) ≤ n → ∀ b, claims.object_uses_tag es i = ok b →
        (b = true ↔ ObjectTagUse (es.val.drop i.val))) ∧
    (∀ (es : Slice claims.Value) (i : Usize),
      sizeOf (es.val.drop i.val) ≤ n → ∀ b, claims.array_uses_tag es i = ok b →
        (b = true ↔ ArrayTagUse (es.val.drop i.val))) := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    have hz : (0#usize).val = 0 := by decide +kernel
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro v hv b h
      cases v with
      | Array es =>
        unfold claims.value_uses_existing_object_tag at h
        have hs := array_size es
        have hh := (ih (sizeOf es.val) (by omega)).2.2 es.deref 0#usize
          (by simp only [deref_val, hz, List.drop_zero]; omega) b h
        simpa only [deref_val,hz,List.drop_zero,ArrayTagUse,← array_use_iff] using hh
      | Object es =>
        unfold claims.value_uses_existing_object_tag at h
        have hs := object_size es
        have hh := (ih (sizeOf es.val) (by omega)).2.1 es.deref 0#usize
          (by simp only [deref_val, hz, List.drop_zero]; omega) b h
        simpa only [deref_val,hz,List.drop_zero,ObjectTagUse,← object_use_iff] using hh
      | Null | Bool _ | Number _ | String _ =>
        unfold claims.value_uses_existing_object_tag at h
        h5i_invert h
        constructor <;> intro hx <;> cases hx
    · intro es i hsize b h
      unfold claims.object_uses_tag at h
      h5i_invert h
      · have hle : es.val.length ≤ i.val := by scalar_tac
        simp [ObjectTagUse,List.drop_eq_nil_of_le hle]
      · rcases x with ⟨key,value⟩
        change (do
          let kb ← claims.is_existing_object_tag_condition_key key.deref
          if kb then ok true else
            let vb ← claims.value_uses_existing_object_tag value
            if vb then ok true else
              let j ← i + 1#usize
              claims.object_uses_tag es j) = ok b at h
        obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hx
        have hex : ObjectTagUse (es.val.drop i.val) ↔
            (ExistingTagKey (nats key.val) ∨ ExistingTagUse value) ∨
              ObjectTagUse (es.val.drop (i.val+1)) := by
          rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt,he]
          simp [ObjectTagUse]
        h5i_invert h
        all_goals
          have hk := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimTags.tag_key_ok _ _ hkb
          rw [deref_val] at hk
        · rw [hex]
          simp [hk.1 hc_1]
        all_goals
          have hvs := child_object_size es i.val hlt
          rw [he] at hvs
          change sizeOf value < sizeOf (es.val.drop i.val) at hvs
          have hvsmall : sizeOf value < n := by omega
          have hvspec := (ih (sizeOf value) hvsmall).1 value (by omega) _ hvb
        · rw [hex]
          simp [hvspec.1 hc_2]
        · have hj := add_ok_val hj
          have hjval : j.val = i.val+1 := by scalar_tac
          have hts := tail_size es i.val hlt
          have htsmall : sizeOf (es.val.drop (i.val+1)) < n := by omega
          have htspec := (ih _ htsmall).2.1 es j (by rw [hjval]) b h
          rw [hjval] at htspec
          rw [hex,← hk,← hvspec]
          simpa only [hc_1,hc_2,Bool.false_eq_true,false_or] using htspec
    · intro es i hsize b h
      unfold claims.array_uses_tag at h
      h5i_invert h
      · have hle : es.val.length ≤ i.val := by scalar_tac
        simp [ArrayTagUse,List.drop_eq_nil_of_le hle]
      all_goals
        obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hv
        have hex : ArrayTagUse (es.val.drop i.val) ↔
            ExistingTagUse v ∨ ArrayTagUse (es.val.drop (i.val+1)) := by
          rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt,he]
          simp [ArrayTagUse]
        have hvs := child_array_size es i.val hlt
        rw [he] at hvs
        have hvsmall : sizeOf v < n := by omega
        have hvspec := (ih (sizeOf v) hvsmall).1 v (by omega) b_1 hb_1
      · rw [hex]
        simp [hvspec.1 hc_1]
      · have hj := add_ok_val hi2
        have hjval : i2.val = i.val+1 := by scalar_tac
        have hts := tail_size es i.val hlt
        have htsmall : sizeOf (es.val.drop (i.val+1)) < n := by omega
        have htspec := (ih _ htsmall).2.2 es i2 (by rw [hjval]) b h
        rw [hjval] at htspec
        rw [hex,← hvspec]
        simpa only [hc_1,Bool.false_eq_true,false_or] using htspec
theorem value_ok (v : claims.Value) (b : Bool)
    (h : claims.value_uses_existing_object_tag v = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ ExistingTagUse v) := (all_ok (sizeOf v)).1 v (Nat.le_refl _) b h
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsClaimTree

theorem member_iff (xs : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (x : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (b : Bool)
    (h : bytes.member xs x.deref = ok b) : (b = true ↔ x ∈ xs.val) := by
  rw [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCondData.member_ok _ _ _ h, deref_val]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y,hy,he⟩
    have hh : y = x := alloc.vec.Vec.ext _ _ he
    simpa only [hh] using hy
  · intro hx; exact ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩

theorem unique_ok (values : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h : claims.unique_values values = ok out) :
    out.val.Nodup ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ out.val ↔ x ∈ values.val := by
  unfold claims.unique_values claims.unique_values_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Usize =>
      x.2.val ≤ values.val.length ∧ x.1.val.Nodup ∧
      ∀ v, v ∈ x.1.val ↔ v ∈ values.val.take x.2.val)
    (fun out => out.val.Nodup ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ out.val ↔ x ∈ values.val)
    (fun x => values.val.length - x.2.val) ?_ _ out
    ⟨by simp,by simp,by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new,alloc.vec.Vec.from_val]⟩ h
  rintro ⟨out,i⟩ r ⟨hi,hnd,hm⟩ hr
  unfold claims.unique_values_loop.body at hr
  simp only [u8vec_clone] at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hv
    have hbmem := member_iff out.deref v b hb
    rw [deref_val] at hbmem
    have hadd := add_ok_val hi2
    have hij : i2.val = i.val+1 := by scalar_tac
    have htake : values.val.take i2.val = values.val.take i.val ++ [v] := by
      rw [hij,List.take_add_one,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt,he]
      rfl
    h5i_invert hout1
    · have hvout := hbmem.1 hc_1
      have hvtake := (hm v).1 hvout
      refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac,hnd,?_⟩,by scalar_tac⟩
      intro x
      rw [htake,List.mem_append,List.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · intro hx; exact Or.inl ((hm x).1 hx)
      · rintro (hx | rfl)
        · exact (hm x).2 hx
        · exact hvout
    · have hp := push_ok hout1
      have hn : v ∉ out.val := fun hh => hc_1 (hbmem.2 hh)
      refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac,?_,?_⟩,by scalar_tac⟩
      · rw [hp]
        simp only [List.nodup_append,hnd,List.nodup_singleton,true_and,List.mem_singleton]

        have hbv : b = v := by simpa using hb
        exact hn ((heq.trans hbv) ▸ ha)
      · intro x
        simp only [hp,htake,List.mem_append,List.mem_singleton,hm]

    exact ⟨hnd,by simpa only [List.take_of_length_le hle] using hm⟩

import Verified.Derived
import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCleanCanonical
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
set_option backward.split true
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false

@[simp] lemma lit_dot : lit "." = [46] := by decide +kernel
@[simp] lemma lit_slash : lit "/" = [47] := by decide +kernel

def Valid (l : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ s ∈ l.splitOn 47, s ≠ [] ∧ s ≠ [46]
def Canon (root : Bool) (l : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ t, l = (if root then [47] else []) ++ t ∧ (t = [] ∨ Valid t)
def pref (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w : Usize) : List Nat := nats (b.val.take w.val)

lemma valid_append (a s : List Nat) (ha : Valid a) (hs : s ≠ [] ∧ s ≠ [46])
    (hn : 47 ∉ s) : Valid (a ++ 47 :: s) := by
  unfold Valid at *
  rw [List.splitOn_append_cons_self, List.splitOn_eq_singleton hn]
  intro t ht
  rcases List.mem_append.mp ht with ht | ht
  · exact ha t ht
  · have he : t = s := by simpa using ht
    simpa [he] using hs

lemma valid_single (s : List Nat) (hs : s ≠ [] ∧ s ≠ [46]) (hn : 47 ∉ s) : Valid s := by
  unfold Valid
  rw [List.splitOn_eq_singleton hn]
  simpa using hs

lemma canon_base (r : Bool) : Canon r (if r then [47] else []) := by
  exact ⟨[], by simp, Or.inl rfl⟩

lemma canon_append (r : Bool) (l s : List Nat) (hl : Canon r l)
    (hs : s ≠ [] ∧ s ≠ [46]) (hn : 47 ∉ s) :
    Canon r (l ++ (if l.length = (if r then 1 else 0) then [] else [47]) ++ s) := by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl, ht⟩ := hl
  rcases ht with rfl | ht
  · cases r <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true, List.length_append,
      List.length_nil, List.length_cons, Nat.add_zero, List.append_nil, ↓reduceIte,
      List.nil_append] <;> exact ⟨s, rfl, Or.inr (valid_single s hs hn)⟩
  · have hne : t ≠ [] := by
      intro e
      subst t
      have := ht [] (by simp)
      exact this.1 rfl
    have hlen : t.length ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
    refine ⟨t ++ 47 :: s, ?_, Or.inr (valid_append t s ht hs hn)⟩
    cases r <;> simp_all [List.append_assoc]

lemma valid_take (l : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h : Valid l) (hk : l[k]? = some 47) :
    Valid (l.take k) := by
  have he : l = l.take k ++ 47 :: l.drop (k+1) := by
    obtain ⟨hb, he⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hk
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop k l, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hb, he]
  rw [he] at h
  unfold Valid at *
  rw [List.splitOn_append_cons_self] at h
  intro s hs
  exact h s (List.mem_append_left _ hs)

lemma canon_take (r : Bool) (l : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h : Canon r l)
    (hk : l[k]? = some 47) (hb : (if r then 1 else 0) ≤ k) : Canon r (l.take k) := by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl, ht⟩ := h
  cases r with
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, List.nil_append] at *
    rcases ht with rfl | ht
    · simp at hk
    · exact ⟨t.take k, rfl, Or.inr (valid_take t k ht hk)⟩
  | true =>
    simp only [if_true, List.singleton_append] at *
    cases k with
    | zero => omega
    | succ k =>
      simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ, List.take_succ_cons] at *
      rcases ht with rfl | ht
      · simp at hk
      · exact ⟨t.take k, rfl, Or.inr (valid_take t k ht hk)⟩

lemma canon_shape (r : Bool) (l : List Nat) (h : Canon r l) (hne : l ≠ []) : CleanShape l := by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl, ht⟩ := h
  cases r with
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, List.nil_append] at *
    rcases ht with rfl | ht
    · exact False.elim (hne rfl)
    · right; right
      have hh : t.head? ≠ some 47 := by
        intro hh
        obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp hh
        have he := ht [] (by simp [List.splitOn_cons_eq_if_modifyHead])
        exact he.1 rfl
      simpa [hh, Valid] using ht
  | true =>
    simp only [if_true, List.singleton_append] at *
    rcases ht with rfl | ht
    · right; left; simp
    · right; right; simpa [Valid] using ht

lemma mut_ok {b : alloc.vec.Vec U8} {w : Usize} {x : U8} {f : U8 → alloc.vec.Vec U8}
    (h : alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b w = ok (x,f)) :
    w.val < b.val.length ∧ f = b.set w := by
  rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_slice_index, alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_usize] at h
  obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hb := (vec_index_ok hv).1
  simp only [ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at he
  exact ⟨hb, he.2.symm⟩

lemma pref_write (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w w' : Usize) (x : U8)
    (hb : w.val < b.val.length) (hw : w'.val = w.val + 1) :
    pref (b.set w x) w' = pref b w ++ [x.val] := by
  simp only [pref, alloc.vec.Vec.set_val_eq, hw, nats, List.map_append]
  rw [List.take_add_one, List.take_set_of_le (Nat.le_refl _), List.getElem?_set_self hb]
  simp only [Option.toList_some, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]

lemma pref_write_before (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w d : Usize) (x : U8) (hd : d.val ≤ w.val) :
    pref (b.set w x) d = pref b d := by
  simp only [pref, alloc.vec.Vec.set_val_eq]
  rw [List.take_set_of_le hd]

lemma pref_length (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w : Usize) (h : w.val ≤ b.val.length) :
    (pref b w).length = w.val := by simp [pref, nats, List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left h]

lemma index_nat {p : Slice U8} {r : Usize} {x : U8} (h : p.index_usize r = ok x) :
    (nats p.val)[r.val]? = some x.val := by
  obtain ⟨hb, he⟩ := slice_index_ok h
  simp [nats, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hb, he]

lemma copy_ok (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w : Usize) (p : Slice U8) (r : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize × Usize)
    (hw : w.val ≤ b.val.length) (hr : r.val < p.val.length)
    (hc : (nats p.val)[r.val]? ≠ some 47)
    (h : pathclean.copy_element b w p r = ok out) :
    ∃ s, pref out.1 out.2.1 = pref b w ++ s ∧ out.2.1.val ≤ out.1.val.length ∧
      r.val < out.2.2.val ∧ out.2.2.val ≤ p.val.length ∧ 47 ∉ s ∧ s ≠ [] ∧
      (s = [46] → (nats p.val)[r.val]? = some 46 ∧
        ((nats p.val)[r.val+1]? = some 47 ∨ r.val+1 = p.val.length)) := by
  let I := fun (x : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize × Usize) =>
    x.2.1.val ≤ x.1.val.length ∧ x.2.2.val ≤ p.val.length ∧
    ∃ s, pref x.1 x.2.1 = pref b w ++ s ∧ 47 ∉ s ∧
      s.length = x.2.2.val - r.val ∧ x.2.1.val = w.val + s.length ∧ r.val ≤ x.2.2.val ∧
      (s = [] ∨ s.head? = (nats p.val)[r.val]?)
  have hx : I (b,w,r) := by
    dsimp [I]
    refine ⟨hw, Nat.le_of_lt hr, [], by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp, by omega, Or.inl rfl⟩
  unfold pathclean.copy_element pathclean.copy_element_loop at h
  have hh := loop_ok
    (fun (bb,ww,rr) => pathclean.copy_element_loop.body p bb ww rr) I
    (fun x => I x ∧ (x.2.2.val = p.val.length ∨ (nats p.val)[x.2.2.val]? = some 47))
    (fun x => p.val.length - x.2.2.val) ?_ (b,w,r) out hx h
  · obtain ⟨⟨hwb, hrb, s, he, hn, hlen, hww, hrr, hhead⟩, hend⟩ := hh
    have hprogress : r.val < out.2.2.val := by
      by_contra hh
      have eq : out.2.2.val = r.val := by omega
      rcases hend with hend | hend
      · omega
      · exact hc (eq ▸ hend)
    refine ⟨s, he, hwb, hprogress, hrb, hn, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro he
      simp only [he, List.length_nil] at hlen
      omega
    · intro he
      have hfirst : (nats p.val)[r.val]? = some 46 := by
        rcases hhead with hhead | hhead
        · simp [he] at hhead
        · simpa only [he, List.head?_cons] using hhead.symm
      refine ⟨hfirst, ?_⟩
      simp only [he, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hlen
      have eq : out.2.2.val = r.val + 1 := by omega
      rcases hend with hend | hend
      · exact Or.inr (by omega)
      · exact Or.inl (eq ▸ hend)
  · rintro ⟨bb,ww,rr⟩ res ⟨hwb, hrb, s, he, hn, hlen, hww, hrr, hhead⟩ hs
    dsimp only at hwb hrb he hlen hww hrr ⊢
    unfold pathclean.copy_element_loop.body at hs
    h5i_invert hs
    · rcases x with ⟨x,f⟩
      obtain ⟨hb, rfl⟩ := mut_ok hx_1
      change (do let w1 ← ww + 1#usize; let r1 ← rr + 1#usize;
                 ok (ControlFlow.cont (bb.set ww i1, w1, r1))) = ok res at hs
      h5i_invert hs
      have hw1 := add_ok_val hw1
      have hr1 := add_ok_val hr1
      have hp := (slice_index_ok hi1).1
      have hn1 : i1.val ≠ 47 := by scalar_tac
      simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hw1 hr1
      dsimp [I]
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, s ++ [i1.val], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.set_val_eq, List.length_set]; omega
      · omega
      · rw [pref_write bb ww w1 i1 hb hw1, he, List.append_assoc]
      · simpa using And.intro hn hn1
      · simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]; omega
      · simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]; omega
      · omega
      · right
        rcases hhead with rfl | hhead
        · simp only [List.length_nil] at hlen
          have heq : rr.val = r.val := by omega
          simpa only [heq, List.nil_append, List.head?_cons] using (index_nat hi1).symm
        · cases s with
          | nil =>
            simp only [List.length_nil] at hlen
            have heq : rr.val = r.val := by omega
            simpa only [heq, List.nil_append, List.head?_cons] using (index_nat hi1).symm
          | cons a s => simpa only [List.cons_append, List.head?_cons] using hhead
      · omega
    · have hi : i1 = 47#u8 := by scalar_tac
      dsimp [I]
      refine ⟨⟨hwb, hrb, s, he, hn, hlen, hww, hrr, hhead⟩, Or.inr ?_⟩
      simpa [hi] using index_nat hi1
    · have hh : rr.val ≥ p.val.length := by scalar_tac
      dsimp [I]
      exact ⟨⟨hwb, hrb, s, he, hn, hlen, hww, hrr, hhead⟩, Or.inl (by omega)⟩

lemma back_ok (p : Slice U8) (w d out : Usize) (hd : d.val ≤ w.val)
    (h : pathclean.back_to_slash p w d = ok out) :
    d.val ≤ out.val ∧ out.val ≤ w.val ∧
      (out.val = d.val ∨ (nats p.val)[out.val]? = some 47) := by
  unfold pathclean.back_to_slash pathclean.back_to_slash_loop at h
  apply loop_ok _ (fun k : Usize => d.val ≤ k.val ∧ k.val ≤ w.val)
    (fun k : Usize => d.val ≤ k.val ∧ k.val ≤ w.val ∧
      (k.val = d.val ∨ (nats p.val)[k.val]? = some 47))
    (fun k => k.val) ?_ w out ⟨hd, by omega⟩ h
  intro k res hk hs
  unfold pathclean.back_to_slash_loop.body at hs
  split at hs
  h5i_invert hs
  · have hv := sub_ok_val hw1
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv
    refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, by omega⟩, by omega⟩
  · have he : i = 47#u8 := by scalar_tac
    exact ⟨hk.1, hk.2, Or.inr (by simpa [he] using index_nat hi)⟩
  · exact ⟨hk.1, hk.2, Or.inl (by scalar_tac)⟩

lemma canon_min (r : Bool) (l : List Nat) (h : Canon r l) :
    (if r then 1 else 0) ≤ l.length := by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl, ht⟩ := h
  cases r <;> simp

lemma pref_take (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w : Usize) (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ w.val) :
    (pref b w).take k = nats (b.val.take k) := by
  simp only [pref, nats, ← List.map_take, List.take_take, Nat.min_eq_left hk]

def Inv (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w d : Usize) : Prop :=
  w.val ≤ b.val.length ∧ d.val ≤ w.val ∧ Canon root (pref b w) ∧ Canon root (pref b d)

lemma inv_back (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w d w1 w2 : Usize)
    (hi : Inv root b w d) (hgt : w > d) (hw1 : w - 1#usize = ok w1)
    (hb : pathclean.back_to_slash (alloc.vec.Vec.deref b) w1 d = ok w2) :
    Inv root b w2 d := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, hd, hc, hdc⟩ := hi
  have hv := sub_ok_val hw1
  simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv
  have hle : d.val ≤ w1.val := by scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨hd2, hw2, he⟩ := back_ok _ _ _ _ hle hb
  refine ⟨by omega, hd2, ?_, hdc⟩
  rcases he with he | he
  · have : w2 = d := by scalar_tac
    simpa [this] using hdc
  · have hroot := canon_min root (pref b d) hdc
    rw [pref_length b d (by omega)] at hroot
    simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.deref, Slice.from_val] at he
    change (nats b.val)[w2.val]? = some 47 at he
    have he' : (pref b w)[w2.val]? = some 47 := by
      simp only [pref, nats, List.map_take, List.getElem?_take]
      simpa only [show w2.val < w.val from by omega, ↓reduceIte, nats] using he
    have ht := canon_take root (pref b w) w2.val hc he' (by omega)
    rw [pref_take b w w2.val (by omega)] at ht
    exact ht

lemma inv_extend (root : Bool) (b b' : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w w' d : Usize)
    (hi : Inv root b w d) (hb : w'.val ≤ b'.val.length)
    (s : List Nat) (he : pref b' w' = pref b w ++ s)
    (hc : Canon root (pref b' w')) : Inv root b' w' d := by
  obtain ⟨hw, hd, ho, hdo⟩ := hi
  have hlen := congrArg List.length he
  simp only [List.length_append, pref_length b w hw, pref_length b' w' hb] at hlen
  refine ⟨hb, by omega, hc, ?_⟩
  have ht := congrArg (List.take d.val) he
  rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [pref_length b w hw]; exact hd)] at ht
  rw [pref_take b' w' d.val (by omega), pref_take b w d.val hd] at ht
  change Canon root (nats (b'.val.take d.val))
  rw [ht]
  exact hdo

def separator (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w : Usize) : Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize) := do
  if root then
    if w != 1#usize then do
      let (_,back) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b w
      let w2 ← w + 1#usize
      ok (back 47#u8,w2)
    else ok (b,w)
  else
    if w != 0#usize then do
      let (_,back) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b w
      let w2 ← w + 1#usize
      ok (back 47#u8,w2)
    else ok (b,w)

lemma separator_ok (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize) (hw : w.val ≤ b.val.length)
    (h : separator root b w = ok out) :
    out.2.val ≤ out.1.val.length ∧
    pref out.1 out.2 = pref b w ++ (if w.val = (if root then 1 else 0) then [] else [47]) := by
  unfold separator at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals first
  | (rcases x with ⟨x,f⟩
     obtain ⟨hb, rfl⟩ := mut_ok hx
     change (do let w2 ← w + 1#usize; ok (b.set w 47#u8,w2)) = ok out at h
     h5i_invert h
     have hv := add_ok_val hw2
     simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv
     have hneq : w.val ≠ (if root then 1 else 0) := by split <;> scalar_tac
     dsimp only
     refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
     · simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.set_val_eq, List.length_set]; omega
     · simp only [hneq, if_false]
       exact pref_write b w w2 47#u8 hb hv)
  | (have heq : w.val = (if root then 1 else 0) := by split <;> scalar_tac
     dsimp only
     exact ⟨hw, by simp only [heq, if_true, List.append_nil]⟩)

def ordinary (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w r d : Usize) (p : Slice U8) :
    Result (ControlFlow (Bool × alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize × Usize × Usize) (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize)) := do
  let (b1,w1) ← if root then
    if w != 1#usize then do
      let (_,back) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b w
      let w2 ← w + 1#usize
      ok (back 47#u8,w2)
    else ok (b,w)
  else
    if w != 0#usize then do
      let (_,back) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b w
      let w2 ← w + 1#usize
      ok (back 47#u8,w2)
    else ok (b,w)
  let (b2,w2,r2) ← pathclean.copy_element b1 w1 p r
  ok (ControlFlow.cont (root,b2,w2,r2,d))

def Progress (r : Usize) :
    ControlFlow (Bool × alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize × Usize × Usize) (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize) → Prop
  | .done _ => False
  | .cont x => Inv x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2 ∧ r.val < x.2.2.2.1.val

lemma ordinary_ok (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w r d : Usize) (p : Slice U8)
    (res : ControlFlow (Bool × alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize × Usize × Usize) (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize))
    (hi : Inv root b w d) (hr : r.val < p.val.length)
    (hslash : (nats p.val)[r.val]? ≠ some 47)
    (hdot : (nats p.val)[r.val]? ≠ some 46 ∨
      ((nats p.val)[r.val+1]? ≠ some 47 ∧ r.val+1 ≠ p.val.length))
    (h : ordinary root b w r d p = ok res) : Progress r res := by
  unfold ordinary at h
  rw [← separator] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨b1,w1⟩, hsep, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  obtain ⟨⟨b2,w2,r2⟩, hcopy, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  change ok (ControlFlow.cont (root,b2,w2,r2,d)) = ok res at h
  have heq := result_ok_inj h
  rw [← heq]
  dsimp only [Progress]
  obtain ⟨hwb, hpref⟩ := separator_ok root b w (b1,w1) hi.1 hsep
  dsimp only at hwb hpref
  obtain ⟨s, he, hb2, hr2, hrb, hn, hne, hdot'⟩ := copy_ok b1 w1 p r (b2,w2,r2) hwb hr hslash hcopy
  dsimp only at he hb2 hr2 hrb hdot'
  have hnotdot : s ≠ [46] := by
    intro hs
    obtain ⟨hfirst,hend⟩ := hdot' hs
    rcases hdot with hh | ⟨hh,hh'⟩
    · exact hh hfirst
    · rcases hend with hend | hend
      · exact hh hend
      · exact hh' hend
  have he' : pref b2 w2 = pref b w ++
      ((if w.val = (if root then 1 else 0) then [] else [47]) ++ s) := by
    rw [he, hpref, List.append_assoc]
  have hc := canon_append root (pref b w) s hi.2.2.1 ⟨hne,hnotdot⟩ hn
  rw [pref_length b w hi.1] at hc
  rw [List.append_assoc, ← he'] at hc
  exact ⟨inv_extend root b b2 w w2 d hi hb2 _ he' hc, hr2⟩

def relativeSep (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w : Usize) : Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize) := do
  if w > 0#usize then
    let (_,back) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b w
    let w2 ← w + 1#usize
    ok (back 47#u8,w2)
  else ok (b,w)

lemma relativeSep_eq (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w : Usize) : relativeSep b w = separator false b w := by
  unfold relativeSep separator
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  by_cases hp : w > 0#usize
  · have he : (w != 0#usize) = true := by scalar_tac
    simp only [hp, he, if_true]
  · have hw : w = 0#usize := by scalar_tac
    have he : (w != 0#usize) = false := by simp only [hw, bne_self_eq_false]
    simp only [hp, he, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]

def dots (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w rNext : Usize) :
    Result (ControlFlow (Bool × alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize × Usize × Usize) (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize)) := do
  let (_,back) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b w
  let w2 ← w + 1#usize
  let b2 := back 46#u8
  let (_,back1) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b2 w2
  let w3 ← w2 + 1#usize
  ok (ControlFlow.cont (false,back1 46#u8,w3,rNext,w3))

lemma dots_ok (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w rNext : Usize) (res)
    (h : dots b w rNext = ok res) :
    ∃ b' w', res = ControlFlow.cont (false,b',w',rNext,w') ∧
      w'.val ≤ b'.val.length ∧ pref b' w' = pref b w ++ [46,46] := by
  unfold dots at h
  obtain ⟨⟨x,f⟩, hx, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  obtain ⟨hb, rfl⟩ := mut_ok hx
  obtain ⟨w2, hw2, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  obtain ⟨⟨x1,f1⟩, hx1, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  obtain ⟨hb1, rfl⟩ := mut_ok hx1
  obtain ⟨w3, hw3, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  change ok (ControlFlow.cont (false,(b.set w 46#u8).set w2 46#u8,w3,rNext,w3)) = ok res at h
  refine ⟨_, w3, (result_ok_inj h).symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  have hv2 := add_ok_val hw2
  have hv3 := add_ok_val hw3
  simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv2 hv3
  · simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.set_val_eq, List.length_set] at hb1 ⊢
    have hv3 := add_ok_val hw3
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv3
    omega
  · have hv2 := add_ok_val hw2
    have hv3 := add_ok_val hw3
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv2 hv3
    rw [pref_write _ w2 w3 46#u8 hb1 hv3, pref_write b w w2 46#u8 hb hv2]
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]

def parent (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w rNext d : Usize) :
    Result (ControlFlow (Bool × alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize × Usize × Usize) (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize)) := do
  if w > d then
    let w1 ← w - 1#usize
    let w2 ← pathclean.back_to_slash (alloc.vec.Vec.deref b) w1 d
    ok (ControlFlow.cont (root,b,w2,rNext,d))
  else if root then ok (ControlFlow.cont (true,b,w,rNext,d))
  else
    let (b1,w1) ← if w > 0#usize then do
      let (_,back) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b w
      let w2 ← w + 1#usize
      ok (back 47#u8,w2)
    else ok (b,w)
    let (_,back) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b1 w1
    let w2 ← w1 + 1#usize
    let b2 := back 46#u8
    let (_,back1) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) b2 w2
    let w3 ← w2 + 1#usize
    ok (ControlFlow.cont (false,back1 46#u8,w3,rNext,w3))

lemma parent_ok (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w r rNext d : Usize) (res)
    (hi : Inv root b w d) (hr : r.val < rNext.val)
    (h : parent root b w rNext d = ok res) : Progress r res := by
  unfold parent at h
  simp only [← relativeSep.eq_def, ← dots.eq_def] at h
  h5i_invert h
  · exact ⟨inv_back root b w d w1 w2 hi hc hw1 hw2, hr⟩
  · simpa only [Progress, hc_1] using And.intro hi hr
  · rcases x with ⟨b1,w1⟩
    change dots b1 w1 rNext = ok res at h
    have hroot : root = false := by cases root <;> simp_all
    subst root
    obtain ⟨b2,w2,he,hb2,hpref⟩ := dots_ok b1 w1 rNext res h
    rw [he]
    dsimp only [Progress]
    rw [relativeSep_eq] at hx
    obtain ⟨hb1,hp1⟩ := separator_ok false b w (b1,w1) hi.1 hx
    dsimp only at hb1 hp1
    have hcanon := canon_append false (pref b w) [46,46] hi.2.2.1 (by simp) (by simp)
    rw [pref_length b w hi.1] at hcanon
    have hc : Canon false (pref b2 w2) := by
      rw [hpref,hp1]
      exact hcanon
    exact ⟨⟨hb2, by omega, hc, hc⟩,hr⟩

def Measured (r : Usize) :
    ControlFlow (Bool × alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize × Usize × Usize) (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize) → Prop
  | .done y => ∃ root, y.2.val ≤ y.1.val.length ∧ Canon root (pref y.1 y.2)
  | .cont x => Inv x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2 ∧ Usize.max - x.2.2.2.1.val < Usize.max - r.val

lemma progress_measure (r : Usize) (res) (h : Progress r res) : Measured r res := by
  cases res with
  | done y => exact False.elim h
  | cont x =>
    exact ⟨h.1, by have hb := x.2.2.2.1.hBounds; dsimp [Progress] at h; scalar_tac⟩

lemma index_ne {p : Slice U8} {r : Usize} {x c : U8}
    (h : p.index_usize r = ok x) (hc : x ≠ c) : (nats p.val)[r.val]? ≠ some c.val := by
  rw [index_nat h]
  intro he
  have he := Option.some.inj he
  exact hc ((u8_eq_iff x c).mpr he)

lemma main_loop_ok (p : Slice U8) (n : Usize) (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (w r d : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize) (hn : n.val = p.val.length)
    (hi : Inv root b w d) (h : pathclean.clean_loop0 p n root b w r d = ok out) :
    ∃ root', out.2.val ≤ out.1.val.length ∧ Canon root' (pref out.1 out.2) := by
  unfold pathclean.clean_loop0 at h
  apply loop_ok _ (fun (root,b,w,r,d) => Inv root b w d)
    (fun out => ∃ root', out.2.val ≤ out.1.val.length ∧ Canon root' (pref out.1 out.2))
    (fun (root,b,w,r,d) => Usize.max - r.val) ?_ (root,b,w,r,d) out hi h
  rintro ⟨root,b,w,r,d⟩ res hi hs
  dsimp only at hi ⊢
  unfold pathclean.clean_loop0.body at hs
  simp only [← ordinary.eq_def, ← parent.eq_def] at hs
  h5i_invert hs
  · exact ⟨hi, by h5i_arith⟩
  · exact ⟨hi, by h5i_arith⟩
  · exact ⟨hi, by h5i_arith⟩
  · have hp := parent_ok root b w r i4 d res hi (by h5i_arith) hs
    cases res <;> exact progress_measure r _ hp
  · have hp := parent_ok root b w r i4 d res hi (by h5i_arith) hs
    cases res <;> exact progress_measure r _ hp
  · suffices hp : Progress r res by cases res <;> exact progress_measure r _ hp
    apply ordinary_ok root b w r d p res hi (by scalar_tac)
      (index_ne hi_1 hc_1)
    · right
      refine ⟨?_, by h5i_arith⟩
      have hnxt := index_ne hi2 hc_4
      have hv := add_ok_val hi1
      simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv
      simpa only [hv, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hnxt
    · exact hs
  · suffices hp : Progress r res by cases res <;> exact progress_measure r _ hp
    apply ordinary_ok root b w r d p res hi (by scalar_tac)
      (index_ne hi_1 hc_1)
    · right
      refine ⟨?_, by h5i_arith⟩
      have hnxt := index_ne hi2 hc_4
      have hv := add_ok_val hi1
      simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv
      simpa only [hv, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hnxt
    · exact hs
  · have hp := ordinary_ok root b w r d p res hi (by scalar_tac)
      (index_ne hi_1 hc_1) (Or.inl (index_ne hi_1 hc_2)) hs
    cases res <;> exact progress_measure r _ hp
  · exact ⟨root,hi.1,hi.2.2.1⟩

lemma output_ok (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w : Usize) (c : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : pathclean.clean_loop1 b w (alloc.vec.Vec.new U8) 0#usize = ok c) :
    c.val = b.val.take w.val := by
  unfold pathclean.clean_loop1 at h
  apply loop_ok _ (fun (out,i) => i.val ≤ w.val ∧ out.val = b.val.take i.val)
    (fun out => out.val = b.val.take w.val) (fun (out,i) => w.val-i.val)
    ?_ (alloc.vec.Vec.new U8, 0#usize) c (by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new]) h

abbrev slash : U8 := 47#u8
abbrev dot : U8 := 46#u8

def base (root : Bool) : List U8 := if root then [slash] else []
def sep (root : Bool) (xs : List U8) : List U8 :=
  if xs.length = (base root).length then [] else [slash]
def Segment (s : List U8) : Prop :=
  s ≠ [] ∧ slash ∉ s ∧ s ≠ [dot] ∧ s ≠ [dot, dot]

/-- Canonical prefixes, with the end of the leading parent segments recorded. -/
inductive Normal : Bool → Nat → List U8 → Prop
  | start (root) : Normal root (base root).length (base root)
  | part {root d xs s} : Normal root d xs → Segment s →
      Normal root d (xs ++ sep root xs ++ s)
  | parent {xs} : Normal false xs.length xs →
      Normal false (xs ++ sep false xs ++ [dot, dot]).length
        (xs ++ sep false xs ++ [dot, dot])

lemma normal_bounds {root d xs} (h : Normal root d xs) :
    (base root).length ≤ d ∧ d ≤ xs.length := by
  induction h with
  | start => simp
  | part h hs ih => simp only [List.length_append]; omega
  | parent h ih => simp only [List.length_append]; omega

lemma normal_cut_d {root d xs} (h : Normal root d xs) :
    Normal root d (xs.take d) := by
  induction h with
  | start root => simpa using Normal.start root
  | @part root d xs s h hs ih =>
      rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by have := normal_bounds h; simp; omega),
        List.take_append_of_le_length (normal_bounds h).2]
      exact ih
  | parent h ih =>
      rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp)]
      exact Normal.parent h

lemma get_mem {α} {xs : List α} {i : Nat} {x : α} (h : xs[i]? = some x) : x ∈ xs :=
  List.mem_of_getElem? h

lemma normal_cut_slash {root d xs} (h : Normal root d xs) :
    ∀ j, d ≤ j → j < xs.length → xs[j]? = some slash → Normal root d (xs.take j) := by
  induction h with
  | start root => intro j hd hj; omega
  | parent h ih => intro j hd hj; omega
  | @part root d xs s hn hs ih =>
      intro j hd hj he
      by_cases hjx : j < xs.length
      · rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by simp; omega),
          List.getElem?_append_left hjx] at he
        rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by simp; omega),
          List.take_append_of_le_length (by omega)]
        exact ih j hd hjx he
      · by_cases hjp : j < (xs ++ sep root xs).length
        · have hsep : sep root xs = [slash] := by
            unfold sep at *
            split at hjp <;> simp_all <;> omega
          have hj' : j = xs.length := by simp [hsep] at hjp; omega
          subst j

          exact hn

          exact False.elim (hs.2.1 (get_mem he))

  rw [List.take_add_one, List.take_set_of_le (by omega)]
  simp [List.getElem?_set, h]

    h.2.symm⟩

    (fun u => d.val ≤ u.val ∧ u.val ≤ w.val ∧

    (fun x => x.val) ?_ w u ⟨hd, by omega⟩ h
  intro x z hx hz
  unfold pathclean.back_to_slash_loop.body at hz
  h5i_invert hz
  all_goals h5i_ok_facts
  all_goals simp only [gt_iff_lt, UScalar.lt_equiv, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at *

lemma read_ok {p : Slice U8} {r : Usize} {x : U8}
    (h : p.index_usize r = ok x) : p.val[r.val]? = some x := by
  obtain ⟨hr, he⟩ := slice_index_ok h
  simp [← he]

lemma copy_ok (p : Slice U8) (buf b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w r v t : Usize)
    (hr : r.val ≤ p.val.length) (hw : w.val ≤ buf.val.length)
    (h : pathclean.copy_element buf w p r = ok (b, v, t)) :
    ∃ s : List U8,
      b.val.take v.val = buf.val.take w.val ++ s ∧
      s = (p.val.drop r.val).take (t.val - r.val) ∧

    r.val ≤ x.2.2.val ∧ x.2.2.val ≤ p.val.length ∧

    (fun x => p.val.length - x.2.2.val) ?_ (buf, w, r) (b, v, t) ?_ h

    · obtain ⟨a, back⟩ := x

      h5i_invert hz

      have hi : i1 = slash := by scalar_tac
