import Verified.RustfsConditionEval
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCondData
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete (deref_val)

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionEquality

theorem allM_eq {T : Type} [DecidableEq T] (inst : core.cmp.PartialEq T T) [EqLaw inst]
    (l : List (T × T)) :
    List.allM (fun p => inst.eq p.1 p.2) l = ok (l.all (fun p => decide (p.1 = p.2))) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p ps ih =>
    simp only [List.allM] 
    rw [EqLaw.eq_ok, ih]
    by_cases hh : p.1 = p.2 <;> simp [hh] <;> rfl

theorem zip_eq {T : Type} [DecidableEq T] (a b : List T) (hl : a.length = b.length) :
    (a.zip b).all (fun p => decide (p.1 = p.2)) = decide (a = b) := by
  induction a generalizing b with
  | nil => cases b <;> simp_all
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases b with
    | nil => simp at hl
    | cons y ys =>
      simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hl
      simp [List.zip_cons_cons, ih ys hl]

theorem vec_eq_law {T : Type} [DecidableEq T] (inst : core.cmp.PartialEq T T) [EqLaw inst]
    (a b : alloc.vec.Vec T) :
    alloc.vec.partial_eq.PartialEqVec.eq inst a b = ok (decide (a.val = b.val)) := by
  unfold alloc.vec.partial_eq.PartialEqVec.eq
  split
  · rename_i hl
    change List.allM (fun p => inst.eq p.1 p.2) (a.val.zip b.val) = _
    rw [allM_eq, zip_eq _ _ hl]
  · rename_i hl
    have hn : a.val ≠ b.val := fun hh => hl (congrArg List.length hh)
    simp [hn]

theorem binary_eq_ok (a b : conddata.BinaryFuncValue) (r : Bool)
    (h : conddata.binary_eq a b = ok r) : (r = true ↔ a.decoded.val = b.decoded.val) := by
  unfold conddata.binary_eq at h
  rw [vec_eq_law] at h
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst r; simp

theorem string_inner_ok (a b : conddata.InnerFunc (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (r : Bool) (h : conddata.string_inner_eq a b = ok r) : (r = true ↔ SameStringCondition a b) := by
  unfold conddata.string_inner_eq at h
  by_cases hl : a.entries.val.length = b.entries.val.length
  · have hl' : a.entries.len = b.entries.len := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simpa using hl
    simp only [hl', bne_self_eq_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h
    unfold conddata.string_inner_eq_loop at h
    unfold SameStringCondition
    simp only [hl, true_and]
    refine all_loop (a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val) SameStringEntry _ (fun i r hi hr => ?_) r h
    have hlen : (a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val).length = a.entries.val.length := by simp [hl]
    unfold conddata.string_inner_eq_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    all_goals try
      have hlt : i.val < a.entries.val.length := by scalar_tac
      have hrt : i.val < b.entries.val.length := by omega
      have hf := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hfkv
      have hg := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hfkv1
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at hf
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hrt] at hg
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hf hg
      have hzip : (a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val)[i.val]'(by omega) = (fkv, fkv1) := by
        simp only [List.getElem_zip, hf, hg]
      have hk := key_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.key_eq _ _ = ok _)
      try have hs := string_set_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.string_set_eq _ _ = ok _)
      try simp only [deref_val] at hs
    · refine ⟨by omega, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
      rw [hzip]; exact ⟨hk.1 hc_1, hs.1 hc_2⟩
    · refine .inl ⟨by omega, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [hzip]; intro hh; exact hc_2 (hs.2 hh.2)
    · refine .inl ⟨by omega, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [hzip]; intro hh; exact hc_1 (hk.2 hh.1)
    · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩
  · have hl' : a.entries.len ≠ b.entries.len := by intro hh; apply hl; exact congrArg UScalar.val hh
    simp [hl', bne_iff_ne] at h
    subst r; simp [SameStringCondition, hl]
theorem num_inner_ok (a b : conddata.InnerFunc I64)
    (r : Bool) (h : conddata.num_inner_eq a b = ok r) : (r = true ↔ SameNumberCondition a b) := by
  unfold conddata.num_inner_eq at h
  by_cases hl : a.entries.val.length = b.entries.val.length
  · have hl' : a.entries.len = b.entries.len := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simpa using hl
    simp only [hl', bne_self_eq_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h
    unfold conddata.num_inner_eq_loop at h
    unfold SameNumberCondition
    simp only [hl, true_and]
    refine all_loop (a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val) SameNumberEntry _ (fun i r hi hr => ?_) r h
    have hlen : (a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val).length = a.entries.val.length := by simp [hl]
    unfold conddata.num_inner_eq_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    all_goals try
      have hlt : i.val < a.entries.val.length := by scalar_tac
      have hrt : i.val < b.entries.val.length := by omega
      have hf := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hfkv
      have hg := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hfkv1
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at hf
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hrt] at hg
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hf hg
      have hzip : (a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val)[i.val]'(by omega) = (fkv, fkv1) := by
        simp only [List.getElem_zip, hf, hg]
      have hk := key_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.key_eq _ _ = ok _)

    · refine .inl ⟨by omega, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [hzip]; intro hh
      have hh' : fkv.values = fkv1.values := hh.2
      simp [hh'] at hc_2
    · refine ⟨by omega, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
      rw [hzip]; refine ⟨hk.1 hc_1, ?_⟩
      apply IScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simpa using hc_2
    · refine .inl ⟨by omega, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [hzip]; intro hh; exact hc_1 (hk.2 hh.1)
    · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩
  · have hl' : a.entries.len ≠ b.entries.len := by intro hh; apply hl; exact congrArg UScalar.val hh
    simp [hl', bne_iff_ne] at h
    subst r; simp [SameNumberCondition, hl]
theorem date_inner_ok (a b : conddata.InnerFunc conddata.DateFuncValue)
    (r : Bool) (h : conddata.date_inner_eq a b = ok r) : (r = true ↔ SameDateCondition a b) := by
  unfold conddata.date_inner_eq at h
  by_cases hl : a.entries.val.length = b.entries.val.length
  · have hl' : a.entries.len = b.entries.len := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simpa using hl
    simp only [hl', bne_self_eq_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h

    have hlen : (a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val).length = a.entries.val.length := by simp [hl]
    unfold conddata.date_inner_eq_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    all_goals try
      have hlt : i.val < a.entries.val.length := by scalar_tac
      have hrt : i.val < b.entries.val.length := by omega
      have hf := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hfkv

      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at hf
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hrt] at hg
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hf hg
      have hzip : (a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val)[i.val]'(by omega) = (fkv, fkv1) := by
        simp only [List.getElem_zip, hf, hg]

    · refine .inl ⟨by omega, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [hzip]; intro hh
      have hh' : fkv.values.unix_nanos = fkv1.values.unix_nanos := hh.2
      simp [hh'] at hc_2
    · refine ⟨by omega, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
      rw [hzip]; refine ⟨hk.1 hc_1, ?_⟩
      apply IScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simpa using hc_2
    · refine .inl ⟨by omega, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [hzip]; intro hh; exact hc_1 (hk.2 hh.1)
    · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩
  · have hl' : a.entries.len ≠ b.entries.len := by intro hh; apply hl; exact congrArg UScalar.val hh
    simp [hl', bne_iff_ne] at h
    subst r; simp [SameDateCondition, hl]

theorem binary_inner_ok (a b : conddata.InnerFunc conddata.BinaryFuncValue)
    (r : Bool) (h : conddata.binary_inner_eq a b = ok r) : (r = true ↔ SameBinaryCondition a b) := by
  unfold conddata.binary_inner_eq at h

  · have hl' : a.entries.len = b.entries.len := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simpa using hl

      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hrt] at hg

      have hzip : (a.entries.val.zip b.entries.val)[i.val]'(by omega) = (fkv, fkv1) := by
        simp only [List.getElem_zip, hf, hg]

    · refine ⟨by omega, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
      rw [hzip]; exact ⟨hk.1 hc_1, hs.1 hc_2⟩

  · have hl' : a.entries.len ≠ b.entries.len := by intro hh; apply hl; exact congrArg UScalar.val hh

import Verified.RustfsCondData
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCondData
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsValids (any_loop)
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBytes (slice_ok push_ok)
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete (bytes_eq_ok deref_val lift_slice)

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionEval

theorem concat_ok (a b : Slice U8) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (h : bytes.concat a b = ok v) :
    v.val = a.val ++ b.val := by
  unfold bytes.concat at h
  obtain ⟨out, hout, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  have hout' := slice_ok _ _ _ _ hout
  simp only [Slice.len_val, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.take_length, List.drop_zero] at hout'
  unfold bytes.concat_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize => x.2.val ≤ b.val.length ∧
      x.1.val = a.val ++ b.val.take x.2.val)
    (fun v => v.val = a.val ++ b.val) (fun x => b.val.length - x.2.val) ?_ _ v
    ⟨by simp, by simpa using hout'⟩ h
  rintro ⟨out, i⟩ r ⟨hi, ho⟩ hr
  unfold bytes.concat_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hp := push_ok hout1
    have hadd := add_ok_val hi3
    refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
    rw [hp, ho, show i3.val = i.val + 1 by scalar_tac,
      List.take_add_one, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt, he]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  · rw [List.take_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)] at ho
    exact ho

theorem lookup_name_ok (k : condfuncs.Key) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : condfuncs.key_lookup_name k = ok v) : v.val = LookupName k := by
  unfold condfuncs.key_lookup_name at h
  cases hv : k.variable with
  | none =>
    simp only [hv, u8vec_clone, Result.ok.injEq] at h
    subst v; simp [LookupName, hv]
  | some suffix =>
    simp only [hv] at h
    h5i_invert h
    have hs : s1.val = [47#u8] := by
      simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at hs1
      subst s1; rfl
    have h1 := concat_ok _ _ _ hv1
    have h2 := concat_ok _ _ _ h
    simp only [deref_val] at h1 h2
    rw [h2, h1, hs]
    simp [LookupName, hv]

theorem get_value_present_ok
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (needle : Slice U8) (o : Option (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (h : condfuncs.get_value values needle = ok o) :
    (o.isSome = true ↔ ∃ e ∈ values.val, e.1.val = needle.val) := by
  unfold condfuncs.get_value condfuncs.get_value_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ values.val.length ∧
      ∀ e ∈ values.val.take i.val, e.1.val ≠ needle.val)
    (fun o => o.isSome = true ↔ ∃ e ∈ values.val, e.1.val = needle.val)
    (fun i => values.val.length - i.val) ?_ _ o ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ h
  rintro i r ⟨hi, hx⟩ hr
  unfold condfuncs.get_value_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨v, vs⟩
    change (do
      let equal ← bytes.eq v.deref needle
      if equal then
        let copied ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone (core.clone.CloneallocvecVec core.clone.CloneU8) vs
        ok (ControlFlow.done (some copied))
      else
        let next ← i + 1#usize
        ok (ControlFlow.cont next)) = ok r at hr
    have he := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hx_1
    have hlt : i.val < values.val.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at he
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at he
    h5i_invert hr
    · have hb := bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : bytes.eq _ _ = ok _)
      simp only [deref_val] at hb
      simp only [Option.isSome_some, true_iff]
      refine ⟨values.val[i.val], List.getElem_mem hlt, ?_⟩
      rw [he]; exact hb.1 (by assumption)
    · have hb := bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : bytes.eq _ _ = ok _)
      simp only [deref_val] at hb
      have hadd := add_ok_val hnext
      refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
      intro e hh
      rw [show next.val = i.val + 1 by scalar_tac, List.take_add_one,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at hh
      simp only [Option.toList_some, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hh
      rcases hh with hh | rfl
      · exact hx e hh
      · rw [he]; intro hh; exact hc_1 (hb.2 hh)
  · simp only [Option.isSome_none, Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    rw [List.take_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)] at hx
    rintro ⟨e, he, hh⟩; exact hx e he hh

theorem inner_has_value_ok {T : Type} (f : conddata.InnerFunc T)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (b : Bool) (h : conddata.inner_has_value f values = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ ∃ e ∈ f.entries.val, ∃ v ∈ values.val, v.1.val = LookupName e.key) := by
  unfold conddata.inner_has_value conddata.inner_has_value_loop at h
  refine any_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold conddata.inner_has_value_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have he := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hfkv
    have hlt : i.val < f.entries.val.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at he
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at he
    have hn := lookup_name_ok _ _ hv
    have hp := get_value_present_ok _ _ _ ho
    simp only [deref_val] at hp
    refine .inl ⟨hlt, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [he]; dsimp only; rw [← hn]; exact hp.1 hc_1
  · have he := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hfkv
    have hlt : i.val < f.entries.val.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at he
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at he
    have hn := lookup_name_ok _ _ hv
    have hp := get_value_present_ok _ _ _ ho
    simp only [deref_val] at hp
    refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
    rw [he]; dsimp only; rw [← hn]; intro hh; exact hc_1 (hp.2 hh)
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩

theorem has_any_key_ok (c : conddata.Condition)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (b : Bool) (h : conddata.has_any_key_in c values = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ RequestHasConditionKey c values) := by
  unfold conddata.has_any_key_in at h
  unfold RequestHasConditionKey ConditionLookupNames
  cases hd : c.data <;> simp only [hd] at h ⊢ <;>
    rw [inner_has_value_ok _ _ _ h]
  all_goals
    simp only [List.mem_map]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨e, he, entry, hv, hsame⟩
      exact ⟨LookupName e.key, ⟨e, he, rfl⟩, entry, hv, hsame⟩
    · rintro ⟨needle, ⟨e, he, rfl⟩, entry, hv, hsame⟩
      exact ⟨e, he, entry, hv, hsame⟩

/-- An IfExists condition accepts a request with none of its named keys. -/
theorem missing_wrapped_key_ok (c : conddata.Condition) (q : condfuncs.Quantifier)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (ctx : Option awsvars.VarContext) (env : condfuncs.Env) (b : Bool)
    (hw : 0 < c.wrappers.val) (hm : ¬ RequestHasConditionKey c values)
    (h : conddata.condition_evaluate c q values ctx env = ok b) : b = true := by
  unfold conddata.condition_evaluate at h
  have hw' : c.wrappers > 0#usize := by scalar_tac
  simp only [hw', ↓reduceIte] at h
  obtain ⟨present, hp, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  have hn := has_any_key_ok c values present hp
  have hfalse : present = false := by
    cases present with
    | false => rfl
    | true => exact False.elim (hm (hn.1 rfl))
  simp only [hfalse, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Result.ok.injEq] at h
  exact h.symm

theorem key_names_ok {T : Type} (f : conddata.InnerFunc T)
    (names : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (h : conddata.key_names f = ok names) :
    names.val.map (·.val) = f.entries.val.map (fun e => LookupName e.key) := by
  unfold conddata.key_names conddata.key_names_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Usize =>
      x.2.val ≤ f.entries.val.length ∧ x.1.val.map (·.val) =
        (f.entries.val.take x.2.val).map (fun e => LookupName e.key))
    (fun names => names.val.map (·.val) = f.entries.val.map (fun e => LookupName e.key))
    (fun x => f.entries.val.length - x.2.val) ?_ _ names ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ h
  rintro ⟨names, i⟩ r ⟨hi, hn⟩ hr
  unfold conddata.key_names_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have he := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hfkv
    have hlt : i.val < f.entries.val.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at he
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at he
    have hk := lookup_name_ok _ _ hv
    have hp := push_ok hnames1
    have hadd := add_ok_val hi2
    refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
    rw [hp, List.map_append, hn, show i2.val = i.val + 1 by scalar_tac,
      List.take_add_one, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt, List.map_append]
    simp only [Option.toList_some, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, he, hk]
  · rw [List.take_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)] at hn
    exact hn

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionEval

import Verified.RustfsCompleteConditionEquality
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsValids (any_loop)
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCondData
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCompleteConditionEquality
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete (deref_val)

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionGroups
 theorem contains_ok (xs : Slice conddata.Condition) (c : conddata.Condition) (b : Bool)
    (h : conddata.contains_condition xs c = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ ∃ d ∈ xs.val, SameCondition d c) := by
  unfold conddata.contains_condition conddata.contains_condition_loop at h
  refine any_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold conddata.contains_condition_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : Slice.index_usize _ _ = ok _)
    have hk := condition_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.condition_eq _ _ = ok _)
    exact .inl ⟨hlt, by rw [he]; exact hk.1 (by assumption), rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : Slice.index_usize _ _ = ok _)
    have hk := condition_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.condition_eq _ _ = ok _)
    refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
    rw [he]; intro hh; exact (by assumption : _ ≠ true) (hk.2 hh)
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩

theorem covers_ok (l r : Slice conddata.Condition) (b : Bool)
    (h : conddata.list_covers l r = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ ConditionGroupCovered l.val r.val) := by
  unfold conddata.list_covers conddata.list_covers_loop at h
  refine all_loop _ _ _ (fun i res _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold conddata.list_covers_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : Slice.index_usize _ _ = ok _)
    have hk := contains_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.contains_condition _ _ = ok _)
    refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
    rw [he]; exact hk.1 (by assumption)
  · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : Slice.index_usize _ _ = ok _)
    have hk := contains_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.contains_condition _ _ = ok _)
    refine .inl ⟨hlt, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [he]; intro hh; exact (by assumption : _ ≠ true) (hk.2 hh)
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩

theorem functions_eq_ok (a b : conddata.Functions) (r : Bool)
    (h : conddata.functions_eq a b = ok r) : (r = true ↔ ConditionGroupsMatch a b) := by
  unfold conddata.functions_eq at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals try have ha := covers_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.list_covers (alloc.vec.Vec.deref a.for_any_value) _ = ok _)
  all_goals try have hb := covers_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.list_covers (alloc.vec.Vec.deref a.for_all_values) _ = ok _)
  all_goals try have hc := covers_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.list_covers (alloc.vec.Vec.deref a.for_normal) _ = ok _)
  all_goals simp_all [ConditionGroupsMatch, deref_val]
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionGroups

import Verified.RustfsOperatorLookup
import SpecConditionKeys
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit

open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsValids (any_loop)
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionKeys
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
theorem named_ok {T : Type} (funcs : Slice (condfuncs.Key × T)) (needle : Slice U8)
    (b : Bool) (h : condfuncs.keys_named funcs needle = ok b) :
    b=true ↔ ∃ entry ∈ funcs.val, entry.1.key_name.val=needle.val := by
  unfold condfuncs.keys_named condfuncs.keys_named_loop at h
  refine any_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold condfuncs.keys_named_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨key,payload⟩
    change (do
      let equal ← bytes.eq key.key_name.deref needle
      if equal then ok (ControlFlow.done true)
      else do
        let next ← i + 1#usize
        ok (ControlFlow.cont next)) = ok r at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hx
      have hm := bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : bytes.eq _ _ = ok _)
      simp only [deref_val] at hm
      exact .inl ⟨hlt,by rw [he]; exact hm.1 (by assumption),rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hx
      have hm := bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : bytes.eq _ _ = ok _)
      simp only [deref_val] at hm
      refine ⟨hlt,?_,by have := add_ok_val (by assumption : i + 1#usize = ok _); scalar_tac⟩
      rw [he]; intro hh; exact (by assumption : _ ≠ true) (hm.2 hh)
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac,rfl⟩
theorem present_ok {T : Type} (funcs : Slice (condfuncs.Key × T))
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (b : Bool) (h : condfuncs.keys_present funcs values = ok b) :
    b=true ↔ ∃ entry ∈ funcs.val, ∃ request ∈ values.val,
      request.1.val = LookupName entry.1 := by
  unfold condfuncs.keys_present condfuncs.keys_present_loop at h
  refine any_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold condfuncs.keys_present_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨key,payload⟩
    change (do
      let lookup ← condfuncs.key_lookup_name key
      let found ← condfuncs.get_value values lookup.deref
      match found with
      | none => do
        let next ← i + 1#usize
        ok (ControlFlow.cont next)
      | some _ => ok (ControlFlow.done true)) = ok r at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    all_goals obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hx
    all_goals have hn := RustfsConditionEval.lookup_name_ok _ _ (by assumption : condfuncs.key_lookup_name _ = ok _)
    all_goals have hp := RustfsConditionEval.get_value_present_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : condfuncs.get_value _ _ = ok _)
    all_goals simp only [deref_val,hn,Option.isSome_none,Option.isSome_some,Bool.false_eq_true,false_iff,true_iff] at hp
    · refine ⟨hlt,?_,by have := add_ok_val (by assumption : i + 1#usize = ok _); scalar_tac⟩
      rw [he]; exact hp
    · exact .inl ⟨hlt,by rw [he]; exact hp,rfl⟩
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac,rfl⟩

theorem has_key_ok (c : condfuncs.Cond)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (b : Bool) (h : condfuncs.has_any_key_in c values = ok b) :
    b=true ↔ OperatorKeyPresent c (RequestValueLists values.val) := by
  unfold condfuncs.has_any_key_in at h
  cases c <;> rw [present_ok _ _ _ h]
  all_goals simp [OperatorKeyPresent,OperatorKeys,RequestValueLists,List.mem_map,deref_val]

theorem references_ok (c : condfuncs.Cond) (needle : Slice U8) (b : Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.cond_references c needle = ok b) :
    b=true ↔ OperatorReferences c needle.val := by
  unfold condfuncs.cond_references at h
  cases c <;> rw [named_ok _ _ _ h]
  all_goals simp [OperatorReferences,OperatorKeys,List.mem_map,deref_val]

theorem group_ok (cs : Slice condfuncs.Condition) (needle : Slice U8) (b : Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.any_references cs needle = ok b) :
    b=true ↔ ∃ c ∈ cs.val, OperatorReferences c.cond needle.val := by
  unfold condfuncs.any_references condfuncs.any_references_loop at h
  refine any_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold condfuncs.any_references_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : cs.index_usize i = ok _)
    have hm := references_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : condfuncs.cond_references _ _ = ok _)
    exact .inl ⟨hlt,by rw [he]; exact hm.1 (by assumption),rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : cs.index_usize i = ok _)
    have hm := references_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : condfuncs.cond_references _ _ = ok _)
    refine ⟨hlt,?_,by have := add_ok_val (by assumption : i + 1#usize = ok _); scalar_tac⟩
    rw [he]; exact fun hh => (by assumption : _ ≠ true) (hm.2 hh)
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac,rfl⟩

theorem functions_ok (f : condfuncs.Functions) (needle : Slice U8) (b : Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.references_key_name f needle = ok b) :
    b=true ↔ FunctionsReference f needle.val := by
  unfold condfuncs.references_key_name at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals have ha := group_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : condfuncs.any_references f.for_any_value.deref needle = ok _)
  all_goals try have hb := group_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : condfuncs.any_references f.for_all_values.deref needle = ok _)
  all_goals try have hc := group_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : condfuncs.any_references f.for_normal.deref needle = ok _)
  all_goals simp_all [FunctionsReference,List.mem_append,or_and_right,exists_or,deref_val]
  all_goals grind
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionKeys

import Verified.RustfsConditionEval
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionLookupContents

theorem get_contents_ok
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (needle : Slice U8) (v : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h : condfuncs.get_value values needle = ok (some v)) :
    ∃ e ∈ values.val, e.1.val = needle.val ∧ e.2 = v := by
  unfold condfuncs.get_value condfuncs.get_value_loop at h
  have hh : ∀ w, (some v : Option (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))) = some w →
      ∃ e ∈ values.val, e.1.val = needle.val ∧ e.2 = w := by
    refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ values.val.length)
      (fun o => ∀ w, o = some w → ∃ e ∈ values.val, e.1.val = needle.val ∧ e.2 = w)
      (fun i => values.val.length - i.val) ?_ _ (some v) (by simp) h
    intro i r hi hr
    unfold condfuncs.get_value_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · rcases x with ⟨v, vs⟩
      change (do
        let equal ← bytes.eq v.deref needle
        if equal then
          let copied ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone (core.clone.CloneallocvecVec core.clone.CloneU8) vs
          ok (ControlFlow.done (some copied))
        else
          let next ← i + 1#usize
          ok (ControlFlow.cont next)) = ok r at hr
      have he := vec_index_slice_ok_get? (by assumption : alloc.vec.Vec.index _ values i = ok (v,vs))
      have hlt : i.val < values.val.length := by scalar_tac
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at he
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at he
      h5i_invert hr
      · intro w hw
        have hb := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hequal
        simp only [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hb
        have hc := post_of_ok (CloneLaw.vec_clone_spec _ vs) hcopied
        refine ⟨(v, vs), ?_, hb.1 hc_1, hc.symm.trans (Option.some.inj hw)⟩
        rw [← he]
        exact List.getElem_mem hlt
      · have hadd := add_ok_val hnext
        exact ⟨by scalar_tac, by scalar_tac⟩
    · intro w hw; cases hw
  exact hh v rfl
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionLookupContents

import Verified.RustfsConditionEval

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec

open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionEval

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionNames
 theorem op_name_ok (op : conddata.Op) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : conddata.op_name op = ok v) : nats v.val = lit (OpSpelling op) := by
  cases op <;> simp only [conddata.op_name, conddata.op_name_late] at h <;> h5i_invert h
  all_goals
    rw [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCleanCanonical.to_vec_ok s v h, lift_slice hs]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, OpSpelling]
    decide +kernel
theorem suffixed_key_ok (c : conddata.Condition) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : conddata.to_key_with_suffix c = ok v) : nats v.val = ConditionKeyName c := by
  unfold conddata.to_key_with_suffix at h
  obtain ⟨base, hb, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  have hb' := op_name_ok c.op base hb
  unfold conddata.to_key_with_suffix_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize => x.2.val ≤ c.wrappers.val ∧
      nats x.1.val = lit (OpSpelling c.op) ++ (List.replicate x.2.val (lit "IfExists")).flatten)
    (fun v => nats v.val = ConditionKeyName c) (fun x => c.wrappers.val - x.2.val)
    ?_ _ v ⟨by simp, by simpa using hb'⟩ h
  rintro ⟨nm, i⟩ r ⟨hi, hn⟩ hr
  unfold conddata.to_key_with_suffix_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have hcat := concat_ok _ _ _ hname1
    have hs := lift_slice hs1
    have hadd := add_ok_val hi2
    refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
    simp only [deref_val] at hcat
    rw [hcat]
    simp only [nats, List.map_append] at hn ⊢
    rw [hn, show i2.val = i.val + 1 by scalar_tac]
    have hspell : nats s1.val = lit "IfExists" := by
      rw [hs]; decide +kernel
    rw [show s1.val.map (·.val) = lit "IfExists" from hspell,
      List.replicate_add, List.flatten_append]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  · have hi' : i.val = c.wrappers.val := by scalar_tac
    simpa [ConditionKeyName, hi'] using hn

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionNames

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionViews
 theorem str_op_ok (op : conddata.Op) : conddata.str_op op = ok (StringOpProjection op) := by
  cases op <;> rfl
 theorem num_op_ok (op : conddata.Op) : conddata.num_op op = ok (NumberOpProjection op) := by
  cases op <;> rfl

 theorem condition_view_ok (c : conddata.Condition) (v : condfuncs.Condition)
    (h : conddata.condition_view c = ok v) : MatchingView c v := by
  unfold conddata.condition_view at h
  simp only [str_op_ok, num_op_ok, op_eq_law, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok] at h
  cases hd : c.data <;> simp only [hd] at h
  all_goals h5i_invert h
  all_goals h5i_invert hcond
  all_goals try have hp := legacy_pairs_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : conddata.legacy_pairs _ _ = ok _)
  all_goals try have hp := key_presence_ok _ _ (by assumption : conddata.key_presence _ = ok _)

theorem forall₂_snoc {A B : Type} {R : A → B → Prop} {xs : List A} {ys : List B}
    (h : List.Forall₂ R xs ys) {x : A} {y : B} (hr : R x y) :
    List.Forall₂ R (xs ++ [x]) (ys ++ [y]) := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .cons hr .nil
  | cons h ht ih => exact .cons h ih

theorem views_ok (cs : Slice conddata.Condition) (vs : alloc.vec.Vec condfuncs.Condition)
    (h : conddata.views cs = ok vs) : MatchingViews cs.val vs.val := by
  unfold conddata.views conddata.views_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec condfuncs.Condition × Usize =>
      x.2.val ≤ cs.val.length ∧ MatchingViews (cs.val.take x.2.val) x.1.val)
    (fun v => MatchingViews cs.val v.val) (fun x => cs.val.length - x.2.val)
    ?_ _ vs ⟨by simp, by constructor⟩ h
  rintro ⟨out, i⟩ r ⟨hi, ho⟩ hr
  unfold conddata.views_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : Slice.index_usize _ _ = ok _)
    have hv := condition_view_ok _ _ (by assumption : conddata.condition_view _ = ok _)
    have hp := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBytes.push_ok hout1
    have hadd := add_ok_val hi2
    refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
    rw [hp, show i2.val = i.val + 1 by scalar_tac, List.take_add_one,
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt, he]
    exact forall₂_snoc ho hv
  · rw [List.take_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)] at ho
    exact ho

theorem matching_view_ok (f : conddata.Functions) (v : condfuncs.Functions)
    (h : conddata.matching_view f = ok v) :
    MatchingViews f.for_any_value.val v.for_any_value.val ∧
    MatchingViews f.for_all_values.val v.for_all_values.val ∧
    MatchingViews f.for_normal.val v.for_normal.val := by
  unfold conddata.matching_view at h
  h5i_invert h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] using views_ok _ _ hv_1
  · simpa only [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] using views_ok _ _ hv1
  · simpa only [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] using views_ok _ _ hv2

theorem base_key_ok (c : conddata.Condition) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : conddata.to_key c = ok v) : nats v.val = ConditionBaseKeyName c := by
  unfold conddata.to_key at h
  by_cases hw : 0 < c.wrappers.val
  · have hw' : c.wrappers > 0#usize := by scalar_tac
    simp only [hw', ↓reduceIte] at h
    h5i_invert h
    rw [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsCleanCanonical.to_vec_ok _ _ h,
      rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.lift_slice hs]
    simp only [ConditionBaseKeyName, hw, ↓reduceIte]
    decide +kernel
  · have hw' : ¬ c.wrappers > 0#usize := by scalar_tac
    simp only [hw', ↓reduceIte] at h
    simpa [ConditionBaseKeyName, hw] using
      rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionNames.op_name_ok c.op v h
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsConditionViews

import Verified.RustfsDateMeaning
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDateDigits
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
open RustfsDateMeaning
lemma window_step (s : List Nat) (start count : Nat) (hc : 0<count) (hs : start<s.length) :
    (s.drop start).take count=s[start]::(s.drop (start+1)).take (count-1) := by
  cases count with
  | zero => omega
  | succ count =>
    simpa only [List.take_succ_cons,Nat.add_sub_cancel] using congrArg (List.take (count+1)) (List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hs)
lemma add_ok (a b r : I64) (h : a+b=ok r) : r.val=a.val+b.val := by
  have hs := IScalar.add_equiv a b
  rw [h] at hs
  exact hs.2.1
lemma mul_ok (a b r : I64) (h : a*b=ok r) : r.val=a.val*b.val := by
  have hs := IScalar.mul_equiv a b
  change IScalar.mul a b=ok r at h
  rw [h] at hs
  exact hs.2.2.1
lemma digit_cast (a : U8) (r : I64) (h : lift (UScalar.hcast .I64 a)=ok r) : r.val=a.val :=
  H5iAppLib.post_of_ok (x:=r) (P:=fun z : I64 => z.val=a.val)
    (UScalar.hcast_inBounds_spec .I64 a (by scalar_tac)) h
lemma loop_meaning (s : Slice U8) (start count : Usize) (n : I64) (i : Usize)
    (bound : start.val+count.val≤s.val.length) (hi : i.val≤count.val) (r : Option I64)
    (h : dates.digits_loop s start count n i=ok r) :
    r.map (·.val)=DecimalAcc (((nats s.val).drop (start.val+i.val)).take (count.val-i.val)) n.val := by
  let target := DecimalAcc (((nats s.val).drop (start.val+i.val)).take (count.val-i.val)) n.val
  unfold dates.digits_loop at h
  apply loop_ok _
    (fun p : I64 × Usize => p.2.val≤count.val ∧
      DecimalAcc (((nats s.val).drop (start.val+p.2.val)).take (count.val-p.2.val)) p.1.val=target)
    (fun out : Option I64 => out.map (·.val)=target) (fun p=>count.val-p.2.val)
    ?_ (n,i) r ⟨hi,rfl⟩ h
  intro p out hinv hb
  rcases p with ⟨acc,j⟩
  rcases hinv with ⟨hj,ht⟩
  dsimp only at *
  unfold dates.digits_loop.body at hb
  h5i_invert hb
  all_goals first
    | (have hlt : j<count := by assumption; skip)
    | (have hend : j.val=count.val := by scalar_tac
       change (some acc.val : Option Int)=target
       have hz : count.val-j.val=0 := by omega
       simpa only [hz,List.take_zero,DecimalAcc] using ht)

  all_goals have ha := add_ok_val (by assumption : start+j=ok _)
  all_goals obtain ⟨hx,hget⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : Slice.index_usize s _=ok _)
  all_goals have hbound : start.val+j.val<s.val.length := by omega
  all_goals have hstep := window_step (nats s.val) (start.val+j.val) (count.val-j.val) (by scalar_tac) (by simpa only [nats,List.length_map] using hbound)
  all_goals have hbyte : (nats s.val)[start.val+j.val]'(by simpa only [nats,List.length_map] using hbound)=b.val := by simp only [nats,List.getElem_map]; simpa only [ha] using congrArg UScalar.val hget
  all_goals rw [hstep,hbyte] at ht
  all_goals first
    | (have hgood : 48≤b.val ∧ b.val≤57 := by scalar_tac; skip)
    | (have hbad : ¬(48≤b.val ∧ b.val≤57) := by scalar_tac
       change (none : Option Int)=target
       simpa only [DecimalAcc,if_neg hbad] using ht)
  have hm := mul_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : _ * _=ok _)
  have hsub := sub_ok_val (by assumption : _ - 48#u8=ok _)
  have hc := digit_cast _ _ (by assumption : lift (UScalar.hcast .I64 _)=ok _)
  have hn := add_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : _ + _=ok _)
  have hj' := add_ok_val (by assumption : j+1#usize=ok _)
  simp only [IScalar.ofInt_val_eq,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at *
  have hd : 48≤b.val ∧ b.val≤57 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [DecimalAcc,if_pos hd] at ht
  refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac,?_⟩,by scalar_tac⟩
  rw [hj',hn,hm,hc]
  have hnval : acc.val*10+(i3.val:Int)=10*acc.val+(b.val:Int)-48 := by omega
  rw [hnval]
  convert ht using 1 <;> congr 2 <;> omega
theorem digits_ok (s : Slice U8) (start count : Usize) (r : Option I64)
    (h : dates.digits s start count=ok r) :
    r.map (·.val)=DateDigits (nats s.val) start.val count.val := by
  unfold dates.digits at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have hn : ¬start.val+count.val≤(nats s.val).length := by simp only [nats,List.length_map]; scalar_tac
    simp only [DateDigits,if_neg hn,Option.map_none]
  · have hv := sub_ok_val (by assumption : _ - start=ok _)
    have hn : ¬start.val+count.val≤(nats s.val).length := by simp only [nats,List.length_map]; scalar_tac
    simp only [DateDigits,if_neg hn,Option.map_none]
  · have hv := sub_ok_val (by assumption : _ - start=ok _)
    have hb : start.val+count.val≤s.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hm := loop_meaning s start count 0#i64 0#usize hb (by scalar_tac) r h
    simpa only [DateDigits,nats,List.length_map,show start.val+count.val≤s.val.length from hb,ite_true,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq,Nat.add_zero,Nat.sub_zero] using hm
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDateDigits

import Verified.RustfsDateParser

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDateEvaluate
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

theorem evaluate_using
    (parse_ok : ∀ (s : Slice U8) (r : Option I128), dates.parse_rfc3339 s=ok r → r.map (·.val)=ParseInstant (nats s.val))
    (inner : conddata.InnerFunc conddata.DateFuncValue) (op : conddata.Op)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (b : Bool) (h : dates.evaluate inner op values=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ DateConditionsHold (inner.entries.val.map (fun e=>(e.key,e.values.unix_nanos.val))) op (RequestValueLists values.val) := by
  unfold dates.evaluate dates.evaluate_loop at h
  let P := fun es : List (conddata.FuncKeyValue conddata.DateFuncValue) =>
    DateConditionsHold (es.map (fun e=>(e.key,e.values.unix_nanos.val))) op (RequestValueLists values.val)
  change b=true ↔ P inner.entries.val
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ inner.entries.val.length ∧ (P inner.entries.val ↔ P (inner.entries.val.drop i.val)))
    (fun b=>b=true ↔ P inner.entries.val) (fun i=>inner.entries.val.length-i.val) ?_ _ b ⟨by simp,by simp⟩ h
  intro i out hinv hr
  rcases hinv with ⟨hi,hm⟩
  unfold dates.evaluate_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  all_goals first
    | (obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hentry
       have hk := RustfsConditionEval.lookup_name_ok _ _ hv
       have hl := RustfsOperatorLookup.lookup_ok _ _ _ ho
       simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val,hk] at hl
       rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt,he] at hm
       simp only [P,List.map_cons,DateConditionsHold,List.forall_mem_cons] at hm)
    | (rw [List.drop_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)] at hm
       simpa [P,DateConditionsHold] using hm.symm)
  all_goals have hf : FirstConditionValue (RequestValueLists values.val) entry.key =
      (ConditionValues (RequestValueLists values.val) (LookupName entry.key)).bind List.head? := rfl

theorem loop_meaning (s : Slice U8) (i : Usize) (nano weight : I64)
    (bound : i.val≤s.val.length) (r : Usize × I64)
    (h : dates.fraction_loop s i nano weight=ok r) :
    let f := FractionAcc ((nats s.val).drop i.val) nano.val weight.val
    r.2.val=f.1 ∧ r.1.val=i.val+f.2 := by
  let f := FractionAcc ((nats s.val).drop i.val) nano.val weight.val
  let target := (f.1,i.val+f.2)
  unfold dates.fraction_loop at h
  apply loop_ok _
    (fun p : Usize × I64 × I64 => p.1.val≤s.val.length ∧
      let g := FractionAcc ((nats s.val).drop p.1.val) p.2.1.val p.2.2.val
      g.1=target.1 ∧ p.1.val+g.2=target.2)
    (fun out : Usize × I64 => out.2.val=target.1 ∧ out.1.val=target.2)
    (fun p=>s.val.length-p.1.val) ?_ (i,nano,weight) r ⟨bound,rfl,rfl⟩ h
  intro p out hinv hb
  rcases p with ⟨j,acc,w⟩
  rcases hinv with ⟨hj,htn,hti⟩
  dsimp only at *
  unfold dates.fraction_loop.body at hb
  h5i_invert hb
  all_goals first
    | (have hlt : j<Slice.len s := by assumption; skip)
    | (have hend : j.val=s.val.length := by scalar_tac
       have hdrop : (nats s.val).drop j.val=[] := by simp [hend,nats]
       simp only [hdrop,FractionAcc,Nat.add_zero] at htn hti
       exact ⟨htn,hti⟩)
  all_goals obtain ⟨hx,hget⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : Slice.index_usize s j=ok _)
  all_goals have hbound : j.val<(nats s.val).length := by simp only [nats,List.length_map]; scalar_tac
  all_goals have hdrop := List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hbound
  all_goals have hbyte : (nats s.val)[j.val]'hbound=i2.val := by simp only [nats,List.getElem_map]; exact congrArg UScalar.val hget
  all_goals rw [hdrop,hbyte] at htn hti
  all_goals first
    | (have hgood : 48 ≤ i2.val ∧ i2.val ≤ 57 := by scalar_tac; skip)
    | (have hbad : ¬(48 ≤ i2.val ∧ i2.val ≤ 57) := by scalar_tac
       simp only [FractionAcc,if_neg hbad,Nat.add_zero] at htn hti
       exact ⟨htn,hti⟩)
  have hsub := sub_ok_val (by assumption : _ - 48#u8=ok _)
  have hc := RustfsDateDigits.digit_cast _ _ (by assumption)
  have hm := RustfsDateMeaning.mul_ok _ _ _ (by assumption)
  have hn := RustfsDateMeaning.add_ok _ _ _ (by assumption)
  have hw := RustfsDateMeaning.div_ok _ _ _ (by assumption) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
  have hj' := add_ok_val (by assumption : j+1#usize=ok _)
  have hgood : 48 ≤ i2.val ∧ i2.val ≤ 57 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [FractionAcc,if_pos hgood] at htn hti
  simp only [IScalar.ofInt_val_eq,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at *
  have hc' : (i3.val:Int)=(i2.val:Int)-48 := by omega
  refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac,?_,?_⟩,by scalar_tac⟩
  · simpa only [hn,hm,hc,hc',hw,hj'] using htn
  · simpa only [hn,hm,hc,hc',hw,hj',Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_left_comm] using hti

    (bound : 20≤s.val.length) (h : dates.fraction s=ok r) :

  all_goals try h5i_invert h

  all_goals try have ha := add_ok_val (by assumption : 19#usize+1#usize=ok _)
  all_goals try have hl := loop_meaning s i1 0#i64 100000000#i64 (by scalar_tac) (j,n) hx

lemma scalar_eq {ty} (a b : IScalar ty) : a=b ↔ a.val=b.val := ⟨congrArg IScalar.val,IScalar.eq_of_val_eq⟩
lemma rem_ok (a b r : I64) (hz : b.val≠0) (h : a%b=ok r) : r.val=a.val.tmod b.val :=
  H5iAppLib.post_of_ok (x := r) (P := fun z : I64 => z.val=a.val.tmod b.val) (IScalar.rem_spec a hz) h
lemma add_ok (a b r : I64) (h : a+b=ok r) : r.val=a.val+b.val := by
  have hs := IScalar.add_equiv a b
  rw [h] at hs
  exact hs.2.1
lemma sub_ok (a b r : I64) (h : a-b=ok r) : r.val=a.val-b.val := by
  have hs := IScalar.sub_equiv a b
  rw [h] at hs
  exact hs.2.1
lemma mul_ok (a b r : I64) (h : a*b=ok r) : r.val=a.val*b.val := by
  have hs := IScalar.mul_equiv a b
  change IScalar.mul a b=ok r at h

lemma div_ok (a b r : I64) (h : a/b=ok r) (hz : b.val≠0) (hpos : b.val≠ -1) : r.val=a.val.tdiv b.val := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz',hv⟩ := IScalar.div_spec (x:=a) (y:=b) hz (by tauto)
  rw [h] at hz'
  have he := Result.ok.inj hz'
  subst z
  exact hv
theorem month_ok (year month out : I64) (h : dates.month_days year month=ok out) :
    out.val=MonthDays year.val month.val := by
  unfold dates.month_days at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals try have h4 := rem_ok year 4#i64 _ (by decide +kernel) (by assumption)
  all_goals try have h100 := rem_ok year 100#i64 _ (by decide +kernel) (by assumption)
  all_goals try have h400 := rem_ok year 400#i64 _ (by decide +kernel) (by assumption)
  all_goals simp only [scalar_eq,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq,ne_eq,decide_eq_true_eq] at *
  all_goals simp_all [MonthDays]
theorem civil_ok (year month day out : I64) (h : dates.civil_days year month day=ok out) :
    out.val=CivilDays year.val month.val day.val := by
  unfold dates.civil_days at h
  h5i_invert h
  have hyval : y.val=(if month.val≤2 then year.val-1 else year.val) := by
    by_cases hc : month≤2#i64
    · simp only [hc,ite_true] at hy
      have hv := sub_ok _ _ _ hy
      have hp : month.val≤2 := by simpa only [IScalar.le_equiv,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq] using hc
      simpa only [hp,ite_true,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq] using hv
    · simp only [hc,ite_false,Result.ok.injEq] at hy
      subst y
      have hn : ¬month.val≤2 := by simpa only [IScalar.le_equiv,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq] using hc
      simp only [hn,ite_false]
  have hmv : m.val=(if 2<month.val then month.val-3 else month.val+9) := by
    by_cases hc : month>2#i64
    · simp only [hc,ite_true] at hm
      have hv := sub_ok _ _ _ hm
      have hp : 2<month.val := by simpa only [IScalar.lt_equiv,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq] using hc
      simpa only [hp,ite_true,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq] using hv
    · simp only [hc,ite_false] at hm
      have hv := add_ok _ _ _ hm
      have hn : ¬2<month.val := by simpa only [IScalar.lt_equiv,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq] using hc
      simpa only [hn,ite_false,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq] using hv
  have hev : era.val=(if 0≤y.val then y.val else y.val-399).tdiv 400 := by
    by_cases hc : y≥0#i64
    · simp only [hc,ite_true] at hera
      have hv := div_ok _ _ _ hera (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
      have hp : 0≤y.val := by simpa only [IScalar.le_equiv,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq] using hc

      obtain ⟨z,hz,hdiv⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hera
      have hzv := sub_ok _ _ _ hz
      have hv := div_ok _ _ _ hdiv (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
      have hn : ¬0≤y.val := by simpa only [IScalar.le_equiv,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq] using hc
      simpa only [hn,ite_false,hzv,IScalar.ofInt_val_eq] using hv

  all_goals repeat' first
    | have hh := add_ok _ _ _ (by assumption); clear ‹_ + _ = ok _›
    | have hh := sub_ok _ _ _ (by assumption); clear ‹_ - _ = ok _›
    | have hh := mul_ok _ _ _ (by assumption); clear ‹_ * _ = ok _›
    | have hh := div_ok _ _ _ (by assumption) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel); clear ‹_ / _ = ok _›

  all_goals try have htime := RustfsDateFields.time_ok _ _ (by assumption)

  all_goals try have hcivil := RustfsDateMeaning.civil_ok _ _ _ _ (by assumption)
  all_goals try have hleap := RustfsDateLeap.leap_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ (by assumption)
  all_goals try have hnanos := RustfsDateNanos.nanos_ok _ _ _ (by assumption)
  all_goals repeat' first
    | have hh := RustfsDateMeaning.add_ok _ _ _ (by assumption); clear ‹(_ : I64) + _ = ok _›
    | have hh := RustfsDateMeaning.sub_ok _ _ _ (by assumption); clear ‹(_ : I64) - _ = ok _›

  all_goals try simp only [Option.bind]
  all_goals try rw [←htime]
  all_goals try simp only [Option.bind]
  all_goals try rw [←hfrac]
  all_goals try simp only [Option.bind]
  all_goals try rw [←hoff]
  all_goals try simp only [Option.bind]

    | (obtain ⟨a,ha,hav⟩ := h4; intro x hx hxv; have he : x=a := Option.some.inj (hx.symm.trans ha); subst x; omega)

/-- Retaining a source timezone never changes the parsed UTC instant. -/
theorem parsed_instant (s : Slice U8) (out : conddata.DateFuncValue)
    (h : dates.parse_value s = ok (some out)) :
    dates.parse_rfc3339 s = ok (some out.unix_nanos) := by
  unfold dates.parse_value at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals cases Option.some.inj h; exact ho
/-- A failed timestamp parse cannot produce a dated condition value. -/
theorem rejects_invalid (s : Slice U8) (h : dates.parse_rfc3339 s = ok none) :
    dates.parse_value s = ok none := by
  simp only [dates.parse_value,h,bind_ok]

/-- A UTC designator has zero source offset. -/
theorem utc_offset (s : Slice U8) (out : conddata.DateFuncValue)
    (hz : s.val[s.val.length - 1]? = some 90#u8 ∨ s.val[s.val.length - 1]? = some 122#u8)
    (h : dates.parse_value s = ok (some out)) : out.offset_seconds = 0#i32 := by
  unfold dates.parse_value at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals try (cases Option.some.inj h; rfl)
  all_goals
    have ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hsub := sub_ok_val hi1
    have heq : i1.val = s.val.length - 1 := by scalar_tac
    have hh : s.val[s.val.length - 1]? = some i2 := by
      rw [←heq,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt,he]
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · rw [hh] at hz
      exact False.elim (hc (Option.some.inj hz))
    · have ⟨hlt4,he4⟩ := slice_index_ok hi5
      have hsub4 := sub_ok_val hi4
      have heq4 : i4.val = s.val.length - 1 := by scalar_tac
      have hh4 : s.val[s.val.length - 1]? = some i5 := by
        rw [←heq4,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt4,he4]
      rw [hh4] at hz
      exact False.elim (hc_1 (Option.some.inj hz))
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDateValues

theorem set_match_general (set : Slice acts.Action) (a : acts.Action) (i : Usize)
    (h : acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop set a false i = ok true) :
    ∃ x ∈ set.val, acts.action_is_match_for_effect x a false = ok true ∨
      (nats x.name.val = lit "s3:GetObjectVersion" ∧ nats a.name.val = lit "s3:GetObject") := by

  refine loop_true_witness _ (fun _ => True) (fun i : Usize => set.val.length - i.val) _ ?_ i trivial h

  · intro _

  · intro _
    have h1 := ((is_s3_ok _ _ _ hb1).1 hc_2).2
    have h2 := ((is_s3_ok _ _ _ hb2).1 hc_3).2

    rw [lift_slice hs1] at h2

    | (simp only [true_and]; have := add_ok_val (by assumption : _ + 1#usize = ok _); scalar_tac)

theorem covers_general (acs nacs : Slice acts.Action) (a : acts.Action) (hne : acs.val ≠ [])

      (nats x.name.val = lit "s3:GetObjectVersion" ∧ nats a.name.val = lit "s3:GetObject") := by

  h5i_invert h
  all_goals try simp_all

  all_goals try (unfold acts.set_is_match_for_effect at h; exact set_match_general _ _ _ h)

theorem stmt_covers (st : stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (hst : st.effect = .Allow) (h : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true) :
    acts.statement_covers (alloc.vec.Vec.deref st.actions) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref st.not_actions) a.action false
      = ok true := by
  unfold stmts.statement_is_allowed at h
  h5i_invert h
  obtain ⟨st1, chk⟩ := x
  cases b
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Result.ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hx
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp [stmts.effect_is_allowed, hst] at h
  · unfold stmts.reaches_condition_eval at hb
    rw [effect_eq_ok, hst] at hb
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hb⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 hb
    obtain rfl : d = false := (Result.ok.inj hd).symm
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hk⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 hb
    cases c
    · simp at hk
    · exact hc

/-- Every statement of the built-in policy named `pname` is an Allow without
`NotAction` whose (non-empty) action list names only actions in `names`. -/
def AllowsOnlyNames (ps : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × defaults.Policy)) (pname : List Nat) (names : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ ps, nats x.1.val = pname →
    ∀ st ∈ x.2.statements.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧ st.not_actions.val = [] ∧ st.actions.val ≠ [] ∧
      ∀ ac ∈ st.actions.val, nats ac.name.val ∈ names

/-- `AllowsOnlyNames` for every policy listed in `builtinOnly`. -/
def BuiltinOK (ps : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × defaults.Policy)) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ builtinOnly, AllowsOnlyNames ps p.1 p.2

set_option maxRecDepth 200000 in
set_option maxHeartbeats 160000000 in
theorem builtin_statements : defaults.default_policies ⦃ ps => BuiltinOK ps.val ⦄ := by
  unfold defaults.default_policies
  step*
  all_goals try scalar_tac
  all_goals try (subst_vars; simp_all [Array.make]; scalar_tac)
  unfold BuiltinOK AllowsOnlyNames
  intro p hp x hx hn st hst
  subst_vars
  simp only [*, alloc.vec.Vec.new, alloc.vec.Vec.from_val, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton,
    List.not_mem_nil, or_false, false_or, or_assoc, List.nil_append] at hx
  simp only [builtinOnly, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hp
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases hx with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;> subst h <;>
    (try simp_all [nats, Array.make, readonlyNames, writeonlyNames, diagnosticsNames, kmsAdministratorNames,
      kmsUserNames, kmsAuditorNames]) <;>
    (rcases hst with rfl | rfl <;> simp_all [nats, Array.make, readonlyNames, writeonlyNames, diagnosticsNames,
      kmsAdministratorNames, kmsUserNames, kmsAuditorNames])

/-- The names of the listed built-in policies have no wildcard and are not
`s3:GetObjectVersion` (which also covers `s3:GetObject`). -/
theorem builtin_names_plain : ∀ q ∈ builtinOnly, ∀ n ∈ q.2, 42 ∉ n ∧ 63 ∉ n ∧ n ≠ lit "s3:GetObjectVersion" := by
  simp only [builtinOnly, readonlyNames, writeonlyNames, diagnosticsNames, kmsAdministratorNames, kmsUserNames,
    kmsAuditorNames, litk_0, litk_1, litk_2, litk_3, litk_4, litk_5, litk_6, litk_7, litk_8, litk_9, litk_10,
    litk_11, litk_12, litk_13, litk_14, litk_15, litk_16, litk_17, litk_18, litk_19, litk_20, litk_21, litk_22,
    litk_23, litk_24, litk_25, litk_26, litk_27]
  decide

/-- When a listed built-in policy allows a request (not as owner, not
deny-only), the action is one the policy names. -/
theorem builtin_allows_only_listed (ps : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × defaults.Policy))
    (hps : defaults.default_policies = ok ps) (q : List Nat × List (List Nat)) (hq : q ∈ builtinOnly)
    (x : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × defaults.Policy) (hx : x ∈ ps.val) (hn : nats x.1.val = q.1)
    (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (h : policies.policy_is_allowed (alloc.vec.Vec.deref x.2.statements) a e = ok true)
    (ho : a.is_owner = false) (hd : a.deny_only = false) :
    nats a.action.name.val ∈ q.2 := by
  have hok : AllowsOnlyNames ps.val q.1 q.2 := by
    have := builtin_statements
    rw [hps, WP.spec_ok] at this
    exact this q hq
  obtain ⟨st, hst, he, hsa⟩ :=
    rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsAllowNeedsStatement.allow_needs_allow_statement _ a e h ho hd
  rw [deref_val] at hst
  obtain ⟨_, _, hne, hacts⟩ := hok x hx hn st hst
  have hc := stmt_covers st a e he hsa
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hm | ⟨hgov, _⟩⟩ := covers_general _ _ _ (by rwa [deref_val]) hc
  · rw [deref_val] at hy
    have hyn := hacts y hy
    obtain ⟨h42, h63, _⟩ := builtin_names_plain q hq _ hyn
    have := is_match_exact _ _ (action_match_general _ _ hm) (by rwa [deref_val]) (by rwa [deref_val])
    rw [deref_val, deref_val] at this
    rw [this]; exact hyn
  · exfalso
    rw [deref_val] at hy
    exact (builtin_names_plain q hq _ (hacts y hy)).2.2 hgov

/-- The `readonly` case of `builtin_allows_only_listed`. -/
theorem readonly_allows_only_reads (ps : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × defaults.Policy))
    (hps : defaults.default_policies = ok ps) (x : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × defaults.Policy) (hx : x ∈ ps.val)
    (hn : nats x.1.val = lit "readonly") (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (h : policies.policy_is_allowed (alloc.vec.Vec.deref x.2.statements) a e = ok true)
    (ho : a.is_owner = false) (hd : a.deny_only = false) :
    nats a.action.name.val ∈ readonlyNames :=
  builtin_allows_only_listed ps hps (lit "readonly", readonlyNames) (by simp [builtinOnly]) x hx hn a e h ho hd

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults

theorem advance_marked (ss : List manage.Statement) (i : Usize) (old new : List Usize)
    (hold : MarkedThrough ss i.val old)
    (hnew : ∀ k, k ∈ new ↔ k ∈ old ∨ i ∉ old ∧ DuplicatePair ss i k) :
    MarkedThrough ss (i.val + 1) new := by
  have hstable (j : Usize) (hj : j.val ≤ i.val) : j ∈ new ↔ j ∈ old := by
    rw [hnew]
    constructor
    · rintro (hh | ⟨_,hp⟩)
      · exact hh
      · exact False.elim (by have := hp.1; omega)
    · exact fun hh => .inl hh
  intro k
  rw [hnew]
  constructor
  · rintro (hk | ⟨hi,hp⟩)
    · obtain ⟨j,hj,hjm,hp⟩ := (hold k).1 hk
      exact ⟨j,by omega,fun hh => hjm ((hstable j (by omega)).1 hh),hp⟩
    · exact ⟨i,by omega,fun hh => hi ((hstable i (Nat.le_refl _)).1 hh),hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨j,hj,hjm,hp⟩
    have hjo : j ∉ old := fun hh => hjm ((hstable j (by omega)).2 hh)
    by_cases hj' : j.val < i.val
    · exact .inl ((hold k).2 ⟨j,hj',hjo,hp⟩)
    · have hje : j = i := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by omega)
      subst j
      exact .inr ⟨hjo,hp⟩

theorem selection_loop_ok (p : manage.Policy)
    (r : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec manage.Statement × alloc.vec.Vec Usize)
    (h : manage.drop_duplicate_statements_loop p (alloc.vec.Vec.new _) 0#usize = ok r) :
    ∃ ds, r = (p.id,p.version,p.statements,ds) ∧ MarkedThrough p.statements.val p.statements.val.length ds.val := by
  unfold manage.drop_duplicate_statements_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec Usize × Usize =>
      x.2.val ≤ p.statements.val.length ∧ MarkedThrough p.statements.val x.2.val x.1.val)
    (fun r => ∃ ds, r = (p.id,p.version,p.statements,ds) ∧ MarkedThrough p.statements.val p.statements.val.length ds.val)
    (fun x => p.statements.val.length - x.2.val) ?_ _ r
    ⟨by simp,by intro k; simp [MarkedThrough,alloc.vec.Vec.new]⟩ h
  rintro ⟨ds,i⟩ r ⟨hi,hd⟩ hr
  dsimp only at hi hd ⊢
  unfold manage.drop_duplicate_statements_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have hlt : i.val < p.statements.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hm := index_member_ok _ _ _ hb
    simp only [deref_val] at hm
    have hadd := add_ok_val hi2
    have hnew : ∀ k, k ∈ dups1.val ↔ k ∈ ds.val ∨ i ∉ ds.val ∧ DuplicatePair p.statements.val i k := by
      h5i_invert hdups1
      · have hin := hm.1 hc_1
        intro k
        simp [hin]
      · have hn : i ∉ ds.val := fun hh => hc_1 (hm.2 hh)
        have hmarks := mark_ok _ i (by simpa [deref_val] using hlt) ds dups1 hdups1
        simp only [deref_val] at hmarks
        intro k
        rw [hmarks k]
        simp only [hn,not_false_eq_true,true_and,DuplicatePair]
        constructor
        · rintro (hh | ⟨hk,hk',he⟩)
          · exact .inl hh
          · exact .inr ⟨hk,hlt,hk',he⟩
        · rintro (hh | ⟨hk,_,hk',he⟩)
          · exact .inl hh
          · exact .inr ⟨hk,hk',he⟩
    dsimp only
    refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac,?_⟩,by scalar_tac⟩
    have he : i2.val = i.val + 1 := by scalar_tac
    rw [he]
    exact advance_marked _ _ _ _ hd hnew
  · dsimp only
    refine ⟨ds,rfl,?_⟩
    have he : i.val = p.statements.val.length := by scalar_tac
    simpa only [he] using hd
theorem drop_ok (p out : manage.Policy) (h : manage.drop_duplicate_statements p = ok out) :
    out.id = p.id ∧ out.version = p.version ∧ DeduplicatedStatements p.statements.val out.statements.val := by
  unfold manage.drop_duplicate_statements at h
  obtain ⟨r,hr,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  obtain ⟨ds,he,hd⟩ := selection_loop_ok p r hr

  obtain ⟨v3,hv3,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst out
  have ht := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsStatementRetention.retain_ok _ _ _ hv3
  simp only [deref_val] at ht
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl,ds.val,hd,ht⟩
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDuplicateSelection

theorem expansion_pass_nonempty (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat))
    (c : AwsValueContext) (text : List Nat) : ExpansionPass inner c text ≠ [] := by
  apply ExpansionPass.induct inner c (fun s => ExpansionPass inner c s ≠ [])
  · simp [ExpansionPass]
  · intro tail closing balance he hb
    simp [ExpansionPass,he,hb]
  · intro tail closing balance he hb ih
    simp only [ExpansionPass,he,hb,ite_false]
    generalize hrep : (if HasPlaceholder (tail.take closing) then
      let expanded := inner (tail.take closing)
      if expanded=[] ∨ expanded=[tail.take closing] then
        [(36::123::tail).take (closing+3)] else expanded
      else match AwsValues c (tail.take closing) with
        | none => [(36::123::tail).take (closing+3)]
        | some [] => [[]]
        | some values => values) = replacements
    have hn : replacements ≠ [] := by
      rw [←hrep]
      split
      · dsimp only
        split
        · simp
        · rename_i h; exact fun he => h (Or.inl he)
      · split
        · simp
        · simp
        · simp_all
    obtain ⟨replacement,hr⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil replacements hn
    obtain ⟨suffix,hs⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ ih
    intro empty
    have hm : replacement++suffix ∈ replacements.flatMap
        (fun replacement => (ExpansionPass inner c (tail.drop (closing+1))).map (replacement++·)) :=
      List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨replacement,hr,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨suffix,hs,rfl⟩⟩
    simpa only [empty,List.not_mem_nil] using hm
  · intro head rest hnot ih
    rw [ExpansionPass.eq_def]
    split
    · simp_all
    · next tail he => exact False.elim (hnot tail (List.cons.inj he).1 (List.cons.inj he).2)
    · next h a hnot2 he =>
        have hh := List.cons.inj he
        rcases hh with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        simpa using ih
theorem placeholder_tail (head : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : HasPlaceholder (head::rest)=false) : HasPlaceholder rest=false := by
  rw [HasPlaceholder.eq_def] at h
  split at h
  · contradiction
  · contradiction
  · next other tail hn he =>
      rcases List.cons.inj he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      exact h

theorem expansion_literal (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List Nat) (h : HasPlaceholder text=false) : ExpansionPass inner c text=[text] := by
  induction text using ExpansionPass.induct inner c with
  | case1 => simp [ExpansionPass]
  | case2 tail closing balance he hb => simp [HasPlaceholder] at h
  | case3 tail closing balance he hb ih => simp [HasPlaceholder] at h
  | case4 head rest hnot ih =>
    have hr := ih (placeholder_tail head rest h)
    rw [ExpansionPass.eq_def]
    split
    · simp_all
    · next tail he => exact False.elim (hnot tail (List.cons.inj he).1 (List.cons.inj he).2)
    · next other tail hn he =>
      rcases List.cons.inj he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      simp [hr]
theorem expansion_cons (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (head : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (hn : ∀ tail, head = 36 → rest = 123::tail → False) :
    ExpansionPass inner c (head::rest) = (ExpansionPass inner c rest).map (head::·) := by
  rw [ExpansionPass.eq_def]
  split
  · contradiction
  · next tail he => exact False.elim (hn tail (List.cons.inj he).1 (List.cons.inj he).2)
  · next other tail hnot he =>
      rcases List.cons.inj he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      rfl

theorem expansion_pre (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (pre tail : List Nat) (h : HasPlaceholder pre=false) :
    ExpansionPass inner c (pre ++ 36::123::tail) =
      (ExpansionPass inner c (36::123::tail)).map (pre++·) := by
  induction pre with
  | nil => simp
  | cons head rest ih =>
    have hr := placeholder_tail head rest h
    have hn : ∀ suffix, head=36 → rest ++ 36::123::tail=123::suffix → False := by
      intro suffix hh he
      subst head
      cases rest with
      | nil => simp at he
      | cons x xs =>
        have hx : x=123 := (List.cons.inj he).1
        subst x
        simp [HasPlaceholder] at h
    rw [List.cons_append, expansion_cons inner c head _ hn, ih hr]
    simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
theorem placeholder_false_iff (text : List Nat) :
    HasPlaceholder text=false ↔ ∀ k, ¬ (text[k]?=some 36 ∧ text[k+1]?=some 123) := by
  induction text with
  | nil => simp [HasPlaceholder]
  | cons head rest ih =>
    constructor
    · intro h k
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        intro hp
        have hh : head=36 := by simpa using hp.1
        subst head
        cases rest with
        | nil => simp at hp
        | cons x xs =>
          have hx : x=123 := by simpa using hp.2
          subst x
          simp [HasPlaceholder] at h
      | succ k =>
        have ht := ih.mp (placeholder_tail head rest h) k
        simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using ht
    · intro h
      by_cases hh : head=36
      · subst head
        cases rest with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons x xs =>
          by_cases hx : x=123
          · subst x; exact False.elim (h 0 (by simp))
          · have hr : HasPlaceholder (x::xs)=false := ih.mpr (by
              intro k
              simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using h (k+1))
            simpa [HasPlaceholder,hx] using hr
      · have hr : HasPlaceholder rest=false := ih.mpr (by
          intro k
          simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using h (k+1))
        simpa [HasPlaceholder,hh] using hr
theorem resume_append (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (pre post : List Nat) :
    ResumeAlternatives inner c (pre++post) pre.length =
      (ExpansionPass inner c post).map (pre++·) := by
  simp [ResumeAlternatives]
theorem resume_literal (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (text : List Nat) (resume : Nat) (hm : HasPlaceholder (text.drop resume)=false) :
    ResumeAlternatives inner c text resume=[text] := by
  simp [ResumeAlternatives,expansion_literal inner c _ hm]
theorem resume_wrapped (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (pre inserted post : List Nat) :
    ResumeAlternatives inner c (pre++inserted++post) (pre.length+inserted.length) =
      (ExpansionPass inner c post).map (fun suffix => pre++inserted++suffix) := by
  simpa [List.append_assoc] using resume_append inner c (pre++inserted) post
theorem expansion_marker (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (tail : List Nat) (closing : Nat) (hc : ClosingTail tail 1=(closing,0)) :
    ExpansionPass inner c (36::123::tail) =
      (PlaceholderAlternatives inner c (tail.take closing)
        ((36::123::tail).take (closing+3))).flatMap (fun replacement =>
          (ExpansionPass inner c (tail.drop (closing+1))).map (replacement++·)) := by
  simp only [ExpansionPass,hc,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,ite_false,PlaceholderAlternatives]

 theorem expansion_unbalanced (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (pre tail : List Nat) (closing balance : Nat) (hn : HasPlaceholder pre=false)
    (hc : ClosingTail tail 1=(closing,balance)) (hb : balance ≠ 0) :
    ExpansionPass inner c (pre++36::123::tail)=[pre++36::123::tail] := by
  rw [expansion_pre inner c pre tail hn]
  simp [ExpansionPass,hc,hb]
theorem resume_marker (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (pre middle tail : List Nat) (hm : HasPlaceholder middle=false) :
    ResumeAlternatives inner c (pre++middle++36::123::tail) pre.length =
      (ExpansionPass inner c (36::123::tail)).map (fun suffix => pre++middle++suffix) := by
  rw [List.append_assoc,resume_append,expansion_pre inner c middle tail hm]
  simp [List.map_map,Function.comp_def,List.append_assoc]
theorem closing_tail_bound (text : List Nat) (balance : Nat) :
    (ClosingTail text balance).1 ≤ text.length ∧
    (balance ≠ 0 → (ClosingTail text balance).2=0 → (ClosingTail text balance).1 < text.length) := by
  induction text generalizing balance with
  | nil =>
    by_cases hb : balance=0 <;> simp [ClosingTail,hb]
  | cons head rest ih =>
    by_cases hb : balance=0
    · simp [ClosingTail,hb]
    · simp only [ClosingTail,hb,ite_false]
      generalize hnext : (if head=123 then balance+1 else if head=125 then balance-1 else balance) = next
      by_cases hn : next=0
      · simp [hn]
      · simp only [hn,ite_false,Prod.fst,Prod.snd,List.length_cons]
        obtain ⟨hl,hs⟩ := ih next
        constructor
        · omega
        · intro _ he
          have ht := hs hn he
          omega
theorem marker_partition (tail : List Nat) (closing : Nat) :
    (36::123::tail).take (closing+3) ++ tail.drop (closing+1) = 36::123::tail := by
  simp [List.take]
theorem resume_keep_placeholder (inner : List Nat → List (List Nat)) (c : AwsValueContext)
    (pre tail : List Nat) (closing : Nat) (hc : ClosingTail tail 1=(closing,0))
    (hr : PlaceholderAlternatives inner c (tail.take closing)
      ((36::123::tail).take (closing+3))=[(36::123::tail).take (closing+3)]) :
    ResumeAlternatives inner c (pre++36::123::tail) pre.length =
      ResumeAlternatives inner c (pre++36::123::tail) (pre.length+closing+3) := by
  have hb := (closing_tail_bound tail 1).2 (by omega)
  rw [hc] at hb
  have hbound : closing < tail.length := hb rfl
  have hlen : ((36::123::tail).take (closing+3)).length=closing+3 := by
    simp only [List.length_take,List.length_cons]
    omega
  have he : pre++36::123::tail =
      (pre++(36::123::tail).take (closing+3)) ++ tail.drop (closing+1) := by
    rw [List.append_assoc,marker_partition]
  rw [resume_append,expansion_marker inner c tail closing hc,hr]
  simp only [List.flatMap_cons,List.flatMap_nil,List.append_nil,List.map_map,Function.comp_def]
  conv_rhs => rw [he]
  have hp : pre.length+closing+3 = (pre++(36::123::tail).take (closing+3)).length := by
    simp only [List.length_append,hlen]
    omega
  rw [hp,resume_append]
  simp [List.map_map,Function.comp_def,List.append_assoc]
end rustfs_kernel.Spec

theorem unique_ok (values : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))

  unfold extras.unique_values extras.unique_values_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Usize =>
      x.2.val ≤ values.val.length ∧ x.1.val.Nodup ∧

    (fun x => values.val.length - x.2.val) ?_ _ out
    ⟨by simp,by simp,by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new,alloc.vec.Vec.from_val]⟩ h

    · have hvout := hbmem.1 hc_1
