theorem lit_kms : lit "kms:" = [107, 109, 115, 58] := by decide +kernel

theorem is_s3_ok (x : acts.Action) (s : Slice U8) (r : Bool) (h : acts.is_s3 x s = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ x.family = .S3 ∧ nats x.name.val = nats s.val) := by
  unfold acts.is_s3 at h
  rw [family_eq_ok] at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have := bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ h
    rw [deref_val] at this
    have hc' : x.family = .S3 := of_decide_eq_true hc
    simp only [hc', true_and, this]
    exact ⟨fun h => by rw [h], nats_inj⟩
  · simp_all

theorem requires_ok (a : acts.Action) (r : Bool) (h : acts.action_requires_explicit_grant a = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ IsForceDelete a) := by
  unfold acts.action_requires_explicit_grant at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have h1 := is_s3_ok _ _ _ hb
    have h2 := lift_slice hs
    simp only [hc, true_iff] at h1 ⊢
    refine ⟨h1.1, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [h1.2, h2, lit_FDB]; rfl
  · have h1 := is_s3_ok _ _ _ hb
    have h2 := lift_slice hs
    have h3 := is_s3_ok _ _ _ h
    have h4 := lift_slice hs1
    rw [h3, h4]
    rw [h2] at h1
    unfold IsForceDelete
    rw [lit_FDB, lit_FDO]
    simp_all

theorem action_match_ok (x a : acts.Action) (hf : IsForceDelete a)
    (h : acts.action_is_match_for_effect x a false = ok true) :
    ¬ (x.family = .S3 ∧ nats x.name.val = lit "s3:" ++ lit "*") ∧
      wildmatch.is_match (alloc.vec.Vec.deref x.name) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref a.name) = ok true := by
  unfold acts.action_is_match_for_effect at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have h1 := requires_ok _ _ hb1
    simp_all
  · have h1 := is_s3_ok _ _ _ hb
    have h2 := lift_slice hs
    refine ⟨?_, h⟩
    rw [lit_s3, lit_star]
    simp_all

theorem set_match_ok (set : Slice acts.Action) (a : acts.Action) (hf : IsForceDelete a) (i : Usize)
    (h : acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop set a false i = ok true) :
    ∃ x ∈ set.val, acts.action_is_match_for_effect x a false = ok true := by
  unfold acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop at h
  refine loop_true_witness _ (fun _ => True) (fun i : Usize => set.val.length - i.val) _ ?_ i trivial h
  intro x r _ hr
  unfold acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · intro _
    exact ⟨a1, slice_index_ok_mem ha1, hc_1 ▸ hb⟩
  all_goals first
    | (simp only [true_and]; have := add_ok_val (by assumption : _ + 1#usize = ok _); scalar_tac)
    | (simp; done)
    | (exfalso
       have h1 := (is_s3_ok _ _ _ hb2).1 hc_3
       rw [lift_slice hs1] at h1
       obtain ⟨_, hn⟩ := hf
       rw [lit_FDB, lit_FDO] at hn
       simp at h1
       rcases hn with hn | hn <;> rw [hn] at h1 <;> simp at h1)

theorem covers_ok (acs nacs : Slice acts.Action) (a : acts.Action) (hf : IsForceDelete a)
    (h : acts.statement_covers acs nacs a false = ok true) :
    ∃ x ∈ acs.val, acts.action_is_match_for_effect x a false = ok true := by
  unfold acts.statement_covers at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have := (requires_ok _ _ hb1).2 hf
    simp_all
  · exact set_match_ok _ _ hf _ h

theorem stmt_allowed_ok (st : stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (hst : st.effect = .Allow) (hf : IsForceDelete a.action)
    (h : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true) :
    ∃ x ∈ st.actions.val, acts.action_is_match_for_effect x a.action false = ok true := by
  unfold stmts.statement_is_allowed at h
  h5i_invert h
  obtain ⟨st1, chk⟩ := x
  cases b
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Result.ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hx
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp [stmts.effect_is_allowed, hst] at h
  · unfold stmts.reaches_condition_eval at hb
    rw [effect_eq_ok, hst] at hb
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hb⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 hb
    obtain rfl : d = false := (Result.ok.inj hd).symm
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hk⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 hb
    cases c
    · simp at hk
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, hm⟩ := covers_ok _ _ _ hf hc
      rw [deref_val] at hx
      exact ⟨x, hx, hm⟩

theorem some_allow_ok (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env) (i : Usize)
    (h : policies.some_allow_loop sts a e i = ok true) :
    ∃ st ∈ sts.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧ stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok true := by
  unfold policies.some_allow_loop at h
  refine loop_true_witness _ (fun _ => True) (fun i : Usize => sts.val.length - i.val) _ ?_ i trivial h
  intro x r _ hr
  unfold policies.some_allow_loop.body at hr
  simp only [effect_eq_ok] at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · intro _
    exact ⟨s, slice_index_ok_mem hs, of_decide_eq_true hc_1, hc_2 ▸ hb1⟩
  all_goals first
    | (simp only [true_and]; have := add_ok_val (by assumption : _ + 1#usize = ok _); scalar_tac)
    | simp

theorem policy_ok (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (h : policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e = ok true) (ho : a.is_owner = false) (hd : a.deny_only = false)
    (hf : IsForceDelete a.action) :
    ∃ st ∈ sts.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧
      ∃ x ∈ st.actions.val, acts.action_is_match_for_effect x a.action false = ok true := by
  unfold policies.policy_is_allowed at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals try simp_all
  obtain ⟨st, hst, he, ha⟩ := some_allow_ok _ _ _ _ h
  exact ⟨st, hst, he, stmt_allowed_ok _ _ _ he hf ha⟩

theorem drop_cons_iff {l : List Nat} {i : Nat} {c : Nat} {t : List Nat} (h : l.drop i = c :: t) :
    ∃ hi : i < l.length, l[i] = c ∧ l.drop (i + 1) = t := by
  have hi : i < l.length := by
    by_contra hc
    rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)] at h
    simp at h
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi] at h
  simp only [List.cons.injEq] at h
  exact ⟨hi, h.1, h.2⟩

theorem deep_lit (p n : Slice U8) (s : Bool) : ∀ (l rest : List Nat) (pi ni : Usize),
    (nats p.val).drop pi.val = l ++ rest → 42 ∉ l → 63 ∉ l →
    wildmatch.deep_match p pi n ni s = ok true →
    ∃ (k : List Nat) (pi' ni' : Usize), (nats n.val).drop ni.val = l ++ k ∧
      pi'.val = pi.val + l.length ∧ ni'.val = ni.val + l.length ∧
      wildmatch.deep_match p pi' n ni' s = ok true := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro rest pi ni _ _ _ h; exact ⟨_, pi, ni, rfl, rfl, rfl, h⟩
  | cons c l ih =>
    intro rest pi ni hp h42 h63 h
    simp only [List.cons_append] at hp
    obtain ⟨hi, hc, hp'⟩ := drop_cons_iff hp
    simp only [List.mem_cons, not_or] at h42 h63
    rw [wildmatch.deep_match] at h
    h5i_invert h
    · exfalso; simp [nats] at hi; scalar_tac
    all_goals obtain ⟨_, hpe⟩ := slice_index_ok hc_1_1
    all_goals have hcv : c_1.val = c := by rw [← hc, ← hpe]; simp [nats]
    · subst hc_2; simp at hcv; omega
    · subst hc_2; simp at hcv; omega
    · subst hc_3; simp at hcv; omega
    · subst hc_3; simp at hcv; omega
    · subst hc_3; simp at hcv; omega
    · obtain ⟨_, hne⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
      have hv : i2.val = c_1.val := by simpa using hc_5
      have h3 : i3.val = pi.val + 1 := by have := add_ok_val hi3; simpa using this
      have h4 : i4.val = ni.val + 1 := by have := add_ok_val hi4; simpa using this
      obtain ⟨k, pi', ni', hk, hpi, hni, hd⟩ := ih rest i3 i4 (by rw [h3]; exact hp') h42.2 h63.2 h
      refine ⟨k, pi', ni', ?_, by simp; omega, by simp; omega, hd⟩
      have hlt : ni.val < (nats n.val).length := by simp [nats]; scalar_tac
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt, ← h4, hk]
      simp [nats, hne, hv, hcv]

theorem is_match_prefix (p n : Slice U8) (h : wildmatch.is_match p n = ok true) (l rest : List Nat)
    (hp : nats p.val = l ++ rest) (h42 : 42 ∉ l) (h63 : 63 ∉ l) (hne : l ≠ []) :
    ∃ k, nats n.val = l ++ k := by
  unfold wildmatch.is_match wildmatch.inner_match at h
  h5i_invert h
  · exfalso
    have : (nats p.val).length = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (·.val) hc; simp at this; simp [nats]; exact this
    rw [hp] at this; simp at this; exact hne this.1
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨hi, hpe⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    obtain ⟨c, l', rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hne
    have h0 : (nats p.val)[0]? = some c := by rw [hp]; simp
    simp [nats, List.getElem?_map] at h0
    have : p.val[0]? = some i2 := by simp at hpe; simp [← hpe]
    rw [this] at h0
    simp at h0
    subst hc_2
    simp at h0; subst h0
    simp at h42
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨k, _, _, hk, _⟩ := deep_lit p n false l rest 0#usize 0#usize (by simpa using hp) h42 h63 h
    exact ⟨k, by simpa using hk⟩

theorem deep_end (p n : Slice U8) (s : Bool) (pi ni : Usize) (hpi : p.val.length ≤ pi.val)
    (h : wildmatch.deep_match p pi n ni s = ok true) : n.val.length ≤ ni.val := by
  rw [wildmatch.deep_match] at h
  h5i_invert h
  · simp at h; scalar_tac
  all_goals exfalso; scalar_tac

theorem is_match_exact (p n : Slice U8) (h : wildmatch.is_match p n = ok true)
    (h42 : 42 ∉ nats p.val) (h63 : 63 ∉ nats p.val) : nats n.val = nats p.val := by
  unfold wildmatch.is_match wildmatch.inner_match at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have h1 := congrArg (·.val) hc; simp at h1
    simp at h
    have h2 := congrArg (·.val) h; simp at h2
    simp [nats, h1, h2]
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨hi, hpe⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    apply h42
    subst hc_2
    simp [nats]
    refine ⟨_, List.getElem_mem hi, ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (·.val) hpe
    simpa using this
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨k, pi', ni', hk, hpi, hni, hd⟩ :=
      deep_lit p n false (nats p.val) [] 0#usize 0#usize (by simp) h42 h63 h
    have := deep_end p n false pi' ni' (by simp [nats] at hpi; omega) hd
    simp at hk
    have hl := congrArg List.length hk
    simp [nats] at hl hni
    have : k = [] := by apply List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero; omega
    simp [hk, this]

theorem force_delete_needs_explicit_grant (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (h : policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e = ok true) (ho : a.is_owner = false) (hd : a.deny_only = false)
    (hf : IsForceDelete a.action) (hw : ∀ st ∈ sts.val, ∀ x ∈ st.actions.val, UpstreamAction x) :
    ∃ st ∈ sts.val, st.effect = .Allow ∧ ∃ x ∈ st.actions.val, x.name = a.action.name := by
  obtain ⟨st, hst, he, x, hx, hm⟩ := policy_ok sts a e h ho hd hf
  refine ⟨st, hst, he, x, hx, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hns3, hmatch⟩ := action_match_ok x a.action hf hm
  obtain ⟨hnone, _, hshape⟩ := hw st hst x hx
  have hfn := hf.2
  rw [lit_FDB, lit_FDO] at hfn
  rcases hshape with hwild | ⟨h42, h63⟩
  · exfalso
    cases hfam : x.family
    · exact hns3 ⟨hfam, by rw [hwild, hfam]; rfl⟩
    all_goals rw [hfam] at hwild
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := is_match_prefix _ _ hmatch (familyPrefix .Admin) (lit "*")
        (by rw [deref_val]; exact hwild) (by simp [familyPrefix, lit_admin]) (by simp [familyPrefix, lit_admin])
        (by simp [familyPrefix, lit_admin])
      rw [deref_val] at hk
      simp only [familyPrefix, lit_admin] at hk
      rcases hfn with hfn | hfn <;> rw [hfn] at hk <;> simp at hk
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := is_match_prefix _ _ hmatch (familyPrefix .Sts) (lit "*")
        (by rw [deref_val]; exact hwild) (by simp [familyPrefix, lit_sts]) (by simp [familyPrefix, lit_sts])
        (by simp [familyPrefix, lit_sts])
      rw [deref_val] at hk
      simp only [familyPrefix, lit_sts] at hk
      rcases hfn with hfn | hfn <;> rw [hfn] at hk <;> simp at hk
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := is_match_prefix _ _ hmatch (familyPrefix .Kms) (lit "*")
        (by rw [deref_val]; exact hwild) (by simp [familyPrefix, lit_kms]) (by simp [familyPrefix, lit_kms])
        (by simp [familyPrefix, lit_kms])
      rw [deref_val] at hk
      simp only [familyPrefix, lit_kms] at hk
      rcases hfn with hfn | hfn <;> rw [hfn] at hk <;> simp at hk
    · have := hnone hfam
      rw [this] at hwild
      simp [nats, familyPrefix, lit_star] at hwild
  · have := is_match_exact _ _ hmatch (by rw [deref_val]; exact h42) (by rw [deref_val]; exact h63)
    rw [deref_val, deref_val] at this
    exact (alloc.vec.Vec.eq_iff _ _).2 (nats_inj this).symm

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete

import SpecFunctions

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsFunctionsMeaning
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
theorem operator_ok (c : condfuncs.Cond) (q : condfuncs.Quantifier)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (ctx : Option awsvars.VarContext) (env : condfuncs.Env) (b : Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.eval_cond c q values ctx env=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ OperatorHolds (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context) (RequestValueLists values.val)
      (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2))) q c := by
  cases c with
  | Str op fs =>
    cases op <;> simp only [condfuncs.eval_cond,bind_ok] at h
    all_goals simpa only [OperatorHolds,StringFlags,RustfsPolicyValues.texts,RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] using
      RustfsStringFunction.function_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h
  | Ip neg fs =>
    unfold condfuncs.eval_cond at h
    obtain ⟨r,hr,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    have hh := RustfsIpDecision.conditions_ok fs.deref values env r hr
    cases neg <;> cases r <;> simp_all [OperatorHolds,Result.ok.injEq,RustfsForceDelete.deref_val]
  | Null fs =>
    simp only [condfuncs.eval_cond] at h
    simpa only [OperatorHolds,RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] using RustfsNullBool.null_conditions_ok fs.deref values b h
  | Bool fs =>
    simp only [condfuncs.eval_cond] at h
    simpa only [OperatorHolds,RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] using RustfsNullBool.bool_conditions_ok fs.deref values b h
  | Num op ie fs =>
    simp only [condfuncs.eval_cond] at h
    simpa only [OperatorHolds,RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] using RustfsNumeric.numeric_conditions_ok op ie fs.deref values b h
theorem condition_ok (c : condfuncs.Condition) (q : condfuncs.Quantifier)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (ctx : Option awsvars.VarContext) (env : condfuncs.Env) (b : Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.condition_evaluate c q values ctx env=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ ConditionHolds (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context) (RequestValueLists values.val)
      (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2))) q c := by
  unfold condfuncs.condition_evaluate at h
  by_cases hi : c.if_exists=true
  · simp only [hi,↓reduceIte] at h
    obtain ⟨present,hpresent,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    have hp := RustfsConditionKeys.has_key_ok c.cond values present hpresent
    cases present with
    | false =>
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,Result.ok.injEq] at h
      have hn : ¬OperatorKeyPresent c.cond (RequestValueLists values.val) := by simpa using hp.symm
      simp [ConditionHolds,hi,hn,←h]
    | true =>
      simp only [↓reduceIte] at h
      have hp' : OperatorKeyPresent c.cond (RequestValueLists values.val) := hp.mp rfl
      simpa only [ConditionHolds,hi,hp',not_true_eq_false,and_false,false_or] using operator_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ h
  · simp only [hi,↓reduceIte] at h
    simpa only [ConditionHolds,hi,Bool.false_eq_true,false_and,false_or] using operator_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ h

theorem all_ok (cs : Slice condfuncs.Condition) (q : condfuncs.Quantifier)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (ctx : Option awsvars.VarContext) (env : condfuncs.Env) (b : Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.all_hold cs q values ctx env=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ ∀ c ∈ cs.val, ConditionHolds (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context) (RequestValueLists values.val)
      (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2))) q c := by
  unfold condfuncs.all_hold condfuncs.all_hold_loop at h
  refine RustfsCondData.all_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold condfuncs.all_hold_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : Slice.index_usize cs i=ok _)
    have hh := condition_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ (by assumption : condfuncs.condition_evaluate _ _ _ _ _=ok _)
    refine ⟨hlt,?_,by have := add_ok_val (by assumption : i+1#usize=ok _); scalar_tac⟩
    rw [he]; exact hh.mp (by assumption)
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok (by assumption : Slice.index_usize cs i=ok _)
    have hh := condition_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ (by assumption : condfuncs.condition_evaluate _ _ _ _ _=ok _)
    exact .inl ⟨hlt,by rw [he]; exact fun hp => (by assumption : _ ≠ true) (hh.mpr hp),rfl⟩
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac,rfl⟩

theorem functions_ok (f : condfuncs.Functions)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (ctx : Option awsvars.VarContext) (env : condfuncs.Env) (b : Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.functions_evaluate f values ctx env=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ FunctionsHold (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context) (RequestValueLists values.val)
      (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2))) f := by
  unfold condfuncs.functions_evaluate at h
  obtain ⟨any,ha,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hAny := all_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ ha
  simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hAny
  cases any with
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,Result.ok.injEq] at h
    simp_all [FunctionsHold]
  | true =>
    simp only [↓reduceIte] at h
    obtain ⟨all,hall,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    have hAll := all_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hall
    simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hAll
    cases all with
    | false =>
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,Result.ok.injEq] at h
      simp_all [FunctionsHold]
    | true =>
      simp only [↓reduceIte] at h
      have hNormal := all_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ h
      simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hNormal
      simp_all [FunctionsHold]

theorem glob_star_last (n : List Nat) : globSpec [42] n = true := by
  induction n with
  | nil => simp [globSpec.eq_1, globSpec.eq_2]
  | cons x n ih => simp [globSpec.eq_3, ih]

theorem glob_lit_nil (c : Nat) (p : List Nat) (h1 : c ≠ 42) (h2 : c ≠ 63) :
    globSpec (c :: p) [] = false := by
  rw [globSpec.eq_def]; split <;> simp_all

theorem glob_lit_cons (c x : Nat) (p n : List Nat) (h1 : c ≠ 42) (h2 : c ≠ 63) :
    globSpec (c :: p) (x :: n) = (decide (c = x) && globSpec p n) := by
  rw [globSpec.eq_def]; split <;> simp_all

theorem nats_drop_cons (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (c : U8) (h : i < l.length) (hc : l[i] = c) :
    nats (l.drop i) = c.val :: nats (l.drop (i+1)) := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons h, hc]; rfl

theorem nats_drop_nil (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : l.length ≤ i) :
    nats (l.drop i) = [] := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le h]; rfl

theorem glob_star_drop (c : Nat) (hc : c = 42) (r : List Nat) (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : i < l.length) :
    globSpec (c :: r) (nats (l.drop i)) = (globSpec r (nats (l.drop i)) || globSpec (c :: r) (nats (l.drop (i+1)))) := by
  subst hc; conv => lhs; rw [nats_drop_cons l i _ h rfl, globSpec.eq_3]
  rw [← nats_drop_cons l i _ h rfl]

theorem deep_spec (p n : Slice U8) (pi ni : Usize) (hp : pi.val ≤ p.length) (hn : ni.val ≤ n.length) :
    wildmatch.deep_match p pi n ni false ⦃ b => b = globSpec (nats (p.val.drop pi.val)) (nats (n.val.drop ni.val)) ⦄ := by
  h5i_measure_induction (p.length - pi.val + (n.length - ni.val)) with ih
  have ih' : ∀ (pi' ni' : Usize), p.length - pi'.val + (n.length - ni'.val) < k → pi'.val ≤ p.length → ni'.val ≤ n.length →
      wildmatch.deep_match p pi' n ni' false ⦃ b => b = globSpec (nats (p.val.drop pi'.val)) (nats (n.val.drop ni'.val)) ⦄ :=
    fun pi' ni' h1 h2 h3 => ih _ h1 p n pi' ni' h2 h3 rfl
  clear ih
  rw [wildmatch.deep_match]
  step*
  · rw [nats_drop_nil _ _ (by scalar_tac), globSpec.eq_1]
    by_cases h : ni.val < n.length
    · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ h rfl]; simp; scalar_tac
    · rw [nats_drop_nil _ _ (by scalar_tac)]; simp; scalar_tac
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [globSpec.eq_4]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ (by scalar_tac) rfl]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [globSpec.eq_5, *]
  · have h1 : pi.val + 1 = p.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑p) (pi.val+1) (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [glob_star_last]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm]
    clear c_post; subst_vars
    by_cases h : ni.val < n.length
    · rw [nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ h rfl] at *; simp_all [globSpec.eq_3]
    · rw [nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)] at *; simp_all [globSpec.eq_2]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm] at b_post
    rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, glob_star_drop _ (by scalar_tac) _ _ _ (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars
    simp_all
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)]
    rw [nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)] at *
    clear c_post; subst_vars
    simp_all [globSpec.eq_2]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)]
    have : c.val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have : c.val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [glob_lit_nil _ _ (by assumption) (by assumption)]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ (by scalar_tac) i2_post.symm]
    have : c.val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have : c.val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [glob_lit_cons _ _ _ _ (by assumption) (by assumption)]
    have hne' : c.val ≠ i2.val := by
      intro h; have : i2 = c := by scalar_tac
      simp_all
    simp [hne']
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ (by scalar_tac) i2_post.symm]
    have : c.val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have : c.val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [glob_lit_cons _ _ _ _ (by assumption) (by assumption)]
    have heq' : i2.val = c.val := by simp_all
    simp [heq', b_post, i3_post, i4_post]

theorem wildcard_is_glob (p n : Slice U8) :
    wildmatch.is_match p n = ok (globSpec (nats p.val) (nats n.val)) := by
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  unfold wildmatch.is_match wildmatch.inner_match
  have hd := deep_spec p n 0#usize 0#usize (by simp) (by simp)
  simp at hd
  step*
  · have : p.val = [] := by rw [← List.length_eq_zero_iff]; scalar_tac
    rw [this, show nats [] = [] from rfl, globSpec.eq_1, nats]
    simp only [decide_eq_decide, ← List.length_eq_zero_iff]
    scalar_tac
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, p.val = [x] := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp (by scalar_tac)
    have : x.val = 42 := by subst_vars; simp_all
    rw [hx]; simp only [nats, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, this, glob_star_last]


@[step] theorem bytes_eq_spec (a b : Slice U8) :
    bytes.eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a.val = b.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold bytes.eq; simp only []
  split
  · simp only [WP.spec_ok]
    have : a.val ≠ b.val := fun h => by simp_all
    simp [this]
  · unfold bytes.eq_loop
    apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun (j : Usize) => a.length - j.val)
      (inv := fun j => j.val ≤ a.length ∧ ∀ k < j.val, a.val[k]! = b.val[k]!)
    · rintro j ⟨hj, hk⟩
      unfold bytes.eq_loop.body; simp only []
      step*
      · refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
        intro k hk'
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 (show k < j.val + 1 by scalar_tac) with h1 | h1
        · exact hk k h1
        · subst h1
          rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
            List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by scalar_tac), List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by scalar_tac)]
          simp only [Option.getD_some]
          apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
          simp_all
      · have hl : (a.val).length = (b.val).length := by scalar_tac
        have : a.val = b.val := by
          apply List.ext_getElem hl
          intro n h1 h2
          have := hk n (by scalar_tac)
          simp at this
          rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)] at this
          simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem h2] using this
        simp [this]
    · simp


@[step] theorem match_total (p n : Slice U8) : wildmatch.is_match p n ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  rw [wildcard_is_glob]
  simp

@[step] theorem family_spec (a b : acts.Family) :
    acts.Family.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqFamily.eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a = b) ⦄ := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [acts.Family.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqFamily.eq, acts.Family.read_discriminant]

@[step] theorem is_s3_total (a : acts.Action) (nm : Slice U8) : acts.is_s3 a nm ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  unfold acts.is_s3
  step*

@[step] theorem requires_total (a : acts.Action) : acts.action_requires_explicit_grant a ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  unfold acts.action_requires_explicit_grant
  step*

@[step] theorem match_action_deny_total (a b : acts.Action) :
    acts.action_is_match_for_effect a b true ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  unfold acts.action_is_match_for_effect
  step*

@[step] theorem match_set_deny_total (set : Slice acts.Action) (a : acts.Action) :
    acts.set_is_match_for_effect set a true ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  unfold acts.set_is_match_for_effect acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop
  apply loop_idx_spec _ id set.length (fun _ => True) _ ?_ _ (by simp) (by simp)
  intro i _ hi
  unfold acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop.body
  step*
  all_goals simp only [id] at *
  all_goals scalar_tac

@[step] theorem match_action_total (a b : acts.Action) (deny : Bool) :
    acts.action_is_match_for_effect a b deny ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  unfold acts.action_is_match_for_effect
  step*

theorem nats_inj {a b : List U8} (h : nats a = nats b) : a = b := by
  unfold nats at h
  exact List.map_injective_iff.2 (fun x y hxy => (u8_eq_iff x y).2 hxy) h

@[step] theorem is_s3_spec (a : acts.Action) (nm : Slice U8) :
    acts.is_s3 a nm ⦃ b => b = decide (a.family = .S3 ∧ a.name.val = nm.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold acts.is_s3
  step*
  all_goals simp_all [alloc.vec.Vec.deref]

theorem get_object_version_covers_get_object (s n : Slice acts.Action) (g o : acts.Action) (deny : Bool)
    (hs : s.val = [g]) (hn : n.val = [])
    (hg : g.family = .S3 ∧ nats g.name.val = lit "s3:GetObjectVersion")
    (hgo : o.family = .S3 ∧ nats o.name.val = lit "s3:GetObject") :
    acts.statement_covers s n o deny = ok true := by
  have lv : lit "s3:GetObjectVersion" =
      [115, 51, 58, 71, 101, 116, 79, 98, 106, 101, 99, 116, 86, 101, 114, 115, 105, 111, 110] := by
    decide +kernel
  have lo : lit "s3:GetObject" = [115, 51, 58, 71, 101, 116, 79, 98, 106, 101, 99, 116] := by
    decide +kernel
  have gv : g.name.val =
      [115#u8, 51#u8, 58#u8, 71#u8, 101#u8, 116#u8, 79#u8, 98#u8, 106#u8, 101#u8, 99#u8, 116#u8,
       86#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8, 115#u8, 105#u8, 111#u8, 110#u8] := by
    apply nats_inj
    simpa [nats, lv] using hg.2
  have ov : o.name.val =
      [115#u8, 51#u8, 58#u8, 71#u8, 101#u8, 116#u8, 79#u8, 98#u8, 106#u8, 101#u8, 99#u8, 116#u8] := by
    apply nats_inj
    simpa [nats, lo] using hgo.2
  have hb : acts.set_is_match_for_effect n o true = ok false := by
    unfold acts.set_is_match_for_effect acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop
    rw [loop.eq_def]
    simp [acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop.body, hn, Slice.len]
  unfold acts.statement_covers
  rw [hb]
  h5i_simp
  have hlen : Slice.len s ≠ 0#usize := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg UScalar.val h
    simp [Slice.len, hs] at hv
  rw [if_neg hlen]
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  unfold acts.set_is_match_for_effect acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop
  apply loop_idx_spec _ id s.length (fun i => i = 0#usize) (fun b => b = true) ?_ _ rfl (by simp)
  intro i hi hle
  subst i
  unfold acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop.body
  have hidx : (0#usize).val < s.length := by simp [hs]
  step*
  all_goals simp_all [hs, hg.1, hgo.1, gv, ov, Array.make_val, alloc.vec.Vec.deref]

import Verified.RustfsIpLookup
import Verified.RustfsIpNetworks
import Verified.RustfsOperatorLookup
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

theorem key_ok (requests : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (networks : Slice (condfuncs.IpAddr × U8)) (env : condfuncs.Env) (out : Option Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.addr_key requests networks env = ok out) :
    out = AddressDecision (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2)))
      networks.val (requests.val.map (·.val)) := by
  unfold condfuncs.addr_key condfuncs.addr_key_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ requests.val.length ∧
      AddressDecision (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2))) networks.val
        ((requests.val.drop i.val).map (·.val)) =
      AddressDecision (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2))) networks.val
        (requests.val.map (·.val)))
    (fun out => out = AddressDecision (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2)))
      networks.val (requests.val.map (·.val)))
    (fun i => requests.val.length-i.val) ?_ _ out (by simp) h
  · intro i result ⟨hi,he⟩ hr
    unfold condfuncs.addr_key_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    all_goals
      try
        have hn : requests.val.length ≤ i.val := by scalar_tac
        rw [List.drop_of_length_le hn] at he
        simpa only [List.map_nil,AddressDecision] using he
    all_goals
      obtain ⟨hlt,hv'⟩ := slice_index_ok hv
      have hdrop : requests.val.drop i.val = v :: requests.val.drop (i.val+1) := by
        rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt,hv']
      rw [hdrop,List.map_cons,AddressDecision] at he
      have hp := RustfsIpLookup.parse_ip_ok env _ _ ho
      simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hp
    · rw [← hp] at he
      exact he
    · have hm := (RustfsIpNetworks.any_net_ok networks ip b hb).mp hc_1
      rw [← hp] at he
      simp only [if_pos hm] at he
      exact he
    · have hm : ¬AnyNetwork networks.val ip := by
        intro hh
        exact hc_1 ((RustfsIpNetworks.any_net_ok networks ip b hb).mpr hh)
      rw [← hp] at he
      simp only [if_neg hm] at he
      have hadd : i2.val = i.val+1 := by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac
      refine ⟨⟨by omega,?_⟩,by omega⟩
      simpa only [hadd] using he

theorem conditions_ok (funcs : Slice (condfuncs.Key × alloc.vec.Vec (condfuncs.IpAddr × U8)))
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (env : condfuncs.Env) (b : Bool) (h : condfuncs.addr_func funcs values env = ok b) :
    b = AddressConditions (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2)))
      (RequestValueLists values.val) (funcs.val.map (fun e => (e.1,e.2.val))) := by
  unfold condfuncs.addr_func condfuncs.addr_func_loop at h
  let P := fun es : List (condfuncs.Key × alloc.vec.Vec (condfuncs.IpAddr × U8)) =>
    AddressConditions (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2)))
      (RequestValueLists values.val) (es.map (fun e => (e.1,e.2.val)))
  change b = P funcs.val
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ funcs.val.length ∧ P (funcs.val.drop i.val) = P funcs.val)
    (fun b => b = P funcs.val) (fun i => funcs.val.length-i.val) ?_ _ b (by simp) h
  intro i result ⟨hi,he⟩ hr
  unfold condfuncs.addr_func_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨key,networks⟩
    change (do
      let n ← condfuncs.key_lookup_name key
      let o ← condfuncs.get_value values n.deref
      let requests ← match o with
        | none => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
        | some v => ok v
      let answer ← condfuncs.addr_key requests.deref networks.deref env
      match answer with
      | none => do
        let next ← i+1#usize
        ok (ControlFlow.cont next)
      | some b => ok (ControlFlow.done b)) = ok result at hr
    obtain ⟨hlt,hx'⟩ := slice_index_ok hx
    have hd : funcs.val.drop i.val = (key,networks) :: funcs.val.drop (i.val+1) := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt,hx']
    change AddressConditions _ _ ((funcs.val.drop i.val).map _) = P funcs.val at he
    rw [hd,List.map_cons,AddressConditions] at he
    h5i_invert hr
    all_goals
      have hn' := RustfsConditionEval.lookup_name_ok key n hn
      have hl := RustfsOperatorLookup.lookup_ok values _ _ ho
      simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val, hn'] at hl
      have hreq : requests.val.map (·.val) =
          ((ConditionValues (RequestValueLists values.val) (LookupName key)).getD []) := by
        rw [← hl]
        cases o with
        | none => simp only [Option.map_none,Option.getD_none] at *
                  h5i_invert hrequests
                  rfl
        | some v => simp only [Option.map_some,Option.getD_some] at *
                    h5i_invert hrequests
                    rfl
      have hk := key_ok _ _ _ _ hanswer
      simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val,hreq] at hk
      rw [← hk] at he
    · have hadd : next.val = i.val+1 := by have := add_ok_val hnext; scalar_tac
      refine ⟨⟨by omega,?_⟩,by omega⟩
      simpa only [hadd] using he
    · exact he
  · have hn : funcs.val.length ≤ i.val := by scalar_tac
    rw [List.drop_of_length_le hn] at he
    exact he

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsIpDecision

import SpecOperators

theorem parse_ip_ok (env : condfuncs.Env) (text : Slice U8) (out : Option condfuncs.IpAddr)
    (h : condfuncs.parse_ip env text = ok out) :
    out = ParsedAddress (env.ips.val.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2))) text.val := by
  unfold condfuncs.parse_ip condfuncs.parse_ip_loop at h
  let P := fun es : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Option condfuncs.IpAddr) =>
    ParsedAddress (es.map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2))) text.val
  change out = P env.ips.val
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ env.ips.val.length ∧
      P env.ips.val = P (env.ips.val.drop i.val))
    (fun o => o = P env.ips.val) (fun i => env.ips.val.length - i.val)
    ?_ _ out ⟨by simp,by simp⟩ h
  rintro i r ⟨hi,hm⟩ hr
  unfold condfuncs.parse_ip_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨keyBytes,parsed⟩
    obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hx
    change (do
      let equal ← bytes.eq keyBytes.deref text
      if equal then ok (ControlFlow.done parsed)
      else let next ← i + 1#usize
           ok (ControlFlow.cont next)) = ok r at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · have hb := (bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hequal).1 hc_1
      simp only [deref_val] at hb
      rw [hm,List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt,he]
      simp [P,ParsedAddress,hb]
    · have hn : keyBytes.val ≠ text.val := by
        intro hh; exact hc_1 ((bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hequal).2 (by simpa [deref_val] using hh))
      have ha := add_ok_val hnext
      refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac,?_⟩,by scalar_tac⟩
      rw [hm,List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt,he]
      simp only [P,List.map_cons,ParsedAddress,List.find?_cons,hn,decide_false,
        Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
      congr 4
      scalar_tac
  · rw [hm,List.drop_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)]
    rfl
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsIpLookup

theorem any_net_ok (networks : Slice (condfuncs.IpAddr × U8)) (address : condfuncs.IpAddr)
    (b : Bool) (h : condfuncs.any_net networks address = ok b) :
    b = true ↔ AnyNetwork networks.val address := by

    · exact ⟨hlt, by simpa [he] using (fun hp => hc_1 ((RustfsScalarOperators.prefix_ok _ _ _ _ hmatched).2 hp)), by have := add_ok_val hnext; scalar_tac⟩

/-- Data-table characterization. -/
theorem s3_name_0_ok (i : Usize) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : keytables.s3_name_0 i = ok v) :
    nats v.val = if 0 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < 16 then (s3KeyNames[i.val]?).getD [] else [] := by
  unfold keytables.s3_name_0 at h

/-- Data-table characterization. -/

    refine rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsValids.any_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
    unfold keytables.contains_name_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · have hn := count_ok _ _ hi1
      have hlt : i.val < (keyNames f).length := by scalar_tac
      have ht := key_name_ok _ _ _ hv
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at ht
      simp only [Option.getD_some] at ht
      have hb := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption)

    · have hn := count_ok _ _ hi1

      have ht := key_name_ok _ _ _ hv
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at ht
      simp only [Option.getD_some] at ht
      have hb := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption)
      rw [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hb
      refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
      intro hh

      apply hb.2

  h5i_invert h
  · have hm := (contains_name_ok _ _ _ hb_1).1 hc

        keytables.KeyFamily.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqKeyFamily.eq,keytables.KeyFamily.read_discriminant]
    simp [hm,hn]
  · have hm := (contains_name_ok _ _ _ hb_1).1 hc

      cases f <;> simp_all [core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default,core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.default,

  · have hm : nats needle.val ∉ keyNames f := fun hh => hc ((contains_name_ok _ _ _ hb_1).2 hh)

import SpecKmsStatement

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsKmsMeaning
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000
open RustfsForceDelete
lemma scalar_eq {ty} (a b : UScalar ty) : a=b ↔ a.val=b.val := ⟨congrArg UScalar.val, UScalar.eq_of_val_eq⟩
lemma zero_not_pos (n : Nat) : n=0 ↔ ¬0<n := by omega
lemma backup_lit : lit "kms:Backup" = [107,109,115,58,66,97,99,107,117,112] := by decide +kernel
lemma restore_lit : lit "kms:Restore" = [107,109,115,58,82,101,115,116,111,114,101] := by decide +kernel
lemma key_lit : lit "key/" = [107,101,121,47] := by decide +kernel
def backupCheck (args : stmts.Args) : Result Bool :=
  if decide (args.action.family=.Kms)
    then
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref args.action.name
      let s1 ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 10#usize [
            107#u8, 109#u8, 115#u8, 58#u8, 66#u8, 97#u8, 99#u8, 107#u8, 117#u8,
            112#u8
            ]))
      let b1 ← bytes.eq s s1
      if b1
      then ok true
      else
        let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref args.action.name
        let s3 ←
          lift (Array.to_slice
            (Array.make 11#usize [
              107#u8, 109#u8, 115#u8, 58#u8, 82#u8, 101#u8, 115#u8, 116#u8,
              111#u8, 114#u8, 101#u8
              ]))
        bytes.eq s2 s3
    else ok false
theorem backup_ok (args : stmts.Args) (b : Bool) (h : backupCheck args=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ args.action.family=.Kms ∧ nats args.action.name.val ∈ [lit "kms:Backup",lit "kms:Restore"] := by
  unfold backupCheck at h
  simp only [family_eq_ok] at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals try have hl1 := lift_slice hs1
  all_goals try have hl2 := lift_slice hs3
  all_goals try have he1 := RustfsResourceMeaning.eq_nats _ _ _ hb1
  all_goals try have he2 := RustfsResourceMeaning.eq_nats _ _ _ h
  all_goals try simp only [deref_val] at *
  all_goals simp_all [backup_lit,restore_lit,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil]
theorem scope_ok (st : stmts.Statement) (args : stmts.Args) (ctx : Option awsvars.VarContext)
    (b : Bool) (h : stmts.kms_key_scope_matches st args ctx=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ KmsScopeHolds (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context) st args := by
  unfold stmts.kms_key_scope_matches at h
  simp only [family_eq_ok,bind_ok] at h
  bcase br with hbr at h
  change backupCheck args=ok br at hbr
  have hbackup := backup_ok args br hbr
  simp only [effect_eq_ok] at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals try have hf := RustfsKmsFilter.filter_ok _ _ (by assumption : stmts.kms_only st.resources.deref=ok _)
  all_goals try have hn := RustfsKmsFilter.filter_ok _ _ (by assumption : stmts.kms_only st.not_resources.deref=ok _)
  all_goals try have hl := lift_slice (by assumption : lift (Array.to_slice _) = ok _)
  all_goals
    try
      have hr : nats requested.val=lit "key/" ++ nats args.object.val := by
        rw [RustfsConditionEval.concat_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : bytes.concat _ _=ok requested)]
        simpa only [nats,List.map_append,deref_val,key_lit,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using congrArg (fun x=>x ++ nats args.object.val) hl
  all_goals try have hp := RustfsResourceMeaning.set_ok _ _ _ _ _ (by assumption : rsrc.set_is_match kms_resources.deref _ args.conditions ctx=ok _)
  all_goals try have hm := RustfsResourceMeaning.set_ok _ _ _ _ _ (by assumption : rsrc.set_is_match kms_not_resources.deref _ args.conditions ctx=ok _)
  all_goals simp only [scalar_eq,deref_val,gt_iff_lt,UScalar.lt_equiv,alloc.vec.Vec.len_val,alloc.vec.Vec.length,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at *
  all_goals unfold KmsScopeHolds
  all_goals simp only [KmsResources]
  all_goals try rw [←hf,←hn]
  all_goals try rw [←hr]
  all_goals simp_all only [ne_eq,decide_eq_true_eq,Bool.false_eq_true,Bool.true_eq_false,true_iff,false_iff,not_true_eq_false,not_false_eq_true,List.eq_nil_iff_length_eq_zero,zero_not_pos]
  all_goals split
  all_goals try cases b1
  all_goals try cases b2
  all_goals try simp only [Bool.true_eq_false,Bool.false_eq_true,true_iff,false_iff,not_true_eq_false,not_false_eq_true] at *
  all_goals try rw [hf,hn] at *
  all_goals tauto
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsKmsMeaning

      unfold condfuncs.str_eval_like_loop at h

        simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hm
        refine ⟨hlt, by simpa [he] using hm, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩

      refine ⟨by simpa using hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩

    · exact .inr ⟨by simpa using (show cs.val.length ≤ i.val by scalar_tac),rfl⟩
  rw [hm]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j,_,hj,hp⟩; exact ⟨j,hj,hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨j,hj,hp⟩; exact ⟨j,List.mem_range.2 hj,hj,hp⟩

import Verified.Derived
import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit



namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsNotActionForceDelete
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem glob_star_last (n : List Nat) : globSpec [42] n = true := by
  induction n with
  | nil => simp [globSpec.eq_1, globSpec.eq_2]
  | cons x n ih => simp [globSpec.eq_3, ih]

theorem glob_lit_nil (c : Nat) (p : List Nat) (h1 : c ≠ 42) (h2 : c ≠ 63) :
    globSpec (c :: p) [] = false := by
  rw [globSpec.eq_def]; split <;> simp_all

theorem glob_lit_cons (c x : Nat) (p n : List Nat) (h1 : c ≠ 42) (h2 : c ≠ 63) :
    globSpec (c :: p) (x :: n) = (decide (c = x) && globSpec p n) := by
  rw [globSpec.eq_def]; split <;> simp_all

theorem nats_drop_cons (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (c : U8) (h : i < l.length) (hc : l[i] = c) :
    nats (l.drop i) = c.val :: nats (l.drop (i+1)) := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons h, hc]; rfl

theorem nats_drop_nil (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : l.length ≤ i) :
    nats (l.drop i) = [] := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le h]; rfl

theorem glob_star_drop (c : Nat) (hc : c = 42) (r : List Nat) (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : i < l.length) :
    globSpec (c :: r) (nats (l.drop i)) = (globSpec r (nats (l.drop i)) || globSpec (c :: r) (nats (l.drop (i+1)))) := by
  subst hc; conv => lhs; rw [nats_drop_cons l i _ h rfl, globSpec.eq_3]
  rw [← nats_drop_cons l i _ h rfl]

theorem deep_spec (p n : Slice U8) (pi ni : Usize) (hp : pi.val ≤ p.length) (hn : ni.val ≤ n.length) :
    wildmatch.deep_match p pi n ni false ⦃ b => b = globSpec (nats (p.val.drop pi.val)) (nats (n.val.drop ni.val)) ⦄ := by
  h5i_measure_induction (p.length - pi.val + (n.length - ni.val)) with ih
  have ih' : ∀ (pi' ni' : Usize), p.length - pi'.val + (n.length - ni'.val) < k → pi'.val ≤ p.length → ni'.val ≤ n.length →
      wildmatch.deep_match p pi' n ni' false ⦃ b => b = globSpec (nats (p.val.drop pi'.val)) (nats (n.val.drop ni'.val)) ⦄ :=
    fun pi' ni' h1 h2 h3 => ih _ h1 p n pi' ni' h2 h3 rfl
  clear ih
  rw [wildmatch.deep_match]
  step*
  · rw [nats_drop_nil _ _ (by scalar_tac), globSpec.eq_1]
    by_cases h : ni.val < n.length
    · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ h rfl]; simp; scalar_tac
    · rw [nats_drop_nil _ _ (by scalar_tac)]; simp; scalar_tac
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [globSpec.eq_4]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ (by scalar_tac) rfl]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [globSpec.eq_5, *]
  · have h1 : pi.val + 1 = p.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑p) (pi.val+1) (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [glob_star_last]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm]
    clear c_post; subst_vars
    by_cases h : ni.val < n.length
    · rw [nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ h rfl] at *; simp_all [globSpec.eq_3]
    · rw [nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)] at *; simp_all [globSpec.eq_2]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm] at b_post
    rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, glob_star_drop _ (by scalar_tac) _ _ _ (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars
    simp_all
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)]
    rw [nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)] at *
    clear c_post; subst_vars
    simp_all [globSpec.eq_2]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)]
    have : c.val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have : c.val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [glob_lit_nil _ _ (by assumption) (by assumption)]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ (by scalar_tac) i2_post.symm]
    have : c.val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have : c.val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [glob_lit_cons _ _ _ _ (by assumption) (by assumption)]
    have hne' : c.val ≠ i2.val := by
      intro h; have : i2 = c := by scalar_tac
      simp_all
    simp [hne']
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ (by scalar_tac) i2_post.symm]
    have : c.val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have : c.val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [glob_lit_cons _ _ _ _ (by assumption) (by assumption)]
    have heq' : i2.val = c.val := by simp_all
    simp [heq', b_post, i3_post, i4_post]

theorem wildcard_is_glob (p n : Slice U8) :
    wildmatch.is_match p n = ok (globSpec (nats p.val) (nats n.val)) := by
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  unfold wildmatch.is_match wildmatch.inner_match
  have hd := deep_spec p n 0#usize 0#usize (by simp) (by simp)
  simp at hd
  step*
  · have : p.val = [] := by rw [← List.length_eq_zero_iff]; scalar_tac
    rw [this, show nats [] = [] from rfl, globSpec.eq_1, nats]
    simp only [decide_eq_decide, ← List.length_eq_zero_iff]
    scalar_tac
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, p.val = [x] := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp (by scalar_tac)
    have : x.val = 42 := by subst_vars; simp_all
    rw [hx]; simp only [nats, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, this, glob_star_last]


@[step] theorem bytes_eq_spec (a b : Slice U8) :
    bytes.eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a.val = b.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold bytes.eq; simp only []
  split
  · simp only [WP.spec_ok]
    have : a.val ≠ b.val := fun h => by simp_all
    simp [this]
  · unfold bytes.eq_loop
    apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun (j : Usize) => a.length - j.val)
      (inv := fun j => j.val ≤ a.length ∧ ∀ k < j.val, a.val[k]! = b.val[k]!)
    · rintro j ⟨hj, hk⟩
      unfold bytes.eq_loop.body; simp only []
      step*
      · refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
        intro k hk'
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 (show k < j.val + 1 by scalar_tac) with h1 | h1
        · exact hk k h1
        · subst h1
          rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
            List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by scalar_tac), List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by scalar_tac)]
          simp only [Option.getD_some]
          apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
          simp_all
      · have hl : (a.val).length = (b.val).length := by scalar_tac
        have : a.val = b.val := by
          apply List.ext_getElem hl
          intro n h1 h2
          have := hk n (by scalar_tac)
          simp at this
          rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)] at this
          simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem h2] using this
        simp [this]
    · simp


@[step] theorem match_total (p n : Slice U8) : wildmatch.is_match p n ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  rw [wildcard_is_glob]
  simp

@[step] theorem family_spec (a b : acts.Family) :
    acts.Family.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqFamily.eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a = b) ⦄ := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [acts.Family.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqFamily.eq, acts.Family.read_discriminant]

@[step] theorem is_s3_total (a : acts.Action) (nm : Slice U8) : acts.is_s3 a nm ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  unfold acts.is_s3
  step*

@[step] theorem requires_total (a : acts.Action) : acts.action_requires_explicit_grant a ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  unfold acts.action_requires_explicit_grant
  step*

@[step] theorem match_action_deny_total (a b : acts.Action) :
    acts.action_is_match_for_effect a b true ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by

theorem eq_loop_ok (a b : Slice U8) (hl : a.val.length = b.val.length) (i : Usize) (r : Bool)
    (hi : ∀ j < i.val, a.val[j]? = b.val[j]?) (h : bytes.eq_loop a b i = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ a.val = b.val) := by

  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => ∀ j < i.val, a.val[j]? = b.val[j]?) (fun r => r = true ↔ a.val = b.val)
    (fun i : Usize => a.val.length - i.val) ?_ i r hi h
  intro x r hx hr
  unfold bytes.eq_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := slice_index_ok hi3
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    intro he
    simp only [he] at h2
    simp_all
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := slice_index_ok hi3
    have := add_ok_val hi4
    simp only
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
    by_cases hjx : j < x.val
    · exact hx j hjx
    · have : j = x.val := by scalar_tac
      subst this
      have : i2 = i3 := (u8_eq_iff _ _).2 (by simpa using hc_1)
      simp_all
  · simp only [true_iff]
    apply List.ext_getElem?
    intro j
    by_cases hjx : j < x.val
    · exact hx j hjx
    · have : a.val.length ≤ j := by scalar_tac
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_none this, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]

theorem deref_val {T} (v : alloc.vec.Vec T) : (alloc.vec.Vec.deref v).val = v.val := by

theorem lift_slice {n : Usize} {l : List U8} {hl} {s : Slice U8}

theorem is_s3_ok (x : acts.Action) (s : Slice U8) (r : Bool) (h : acts.is_s3 x s = ok r) :

import Verified.RustfsOperatorLookup

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec

theorem null_conditions_ok (funcs : Slice (condfuncs.Key × Bool))
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (b : Bool) (h : condfuncs.null_func funcs values = ok b) :
    b = true ↔ NullConditions funcs.val (RequestValueLists values.val) := by
  unfold condfuncs.null_func condfuncs.null_func_loop at h
  unfold NullConditions
  refine all_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold condfuncs.null_func_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨key,want⟩
    obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hx
    change (do
      let count ← condfuncs.value_count values key
      let matched ← condfuncs.null_ok want count
      if matched then
        let next ← i + 1#usize
        ok (ControlFlow.cont next)
      else ok (ControlFlow.done false)) = ok r at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · have hn := RustfsOperatorLookup.count_ok _ _ _ hcount
      have hc := (RustfsScalarOperators.null_ok _ _ _ hmatched).1 hc_1
      refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hnext; scalar_tac⟩
      rw [he]
      simpa only [hn] using hc
    · have hn := RustfsOperatorLookup.count_ok _ _ _ hcount
      have hc := RustfsScalarOperators.null_ok _ _ _ hmatched
      refine .inl ⟨hlt, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [he]
      intro hh
      exact hc_1 (hc.2 (by simpa only [hn] using hh))
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩

/-- The byte spelling is case sensitive and only the first value is inspected. -/
theorem bool_conditions_ok (funcs : Slice (condfuncs.Key × Bool))
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (b : Bool) (h : condfuncs.bool_func funcs values = ok b) :
    b = true ↔ BoolConditions funcs.val (RequestValueLists values.val) := by
  unfold condfuncs.bool_func condfuncs.bool_func_loop at h
  unfold BoolConditions
  refine all_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold condfuncs.bool_func_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨key,want⟩
    obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hx
    change (do
      let first ← condfuncs.first_value values key
      let matched ← match first with
        | none => ok false
        | some text =>
          if want then do
            let literal ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 4#usize [116#u8,114#u8,117#u8,101#u8]))
            bytes.eq text.deref literal
          else do
            let literal ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 5#usize [102#u8,97#u8,108#u8,115#u8,101#u8]))
            bytes.eq text.deref literal
      if matched then
        let next ← i + 1#usize
        ok (ControlFlow.cont next)
      else ok (ControlFlow.done false)) = ok r at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    all_goals
      have hf := RustfsOperatorLookup.first_ok _ _ _ hfirst
      have hm : matched = true ↔ first.map (fun text => nats text.val) =
          some (if want then lit "true" else lit "false") := by
        cases first with
        | none => simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hmatched; subst matched; simp_all
        | some text =>
          cases want <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true] at hmatched <;>
            h5i_invert hmatched
          all_goals
            have hb := RustfsForceDelete.bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hmatched
            simp only [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hb
            have hl := RustfsForceDelete.lift_slice hliteral
            have hn : text.val = literal.val ↔ nats text.val = nats literal.val :=
              ⟨congrArg nats, RustfsForceDelete.nats_inj⟩
            have hh := hb.trans hn
            rw [hl] at hh
            have ht : lit "true" = [116,114,117,101] := by decide +kernel
            have hf : lit "false" = [102,97,108,115,101] := by decide +kernel
            simpa [ht,hf] using hh
    · refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hnext; scalar_tac⟩
      simp only [he, Prod.fst, Prod.snd]
      rw [← hf]
      simp only [Option.map_map, Function.comp_def]
      exact hm.1 hc_1
    · refine .inl ⟨hlt, ?_, rfl⟩
      simp only [he, Prod.fst, Prod.snd]
      rw [← hf]
      simp only [Option.map_map, Function.comp_def]
      exact fun hh => hc_1 (hm.2 hh)
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac,rfl⟩
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsNullBool

theorem parse_ok (s : Slice U8) (out : Option I64) (h : bytes.parse_i64 s = ok out) :
    out.map (·.val) = parseI64Spec (nats s.val) := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hm⟩ := RustfsParseI64.parse_i64_spec s
  rw [h] at hr
  cases Result.ok.inj hr
  exact hm

/-- A missing first request value returns `if_exists` immediately. -/
theorem numeric_conditions_ok (op : condfuncs.NumOp) (ifExists : Bool)
    (funcs : Slice (condfuncs.Key × I64))
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (b : Bool) (h : condfuncs.num_func op ifExists funcs values = ok b) :
    b = true ↔ NumericConditions op ifExists (RequestValueLists values.val)
      (funcs.val.map (fun e => (e.1,e.2.val))) := by
  unfold condfuncs.num_func condfuncs.num_func_loop at h
  let P := fun fs : List (condfuncs.Key × I64) =>
    NumericConditions op ifExists (RequestValueLists values.val) (fs.map (fun e => (e.1,e.2.val)))
  change b = true ↔ P funcs.val
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ funcs.val.length ∧
      (P funcs.val ↔ P (funcs.val.drop i.val)))
    (fun b => b = true ↔ P funcs.val)
    (fun i => funcs.val.length - i.val) ?_ _ b ⟨by simp,by simp⟩ h
  rintro i r ⟨hi,hm⟩ hr
  unfold condfuncs.num_func_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨key,bound⟩
    obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hx
    change (do
      let first ← condfuncs.first_value values key
      match first with
      | none => ok (ControlFlow.done ifExists)
      | some text => do
        let parsed ← bytes.parse_i64 text.deref
        match parsed with
        | none => ok (ControlFlow.done false)
        | some number => do
          let matched ← condfuncs.num_op op number bound
          if matched then
            let next ← i + 1#usize
            ok (ControlFlow.cont next)
          else ok (ControlFlow.done false)) = ok r at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    all_goals
      have hf := RustfsOperatorLookup.first_ok _ _ _ hfirst
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt, he] at hm
      simp only [P,List.map_cons,NumericConditions, ← hf,Option.map_none,
        Option.map_some] at hm
    · exact hm.symm
    · have hp := parse_ok _ _ hparsed
      simp only [Option.map_none, RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hp
      simp only [← hp] at hm
      simpa using hm.symm
    · have hp := parse_ok _ _ hparsed
      simp only [Option.map_some, RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hp
      have hn := (RustfsScalarOperators.numeric_ok _ _ _ _ hmatched).1 hc_1
      simp only [← hp,Option.some.injEq, exists_eq_left',hn,true_and] at hm
      have ha := add_ok_val hnext
      refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac,?_⟩,by scalar_tac⟩
      convert hm using 2
      congr 3
    · have hp := parse_ok _ _ hparsed
      simp only [Option.map_some, RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] at hp
      have hn : ¬ NumericComparison op number.val bound.val := by
        intro hh; exact hc_1 ((RustfsScalarOperators.numeric_ok _ _ _ _ hmatched).2 hh)
      simp only [← hp,Option.some.injEq, exists_eq_left',hn,false_and] at hm
      simpa using hm.symm
  · rw [List.drop_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)] at hm
    simpa [P, NumericConditions] using hm.symm
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsNumeric

theorem lookup_ok
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (needle : Slice U8) (out : Option (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (h : condfuncs.get_value values needle = ok out) :
    out.map (fun vs => vs.val.map (·.val)) =
      ConditionValues (RequestValueLists values.val) needle.val := by
  unfold condfuncs.get_value condfuncs.get_value_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ values.val.length ∧
      ConditionValues (RequestValueLists values.val) needle.val =
        ConditionValues (RequestValueLists (values.val.drop i.val)) needle.val)
    (fun o => o.map (fun vs => vs.val.map (·.val)) =
      ConditionValues (RequestValueLists values.val) needle.val)
    (fun i => values.val.length - i.val) ?_ _ out ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ h
  rintro i r ⟨hi,hm⟩ hr
  unfold condfuncs.get_value_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨keyBytes,vs⟩
    change (do
      let equal ← bytes.eq keyBytes.deref needle
      if equal then
        let copied ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone (core.clone.CloneallocvecVec core.clone.CloneU8) vs
        ok (ControlFlow.done (some copied))
      else
        let next ← i + 1#usize
        ok (ControlFlow.cont next)) = ok r at hr
    obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hx
    h5i_invert hr
    · have hb := (bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hequal).1 hc_1
      have hc := post_of_ok (CloneLaw.vec_clone_spec _ vs) hcopied
      rw [hm, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt, he]
      simp only [deref_val] at hb
      simp [ConditionValues, RequestValueLists, hc, hb]
    · have hb : keyBytes.val ≠ needle.val := by
        intro hh; exact hc_1 ((bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hequal).2 (by simpa [deref_val] using hh))
      have ha := add_ok_val hnext
      refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
      rw [hm, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt, he]
      simp only [RequestValueLists, List.map_cons, ConditionValues, List.find?_cons,
        hb, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
      congr 4
      scalar_tac
  · rw [hm, List.drop_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)]
    rfl

theorem first_ok
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))

theorem denies_pass_loop_spec (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)

    (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ sts.val.length) :

    (measure := fun (j : Usize) => sts.val.length - j.val)
    (inv := fun (j : Usize) => j.val ≤ sts.val.length)
    (post := fun (b : Bool) => b = true)

    policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e = ok true := by
  have hpass : policies.denies_pass sts a e = ok true := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 (denies_pass_spec sts a e hd)
    exact hy

import Verified.Derived

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec

def signed (neg : Bool) (v : Nat) : Int := if neg then -(v : Int) else v

/-- The negative magnitude may reach `2^63`; the positive one may not. -/
def limit (neg : Bool) : Nat := if neg then 2 ^ 63 else 2 ^ 63 - 1

def decimal (ds : List Nat) (a : Nat) : Nat :=
  ds.foldl (fun acc d => 10 * acc + (d - 48)) a

def digit (d : Nat) : Bool := decide (48 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 57)

def digitsModel (neg : Bool) (ds : List Nat) (a : Nat) : Option Int :=
  if ds.all digit ∧ decimal ds a ≤ limit neg then some (signed neg (decimal ds a)) else none

/-- Appending digits cannot bring an overflowing magnitude back into range. -/
theorem decimal_ge (ds : List Nat) (a : Nat) : a ≤ decimal ds a := by
  induction ds generalizing a with
  | nil => simp [decimal]
  | cons d ds ih =>
    have := ih (10 * a + (d - 48))
    simp only [decimal, List.foldl_cons] at *
    omega

theorem signed_bounds (neg : Bool) (a : Nat) :
    (I64.min ≤ signed neg a ∧ signed neg a ≤ I64.max) ↔ a ≤ limit neg := by
  cases neg <;> simp [signed, limit, I64.min, I64.max, I64.numBits]

theorem signed_range (neg : Bool) (a : Nat) :
    (-(2 ^ 63 : Int) ≤ signed neg a ∧ signed neg a < 2 ^ 63) ↔ a ≤ limit neg := by
  cases neg <;> simp [signed, limit] <;> omega

theorem digitsModel_eq_spec (neg : Bool) (ds : List Nat) (hne : ds ≠ []) :
    digitsModel neg ds 0 =
      match digitsVal ds with
      | none => none
      | some v => if -(2 ^ 63 : Int) ≤ signed neg v ∧ signed neg v < 2 ^ 63
          then some (signed neg v) else none := by
  cases ds with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons d ds =>
    simp only [digitsModel, digitsVal, decimal, signed_range]
    split
    · simp_all [digit]
    · split <;> simp_all [digit]

theorem parseI64Spec_unsigned (d : Nat) (ds : List Nat)
    (hm : d ≠ 45) (hp : d ≠ 43) :
    parseI64Spec (d :: ds) = digitsModel false (d :: ds) 0 := by
  rw [digitsModel_eq_spec false (d :: ds) (by simp)]
  delta parseI64Spec
  split
  rename_i p neg rest hsign
  split at hsign <;> simp_all [signed]
  rfl

theorem digitsModel_nil (neg : Bool) (a : Nat) (ha : a ≤ limit neg) :
    digitsModel neg [] a = some (signed neg a) := by
  simp [digitsModel, decimal, ha]

theorem digitsModel_bad (neg : Bool) (ds : List Nat) (a d : Nat)
    (hd : ¬ (48 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 57)) : digitsModel neg (d :: ds) a = none := by
  simp [digitsModel, digit, hd]

theorem digitsModel_cons (neg : Bool) (ds : List Nat) (a d : Nat)
    (hd : 48 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 57) :
    digitsModel neg (d :: ds) a = digitsModel neg ds (10 * a + (d - 48)) := by
  simp [digitsModel, digit, hd, decimal]

theorem digitsModel_overflow (neg : Bool) (ds : List Nat) (a : Nat)
    (ha : limit neg < a) : digitsModel neg ds a = none := by
  have := decimal_ge ds a
  simp [digitsModel, show ¬ decimal ds a ≤ limit neg by omega]

theorem checked_scale (acc : I64) (neg : Bool) (a : Nat)
    (hacc : acc.val = signed neg a) :
    match I64.checked_mul acc 10#i64 with
    | none => limit neg < 10 * a
    | some m => m.val = signed neg (10 * a) := by
  have h := I64.checked_mul_bv_spec acc 10#i64
  cases hm : I64.checked_mul acc 10#i64 with
  | none =>
    simp only [I64.checked_mul] at hm
    rw [hm] at h
    cases neg <;> simp [signed, limit, I64.min, I64.max, I64.numBits] at * <;> omega
  | some m =>
    simp only [I64.checked_mul] at hm
    rw [hm] at h
    cases neg <;> simp [signed] at * <;> omega

theorem checked_digit (m d : I64) (neg : Bool) (a b : Nat)
    (hm : m.val = signed neg a) (hd : d.val = b) :
    match (if neg then I64.checked_sub m d else I64.checked_add m d) with
    | none => limit neg < a + b
    | some v => v.val = signed neg (a + b) := by
  cases neg with
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    have h := I64.checked_add_bv_spec m d
    cases hv : I64.checked_add m d with
    | none =>
      simp only [I64.checked_add] at hv
      rw [hv] at h
      simp [signed, limit, I64.min, I64.max, I64.numBits] at *
      omega
    | some v =>
      simp only [I64.checked_add] at hv
      rw [hv] at h
      simp [signed] at *
      omega
  | true =>
    simp only [if_true]
    have h := I64.checked_sub_bv_spec m d
    cases hv : I64.checked_sub m d with
    | none =>
      simp only [I64.checked_sub] at hv
      rw [hv] at h
      simp [signed, limit, I64.min, I64.max, I64.numBits] at *
      omega
    | some v =>
      simp only [I64.checked_sub] at hv
      rw [hv] at h
      simp [signed] at *
      omega

/-- The recursive parser computes the decimal fold of the remaining bytes. -/
theorem parse_digits_spec (ds : List U8) (s : Slice U8) (i : Usize)
    (acc : I64) (neg : Bool) (a : Nat)
    (hi : i.val ≤ s.val.length) (hds : s.val.drop i.val = ds)
    (hacc : acc.val = signed neg a) :
    bytes.parse_digits s i acc neg ⦃ r => r.map (·.val) = digitsModel neg (nats ds) a ⦄ := by
  induction ds generalizing i acc a with
  | nil =>
    have hend : i.val = s.val.length := by
      have := congrArg List.length hds
      simp only [List.length_drop, List.length_nil] at this
      omega
    have ha : a ≤ limit neg := (signed_bounds neg a).1 (by rw [← hacc]; scalar_tac)
    rw [bytes.parse_digits]
    simp only [show i ≥ Slice.len s by scalar_tac, reduceIte, WP.spec_ok,
      Option.map_some, hacc, nats, List.map_nil, digitsModel_nil neg a ha]
  | cons c ds ih =>
    have hlt : i.val < s.val.length := by
      have := congrArg List.length hds
      simp only [List.length_drop, List.length_cons] at this
      omega
    have hc : s.val[i.val] = c := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt] at hds
      exact (List.cons.inj hds).1
    have htail : s.val.drop (i.val + 1) = ds := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt] at hds
      exact (List.cons.inj hds).2
    rw [bytes.parse_digits]
    simp only [show ¬ i ≥ Slice.len s by scalar_tac, reduceIte]
    step as ⟨c', hc'⟩
    have heq : c' = c := hc'.trans hc
    subst c'
    rw [hc]
    split
    · rename_i hbad
      simp only [WP.spec_ok, Option.map_none]
      exact (digitsModel_bad neg (nats ds) a c.val (by scalar_tac)).symm
    · split
      · rename_i hbad
        simp only [WP.spec_ok, Option.map_none]
        exact (digitsModel_bad neg (nats ds) a c.val (by scalar_tac)).symm
      · rename_i hlo hhi
        have hd : 48 ≤ c.val ∧ c.val ≤ 57 := by scalar_tac
        change _ ⦃ (r : Option I64) => r.map (·.val) = digitsModel neg (c.val :: nats ds) a ⦄
        rw [digitsModel_cons neg (nats ds) a c.val hd]
        step as ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩
        step with UScalar.hcast_inBounds_spec .I64 b (by scalar_tac) as ⟨d, hdval⟩
        have hdval' : d.val = (c.val - 48 : Nat) := by omega
        simp only [lift, bind_ok]
        have hscale := checked_scale acc neg a hacc
        cases hmul : I64.checked_mul acc 10#i64 with
        | none =>
          rw [hmul] at hscale
          simp only [WP.spec_ok, Option.map_none]
          exact (digitsModel_overflow neg (nats ds) _ (by omega)).symm
        | some m =>
          rw [hmul] at hscale
          have hnext := checked_digit m d neg (10 * a) (c.val - 48) hscale hdval'
          dsimp only
          rw [show (if neg then ok (I64.checked_sub m d) else ok (I64.checked_add m d)) =
            ok (if neg then I64.checked_sub m d else I64.checked_add m d) by cases neg <;> rfl]
          simp only [bind_ok]
          cases hn : (if neg then I64.checked_sub m d else I64.checked_add m d) with
          | none =>
            rw [hn] at hnext
            simp only [WP.spec_ok, Option.map_none]
            exact (digitsModel_overflow neg (nats ds) _ hnext).symm
          | some v =>
            rw [hn] at hnext
            step as ⟨j, hj⟩
            apply ih j v (10 * a + (c.val - 48)) (by scalar_tac) ?_ hnext
            simpa only [hj] using htail

theorem parse_i64_spec (s : Slice U8) :
    ∃ r, bytes.parse_i64 s = ok r ∧ r.map (·.val) = parseI64Spec (nats s.val) := by
  apply (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1
  cases hs : s.val with
  | nil =>
    unfold bytes.parse_i64
    have hlen : Slice.len s = 0#usize := by scalar_tac
    simp only [hlen, if_true, WP.spec_ok, Option.map_none]
    rfl
  | cons c ds =>
    unfold bytes.parse_i64
    have hlen : Slice.len s ≠ 0#usize := by scalar_tac
    simp only [hlen, reduceIte]
    step as ⟨c', hc'⟩
    have hc : s.val[0]'(by scalar_tac) = c := by simp [hs]
    have heq : c' = c := hc'.trans hc
    subst c'
    rw [hc]
    split
    · rename_i hminus
      simp only [bind_ok]
      split
      · rename_i hend
        have hnil : ds = [] := by
          have hv := congrArg UScalar.val hend
          have hl : ds.length = 0 := by scalar_tac
          exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hl
        subst ds
        rw [hminus]
        simp only [WP.spec_ok, Option.map_none]
        rfl
      · rename_i hmore
        have hne : nats ds ≠ [] := by
          intro hempty
          have hl : ds.length = 0 := by simpa [nats] using congrArg List.length hempty
          apply hmore
          scalar_tac
        rw [hminus]
        simp only [decide_true]
        apply WP.spec_mono (parse_digits_spec ds s 1#usize 0#i64 true 0
          (by scalar_tac) (by simp [hs]) (by simp [signed]))
        intro r hr
        rw [hr, digitsModel_eq_spec true (nats ds) hne]
        rfl
    · split
      · rename_i hplus
        simp only [bind_ok]
        split
        · rename_i hend
          have hnil : ds = [] := by
            have hv := congrArg UScalar.val hend
            have hl : ds.length = 0 := by scalar_tac
            exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hl
          subst ds
          rw [hplus]
          simp only [WP.spec_ok, Option.map_none]
          rfl
        · rename_i hmore
          have hne : nats ds ≠ [] := by
            intro hempty
            have hl : ds.length = 0 := by simpa [nats] using congrArg List.length hempty
            apply hmore
            scalar_tac
          rw [hplus]
          simp only [show (43#u8 : U8) ≠ 45#u8 by decide, decide_false]
          apply WP.spec_mono (parse_digits_spec ds s 1#usize 0#i64 false 0
            (by scalar_tac) (by simp [hs]) (by simp [signed]))
          intro r hr
          rw [hr, digitsModel_eq_spec false (nats ds) hne]
          rfl
      · rename_i hminus hplus
        simp only [bind_ok]
        split
        · rename_i hend
          exact False.elim (hlen hend.symm)
        · simp only [hminus, decide_false]
          apply WP.spec_mono (parse_digits_spec (c :: ds) s 0#usize 0#i64 false 0
            (by scalar_tac) (by simpa using hs) (by simp [signed]))
          intro r hr
          rw [hr]
          have hm : c.val ≠ 45 := by intro h; apply hminus; scalar_tac
          have hp : c.val ≠ 43 := by intro h; apply hplus; scalar_tac
          exact (parseI64Spec_unsigned c.val (nats ds) hm hp).symm

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsParseI64

import Verified.RustfsPathLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsPathFull
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
open RustfsCleanCanonical RustfsPathMeaning RustfsPathLoop
lemma init_meaning (p : Slice U8) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (first : U8) (out)
    (hp : p.index_usize 0#usize=ok first) (h : initState b first=ok out) :
    Meaning p out.1 out.2.1 out.2.2.1 out.2.2.2.1 out.2.2.2.2=NormalizedPath (nats p.val) := by
  have hh : (nats p.val).head?=some first.val := by
    simpa only [List.head?_eq_getElem?,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using index_nat hp
  unfold initState at h
  h5i_invert h
  · rcases x with ⟨x,f⟩
    obtain ⟨hb,rfl⟩ := mut_ok hx
    change (do
      let w ← 0#usize + 1#usize
      ok (true,b.set 0#usize 47#u8,w,1#usize,1#usize))=ok out at h
    h5i_invert h
    have hv := add_ok_val hw
    have he : w=1#usize := by scalar_tac
    subst w
    have hf : first=47#u8 := by assumption
    have hwrite := pref_write b 0#usize 1#usize 47#u8 hb (by scalar_tac)
    simp only [pref,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,List.take_zero,nats,List.map_nil,List.nil_append] at hwrite
    dsimp only [Meaning]
    have hpref : pref (b.set 0#usize 47#u8) 1#usize=[47] := by
      simpa only [pref,nats,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hwrite
    rw [hpref]
    simp only [NormalizedPath,hh,hf,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,decide_true,↓reduceIte]
  · have hf : first.val≠47 := by scalar_tac
    dsimp only [Meaning]
    simp only [NormalizedPath,hh,Option.some.injEq,hf,decide_false,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
    simp only [pref,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,List.take_zero,nats,List.map_nil,List.drop_zero]
theorem clean_meaning (p : Slice U8) (c : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (h : pathclean.clean p=ok c) :
    nats c.val=CleanPath (nats p.val) := by
  unfold pathclean.clean at h
  simp only [←initState.eq_def,lift] at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have hp : p.val=[] := List.eq_nil_iff_length_eq_zero.mpr (by scalar_tac)
    rw [to_vec_ok _ c h]
    simp only [Array.to_slice,Slice.from_val,Array.make_val,nats,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,
      UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,hp,CleanPath,NormalizedPath,List.head?_nil,
      reduceCtorEq,decide_false,↓reduceIte,NormalizeTail]
  · rcases x with ⟨root,b1,w,r,d⟩
    have hinv := initState_ok buf i1 (root,b1,w,r,d) hx
    have hm := init_meaning p buf i1 (root,b1,w,r,d) (by assumption) hx
    dsimp only at hinv hm
    obtain ⟨⟨b2,w2⟩,hloop,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    have hl := main_meaning p p.len root b1 w r d (b2,w2) (by simp) hinv hloop
    dsimp only at hl
    rw [hm] at hl
    change (if w2=0#usize then _ else pathclean.clean_loop1 b2 w2 (alloc.vec.Vec.new U8) 0#usize)=ok c at h
    h5i_invert h
    · have hz : NormalizedPath (nats p.val)=[] := by
        rw [←hl,hc_1]
        simp only [pref,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,List.take_zero,nats,List.map_nil]
      simp only [CleanPath,hz,↓reduceIte]
      rw [to_vec_ok _ c h]
      simp only [Array.to_slice,Slice.from_val,Array.make_val,nats,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,
        UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    · obtain ⟨_,hb,_⟩ := main_loop_ok p p.len root b1 w r d (b2,w2) (by simp) hinv hloop
      dsimp only at hb
      have hn : NormalizedPath (nats p.val)≠[] := by
        intro he
        have he := congrArg List.length (hl.trans he)
        rw [pref_length b2 w2 hb] at he
        scalar_tac
      rw [output_ok b2 w2 c h]
      change pref b2 w2=CleanPath (nats p.val)
      simp only [CleanPath,hn,↓reduceIte]
      exact hl
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsPathFull

import Verified.RustfsPathMeaning
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsPathLoop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
open RustfsCleanCanonical RustfsPathMeaning
lemma drop_index (text : List Nat) (r c : Nat) (h : text[r]?=some c) :
    text.drop r=c::text.drop (r+1) := by
  have hr : r<text.length := by exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h).1
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hr]
  congr 1
  exact Option.some.inj ((List.getElem?_eq_getElem hr).symm.trans h)
lemma norm_slash root d out rest :
    NormalizeTail root d out (47::rest)=NormalizeTail root d out rest := by
  simp only [NormalizeTail]
lemma norm_dot root d out rest (hr : rest=[] ∨ rest.head?=some 47) :
    NormalizeTail root d out (46::rest)=NormalizeTail root d out rest := by
  rcases hr with rfl | hr
  · rw [NormalizeTail,NormalizeTail]
  · cases rest with
    | nil => simp at hr
    | cons c cs =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons,Option.some.injEq] at hr
      subst c
      simp only [NormalizeTail]
lemma norm_parent root d out rest (hr : rest=[] ∨ rest.head?=some 47) :
    NormalizeTail root d out (46::46::rest)=
      NormalizeTail root (ParentPath root d out).2 (ParentPath root d out).1 rest := by
  rcases hr with rfl | hr
  · rw [NormalizeTail,NormalizeTail]
  · cases rest with
    | nil => simp at hr
    | cons c cs =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons,Option.some.injEq] at hr
      subst c
      simp only [NormalizeTail]
lemma norm_ordinary root d out (input : List Nat)
    (hn : input≠[]) (hs : input.head?≠some 47)
    (hd : input≠[46] ∧ (∀ rest, input≠46::47::rest) ∧ input≠[46,46] ∧
      (∀ rest,input≠46::46::47::rest)) :
    NormalizeTail root d out input=
      NormalizeTail root d
        (out ++ (if out.length=(if root then 1 else 0) then [] else [47]) ++
           input.takeWhile (fun c => c != 47))
        (input.dropWhile (fun c => c != 47)) := by
  fun_cases NormalizeTail root d out input <;> simp_all
lemma next_drop (p : Slice U8) (r next : Usize) (c : U8)
    (hi : p.index_usize r=ok c) (hv : next.val=r.val+1) :
    (nats p.val).drop r.val=c.val::(nats p.val).drop next.val := by
  rw [drop_index _ _ _ (index_nat hi),hv]
lemma end_drop (p : Slice U8) (r : Usize) (h : r.val≥p.val.length) :
    (nats p.val).drop r.val=[] := by
  simp only [List.drop_eq_nil_iff,nats,List.length_map]
  exact h
def Meaning (p : Slice U8) (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w r d : Usize) : List Nat :=
  NormalizeTail root d.val (pref b w) ((nats p.val).drop r.val)
def StepMeaning (p : Slice U8) (expected : List Nat) :
    ControlFlow (Bool × alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize × Usize × Usize) (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize) → Prop
  | .cont (root,b,w,r,d) => Meaning p root b w r d=expected
  | .done (b,w) => pref b w=expected
lemma parent_step (p : Slice U8) (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w r next d : Usize) (res)
    (hw : w.val≤b.val.length)
    (ht : (nats p.val).drop r.val=46::46::(nats p.val).drop next.val)
    (hr : (nats p.val).drop next.val=[] ∨ ((nats p.val).drop next.val).head?=some 47)
    (h : parent root b w next d=ok res) : StepMeaning p (Meaning p root b w r d) res := by
  obtain ⟨b',w',d',he,hpair⟩ := parent_meaning root b w next d res hw h
  rw [he]
  dsimp only [StepMeaning,Meaning]
  have hp := congrArg Prod.fst hpair
  have hd := congrArg Prod.snd hpair
  dsimp only at hp hd
  rw [hp,hd,ht]
  exact (norm_parent root d.val (pref b w) _ hr).symm
lemma ordinary_step (p : Slice U8) (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (w r d : Usize) (res)
    (hw : w.val≤b.val.length) (hr : r.val<p.val.length)
    (hs : (nats p.val)[r.val]?≠some 47)
    (hd : (nats p.val).drop r.val≠[46] ∧
      (∀ rest, (nats p.val).drop r.val≠46::47::rest) ∧
      (nats p.val).drop r.val≠[46,46] ∧
      (∀ rest,(nats p.val).drop r.val≠46::46::47::rest))
    (h : ordinary root b w r d p=ok res) : StepMeaning p (Meaning p root b w r d) res := by
  obtain ⟨b',w',r',he,hp,ht⟩ := ordinary_meaning root b w r d p res hw hr hs h
  rw [he]
  dsimp only [StepMeaning,Meaning]
  rw [hp,ht]
  have hl := pref_length b w hw
  rw [←hl]
  apply (norm_ordinary root d.val (pref b w) _ ?_ ?_ hd).symm
  · intro he
    have hl := congrArg List.length he
    simp only [List.length_drop,nats,List.length_map,List.length_nil] at hl
    omega
  · simpa only [List.head?_drop] using hs
theorem step_meaning (p : Slice U8) (n : Usize) (root : Bool) (b : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (w r d : Usize) (res) (hn : n.val=p.val.length) (hi : Inv root b w d)
    (hs : pathclean.clean_loop0.body p n root b w r d=ok res) :
    StepMeaning p (Meaning p root b w r d) res := by
  unfold pathclean.clean_loop0.body at hs
  simp only [←ordinary.eq_def,←parent.eq_def] at hs
  h5i_invert hs
  · dsimp only [StepMeaning,Meaning]
    have hv := add_ok_val hr1
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv
    have ht := next_drop p r r1 i hi_1 hv
    have hc : i=47#u8 := by assumption
    rw [ht,hc]
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,norm_slash]
  · dsimp only [StepMeaning,Meaning]
    have hv := add_ok_val hi1
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv
    have ht := next_drop p r i1 i hi_1 hv
    have hc : i=46#u8 := by assumption
    have he := end_drop p i1 (by scalar_tac)
    rw [ht,hc]
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    exact (norm_dot root d.val (pref b w) _ (Or.inl he)).symm
  · dsimp only [StepMeaning,Meaning]
    have hv := add_ok_val hi1
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv
    have ht := next_drop p r i1 i hi_1 hv
    have hc : i=46#u8 := by assumption
    have hc2 : i2=47#u8 := by assumption
    have hh : ((nats p.val).drop i1.val).head?=some 47 := by
