def Inv (p t : List U8) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  i ≤ p.length ∧ i ≤ t.length ∧ ∀ j < i,
    p[j]? ≠ some (42#u8) ∧ (p[j]? = some (63#u8) ∨ p[j]? = t[j]?)

theorem star_accept (p t : List U8) (i : Nat) (hi : Inv p t i)
    (hp : i < p.length) (ht : i < t.length) (hs : p[i]? = some (42#u8)) :
    PatternPrefix p t :=
  ⟨i,hi.1,hi.2.1,fun j hj => (hi.2.2 j hj).2,Or.inl ⟨hp,ht,hs⟩⟩

theorem end_accept (p t : List U8) (i : Nat) (hi : Inv p t i) (ht : t.length ≤ i) :
    PatternPrefix p t := by
  have ht2 := hi.2.1
  have he : i = t.length := by omega
  exact ⟨i,hi.1,hi.2.1,fun j hj => (hi.2.2 j hj).2,Or.inr he⟩

theorem advance (p t : List U8) (i : Nat) (hi : Inv p t i)
    (hp : i < p.length) (ht : i < t.length) (hs : p[i]? ≠ some (42#u8))
    (ha : p[i]? = some (63#u8) ∨ p[i]? = t[i]?) : Inv p t (i+1) := by
  refine ⟨by omega,by omega,fun j hj => ?_⟩
  by_cases hji : j < i
  · exact hi.2.2 j hji
  · have he : j = i := by omega
    simpa [he] using And.intro hs ha

theorem mismatch_reject (p t : List U8) (i : Nat) (hi : Inv p t i)
    (ht : i < t.length) (hs : p[i]? ≠ some (42#u8))
    (ha : ¬ (p[i]? = some (63#u8) ∨ p[i]? = t[i]?)) : ¬ PatternPrefix p t := by
  rintro ⟨k,hkp,hkt,hagree,hend⟩
  by_cases hik : i < k
  · exact ha (hagree i hik)
  · rcases hend with ⟨_,_,hkstar⟩ | hk
    · by_cases hki : k < i

theorem version_append (ps : List manage.Policy) (p : manage.Policy) :

theorem merge_loop_ok (ps : Slice manage.Policy) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (ss : alloc.vec.Vec manage.Statement)

    v.val = FirstPolicyVersion ps.val ∧ ss.val = (ps.val.map (fun p => p.statements.val)).flatten := by
  unfold manage.merge_policies_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec manage.Statement × Usize =>
      x.2.2.val ≤ ps.val.length ∧ x.1.val = FirstPolicyVersion (ps.val.take x.2.2.val) ∧
        x.2.1.val = ((ps.val.take x.2.2.val).map (fun p => p.statements.val)).flatten)
    (fun r => r.1.val = FirstPolicyVersion ps.val ∧ r.2.val = (ps.val.map (fun p => p.statements.val)).flatten)
    (fun x => ps.val.length - x.2.2.val) ?_ _ (v,ss) ⟨by simp,by simp [FirstPolicyVersion],by simp⟩ h
  rintro ⟨ver,acc,i⟩ r ⟨hi,hv,ha⟩ hr

  unfold manage.merge_policies_loop.body at hr
  simp only [u8vec_clone,bind_ok] at hr

    have hadd := add_ok_val hi3

    have ht : ps.val.take i3.val = ps.val.take i.val ++ [p] := by

  · dsimp only
    have he : i.val = ps.val.length := by scalar_tac
    simpa only [he,List.take_length] using And.intro hv ha
theorem merge_ok (ps : Slice manage.Policy) (out : manage.Policy)
    (h : manage.merge_policies ps = ok out) :
    out.id.val = [] ∧ out.version.val = FirstPolicyVersion ps.val ∧

theorem inner_ok (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (resolved initial : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (ignoreCase : Bool)

  refine loop_ok _ (fun s : Bool × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Usize =>
    s.1=ignoreCase ∧ s.2.2.val ≤ resolved.val.length ∧
    texts s.2.1.val=texts initial.val ++ (resolved.val.take s.2.2.val).map F)

theorem resolve_ok (policy : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (i : Usize)

    (PolicyValueTransform (RequestValueLists values.val) ignoreCase)
  refine loop_ok _ (fun s : Bool × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) × Usize =>
    s.1=ignoreCase ∧ s.2.2.val ≤ policy.val.length ∧
    texts s.2.1.val=texts initial.val ++ (policy.val.take s.2.2.val).flatMap F)
    (fun r => texts r.val=texts initial.val ++ PolicyCandidates (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context)
      (RequestValueLists values.val) ignoreCase (texts policy.val))
    (fun s => policy.val.length-s.2.2.val) ?_ _ out ⟨rfl,by simp,by simp⟩ h
  rintro ⟨flag,buf,i⟩ r ⟨hflag,hi,ha⟩ hr

  subst flag
  unfold condfuncs.policy_values_loop0.body at hr
  by_cases hb : i<policy.len

    obtain ⟨resolved,hresolved,hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hr

    rw [hbuf,ha,hres,htake,List.flatMap_append,List.flatMap_cons,List.flatMap_nil,List.append_nil]

  rintro ⟨acc,i⟩ result ⟨hi,he⟩ hr
  unfold bytes.replace_loop0.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have hlt : i.val<s.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hpos : 0<search.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hp := (starts_with_at_ok s search i b hb).mp hc_2
    have hbound := hp.1
    have hprefix := (prefix_iff _ _ _ (by omega)).mp hp
    have hpred : 0<search.val.length ∧ search.val <+: s.val.drop i.val := ⟨hpos,hprefix⟩
    have hadd : i4.val=i.val+search.val.length := by have := add_ok_val hi4; scalar_tac
    simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] at hi he ⊢
    rw [ReplaceSuffix] at he
    simp only [dif_pos hlt,dif_pos hpred] at he
    refine ⟨⟨by omega,?_⟩,by omega⟩
    rw [append_loop _ _ _ hout1,hadd,List.append_assoc]
    exact he
  · have hlt : i.val<s.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hp : ¬ (0<search.val.length ∧ search.val <+: s.val.drop i.val) := by
      intro hh
      exact hc_2 ((starts_with_at_ok s search i b hb).mpr
        ((prefix_iff _ _ _ (by omega)).mpr hh.2))
    obtain ⟨_,hv⟩ := slice_index_ok hi3
    have hadd : i4.val=i.val+1 := by have := add_ok_val hi4; scalar_tac
    simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] at hi he ⊢
    rw [ReplaceSuffix] at he
    simp only [dif_pos hlt,dif_neg hp] at he
    refine ⟨⟨by omega,?_⟩,by omega⟩
    rw [push_ok hout1,hadd,List.append_assoc]
    simpa only [hv,List.singleton_append] using he
  · have hlt : i.val<s.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hp : ¬ (0<search.val.length ∧ search.val <+: s.val.drop i.val) := by
      intro hh
      have : 0<search.val.length := hh.1
      scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨_,hv⟩ := slice_index_ok hi3
    have hadd : i4.val=i.val+1 := by have := add_ok_val hi4; scalar_tac
    simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] at hi he ⊢
    rw [ReplaceSuffix] at he
    simp only [dif_pos hlt,dif_neg hp] at he
    refine ⟨⟨by omega,?_⟩,by omega⟩
    rw [push_ok hout1,hadd,List.append_assoc]
    simpa only [hv,List.singleton_append] using he
  · have hlt : ¬i.val<s.val.length := by scalar_tac
    simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] at he
    rw [ReplaceSuffix] at he
    simpa only [dif_neg hlt,List.append_nil] using he
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsReplace

import Verified.RustfsManagementTags
import Verified.RustfsBucketPrincipal
import Verified.RustfsManagementViews
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsRequestTags
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsManagementTags (functions_tag_ok)
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsManagementViews (statement_view_ok bp_view_ok)
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete (effect_eq_ok deref_val)

theorem policy_loop_witness (p : manage.Policy) (args : stmts.Args) (vc : awsvars.VarContext)
    (b : Bool) (h : manage.policy_needs_existing_object_tag_for_args_loop p args vc 0#usize = ok b) :
    b = true → ∃ st ∈ p.statements.val, FunctionsUseExistingTag st.conditions ∧
      ∃ view, manage.statement_view st = ok view ∧ stmts.reaches_condition_eval view args (some vc) = ok true := by
  unfold manage.policy_needs_existing_object_tag_for_args_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun _ : Usize => True) (fun b => b = true → ∃ st ∈ p.statements.val,
      FunctionsUseExistingTag st.conditions ∧ ∃ view, manage.statement_view st = ok view ∧
      stmts.reaches_condition_eval view args (some vc) = ok true)
    (fun i => p.statements.val.length - i.val) ?_ _ b trivial h
  intro i r _ hr
  unfold manage.policy_needs_existing_object_tag_for_args_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hst
    exact ⟨st,by rw [←he]; exact List.getElem_mem hlt,
      (functions_tag_ok _ _ hb_1).1 hc_1,s,hs,by simpa only [hc_2] using hb1⟩
  · exact ⟨trivial,by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
  · exact ⟨trivial,by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
  · simp
theorem bucket_loop_witness (p : manage.BucketPolicy) (args : stmts.BucketPolicyArgs)
    (b : Bool) (h : manage.bucket_policy_needs_existing_object_tag_for_args_loop p args 0#usize = ok b) :
    b = true → ∃ st ∈ p.statements.val, FunctionsUseExistingTag st.conditions ∧
      ∃ view, manage.bp_statement_view st = ok view ∧ stmts.bp_reaches_condition_eval view args = ok true := by
  unfold manage.bucket_policy_needs_existing_object_tag_for_args_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun _ : Usize => True) (fun b => b = true → ∃ st ∈ p.statements.val,
      FunctionsUseExistingTag st.conditions ∧ ∃ view, manage.bp_statement_view st = ok view ∧
      stmts.bp_reaches_condition_eval view args = ok true)
    (fun i => p.statements.val.length - i.val) ?_ _ b trivial h
  intro i r _ hr
  unfold manage.bucket_policy_needs_existing_object_tag_for_args_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hst
    exact ⟨st,by rw [←he]; exact List.getElem_mem hlt,
      (functions_tag_ok _ _ hb_1).1 hc_1,b1,hb1,by simpa only [hc_2] using hb2⟩
  · exact ⟨trivial,by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
  · exact ⟨trivial,by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
  · simp
theorem policy_needs_sound (p : manage.Policy) (args : stmts.Args) (env : condfuncs.Env)
    (h : manage.policy_needs_existing_object_tag_for_args p args env = ok true) :
    ∃ st ∈ p.statements.val, FunctionsUseExistingTag st.conditions ∧
      (st.effect = .Allow → IsForceDelete args.action →
        ∃ x ∈ st.actions.val, acts.action_is_match_for_effect x args.action false = ok true) := by
  unfold manage.policy_needs_existing_object_tag_for_args at h
  h5i_invert h
  obtain ⟨st,hm,ht,view,hv,hr⟩ := policy_loop_witness _ _ _ _ h rfl
  refine ⟨st,hm,ht,?_⟩
  intro he hf
  have hv' := statement_view_ok _ _ hv
  unfold stmts.reaches_condition_eval at hr
  rw [effect_eq_ok,hv'.1,he] at hr
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
  have hd' : d = false := (Result.ok.inj hd).symm
  subst d
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
  cases c
  · simp at hr
  · have hw := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.covers_ok _ _ _ hf hc
    simpa only [deref_val,hv'.2.1] using hw

theorem bucket_needs_sound (p : manage.BucketPolicy) (args : stmts.BucketPolicyArgs)
    (h : manage.bucket_policy_needs_existing_object_tag_for_args p args = ok true) :
    ∃ st ∈ p.statements.val, FunctionsUseExistingTag st.conditions ∧
      stmts.principal_is_match st.principal args.account.deref = ok true := by
  unfold manage.bucket_policy_needs_existing_object_tag_for_args at h
  h5i_invert h
  obtain ⟨st,hm,ht,view,hv,hr⟩ := bucket_loop_witness _ _ _ h rfl
  have hp := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBucketPrincipal.bp_reaches_condition_eval_principal _ _ hr
  have hv' := bp_view_ok _ _ hv
  exact ⟨st,hm,ht,by simpa only [hv'.2.1] using hp⟩
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsRequestTags

Verified.RustfsResolutionTerminates.code:
import Verified.Derived
import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsResolutionTerminates

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
open ControlFlow

/-- A finite execution, with a postcondition on successful results. -/
def Finishes {α : Type} (m : Result α) (P : α → Prop) : Prop :=
  (∃ x, m = ok x ∧ P x) ∨ ∃ e, m = fail e

namespace Finishes

theorem ret {α : Type} {x : α} {P : α → Prop} (h : P x) : Finishes (ok x) P :=
  .inl ⟨x, rfl, h⟩

theorem error {α : Type} (e : Error) (P : α → Prop) : Finishes (fail e) P :=
  .inr ⟨e, rfl⟩

theorem of_spec {α : Type} {m : Result α} {P : α → Prop} (h : m ⦃ P ⦄) :
    Finishes m P := .inl ((WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).mp h)

theorem mono {α : Type} {m : Result α} {P Q : α → Prop}
    (h : Finishes m P) (hq : ∀ x, P x → Q x) : Finishes m Q := by
  rcases h with ⟨x, hx, hp⟩ | h
  · exact .inl ⟨x, hx, hq x hp⟩
  · exact .inr h

theorem bind {α β : Type} {m : Result α} {k : α → Result β} {P : α → Prop}
    {Q : β → Prop} (h : Finishes m P)
    (hk : ∀ x, m = ok x → P x → Finishes (k x) Q) :
    Finishes (Std.bind m k) Q := by
  rcases h with ⟨x, hx, hp⟩ | ⟨e, he⟩
  · simpa [hx] using hk x hx hp
  · simp only [he, bind_fail]; exact error e Q

theorem loop_nat {α β : Type} (body : α → Result (ControlFlow α β))
    (μ : α → Nat) (P : α → Prop) (Q : β → Prop)
    (hs : ∀ x, P x → Finishes (body x) (fun r => match r with
      | .done y => Q y
      | .cont y => P y ∧ μ y < μ x)) :
    ∀ x, P x → Finishes (loop body x) Q := by
  intro x
  induction h : μ x using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing x with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hx
    rw [loop]
    apply bind (hs x hx)
    intro r _ hr
    cases r with
    | done y => exact ret hr
    | cont y => exact ih (μ y) (h ▸ hr.2) y rfl hr.1

theorem add (x y : Usize) : Finishes (x + y) (fun z => z.val = x.val + y.val) := by
  by_cases h : x.val + y.val ≤ Usize.max
  · exact of_spec (Usize.add_spec h)
  · change Finishes (UScalar.tryMk .Usize (x.val + y.val)) _
    unfold UScalar.tryMk UScalar.tryMkOpt
    split
    · rename_i hb
      exfalso; apply h
      simp only [UScalar.check_bounds_eq_inBounds, UScalar.inBounds] at hb
      scalar_tac
    · exact error _ _

theorem sub (x y : Usize) : Finishes (x - y) (fun z => z.val = x.val - y.val) := by
  by_cases h : y.val ≤ x.val
  · exact (of_spec (Usize.sub_spec h)).mono (fun _ h => h.1)
  · change Finishes (UScalar.sub x y) _
    unfold UScalar.sub
    simp only [show x.val < y.val from by omega, ↓reduceIte]
    exact error _ _

theorem index {α : Type} (s : Slice α) (i : Usize) :
    Finishes (s.index_usize i) (fun x => s.val[i.val]? = some x) := by
  unfold Slice.index_usize
  cases h : s.val[i.val]? with
  | none => exact error _ _
  | some x => exact ret rfl

theorem vindex {α : Type} (s : alloc.vec.Vec α) (i : Usize) :
    Finishes (alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice α) s i)
      (fun x => s.val[i.val]? = some x) := by
  simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.index, alloc.vec.Vec.val] using index s.slice i

theorem push {α : Type} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) (x : α) :
    Finishes (alloc.vec.Vec.push v x) (fun w => w.val = v.val ++ [x]) := by
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.push
  dsimp only
  split
  · exact ret (by simp)
  · exact error _ _

theorem clone (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8) :
    Finishes (alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 v) (fun w => w = v) := by
  rw [u8vec_clone]; exact ret rfl

theorem to_vec (s : Slice U8) :
    Finishes (alloc.slice.Slice.to_vec core.clone.CloneU8 s) (fun w => w.val = s.val) := by
  apply of_spec
  step*; simp_all [alloc.vec.Vec.val]

end Finishes

@[simp] theorem deref_eq {α : Type} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) :
    alloc.vec.Vec.deref v = v.slice := by
  apply (Slice.eq_iff _ _).mpr
  simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.deref, Slice.from_val, alloc.vec.Vec.val]

theorem loop_fin {α β : Type} (body : α → Result (ControlFlow α β))
    (μ : α → Nat) (Q : α → β → Prop)
    (hs : ∀ x, Finishes (body x) (fun r => match r with
      | .done y => Q x y
      | .cont y => μ y < μ x ∧ ∀ z, Q y z → Q x z)) :
    ∀ x, Finishes (loop body x) (Q x) := by
  intro x
  induction h : μ x using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing x with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [loop]
    apply Finishes.bind (hs x)
    intro r _ hr
    cases r with
    | done y => exact Finishes.ret hr
    | cont y => exact (ih (μ y) (h ▸ hr.1) y rfl).mono hr.2

macro "fstep" t:term " with " x:ident h:ident : tactic => `(tactic| (
  try simp only [deref_eq]
  apply Finishes.bind $t
  intro $x _ $h
  try dsimp only at $h ⊢
))

macro "fprimitive" : tactic => `(tactic| (
  first
  | exact Finishes.add _ _
  | exact Finishes.sub _ _
  | exact Finishes.index _ _
  | exact Finishes.vindex _ _
  | exact Finishes.push _ _
  | exact Finishes.clone _
  | exact Finishes.to_vec _
))

theorem slice_fin (s : Slice U8) (a b : Usize) :
    Finishes (bytes.slice s a b) (fun v => v.val.length = b.val - a.val) := by
  unfold bytes.slice bytes.slice_loop
  refine (loop_fin (fun x => bytes.slice_loop.body s b x.1 x.2)
    (fun x => b.val - x.2.val)
    (fun x (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8) => v.val.length = x.1.val.length + (b.val - x.2.val))
    ?_ (alloc.vec.Vec.new U8, a)).mono ?_
  · rintro ⟨out, i⟩
    unfold bytes.slice_loop.body
    dsimp only
    split
    · rename_i hi
      fstep (Finishes.index s i) with c hc
      fstep (Finishes.push out c) with out' ho
      fstep (Finishes.add i 1#usize) with j hj
      apply Finishes.ret
      simp only [ho, List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
      simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hj
      constructor
      · scalar_tac
      · intro v hv; scalar_tac
    · apply Finishes.ret; scalar_tac
  · intro v hv
    simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new, alloc.vec.Vec.from_val, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add] using hv

theorem concat_fin (a b : Slice U8) :
    Finishes (bytes.concat a b) (fun v => v.val.length = a.val.length + b.val.length) := by
  unfold bytes.concat
  fstep (slice_fin a 0#usize (Slice.len a)) with out ho
  unfold bytes.concat_loop
  refine (loop_fin (fun x => bytes.concat_loop.body b x.1 x.2)
    (fun x => b.val.length - x.2.val)
    (fun x (v : alloc.vec.Vec U8) => v.val.length = x.1.val.length + (b.val.length - x.2.val)) ?_
    (out, 0#usize)).mono ?_
  · rintro ⟨out, i⟩
    unfold bytes.concat_loop.body
    dsimp only
    split
    · rename_i hi
      fstep (Finishes.index b i) with c hc
      fstep (Finishes.push out c) with out' ho
      fstep (Finishes.add i 1#usize) with j hj
      apply Finishes.ret
      simp only [ho, List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
      simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hj
      constructor
      · scalar_tac
      · intro v hv; scalar_tac
    · apply Finishes.ret; scalar_tac
  · intro v hv
    simp only [Slice.len_val, Slice.length, Nat.sub_zero, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at ho hv
    omega

theorem eq_fin (a b : Slice U8) : Finishes (bytes.eq a b) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold bytes.eq
  dsimp only
  split
  · exact Finishes.ret trivial
  · unfold bytes.eq_loop
    apply Finishes.loop_nat _ (fun i => a.val.length + 1 - i.val)
      (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True) ?_ _ trivial
    intro i _
    unfold bytes.eq_loop.body
    dsimp only
    split
    · rename_i hi
      fstep (Finishes.index a i) with c hc
      fstep (Finishes.index b i) with d hd
      split
      · exact Finishes.ret trivial
      · fstep (Finishes.add i 1#usize) with j hj
        apply Finishes.ret; constructor
        · trivial
        · scalar_tac
    · exact Finishes.ret trivial

theorem starts_fin (s p : Slice U8) (a : Usize) :
    Finishes (bytes.starts_with_at s a p) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold bytes.starts_with_at
  dsimp only
  split
  · exact Finishes.ret trivial
  · fstep (Finishes.sub (Slice.len s) a) with n hn
    split
    · exact Finishes.ret trivial
    · unfold bytes.starts_with_at_loop
      apply Finishes.loop_nat _ (fun i => p.val.length + 1 - i.val)
        (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True) ?_ _ trivial
      intro i _
      unfold bytes.starts_with_at_loop.body
      dsimp only
      split
      · rename_i hi
        fstep (Finishes.add a i) with j hj
        fstep (Finishes.index s j) with c hc
        fstep (Finishes.index p i) with d hd
        split
        · exact Finishes.ret trivial
        · fstep (Finishes.add i 1#usize) with k hk
          apply Finishes.ret; constructor
          · trivial
          · scalar_tac
      · exact Finishes.ret trivial

theorem find_fin (s p : Slice U8) (a : Usize) :
    Finishes (bytes.find_from s a p) (fun o => ∀ j, o = some j →
      a.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val + p.val.length ≤ s.val.length) := by
  unfold bytes.find_from bytes.find_from_loop
  apply loop_fin (fun i => bytes.find_from_loop.body s p i)
    (fun i => s.val.length + 1 - i.val)
    (fun i o => ∀ j, o = some j → i.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val + p.val.length ≤ s.val.length)
  intro i
  unfold bytes.find_from_loop.body
  dsimp only
  split
  · rename_i hi
    fstep (Finishes.sub (Slice.len s) i) with n hn
    split
    · rename_i hp
      fstep (starts_fin s p i) with b hb
      split
      · apply Finishes.ret
        intro j hj
        cases Option.some.inj hj
        scalar_tac
      · fstep (Finishes.add i 1#usize) with k hk
        apply Finishes.ret
        constructor
        · scalar_tac
        · intro o ho j hj
          obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ho j hj
          constructor
          · scalar_tac
          · exact h2
    · apply Finishes.ret; simp
  · apply Finishes.ret; simp

theorem contains_fin (s p : Slice U8) : Finishes (bytes.contains s p) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold bytes.contains
  fstep (find_fin s p 0#usize) with o ho
  cases o <;> exact Finishes.ret trivial

theorem pending_fin (p : awsvars.Pending) :
    Finishes (awsvars.pending_clone p) (fun q => q = p) := by
  unfold awsvars.pending_clone
  fstep (Finishes.clone p.text) with v hv
  subst v
  exact Finishes.ret rfl

macro "fbase" : tactic => `(tactic| (
  first
  | exact eq_fin _ _
  | exact starts_fin _ _ _
  | exact contains_fin _ _
  | exact pending_fin _
  | exact slice_fin _ _ _
  | exact concat_fin _ _
  | fprimitive
  | exact (Finishes.add _ _).mono (fun _ _ => True.intro)
  | exact (Finishes.sub _ _).mono (fun _ _ => True.intro)
))

macro "fplain_using " "[" solver:tacticSeq "]" : tactic => `(tactic| (
  try dsimp only
  repeat' first
  | (simp only [bind_ok, lift])
  | $solver
  | (apply Finishes.ret; first
      | trivial
      | (constructor; trivial; scalar_tac)
      | scalar_tac)
  | (apply Finishes.bind (by $solver)
     intro x hx hp
     try dsimp only at hp ⊢)
  | split
))

macro "fplain" : tactic => `(tactic| fplain_using [fbase])

theorem clone_list_fin (s : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) :
    Finishes (awsvars.clone_list s) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold awsvars.clone_list awsvars.clone_list_loop
  apply Finishes.loop_nat _ (fun x => s.val.length + 1 - x.2.val)
    (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True) ?_ _ trivial
  rintro ⟨out, i⟩ _
  unfold awsvars.clone_list_loop.body
  fplain

macro "fclone" : tactic => `(tactic| first | fbase | exact clone_list_fin _)

theorem userid_fin (c : awsvars.ClaimStrings) :
    Finishes (awsvars.userid_strings c) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold awsvars.userid_strings
  fplain_using [fclone]

macro "fuserid" : tactic => `(tactic| first | fclone | exact userid_fin _)

theorem resolve_fin (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (s : Slice U8) :
    Finishes (awsvars.resolve ctx s) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold awsvars.resolve
  simp only [lift, bind_ok]
  fplain_using [fuserid]

macro "fresolve" : tactic => `(tactic| first | fuserid | exact resolve_fin _ _)

theorem multiple_fin (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (s : Slice U8) :
    Finishes (awsvars.resolve_multiple ctx s) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold awsvars.resolve_multiple
  simp only [lift, bind_ok]
  fplain_using [fresolve]

theorem member_fin (s : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (p : Slice U8) :
    Finishes (bytes.member s p) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold bytes.member bytes.member_loop
  apply Finishes.loop_nat _ (fun i => s.val.length + 1 - i.val)
    (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True) ?_ _ trivial
  intro i _
  unfold bytes.member_loop.body
  fplain

macro "fmember" : tactic => `(tactic| first | fresolve | exact member_fin _ _)

theorem dedup_fin (s : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) :
    Finishes (awsvars.dedup s) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold awsvars.dedup awsvars.dedup_loop
  apply Finishes.loop_nat _ (fun x => s.val.length + 1 - x.2.val)
    (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True) ?_ _ trivial
  rintro ⟨out, i⟩ _
  unfold awsvars.dedup_loop.body
  fplain_using [fmember]

theorem extend_fin (out : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (s : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) :
    Finishes (awsvars.extend out s) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold awsvars.extend awsvars.extend_loop
  apply Finishes.loop_nat _ (fun x => s.val.length + 1 - x.2.val)
    (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True) ?_ _ trivial
  rintro ⟨out, i⟩ _
  unfold awsvars.extend_loop.body
  fplain

theorem texts_fin (s : Slice awsvars.Pending) :
    Finishes (awsvars.texts s) (fun _ => True) := by
  unfold awsvars.texts awsvars.texts_loop
  apply Finishes.loop_nat _ (fun x => s.val.length + 1 - x.2.val)
    (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True) ?_ _ trivial
  rintro ⟨out, i⟩ _
  unfold awsvars.texts_loop.body
  fplain

theorem closing_fin (s : Slice U8) (a : Usize) :
    Finishes (awsvars.closing s a) (fun r => a.val ≤ r.1.val ∧
      (r.2 = 0#usize → r.1.val < s.val.length)) := by
  unfold awsvars.closing awsvars.closing_loop
  apply Finishes.loop_nat (fun x : Usize × Usize => awsvars.closing_loop.body s x.1 x.2)
    (fun x => 2 * (s.val.length + 1 - x.2.val) + if x.1 = 0#usize then 0 else 1)
    (fun x => a.val ≤ x.2.val ∧ (x.1 = 0#usize → x.2.val < s.val.length))
    (fun r : Usize × Usize => a.val ≤ r.1.val ∧ (r.2 = 0#usize → r.1.val < s.val.length))
  · rintro ⟨brace, e⟩ ⟨ha, hz⟩
    unfold awsvars.closing_loop.body
    dsimp only
    split
    · rename_i he
      split
      · rename_i hb
        have hb0 : brace ≠ 0#usize := by scalar_tac
        fstep (Finishes.index s e) with c hc
        have hf : Finishes
            (if c = 123#u8 then brace + 1#usize else
              if c = 125#u8 then brace - 1#usize else ok brace)
            (fun _ => True) := by fplain
        fstep hf with b hbb
        split
        · rename_i hbn
          fstep (Finishes.add e 1#usize) with e' he'
          have hb' : b ≠ 0#usize := by scalar_tac
          apply Finishes.ret
          simp only [hb', ↓reduceIte]
          constructor
          · constructor
            · scalar_tac
            · intro h; contradiction
          · scalar_tac
        · rename_i hbn
          have hb' : b = 0#usize := by scalar_tac
          apply Finishes.ret
          simp only [hb', ↓reduceIte]
          constructor
          · exact ⟨ha, fun _ => by scalar_tac⟩
          · omega
      · exact Finishes.ret ⟨ha, hz⟩
    · exact Finishes.ret ⟨ha, hz⟩
  · exact ⟨Nat.le_refl _, by simp⟩

def copyBody (s : Slice awsvars.Pending) (n : Nat)
    (x : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Usize) :
    Result (ControlFlow (alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Usize) (alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending)) := do
  if x.2.val < n then
    let p ← s.index_usize x.2
    let q ← awsvars.pending_clone p
    let out ← alloc.vec.Vec.push x.1 q
    let j ← x.2 + 1#usize
    ok (.cont (out, j))
  else ok (.done x.1)

theorem copy_fin (s : Slice awsvars.Pending) (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ s.val.length)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize) :
    Finishes (loop (copyBody s n) (out, i))
      (fun v => v.val = out.val ++ (s.val.take n).drop i.val) := by
  apply loop_fin (copyBody s n) (fun x => n + 1 - x.2.val)
    (fun x v => v.val = x.1.val ++ (s.val.take n).drop x.2.val)
  rintro ⟨out, i⟩
  unfold copyBody
  dsimp only
  split
  · rename_i hi
    fstep (Finishes.index s i) with p hp
    fstep (pending_fin p) with q hq
    subst q
    fstep (Finishes.push out p) with out' ho
    fstep (Finishes.add i 1#usize) with j hj
    apply Finishes.ret
    constructor
    · simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hj
      dsimp only
      omega
    · intro v hv
      rw [hv, ho, List.append_assoc]
      have hil : i.val < (s.val.take n).length := by simp; omega
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hil]
      have hpi : s.val[i.val] = p := by
        have hi' : i.val < s.val.length := by omega
        simpa only [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi', Option.some.injEq] using hp
      simp only [List.getElem_take, hpi, hj, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.singleton_append]
  · apply Finishes.ret
    have he : (s.val.take n).drop i.val = [] :=
      List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by simp; omega)
    simp [he]

theorem splice_fin (s : Slice awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize) (new : Slice awsvars.Pending)
    (hi : i.val < s.val.length) :
    Finishes (awsvars.splice s i new)
      (fun v => v.val = s.val.take i.val ++ new.val ++ s.val.drop (i.val + 1)) := by
  unfold awsvars.splice
  have h0 : Finishes (awsvars.splice_loop0 s i (alloc.vec.Vec.new awsvars.Pending) 0#usize)
      (fun v => v.val = s.val.take i.val) := by
    unfold awsvars.splice_loop0
    change Finishes (loop (copyBody s i.val) (alloc.vec.Vec.new _, 0#usize)) _
    exact (copy_fin s i.val (by omega) _ _).mono (by intro v hv; simpa using hv)
  fstep h0 with out ho
  have h1 : Finishes (awsvars.splice_loop1 new out 0#usize)
      (fun v => v.val = out.val ++ new.val) := by
    unfold awsvars.splice_loop1
    change Finishes (loop (copyBody new new.val.length) (out, 0#usize)) _
    exact (copy_fin new new.val.length (by omega) _ _).mono (by intro v hv; simpa using hv)
  fstep h1 with out' ho'
  fstep (Finishes.add i 1#usize) with j hj
  unfold awsvars.splice_loop2
  change Finishes (loop (copyBody s s.val.length) (out', j)) _
  apply (copy_fin s s.val.length (by omega) _ _).mono
  intro v hv
  simpa [ho', ho, hj] using hv

theorem wrap_fin («prefix» : Slice U8) (values : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (suffix : Slice U8) (a : Usize) (ha : «prefix».val.length = a.val) :
    Finishes (awsvars.wrap_all «prefix» values suffix a)
      (fun out => ∀ p ∈ out.val, p.text.val.length - p.resume.val = suffix.val.length) := by
  unfold awsvars.wrap_all awsvars.wrap_all_loop
  apply Finishes.loop_nat
    (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Usize =>
      awsvars.wrap_all_loop.body «prefix» values suffix a x.1 x.2)
    (fun x => values.val.length + 1 - x.2.val)
    (fun x => ∀ p ∈ x.1.val, p.text.val.length - p.resume.val = suffix.val.length)
    (fun out => ∀ p ∈ out.val, p.text.val.length - p.resume.val = suffix.val.length)
  · rintro ⟨out, i⟩ hout
    unfold awsvars.wrap_all_loop.body
    dsimp only
    split
    · rename_i hi
      fstep (Finishes.index values i) with v hv
      fstep (concat_fin «prefix» v.slice) with v1 h1
      fstep (concat_fin v1.slice suffix) with v2 h2
      fstep (Finishes.add a (alloc.vec.Vec.len v)) with j hj
      fstep (Finishes.push out {text := v2, resume := j}) with out' ho
      fstep (Finishes.add i 1#usize) with k hk
      apply Finishes.ret
      constructor
      · intro p hp
        rw [ho, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hp
        rcases hp with hp | rfl
        · exact hout p hp
        · dsimp only
          change v1.val.length = «prefix».val.length + v.val.length at h1
          change v2.val.length = v1.val.length + suffix.val.length at h2
          scalar_tac
      · scalar_tac
    · exact Finishes.ret hout
  · simp

def base : Nat := Usize.max + 1

theorem base_gt_one : 1 < base := by
  have := usize_max_ge
  unfold base
  omega

/-- The base exceeds the number of results any successful substitution can produce.
Replacing a pending result with shorter unprocessed suffixes decreases their total weight. -/
def weight (p : awsvars.Pending) : Nat := base ^ (p.text.val.length - p.resume.val + 1)

def score (ps : List awsvars.Pending) : Nat := (ps.map weight).sum

theorem score_append (xs ys : List awsvars.Pending) :
    score (xs ++ ys) = score xs + score ys := by simp [score]

theorem score_cons (p : awsvars.Pending) (ps : List awsvars.Pending) :
    score (p :: ps) = weight p + score ps := by simp [score]

theorem weight_pos (p : awsvars.Pending) : 0 < weight p :=
  Nat.pow_pos (by have := base_gt_one; omega)

theorem score_bound (ps : List awsvars.Pending) (n : Nat)
    (h : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.text.val.length - p.resume.val ≤ n) :
    score ps ≤ ps.length * base ^ (n + 1) := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp [score]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    rw [score_cons, List.length_cons]
    have hp : weight p ≤ base ^ (n + 1) := by
      apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by have := base_gt_one; omega)
      have := h p (by simp)
      omega
    have ht := ih (fun q hq => h q (by simp [hq]))
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    omega

theorem score_replace (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize)
    (p : awsvars.Pending) (hp : results.val[i.val]? = some p)
    (new : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (n : Nat)
    (hn : n < p.text.val.length - p.resume.val)
    (hnew : ∀ q ∈ new.val, q.text.val.length - q.resume.val ≤ n) :
    score ((results.val.take i.val ++ new.val ++ results.val.drop (i.val + 1)).drop i.val) <
      score (results.val.drop i.val) := by
  have hi : i.val < results.val.length := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hp |>.1
  have hpi : results.val[i.val] = p := by simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi] using hp
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi, hpi, score_cons]
  have hlen : (results.val.take i.val).length = i.val := by simp; omega
  rw [List.append_assoc, List.drop_append_of_le_length (by omega)]
  have hem : (results.val.take i.val).drop i.val = [] :=
    List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)
  rw [hem, List.nil_append, score_append]
  have hbound := score_bound new.val n hnew
  have hm := alloc.vec.Vec.property new
  have hpow : base ^ (n + 1) * base ≤ weight p := by
    rw [← Nat.pow_succ]
    apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by have := base_gt_one; omega)
    omega
  have hpos : 0 < base ^ (n + 1) := Nat.pow_pos (by have := base_gt_one; omega)
  have hlt : new.val.length * base ^ (n + 1) < base ^ (n + 1) * base := by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm (base ^ (n + 1)) base]
    apply Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
    · unfold base; omega
    · exact hpos
  omega

def ScanPost (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize)
    (r : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending × Bool) : Prop :=
  if r.2 then score (r.1.val.drop i.val) < score (results.val.drop i.val)
  else r.1 = results

theorem splice_modified_fin (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize)
    (p : awsvars.Pending) (hp : results.val[i.val]? = some p)
    (new : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (n : Nat)
    (hn : n < p.text.val.length - p.resume.val)
    (hnew : ∀ q ∈ new.val, q.text.val.length - q.resume.val ≤ n) :
    Finishes (do let v ← awsvars.splice results.slice i new.slice; ok (v, true))
      (ScanPost results i) := by
  have hi : i.val < results.val.length := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hp |>.1
  fstep (splice_fin results.slice i new.slice hi) with v hv
  apply Finishes.ret
  simp only [ScanPost, ↓reduceIte]
  change v.val = results.val.take i.val ++ new.val ++ results.val.drop (i.val + 1) at hv
  rw [hv]
  exact score_replace results i p hp new n hn hnew

theorem scan_fin (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (hinner : ∀ (s : Slice U8) (d : Usize), depth.val < d.val →
      Finishes (awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx s d) (fun _ => True))
    (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize) (p : awsvars.Pending)
    (hp : results.val[i.val]? = some p) (start : Usize) (hs : p.resume.val ≤ start.val) :
    Finishes (awsvars.scan ctx results i start depth) (ScanPost results i) := by
  induction hm : p.text.val.length + 1 - start.val using Nat.strong_induction_on
      generalizing start with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [awsvars.scan]
    simp only [deref_eq]
    fstep (Finishes.vindex results i) with q hq
    have heq : q = p := by rw [hp] at hq; exact (Option.some.inj hq).symm
    subst q
    fstep (Finishes.clone p.text) with s hs'
    subst s
    simp only [lift, bind_ok]
    fstep (find_fin _ _ _) with pos hpos
    cases pos with
    | none => exact Finishes.ret (by simp [ScanPost])
    | some posIdx =>
      dsimp only
      have hfind := hpos posIdx rfl
      change start.val ≤ posIdx.val ∧ posIdx.val + 2 ≤ p.text.val.length at hfind
      fstep (Finishes.add posIdx 2#usize) with a ha
      fstep (closing_fin p.text.slice a) with closing hc
      rcases closing with ⟨e, brace⟩
      simp only [uncurry_apply_pair]
      dsimp only at hc
      split
      · exact Finishes.ret (by simp [ScanPost])
      · rename_i hb
        have hb0 : brace = 0#usize := by scalar_tac
        have he : e.val < p.text.val.length := hc.2 hb0
        have hea : a.val ≤ e.val := hc.1
        fstep (slice_fin p.text.slice a e) with var hv
        fstep (slice_fin p.text.slice 0#usize posIdx) with pref hpr
        fstep (Finishes.add e 1#usize) with next hnext
        fstep (slice_fin p.text.slice next (alloc.vec.Vec.len p.text)) with suffix hsu
        have hplen : pref.val.length = posIdx.val := by simpa using hpr
        have hshort : suffix.val.length < p.text.val.length - p.resume.val := by
          change suffix.val.length = p.text.val.length - next.val at hsu
          simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at ha hnext
          omega
        have hrec : Finishes (awsvars.scan ctx results i next depth) (ScanPost results i) := by
          apply ih (p.text.val.length + 1 - next.val) ?_ next ?_ rfl
          · simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at ha hnext
            omega
          · simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at ha hnext
            omega
        have hwrap (values : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) :=
          wrap_fin pref.slice values suffix.slice posIdx hplen
        try simp only [lift, bind_ok]
        fstep (contains_fin _ _) with nested hnested
        split
        · fstep (Finishes.add depth 1#usize) with d hd
          have hdgt : depth.val < d.val := by scalar_tac
          fstep (hinner var.slice d hdgt) with inner hinner'
          split
          · fstep (Finishes.vindex inner 0#usize) with v hv'
            fstep (eq_fin v.slice var.slice) with same hsame
            split
            · exact hrec
            · fstep (hwrap inner.slice) with new hnew
              split
              · exact splice_modified_fin results i p hp new suffix.val.length hshort
                  (fun q hq => Nat.le_of_eq (hnew q hq))
              · exact hrec
          · fstep (hwrap inner.slice) with new hnew
            split
            · exact splice_modified_fin results i p hp new suffix.val.length hshort
                (fun q hq => Nat.le_of_eq (hnew q hq))
            · exact hrec
        · fstep (multiple_fin ctx var.slice) with values hvalues
          cases values with
          | none => exact hrec
          | some values =>
            dsimp only
            split
            · fstep (hwrap values.slice) with new hnew
              exact splice_modified_fin results i p hp new suffix.val.length hshort
                (fun q hq => Nat.le_of_eq (hnew q hq))
            · fstep (concat_fin pref.slice suffix.slice) with text ht
              fstep (Finishes.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new awsvars.Pending) {text := text, resume := posIdx})
                with new hnew
              apply splice_modified_fin results i p hp new suffix.val.length hshort
              intro q hq
              rw [hnew] at hq
              simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.new, alloc.vec.Vec.from_val, List.nil_append,
                List.mem_singleton] at hq
              subst q
              change text.val.length = pref.val.length + suffix.val.length at ht
              dsimp only
              omega

theorem score_skip (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize)
    (p : awsvars.Pending) (hp : results.val[i.val]? = some p) :
    score (results.val.drop (i.val + 1)) < score (results.val.drop i.val) := by
  have hi : i.val < results.val.length := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hp |>.1
  have hpi : results.val[i.val] = p := by simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi] using hp
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi, hpi, score_cons]
  have := weight_pos p
  omega

theorem pass_from_fin (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (hinner : ∀ (s : Slice U8) (d : Usize), depth.val < d.val →
      Finishes (awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx s d) (fun _ => True))
    (results : alloc.vec.Vec awsvars.Pending) (i : Usize) :
    Finishes (awsvars.pass_from ctx results i depth) (fun _ => True) := by
  induction hm : score (results.val.drop i.val) using Nat.strong_induction_on
      generalizing results i with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [awsvars.pass_from]
    try dsimp only
    split
    · exact Finishes.ret trivial
    · fstep (Finishes.vindex results i) with p hp
      fstep (scan_fin ctx depth hinner results i p hp p.resume (by omega)) with r hr
      rcases r with ⟨results', modified⟩
      simp only [uncurry_apply_pair]
      try dsimp only at hr
      cases modified with
      | false =>
        simp only [ScanPost, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hr
        subst results'
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
        fstep (Finishes.add i 1#usize) with j hj
        apply ih (score (results.val.drop j.val)) ?_ results j rfl
        have hh := score_skip results i p hp
        simpa [hj, hm] using hh
      | true =>
        simp only [ScanPost, ↓reduceIte] at hr
        simp only [↓reduceIte]
        exact ih (score (results'.val.drop i.val)) (hm ▸ hr) results' i rfl

theorem single_fin (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (hinner : ∀ (s : Slice U8) (d : Usize), depth.val < d.val →
      Finishes (awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx s d) (fun _ => True))
    (pattern : Slice U8) :
    Finishes (awsvars.resolve_single_pass ctx pattern depth) (fun _ => True) := by
  rw [awsvars.resolve_single_pass]
  simp only [deref_eq]
  fstep (Finishes.to_vec pattern) with text ht
  fstep (Finishes.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new awsvars.Pending)
    ({text := text, resume := 0#usize} : awsvars.Pending)) with results hr
  fstep (pass_from_fin ctx depth hinner results 0#usize) with out ho
  exact texts_fin out.slice

theorem pass_all_fin (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (hinner : ∀ (s : Slice U8) (d : Usize), depth.val < d.val →
      Finishes (awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx s d) (fun _ => True))
    (results : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (k : Usize)
    (acc : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (changed : Bool) :
    Finishes (awsvars.pass_all ctx results k acc changed depth) (fun _ => True) := by
  induction hm : results.val.length + 1 - k.val using Nat.strong_induction_on
      generalizing k acc changed with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [awsvars.pass_all]
    simp only [deref_eq]
    try dsimp only
    split
    · exact Finishes.ret trivial
    · rename_i hk
      fstep (Finishes.index results k) with v hv
      fstep (single_fin ctx depth hinner v.slice) with resolved hr
      have hdiff : Finishes
          (if alloc.vec.Vec.len resolved > 1#usize then ok true else
            if alloc.vec.Vec.len resolved = 1#usize then do
              let w ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
                resolved 0#usize
              let b ← bytes.eq w.slice v.slice
              ok (¬b)
            else ok false) (fun _ => True) := by fplain
      fstep hdiff with differs hd
      fstep (extend_fin acc resolved.slice) with acc' ha
      fstep (Finishes.add k 1#usize) with j hj
      have hc : Finishes (if changed then ok true else ok differs) (fun _ => True) := by
        split <;> exact Finishes.ret trivial
      fstep hc with changed' hc'
      apply ih (results.val.length + 1 - j.val) ?_ j acc' changed' rfl
      scalar_tac

theorem fixpoint_fin (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (depth : Usize)
    (hinner : ∀ (s : Slice U8) (d : Usize), depth.val < d.val →
      Finishes (awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx s d) (fun _ => True))
    (results : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (iteration : Usize) :
    Finishes (awsvars.fixpoint ctx results iteration depth) (fun _ => True) := by
  induction hm : 10 - iteration.val using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing iteration results with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [awsvars.fixpoint]
    simp only [deref_eq]
    split
    · exact Finishes.ret trivial
    · rename_i hit
      fstep (pass_all_fin ctx depth hinner results.slice 0#usize (alloc.vec.Vec.new _) false)
        with r hr
      rcases r with ⟨new, changed⟩
      simp only [uncurry_apply_pair]
      fstep (dedup_fin new.slice) with results' hd
      split
      · fstep (Finishes.add iteration 1#usize) with j hj
        apply ih (10 - j.val) ?_ results' j rfl
        scalar_tac
      · exact Finishes.ret trivial

/-- The kernel's resume offsets and depth bound ensure termination for every context. -/
theorem depth_fin (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (pattern : Slice U8) (depth : Usize) :
    Finishes (awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth ctx pattern depth) (fun _ => True) := by
  induction hm : 10 - depth.val using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing depth pattern with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [awsvars.resolve_aws_variables_with_depth]
    split
    · fstep (Finishes.to_vec pattern) with text ht
      exact (Finishes.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new _) text).mono (fun _ _ => trivial)
    · rename_i hd
      fstep (Finishes.to_vec pattern) with text ht
      fstep (Finishes.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new _) text) with results hr
      apply fixpoint_fin ctx depth ?_ results 0#usize
      intro s d hgt
      apply ih (10 - d.val) ?_ s d rfl
      scalar_tac

theorem resolution_terminates (ctx : awsvars.VarContext) (p : Slice U8) (hv : PlainValues ctx) :
    (∃ r, awsvars.resolve_aws_variables ctx p = ok r) ∨
      ∃ err, awsvars.resolve_aws_variables ctx p = fail err := by
  clear hv
  unfold awsvars.resolve_aws_variables

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
open RustfsForceDelete RustfsCommonSubstitution
lemma transform_ok (pattern : Slice U8)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : (if values.len>0#usize then rsrc.substitute_common pattern values
      else alloc.slice.Slice.to_vec core.clone.CloneU8 pattern)=ok out) :
    nats out.val=ResourcePattern (RequestValueLists values.val) (nats pattern.val) := by
  have hn : RequestValueLists values.val=[] ↔ values.val=[] := by simp [RequestValueLists]
  h5i_invert h
  · have he : values.val≠[] := by intro he; simp [he] at hc
    rw [RustfsCommonSubstitution.all_ok _ _ _ h]
    simp only [ResourcePattern,hn,he,↓reduceIte,bytes_nats]
  · have he : values.val=[] := List.eq_nil_iff_length_eq_zero.mpr (by scalar_tac)
    rw [RustfsCleanCanonical.to_vec_ok _ _ h]
    simp [ResourcePattern,he,RequestValueLists]
lemma eq_nats (a b : Slice U8) (r : Bool) (h : bytes.eq a b=ok r) :
    r=true ↔ nats a.val=nats b.val :=
  (bytes_eq_ok a b r h).trans ⟨congrArg nats,nats_inj⟩
theorem pattern_ok (pattern resource : Slice U8)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))) (b : Bool)
    (h : rsrc.pattern_matches pattern resource values=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ ResourcePatternHolds (RequestValueLists values.val) (nats pattern.val) (nats resource.val) := by
  unfold rsrc.pattern_matches at h
  obtain ⟨resolved,hres,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hr := transform_ok pattern values resolved hres
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals
    have hcp' := RustfsPathFull.clean_meaning resource cp hcp
    have hs := lift_slice hs1
    simp only [List.map_cons,List.map_nil,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hs
    have hd := eq_nats _ _ _ hdot
    simp only [deref_val,hs,hcp'] at hd
    unfold ResourcePatternHolds
  · have hh := hd.mp hc
    simp only [hh,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,false_and,Bool.false_eq_true]
  · have hd' : CleanPath (nats resource.val)≠[46] := fun he => hc (hd.mpr he)
    have he := eq_nats _ _ _ hb_1
    simp only [deref_val,hcp',hr] at he
    have he' := he.mp hc_1
    exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨hd',Or.inl he'⟩,fun _ => rfl⟩
  · have hd' : CleanPath (nats resource.val)≠[46] := fun he => hc (hd.mpr he)
    have he := eq_nats _ _ _ hb_1
    simp only [deref_val,hcp',hr] at he
    have he' : CleanPath (nats resource.val)≠ResourcePattern (RequestValueLists values.val) (nats pattern.val) :=
      fun hh => hc_1 (he.mpr hh)
    rw [RustfsWildcard.wildcard_is_glob] at h
    have hb := Result.ok.inj h
    simp only [deref_val,hcp',hr] at hb
    rw [←hb]
    constructor
    · intro hh; exact ⟨hd',Or.inr hh⟩
    · rintro ⟨_,hh | hh⟩
      · exact False.elim (he' hh)
      · exact hh
theorem alternatives_ok (patterns : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (resource : Slice U8)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))) (b : Bool)
    (h : rsrc.resource_is_match_loop resource values patterns 0#usize=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ ∃ pattern ∈ patterns.val,
      ResourcePatternHolds (RequestValueLists values.val) (nats pattern.val) (nats resource.val) := by
  unfold rsrc.resource_is_match_loop at h
  refine RustfsValids.any_loop patterns.val
    (fun pattern => ResourcePatternHolds (RequestValueLists values.val) (nats pattern.val) (nats resource.val))
    _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold rsrc.resource_is_match_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hv
    have hm := pattern_ok _ _ _ _ (by assumption)
    simp only [deref_val] at hm
    exact Or.inl ⟨hlt,by rw [he]; exact hm.mp hc_1,rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hv
    have hm := pattern_ok _ _ _ _ (by assumption)
    simp only [deref_val] at hm
    refine ⟨hlt,?_,by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
    rw [he]
    exact fun hh => hc_1 (hm.mpr hh)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨by scalar_tac,rfl⟩
theorem resource_ok (r : rsrc.Resource) (resource : Slice U8)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (ctx : Option awsvars.VarContext) (b : Bool)
    (h : rsrc.resource_is_match r resource values ctx=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ ResourceHolds (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context) (RequestValueLists values.val)
      (ResourceText r) (nats resource.val) := by
  cases r with
  | S3 text | Kms text =>
    unfold rsrc.resource_is_match at h
    simp only [u8vec_clone,bind_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨patterns,hpatterns,h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    have hm := alternatives_ok patterns resource values b h
    have hp : patterns.val.map (fun v => nats v.val)=
        ResolvedPolicy (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context) (nats text.val) := by
      cases ctx with
      | none =>
        have hp := RustfsBytes.push_ok hpatterns
        change patterns.val=[text] at hp
        simp only [hp,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,Option.map_none,ResolvedPolicy]
      | some c =>
        change awsvars.resolve_aws_variables c text.deref=ok patterns at hpatterns
        unfold awsvars.resolve_aws_variables at hpatterns
        have hp := RustfsAwsResolution.depth_ok c text.deref 0#usize patterns hpatterns
        simpa only [ResolvedPolicy,Option.map_some,deref_val,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hp
    simp only [ResourceHolds,ResourceText]
    rw [←hp]
    simpa only [List.mem_map,exists_exists_and_eq_and] using hm
theorem set_ok (set : Slice rsrc.Resource) (resource : Slice U8)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (ctx : Option awsvars.VarContext) (b : Bool)
    (h : rsrc.set_is_match set resource values ctx=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ ResourceSetHolds (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context) (RequestValueLists values.val)
      (set.val.map ResourceText) (nats resource.val) := by
  unfold rsrc.set_is_match rsrc.set_is_match_loop at h
  have hm : b=true ↔ ∃ r ∈ set.val, ResourceHolds (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context)
      (RequestValueLists values.val) (ResourceText r) (nats resource.val) := by
    refine RustfsValids.any_loop set.val
      (fun r => ResourceHolds (ctx.map RustfsAwsValues.context) (RequestValueLists values.val)
        (ResourceText r) (nats resource.val)) _ (fun i res _ hr => ?_) b h
    unfold rsrc.set_is_match_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hr_1
      have hm := resource_ok _ _ _ _ _ (by assumption)
      exact Or.inl ⟨hlt,by rw [he]; exact hm.mp hc_1,rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hr_1
      have hm := resource_ok _ _ _ _ _ (by assumption)
      refine ⟨hlt,?_,by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
      rw [he]
      exact fun hh => hc_1 (hm.mpr hh)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨by scalar_tac,rfl⟩
  simpa only [ResourceSetHolds,List.mem_map,exists_exists_and_eq_and] using hm

import Verified.RustfsActionSets
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec

theorem resource_eq_law (a b : rsrc.Resource) :
    rsrc.Resource.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqResource.eq a b = ok (decide (a = b)) := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;>
    simp [rsrc.Resource.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqResource.eq, rsrc.Resource.read_discriminant, vec_eq_law,
      alloc.vec.Vec.ext_iff]

theorem member_ok (xs : Slice rsrc.Resource) (x : rsrc.Resource) (b : Bool)
    (h : resets.member xs x = ok b) : (b = true ↔ x ∈ xs.val) := by
  unfold resets.member resets.member_loop at h
  have hm : (b = true ↔ ∃ y ∈ xs.val, y = x) := by
    refine any_loop xs.val (fun y => y = x) _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
    unfold resets.member_loop.body at hr
    simp only [resource_eq_law, bind_ok] at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hr_1
      exact .inl ⟨hlt, by rw [he]; simpa using hc_1, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hr_1
      refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
      rw [he]; simpa using hc_1
    · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩
  simpa using hm

theorem covers_ok (xs ys : Slice rsrc.Resource) (b : Bool)
    (h : resets.covers xs ys = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ ∀ x ∈ xs.val, x ∈ ys.val) := by
  unfold resets.covers resets.covers_loop at h
  refine all_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold resets.covers_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hr_1
    have hm := member_ok _ _ _ (by assumption)
    refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
    rw [he]; exact hm.1 hc_1
  · obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hr_1
    have hm := member_ok _ _ _ (by assumption)
    exact .inl ⟨hlt, by rw [he]; exact fun hh => hc_1 (hm.2 hh), rfl⟩
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩

theorem eq_ok (xs ys : Slice rsrc.Resource) (b : Bool)
    (h : resets.eq xs ys = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ ∀ x, x ∈ xs.val ↔ x ∈ ys.val) := by
  unfold resets.eq at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have hl := covers_ok xs ys _ (by assumption)
    have hr := covers_ok ys xs _ h
    have hleft := hl.1 hc
    rw [hr]
    constructor
    · intro hh x; exact ⟨hleft x, hh x⟩
    · intro hh x hx; exact (hh x).2 hx
  · have hl := covers_ok xs ys _ (by assumption)
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    intro hh; apply hc; exact hl.2 (fun x hx => (hh x).1 hx)

theorem push_unique_ok (xs : alloc.vec.Vec rsrc.Resource) (x : rsrc.Resource)
    (ys : alloc.vec.Vec rsrc.Resource) (h : resets.push_unique xs x = ok ys) :
    ys.val = if x ∈ xs.val then xs.val else xs.val ++ [x] := by
  unfold resets.push_unique at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have hm := (member_ok _ _ _ hb).1 hc
    simpa [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] using hm
  · have hm : x ∉ xs.val := fun hx => hc ((member_ok _ _ _ hb).2 (by simpa [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.deref_val] using hx))
    rw [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBytes.push_ok h]
    simp [hm]

theorem empty_ok (xs : Slice rsrc.Resource) :
    resets.is_empty xs = ok (decide (xs.val = [])) := by
  unfold resets.is_empty
  dsimp only
  apply congrArg Result.ok
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, ← List.length_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h; have := congrArg UScalar.val h; simpa using this
  · intro h; apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simpa using h

theorem slice_ok (xs : Slice rsrc.Resource) : resets.as_slice xs = ok xs := rfl

/-- A successful resource-set match has a witness in the supplied set. -/
theorem set_match_ok (xs : Slice rsrc.Resource) (needle : Slice U8) (b : Bool)
    (h : resets.set_match_resource xs needle = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ xs.val, resets.match_resource x needle = ok true) := by
  unfold resets.set_match_resource resets.set_match_resource_loop at h
  refine any_loop xs.val (fun x => resets.match_resource x needle = ok true) _
    (fun i r _ hr => ?_) b h
  unfold resets.set_match_resource_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hr_1
    exact .inl ⟨hlt, by rw [he]; simpa [hc_1] using hb_1, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hr_1
    refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
    rw [he]
    intro hh
    rw [hh] at hb_1
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hb_1
    exact hc_1 hb_1.symm
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac,rfl⟩

/-- Empty resource sets cannot authorize any needle, regardless of condition values. -/
theorem empty_matches (xs : Slice rsrc.Resource) (needle : Slice U8)
    (values : alloc.vec.Vec ((alloc.vec.Vec U8) × (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))) (hx : xs.val = []) :
    resets.set_matches xs needle values = ok false := by
  unfold resets.set_matches rsrc.set_is_match rsrc.set_is_match_loop
  rw [loop]
  simp [rsrc.set_is_match_loop.body, Slice.len, hx]

import SpecOperators

theorem unsigned_eq {ty} (a b : UScalar ty) : a = b ↔ a.val = b.val :=
  ⟨UScalar.val_eq_of_eq, UScalar.eq_of_val_eq⟩
theorem signed_eq {ty} (a b : IScalar ty) : a = b ↔ a.val = b.val :=
  ⟨IScalar.val_eq_of_eq, IScalar.eq_of_val_eq⟩

theorem numeric_ok (op : condfuncs.NumOp) (a b : I64) (r : Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.num_op op a b = ok r) :
    r = true ↔ NumericComparison op a.val b.val := by
  cases op <;> simp only [condfuncs.num_op, Result.ok.injEq] at h <;>
    subst r <;> simp [NumericComparison, signed_eq]

theorem null_ok (want : Bool) (count : Usize) (r : Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.null_ok want count = ok r) :
    r = true ↔ NullComparison want count.val := by
  cases want <;> simp [condfuncs.null_ok] at h <;>
    subst r <;> simp [NullComparison, unsigned_eq]
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsScalarOperators

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsScalarOperators
/-- The numeric address prefix, including width-clamped prefixes. -/
theorem prefix_ok (net ip : condfuncs.IpAddr) (pref : U8) (r : Bool)
    (h : condfuncs.net_contains net pref ip = ok r) :
    r = true ↔ IpPrefix net pref.val ip := by
  cases net with
  | V4 n =>
    cases ip with
    | V6 a =>
      simp only [condfuncs.net_contains, Result.ok.injEq] at h
      subst r
      simp [IpPrefix]
    | V4 a =>
      unfold condfuncs.net_contains at h
      h5i_invert h
      · simp [IpPrefix, NumericPrefix, hc]
        rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac), Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
      · have hp : 32 ≤ pref.val := by scalar_tac
        simp [IpPrefix, NumericPrefix, Nat.min_eq_right hp, unsigned_eq]
      · have hs := sub_ok_val hi
        have hn := post_of_ok (UScalar.ShiftRight_spec n i (by scalar_tac)) hi1
        have ha := post_of_ok (UScalar.ShiftRight_spec a i (by scalar_tac)) hi2
        have hp : pref.val ≤ 32 := by scalar_tac
        simp only [IpPrefix, NumericPrefix, Nat.min_eq_left hp]
        have hv : i.val = 32 - pref.val := by scalar_tac
        simp only [unsigned_eq, decide_eq_true_eq, hn.1, ha.1, hv, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  | V6 n =>
    cases ip with
    | V4 a =>
      simp only [condfuncs.net_contains, Result.ok.injEq] at h
      subst r
      simp [IpPrefix]
    | V6 a =>
      unfold condfuncs.net_contains at h
      h5i_invert h
      · simp [IpPrefix, NumericPrefix, hc]
        rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac), Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
      · have hp : 128 ≤ pref.val := by scalar_tac
        simp [IpPrefix, NumericPrefix, Nat.min_eq_right hp, unsigned_eq]
      · have hs := sub_ok_val hi
        have hn := post_of_ok (UScalar.ShiftRight_spec n i (by scalar_tac)) hi1
        have ha := post_of_ok (UScalar.ShiftRight_spec a i (by scalar_tac)) hi2
        have hp : pref.val ≤ 128 := by scalar_tac
        simp only [IpPrefix, NumericPrefix, Nat.min_eq_left hp]
        have hv : i.val = 128 - pref.val := by scalar_tac
        simp only [unsigned_eq, decide_eq_true_eq, hn.1, ha.1, hv, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]

theorem date_comparison_ok (op : conddata.Op) (a b : I128) (r : Bool)

import Verified.RustfsWildcard
import SpecStatements
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsSimpleWildcard

theorem glob_star_last (n : List Nat) : simpleGlobSpec [42] n = true := by
  induction n with
  | nil => simp [simpleGlobSpec.eq_1, simpleGlobSpec.eq_2]
  | cons x n ih => simp [simpleGlobSpec.eq_3, ih]

theorem glob_lit_nil (c : Nat) (p : List Nat) (h1 : c ≠ 42) (h2 : c ≠ 63) :
    simpleGlobSpec (c :: p) [] = false := by
  rw [simpleGlobSpec.eq_def]; split <;> simp_all

theorem glob_lit_cons (c x : Nat) (p n : List Nat) (h1 : c ≠ 42) (h2 : c ≠ 63) :
    simpleGlobSpec (c :: p) (x :: n) = (decide (c = x) && simpleGlobSpec p n) := by
  rw [simpleGlobSpec.eq_def]; split <;> simp_all

theorem nats_drop_cons (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (c : U8) (h : i < l.length) (hc : l[i] = c) :
    nats (l.drop i) = c.val :: nats (l.drop (i+1)) := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons h, hc]; rfl

theorem nats_drop_nil (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : l.length ≤ i) :
    nats (l.drop i) = [] := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le h]; rfl

theorem glob_star_drop (c : Nat) (hc : c = 42) (r : List Nat) (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : i < l.length) :
    simpleGlobSpec (c :: r) (nats (l.drop i)) = (simpleGlobSpec r (nats (l.drop i)) || simpleGlobSpec (c :: r) (nats (l.drop (i+1)))) := by
  subst hc; conv => lhs; rw [nats_drop_cons l i _ h rfl, simpleGlobSpec.eq_3]
  rw [← nats_drop_cons l i _ h rfl]

theorem deep_spec (p n : Slice U8) (pi ni : Usize) (hp : pi.val ≤ p.length) (hn : ni.val ≤ n.length) :
    wildmatch.deep_match p pi n ni true ⦃ b => b = simpleGlobSpec (nats (p.val.drop pi.val)) (nats (n.val.drop ni.val)) ⦄ := by
  h5i_measure_induction (p.length - pi.val + (n.length - ni.val)) with ih
  have ih' : ∀ (pi' ni' : Usize), p.length - pi'.val + (n.length - ni'.val) < k → pi'.val ≤ p.length → ni'.val ≤ n.length →
      wildmatch.deep_match p pi' n ni' true ⦃ b => b = simpleGlobSpec (nats (p.val.drop pi'.val)) (nats (n.val.drop ni'.val)) ⦄ :=
    fun pi' ni' h1 h2 h3 => ih _ h1 p n pi' ni' h2 h3 rfl
  clear ih
  rw [wildmatch.deep_match]
  step*
  · rw [nats_drop_nil _ _ (by scalar_tac), simpleGlobSpec.eq_1]
    by_cases h : ni.val < n.length
    · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ h rfl]; simp; scalar_tac
    · rw [nats_drop_nil _ _ (by scalar_tac)]; simp; scalar_tac
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [simpleGlobSpec.eq_4]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ (by scalar_tac) rfl]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [simpleGlobSpec.eq_5, *]
  · have h1 : pi.val + 1 = p.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑p) (pi.val+1) (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [glob_star_last]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm]
    clear c_post; subst_vars
    by_cases h : ni.val < n.length
    · rw [nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ h rfl] at *; simp_all [simpleGlobSpec.eq_3]
    · rw [nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)] at *; simp_all [simpleGlobSpec.eq_2]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm] at b_post

theorem action_match_ok (pattern requested : acts.Action) (deny b : Bool)

    b = true ↔ EffectActionMatches deny pattern requested := by
  cases deny with
  | false => exact RustfsActionSets.action_match_ok pattern requested b h
  | true =>

theorem set_match_ok (xs : Slice acts.Action) (requested : acts.Action) (deny b : Bool)

  unfold acts.set_is_match_for_effect_loop.body at hr

      simpa [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults.lit_GOV, rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults.lit_GO] using rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.lift_slice hs1
    rw [hl] at h1; rw [hr] at h2

      (h2.1 hc_3).1, (h2.1 hc_3).2⟩, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok ha1
    have hm := action_match_ok a1 requested deny b_1 hb_1
    have h2 := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.is_s3_ok _ _ _ hb2
    have hl : nats s1.val = lit "s3:GetObject" := by
      simpa [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults.lit_GOV, rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults.lit_GO] using rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.lift_slice hs1

    rw [he]
    rintro (hh | hh)
    · exact hc_1 (hm.2 hh)
    · exact hc_3 (h2.2 ⟨hh.2.2.1, hh.2.2.2⟩)
  · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := slice_index_ok ha1
    have hm := action_match_ok a1 requested deny b_1 hb_1
    have h1 := rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.is_s3_ok _ _ _ hb1
    have hl : nats s.val = lit "s3:GetObjectVersion" := by
      simpa [rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults.lit_GOV, rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsDefaults.lit_GO] using rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete.lift_slice hs
    rw [hl] at h1

theorem coverage_ok (actions excluded : Slice acts.Action) (requested : acts.Action)

  · have hh := hm.mp hc
    simp [StatementActionCoverage,hh]
  · have hh : ¬EffectActionSetMatches true excluded.val requested := fun hh => hc (hm.mpr hh)
    have he : actions.val=[] := List.eq_nil_iff_length_eq_zero.mpr (by scalar_tac)

    have hf := RustfsForceDelete.requires_ok requested b1 hb1
    simp [StatementActionCoverage,hh,he,hc_2,Bool.eq_false_iff,hf]
  · have hh : ¬EffectActionSetMatches true excluded.val requested := fun hh => hc (hm.mpr hh)
    have he : actions.val≠[] := by intro he; have hl:=congrArg List.length he; scalar_tac

theorem reaches_ok (st : stmts.Statement) (args : stmts.Args) (ctx : Option awsvars.VarContext)

  all_goals try (have hh := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h; clear h; obtain ⟨iskms,hiskms,h⟩ := hh; cases iskms <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,ite_true] at h)

  all_goals h5i_invert h

  all_goals try have hk := RustfsStatementSkips.family_ok _ _ _ (by assumption : stmts.has_family st.actions.deref .Kms=ok _)

  all_goals simp only [RustfsKmsMeaning.scalar_eq,deref_val,gt_iff_lt,UScalar.lt_equiv,alloc.vec.Vec.len_val,alloc.vec.Vec.length,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at *
  all_goals simp only [StatementReaches,←deny_effect]

  all_goals try simp only [ne_eq,List.eq_nil_iff_length_eq_zero,zero_not_pos,not_not,implies_true,forall_const] at *
  all_goals try rw [←ha]

  all_goals try rw [←hadmin]
  all_goals try rw [←hsts]
  all_goals try rw [←hs]

theorem allowed_ok (st : stmts.Statement) (args : stmts.Args)
    (env : condfuncs.Env) (b : Bool)
    (h : stmts.statement_is_allowed st args env=ok b) :
    b=true ↔ StatementAllowed st args env := by

    cases he : st.effect <;> simp only [stmts.effect_is_allowed,he] at h
    all_goals have hb := Result.ok.inj h
    all_goals cases b <;> simp_all [StatementAllowed,EffectAllows]

    (out : alloc.vec.Vec manage.Statement) (h : manage.retained_statements ss ds = ok out) :
    out.val = RetainStatements ss.val (ds.val.map (fun k => k.val)) := by
  unfold manage.retained_statements manage.retained_statements_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec manage.Statement × Usize =>
      x.2.val ≤ ss.val.length ∧ x.1.val =
        ((ss.val.zipIdx.take x.2.val).filter (fun e => !decide (e.2 ∈ ds.val.map (fun k => k.val)))).map Prod.fst)
    (fun out => out.val = RetainStatements ss.val (ds.val.map (fun k => k.val)))
    (fun x => ss.val.length - x.2.val) ?_ _ out ⟨by simp,by simp⟩ h
  rintro ⟨acc,i⟩ r ⟨hi,ha⟩ hr
  dsimp only at hi ha ⊢
  unfold manage.retained_statements_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have hlt : i.val < ss.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hm := index_member_ok ds i b hb
    have hadd := add_ok_val hi2
    have htake : ss.val.zipIdx.take i2.val = ss.val.zipIdx.take i.val ++ [(ss.val[i.val],i.val)] := by

      simp only [List.getElem_zipIdx,Option.toList_some,Nat.zero_add]

    h5i_invert hout1
    · have hin := (index_val_mem ds.val i).1 (hm.1 hc_1)
      dsimp only

      rw [htake,List.filter_append,List.map_append]
      simpa only [List.filter_cons,List.filter_nil,Prod.snd,hin,decide_true,Bool.not_true,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,List.map_nil,List.append_nil] using ha
    · obtain ⟨_,he⟩ := slice_index_ok hs1

        intro hh; exact hc_1 (hm.2 ((index_val_mem ds.val i).2 hh))

      refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac,?_⟩,by scalar_tac⟩

theorem equality_ok (key : condfuncs.Key) (policy : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8))

            condfuncs.str_eval_like key s condfuncs.Quantifier.ForAllValues

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

theorem value_monotone (r : LowerRange) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
    LowerRangeValue a r ≤ LowerRangeValue b r := by
  unfold LowerRangeValue
  split <;> omega

theorem range_destination_valid (r : LowerRange) (cp : Nat)
    (hr : r ∈ LowerRangeEntries) (h : LowerRangeApplies cp r) :
    LowerRangeValue cp r < 0x110000 ∧
      (LowerRangeValue cp r < 0xD800 ∨ 0xDFFF < LowerRangeValue cp r) := by
  have hs := RustfsUnicodeStructure.range_entries_well_formed r hr
  have hlo := value_monotone r h.1
  have hhi := value_monotone r h.2.1
  omega

theorem lookup_witness (cp : Nat) (rs : List LowerRange) (a b n : Nat)
    (h : LookupLowerRanges cp rs = some (a,b,n)) :
    ∃ r ∈ rs, LowerRangeApplies cp r ∧ a = LowerRangeValue cp r ∧ b = 0 ∧ n = 1 := by
  induction rs with
  | nil => simp [LookupLowerRanges] at h
  | cons r rs ih =>
    simp only [LookupLowerRanges] at h
    split at h
    · cases h
      exact ⟨r, by simp, by assumption, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨r',hr',hc,ha,hb,hn⟩ := ih h
      exact ⟨r', by simp [hr'],hc,ha,hb,hn⟩
theorem chunk_row (i : Nat) (r : LowerRange)
    (hr : r ∈ ((RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks[i]?).getD [])) : r ∈ LowerRangeEntries := by
  cases he : RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks[i]? with
  | none => simp [he] at hr
  | some rs =>
    have hm : rs ∈ RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks := List.mem_of_getElem? he
    have hf : r ∈ RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks.flatten :=
      List.mem_flatten.mpr ⟨rs, hm, by simpa [he] using hr⟩
    simpa [RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks, LowerRangeEntries] using hf

theorem chunk_result_valid (cp : U32) (i : Usize) (out : U32 × U32 × Usize)
    (h : unicode.range_chunk cp i = ok (some out)) :
    out.2.1.val = 0 ∧ out.2.2.val = 1 ∧ out.1.val < 0x110000 ∧
      (out.1.val < 0xD800 ∨ 0xDFFF < out.1.val) := by
  have ht := RustfsUnicodeChunks.chunk_ok cp i (some out) h
  simp only [Option.map_some] at ht
  obtain ⟨r,hr,ha,hv,hb,hn⟩ := lookup_witness _ _ _ _ _ ht.symm
  have hs := range_destination_valid r cp.val (chunk_row i.val r hr) ha
  exact ⟨hb,hn,by simpa [hv] using hs.1,by simpa [hv] using hs.2⟩

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsUnicodeLower
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

theorem lookup_append (cp : Nat) (xs ys : List LowerRange) :
    LookupLowerRanges cp (xs ++ ys) =
      (LookupLowerRanges cp xs).orElse (fun _ => LookupLowerRanges cp ys) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons r rs ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, LookupLowerRanges]
    split <;> simp_all

theorem chunks_flatten : RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks.flatten = LowerRangeEntries := by
  simp [RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks, LowerRangeEntries, List.append_assoc]

/-- Lowercase dispatch chooses the first applicable range in table order,
then the singleton exception table, with identity for an unlisted scalar. -/
theorem scalar_ok (cp : U32) (out : U32 × U32 × Usize)
    (h : unicode.lowercase_scalar cp = ok out) :
    (out.1.val,out.2.1.val,out.2.2.val) = LowercaseScalar cp.val := by
  unfold unicode.lowercase_scalar unicode.lowercase_scalar_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ 9 ∧
      LookupLowerRanges cp.val LowerRangeEntries =
        LookupLowerRanges cp.val (RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks.drop i.val).flatten)
    (fun out : U32 × U32 × Usize =>
      (out.1.val,out.2.1.val,out.2.2.val) = LowercaseScalar cp.val)
    (fun i => 9 - i.val) ?_ _ out ⟨by simp, by simp [chunks_flatten]⟩ h
  intro i r ⟨hi, he⟩ hr
  unfold unicode.lowercase_scalar_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have ht := RustfsUnicodeChunks.chunk_ok cp i none ho
    simp only [Option.map_none] at ht
    have hadd := add_ok_val hi1
    have hlt : i.val < RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks.length := by
      simpa [RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks] using (show i.val < 9 by scalar_tac)
    refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
    rw [he, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt, List.flatten_cons, lookup_append]
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at ht
    simp only [Option.getD_some] at ht
    rw [← ht]
    simp only [Option.orElse_none]
    congr 3
    scalar_tac
  · rcases v with ⟨a,b,c⟩
    change ok (ControlFlow.done (a,b,c)) = ok r at hr
    cases Result.ok.inj hr
    have ht := RustfsUnicodeChunks.chunk_ok cp i (some (a,b,c)) ho
    simp only [Option.map_some] at ht
    have hlt : i.val < RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks.length := by
      simpa [RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks] using (show i.val < 9 by scalar_tac)
    unfold LowercaseScalar
    rw [he, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt, List.flatten_cons, lookup_append]
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at ht
    simp only [Option.getD_some] at ht
    rw [← ht]
    rfl
  · rcases v with ⟨a,b,c⟩
    change ok (ControlFlow.done (a,b,c)) = ok r at hr
    cases Result.ok.inj hr
    have ht := RustfsUnicodeSingleton.singleton_ok cp (a,b,c) hv
    unfold LowercaseScalar
    rw [he, List.drop_of_length_le (by simpa [RustfsUnicodeChunks.Chunks] using (show 9 ≤ i.val by scalar_tac))]
    exact ht
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsUnicodeLower

/-- Whole-string lowercasing concatenates the table image of every decoded scalar. -/
theorem lower_ok (s : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : unicode.lower s = ok out) : nats out.val = LowerBytes (nats s.val) := by
  unfold unicode.lower unicode.lower_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun state : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize =>
      state.2.val ≤ s.val.length ∧
      nats state.1.val ++ LowerSuffix (nats s.val) state.2.val = LowerBytes (nats s.val))
    (fun out => nats out.val = LowerBytes (nats s.val))
    (fun state => s.val.length - state.2.val) ?_ _ out ?_ h
  · rintro ⟨initial,i⟩ result ⟨hi,he⟩ hr
    unfold unicode.lower_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · rcases x with ⟨cp,next⟩
      change (do
        let (a,b,count) ← unicode.lowercase_scalar cp
        let encoded ← unicode.append_scalar initial a
        if count = 2#usize then do
          let encoded2 ← unicode.append_scalar encoded b
          ok (ControlFlow.cont (encoded2,next))
        else ok (ControlFlow.cont (encoded,next))) = ok result at hr
      h5i_invert hr
      rcases x with ⟨a,b,count⟩
      change (do
        let encoded ← unicode.append_scalar initial a
        if count = 2#usize then do
          let encoded2 ← unicode.append_scalar encoded b
          ok (ControlFlow.cont (encoded2,next))
        else ok (ControlFlow.cont (encoded,next))) = ok result at hr
      have hd := RustfsUnicodeCodec.decode_ok s i (cp,next) hx
      have ha := RustfsUnicodeDecode.scalar_advances s i (cp,next) hx
      have hl := RustfsUnicodeLower.scalar_ok cp (a,b,count) hx_1
      have hlt : i.val < (nats s.val).length := by simpa [nats] using (lt_of_lt_of_le ha.1 ha.2.1)
      have heq : LowerSuffix (nats s.val) i.val =
          (EncodeScalar a.val ++ if count.val = 2 then EncodeScalar b.val else []) ++
          LowerSuffix (nats s.val) next.val := by
        rw [LowerSuffix, dif_pos hlt, ← hd]
        simp only [LowerScalarBytes, ← hl]
      h5i_invert hr
      all_goals
        have happ := RustfsUnicodeCodec.append_ok initial _ a hencoded
        try have happ2 := RustfsUnicodeCodec.append_ok _ _ b hencoded2
        simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] at *
        constructor
        · constructor
          · exact ha.2.1
          · rw [heq] at he
            simp only [happ] at *
            try rw [happ2]
            have hcount : (count.val = 2 ↔ count = 2#usize) := by scalar_tac
            simpa only [show (2#usize).val = 2 by decide, hcount, hc_1, ↓reduceIte, List.append_assoc,
              List.append_nil] using he
        · omega
    · have hn : ¬ i.val < (nats s.val).length := by simpa [nats] using (show ¬ i.val < s.val.length by scalar_tac)
      simpa [LowerSuffix,hn] using he
  · simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new,nats,LowerBytes]
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsUnicodeLowerBytes

import Verified.RustfsUnicodeCodec

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec

theorem or_prefix (low high bits : Nat) (h : low < 2 ^ bits) :
    (2 ^ bits * high) ||| low = 2 ^ bits * high + low :=
  (Nat.two_pow_add_eq_or_of_lt h high).symm

theorem pack (high low bits : Nat) (h : low < 2 ^ bits) :
    (high <<< bits) ||| low = high * 2 ^ bits + low := by
  rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq,Nat.mul_comm]
  exact or_prefix low high bits h

theorem mask63 (a : Nat) : a &&& 63 = a % 64 := by
  exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod a 6

theorem mask31 (a : Nat) : a &&& 31 = a % 32 := by
  exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod a 5

theorem encoding_two (cp : Nat) (h0 : 128 ≤ cp) (h1 : cp < 2048) :
    EncodeScalar cp = [192 + cp / 64,128 + cp % 64] := by
  have h192 : 192 ||| (cp >>> 6) = 192 + cp / 64 := by
    simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    exact or_prefix (cp / 64) 6 5 (by omega)
  have h128 : 128 ||| (cp &&& 63) = 128 + cp % 64 := by
    rw [mask63]
    exact or_prefix (cp % 64) 2 6 (by omega)
  simp only [EncodeScalar,if_neg (by omega : ¬ cp < 128),if_pos h1,h192,h128]
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega),Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]

theorem roundtrip_two (cp : Nat) (h0 : 128 ≤ cp) (h1 : cp < 2048) :
    DecodeScalar (EncodeScalar cp) 0 = (cp,2) := by
  rw [encoding_two cp h0 h1]
  unfold DecodeScalar
  dsimp only
  simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero,List.getElem?_cons_succ,Option.getD_some]
  rw [if_neg (by omega),if_pos (by omega)]
  rw [mask31,mask63]
  have hm : (192 + cp / 64) % 32 = cp / 64 := by omega
  have hl : (128 + cp % 64) % 64 = cp % 64 := by omega
  rw [hm,hl,pack _ _ 6 (by omega)]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem mask7 (a : Nat) : a &&& 7 = a % 8 :=

theorem encoding_three (cp : Nat) (h0 : 2048 ≤ cp) (h1 : cp < 65536) :
    EncodeScalar cp = [224 + cp / 4096,128 + (cp / 64) % 64,128 + cp % 64] := by
  have h224 : 224 ||| (cp >>> 12) = 224 + cp / 4096 := by
    simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    exact or_prefix (cp / 4096) 14 4 (by omega)
  have h128 (x : Nat) : 128 ||| (x &&& 63) = 128 + x % 64 := by

    exact or_prefix (x % 64) 2 6 (by omega)

    if_neg (by omega : ¬ cp < 2048),if_pos h1,h224,h128]
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]

/-- Numeric UTF-8 encoding and decoding round trip for Unicode scalar values.
The equation also holds for surrogate code points in this numeric interval. -/
theorem roundtrip (cp : Nat) (h : cp < 1114112) :
    DecodeScalar (EncodeScalar cp) 0 = (cp,(EncodeScalar cp).length) := by
  by_cases h0 : cp < 128
  · simp [EncodeScalar,h0,DecodeScalar,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : cp < 256)]
  by_cases h1 : cp < 2048
  · rw [roundtrip_two cp (by omega) h1,encoding_two cp (by omega) h1]
    rfl
  by_cases h2 : cp < 65536
  · rw [roundtrip_three cp (by omega) h2,encoding_three cp (by omega) h2]
    rfl
  · rw [roundtrip_four cp (by omega) h,encoding_four cp (by omega) h]
    rfl

/-- Decoding the successful encoding of a scalar returns that scalar and
consumes precisely the emitted octets. -/
theorem append_decode (cp : U32) (encoded : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (actual : U32 × Usize)
    (hc : cp.val < 1114112)
    (he : unicode.append_scalar (alloc.vec.Vec.new U8) cp = ok encoded)
    (hd : unicode.scalar_at (alloc.vec.Vec.deref encoded) 0#usize = ok actual) :
    actual.1 = cp ∧ actual.2.val = encoded.val.length := by
  have he' : nats encoded.val = EncodeScalar cp.val := by
    simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.new,nats] using (RustfsUnicodeCodec.append_ok _ _ _ he)
  have hd' := RustfsUnicodeCodec.decode_ok _ _ _ hd
  rw [RustfsForceDelete.deref_val, he'] at hd'
  change (actual.1.val,actual.2.val) = DecodeScalar (EncodeScalar cp.val) 0 at hd'
  rw [roundtrip cp.val hc] at hd'
  have hl : (EncodeScalar cp.val).length = encoded.val.length := by
    rw [← he']; simp [nats]
  constructor
  · apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact congrArg Prod.fst hd'
  · exact (congrArg Prod.snd hd').trans hl

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsUnicodeRoundtrip
