import SpecUnicode
open rustfs_kernel.Spec
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsUnicodeStructure
set_option maxRecDepth 8192
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

theorem whitespace_distinct : UnicodeWhitespace.Nodup := by decide +kernel

theorem whitespace_count : UnicodeWhitespace.length = 25 := by decide +kernel

theorem singleton_keys_distinct :
    (LowerSingletonEntries.map Prod.fst).Nodup := by decide +kernel

theorem singleton_expansion_shape :
    ∀ r ∈ LowerSingletonEntries,
      r.2.2.2 = 1 ∨ (r.1 = 304 ∧ r.2.1 = 105 ∧ r.2.2.1 = 775 ∧ r.2.2.2 = 2) := by
  decide +kernel

theorem singleton_scalar_bounds :
    ∀ r ∈ LowerSingletonEntries,
      r.1 < 0x110000 ∧ r.2.1 < 0x110000 ∧ r.2.2.1 < 0x110000 ∧
      (r.2.1 < 0xD800 ∨ 0xDFFF < r.2.1) ∧
      (r.2.2.1 < 0xD800 ∨ 0xDFFF < r.2.2.1) := by decide +kernel

theorem range_shape (cp : Nat) (rs : List LowerRange) (a b n : Nat)
    (h : LookupLowerRanges cp rs = some (a,b,n)) : b = 0 ∧ n = 1 := by
  induction rs with
  | nil => simp [LookupLowerRanges] at h
  | cons r rs ih =>
    simp only [LookupLowerRanges] at h
    split at h
    · cases h; exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    · exact ih h
theorem range_entries_well_formed :
    ∀ r ∈ LowerRangeEntries,
      r.1 ≤ r.2.1 ∧ r.2.1 < 0x110000 ∧ r.2.2.1 ≤ 2 ∧
      (r.2.2.2 < 0 → (-r.2.2.2).toNat ≤ r.1) ∧
      LowerRangeValue r.1 r < 0x110000 ∧ LowerRangeValue r.2.1 r < 0x110000 ∧
      (LowerRangeValue r.2.1 r < 0xD800 ∨ 0xDFFF < LowerRangeValue r.1 r) := by
  decide +kernel

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsUnicodeStructure

theorem within_ok (cp start stop parity : U32) (b : Bool)
    (h : unicode.within cp start stop parity = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ LowerRangeApplies cp.val (start.val,stop.val,parity.val,0)) := by
  unfold unicode.within at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals simp only [LowerRangeApplies,Prod.fst,Prod.snd]
  all_goals first
    | (have := rem_ok_val hi; have := sub_ok_val hi1; scalar_tac)

    (h : unicode.within cp start stop parity = ok b) :

import Verified.RustfsValids
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit

set_option maxRecDepth 8192

/-- Trimming retains a contiguous segment of the original bytes. -/
theorem trim_segment (s : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : unicode.trim s = ok out) :
    ∃ a b : Nat, out.val = (s.val.take b).drop a := by
  unfold unicode.trim at h
  h5i_invert h
  rcases x with ⟨first,last⟩
  change (if first = s.len then ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new U8) else bytes.slice s first last) = ok out at h
  h5i_invert h
  · exact ⟨0,0,by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new]⟩
  · exact ⟨_,_,RustfsBytes.slice_ok _ _ _ _ h⟩
end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsUnicodeTrim

import Verified.RustfsUnicodeCodec
import Verified.RustfsUnicodeWhitespace
import Verified.RustfsForceDelete
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

theorem loop_bounds (s : Slice U8) (out : Usize × Usize)
    (h : unicode.trim_loop s s.len 0#usize 0#usize = ok out) :
    (out.1.val,out.2.val) = SpanBounds s.val.length (s.val.length,0)
      (ScalarSpans (nats s.val) 0) := by
  unfold unicode.trim_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun state : Usize × Usize × Usize =>
      state.2.2.val ≤ s.val.length ∧
      SpanBounds s.val.length (state.1.val,state.2.1.val)
        (ScalarSpans (nats s.val) state.2.2.val) =
      SpanBounds s.val.length (s.val.length,0) (ScalarSpans (nats s.val) 0))
    (fun out => (out.1.val,out.2.val) = SpanBounds s.val.length (s.val.length,0)
      (ScalarSpans (nats s.val) 0))
    (fun state => s.val.length-state.2.2.val) ?_ _ out ?_ h
  · rintro ⟨first,last,i⟩ result ⟨hi,he⟩ hr
    unfold unicode.trim_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    all_goals
      try
        have hn : ¬i.val < (nats s.val).length := by simpa [nats] using (show ¬i.val<s.val.length by scalar_tac)
        rw [ScalarSpans, dif_neg hn] at he
        simpa only [SpanBounds,List.filter_nil,List.foldl_nil] using he
    all_goals
      rcases x with ⟨cp,next⟩
      first
      | change (do
          let b ← unicode.whitespace cp
          if b then ok (ControlFlow.cont (first,last,next))
          else ok (ControlFlow.cont (i,next,next))) = ok result at hr
      | change (do
          let b ← unicode.whitespace cp
          if b then ok (ControlFlow.cont (first,last,next))
          else ok (ControlFlow.cont (first,next,next))) = ok result at hr
      have hd := RustfsUnicodeCodec.decode_ok s i (cp,next) hx
      have ha := RustfsUnicodeDecode.scalar_advances s i (cp,next) hx
      have hlt : i.val < (nats s.val).length := by simpa [nats] using (lt_of_lt_of_le ha.1 ha.2.1)
      rw [ScalarSpans,dif_pos hlt, ← hd,spanBounds_cons] at he
      h5i_invert hr
      all_goals
        have hw := RustfsUnicodeWhitespace.whitespace_ok cp _ hb
        simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] at *
        constructor
        · constructor
          · exact ha.2.1
          · first
            | have hf : first.val = s.val.length := by scalar_tac
              simpa only [← hw,hc_2,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,ExtendBounds,Prod.fst,Prod.snd,hf] using he
            | have hf : first.val ≠ s.val.length := by scalar_tac
              simpa only [← hw,hc_2,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,ExtendBounds,Prod.fst,Prod.snd,hf] using he
        · omega
  · simp

/-- Trimming removes precisely the leading and trailing whitespace scalars.
All bytes between the first and last retained scalar are unchanged. -/
theorem trim_ok (s : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : unicode.trim s = ok out) : nats out.val = TrimBytes (nats s.val) := by
  unfold unicode.trim at h
  h5i_invert h
  rcases x with ⟨first,last⟩
  have hb := loop_bounds s (first,last) hx
  change (if first = s.len then ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new U8)
    else bytes.slice s first last) = ok out at h
  let retained := (ScalarSpans (nats s.val) 0).filter
    (fun span => span.2.1 ∉ UnicodeWhitespace)
  have ht : ∀ span ∈ retained, span.1 < s.val.length := by
    intro span hs
    have hh := (List.mem_filter.mp hs).1
    simpa [nats] using spans_start_lt (nats s.val) 0 span hh
  change (first.val,last.val) = retained.foldl (ExtendBounds s.val.length) (s.val.length,0) at hb
  rw [bounds_fold _ _ _ _ ht] at hb
  change nats out.val = match retained.head?,retained.getLast? with
    | some a,some b => ((nats s.val).take b.2.2).drop a.1
    | _,_ => []
  cases hr : retained with
  | nil =>
    simp only [hr,List.head?_nil,List.getLast?_nil] at hb ⊢
    have hf : first = s.len := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; exact congrArg Prod.fst hb
    simp only [hf,ite_true,Result.ok.injEq] at h
    subst out
    simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new,nats]
  | cons a rest =>
    simp only [hr,List.head?_cons,List.getLast?_cons] at hb ⊢
    have ha : a.1 < s.val.length := ht a (by simp [hr])
    have hf : first.val = a.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hb
    have hl : last.val = (rest.getLast?.getD a).2.2 := congrArg Prod.snd hb
    have hf' : first ≠ s.len := by scalar_tac
    rw [if_neg hf'] at h
    have hs := RustfsBytes.slice_ok s first last out h
    rw [hs]
    simpa only [nats,List.map_drop,List.map_take,hf,hl]

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsUnicodeTrimExact

import Verified.RustfsBytes
import Verified.RustfsForceDelete
import SpecKernel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsBytes
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete (lift_slice nats_inj family_eq_ok deref_val bytes_eq_ok)

/-! `BPStatement::is_valid` and `Resource::is_valid` (`valids.rs`) accept
exactly what `SpecKernel` describes; `Statement::action_family` agrees with
`UniformFamily`. -/

namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsValids

theorem prefAt_iff (s p : List U8) (k : Nat) : PrefAt s p k ↔ k ≤ s.length ∧ p <+: s.drop k := by
  rw [List.prefix_iff_eq_take]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    apply List.ext_getElem?; intro j
    by_cases hj : j < p.length
    · rw [List.getElem?_take_of_lt hj, List.getElem?_drop, h2 j hj]
    · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega), List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp; omega)]
  · rintro ⟨hk, h⟩
    have hl := congrArg List.length h
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_drop] at hl
    refine ⟨by omega, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    rw [h, List.getElem?_take_of_lt hj, List.getElem?_drop]

theorem nats_prefix {p s : List U8} : nats p <+: nats s ↔ p <+: s :=
  List.prefix_map_iff_of_injective (fun x y h => (u8_eq_iff x y).2 h)

theorem starts_lit {s p : Slice U8} {l : List Nat} (hp : nats p.val = l) {b : Bool}
    (h : bytes.starts_with s p = ok b) : (b = true ↔ l <+: nats s.val) := by
  rw [starts_with_ok s p b h, prefAt_iff, ← hp, nats_prefix]
  simp

theorem contains_byte {s p : Slice U8} {c : Nat} (hp : nats p.val = [c]) {b : Bool}
    (h : bytes.contains s p = ok b) : (b = true ↔ c ∈ nats s.val) := by
  rw [contains_ok s p b h]
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxc⟩ : ∃ x, p.val = [x] ∧ x.val = c := by
    cases hpv : p.val with
    | nil => simp [nats, hpv] at hp
    | cons x t =>
      rw [hpv] at hp
      simp only [nats, List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq, List.map_eq_nil_iff] at hp
      exact ⟨x, by rw [hp.2], hp.1⟩
  unfold PrefAt
  rw [hx]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩
    have := hk2 0 (by simp)
    simp only [Nat.add_zero, List.getElem?_cons_zero] at this
    simp only [nats, List.mem_map]
    exact ⟨x, List.mem_of_getElem? this, hxc⟩
  · intro hc
    simp only [nats, List.mem_map] at hc
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyc⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hky⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hy
    have : y = x := (u8_eq_iff _ _).2 (by omega)
    subst this
    refine ⟨k, by simp; omega, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    simp only [List.length_singleton, Nat.lt_one_iff] at hj
    subst hj
    simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk, hky]

theorem lit_key : lit "key/" = [107, 101, 121, 47] := by decide +kernel
theorem lit_alias : lit "alias/" = [97, 108, 105, 97, 115, 47] := by decide +kernel
theorem lit_star : lit "*" = [42] := by decide +kernel

theorem nats_drop (l : List U8) (n : Nat) : nats (l.drop n) = (nats l).drop n := by
  simp [nats, List.map_drop]

theorem nats_length (l : List U8) : (nats l).length = l.length := by simp [nats]

theorem kms_key_ok (p : Slice U8) (r : Bool) (h : valids.kms_key_valid p = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ lit "key/" <+: nats p.val ∧ 4 < (nats p.val).length ∧
      47 ∉ (nats p.val).drop 4 ∧ 92 ∉ nats p.val) := by
  unfold valids.kms_key_valid at h
  rw [lit_key, nats_length]
  h5i_invert h
  · have h1 := starts_lit (by simpa using lift_slice hs) hb
    have hv := slice_ok _ _ _ _ hv
    have h2 := contains_byte (c := 47) (by simpa using lift_slice hs2) hb1
    rw [deref_val, hv, nats_drop] at h2
    simp_all
  · have h1 := starts_lit (by simpa using lift_slice hs) hb
    have hv := slice_ok _ _ _ _ hv
    have h2 := contains_byte (c := 47) (by simpa using lift_slice hs2) hb1
    have h3 := contains_byte (c := 92) (by simpa using lift_slice hs3) hb2
    rw [deref_val, hv, nats_drop] at h2
    cases b2 <;> simp_all
  · have h1 := starts_lit (by simpa using lift_slice hs) hb
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, not_and]
    intro _ h; scalar_tac
  · have h1 := starts_lit (by simpa using lift_slice hs) hb
    simp_all

theorem kms_alias_ok (p : Slice U8) (r : Bool) (h : valids.kms_alias_valid p = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ lit "alias/" <+: nats p.val ∧ 6 < (nats p.val).length ∧ 92 ∉ nats p.val) := by
  unfold valids.kms_alias_valid at h
  rw [lit_alias, nats_length]
  h5i_invert h
  · have h1 := starts_lit (by simpa using lift_slice hs) hb
    have h3 := contains_byte (c := 92) (by simpa using lift_slice hs1) hb1
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, Bool.not_eq_true] at *
    constructor
    · intro hb2'
      refine ⟨h1.1 hc, by scalar_tac, fun h => ?_⟩
      simp_all
    · rintro ⟨-, -, h4⟩
      cases b1 <;> simp_all
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, not_and]
    intro _ h; scalar_tac
  · have h1 := starts_lit (by simpa using lift_slice hs) hb
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, not_and]
    intro h; simp_all

theorem resource_pattern_ok (x : rsrc.Resource) (r : Bool) (h : valids.resource_pattern_valid x = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ resourceOK x) := by
  unfold valids.resource_pattern_valid at h
  cases x with
  | S3 p =>
    simp only [resourceOK]
    h5i_invert h
    · have h0 := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hi1
      have hne : p.val ≠ [] := by intro h; simp [h] at h0
      obtain ⟨y, t, hyt⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hne
      rw [hyt] at h0
      simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, Option.some.injEq] at h0
      subst h0
      simp only [hyt, nats, List.map_cons, List.head?_cons, ne_eq, Option.some.injEq, reduceCtorEq,
        not_false_eq_true, true_and, bne_iff_ne]
      rw [u8_eq_iff]; rfl
    · have : p.val = [] := by
        have : p.len.val = 0 := by scalar_tac
        simpa using this
      simp [this]
  | Kms p =>
    simp only [resourceOK, kmsResourceOK]
    h5i_invert h
    · have h0 := (bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hb).1 hc
      rw [deref_val] at h0
      simp [h0, lift_slice hs1, lit_star]
    · have h0 := (bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hb)
      have h1 := (kms_key_ok _ _ hb1)
      rw [deref_val] at h1
      simp_all
    · have h0 := (bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ hb)
      have h1 := (kms_key_ok _ _ hb1)
      have h2 := (kms_alias_ok _ _ h)
      rw [deref_val] at h0 h1 h2
      have h3 : ¬ nats p.val = lit "*" := by
        intro he
        apply hc; rw [h0]
        apply nats_inj
        rw [he, lift_slice hs1, lit_star]; rfl
      simp only [h3, false_or]
      rw [h2, ← h1]
      simp [hc_1]

theorem resource_ok (x : rsrc.Resource) (res) (h : valids.resource_is_valid x = ok res) :
    (res = .Ok () ↔ resourceOK x) := by
  unfold valids.resource_is_valid at h
  h5i_invert h
  · simp [← resource_pattern_ok _ _ hb, hc]
  all_goals (have := resource_pattern_ok _ _ hb; simp_all)

/-- One step of a loop that returns `true` at the first element satisfying `P`. -/
def AnyStep {β} (l : List β) (P : β → Prop) (i : Usize) : ControlFlow Usize Bool → Prop
  | .done b => (∃ h : i.val < l.length, P l[i.val] ∧ b = true) ∨ (l.length ≤ i.val ∧ b = false)
  | .cont j => ∃ h : i.val < l.length, ¬ P l[i.val] ∧ j.val = i.val + 1

theorem any_loop {β} (l : List β) (P : β → Prop) (body : Usize → Result (ControlFlow Usize Bool))
    (hb : ∀ i r, i.val ≤ l.length → body i = ok r → AnyStep l P i r) (r : Bool)
    (h : loop body 0#usize = ok r) : (r = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ l, P x) := by
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ l.length ∧ ∀ x ∈ l.take i.val, ¬ P x)
    (fun r => r = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ l, P x) (fun i : Usize => l.length - i.val) ?_ _ r
    ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ h
  rintro i r ⟨hi, hx⟩ hr
  have := hb i r hi hr
  cases r with
  | done b =>
    rcases this with ⟨hlt, hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨hle, rfl⟩
    · simp only [true_iff]; exact ⟨_, List.getElem_mem hlt, hp⟩
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, not_exists, not_and]
      rw [List.take_of_length_le hle] at hx
      exact hx
  | cont j =>
    obtain ⟨hlt, hp, hj⟩ := this
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, fun x hx' => ?_⟩, by omega⟩
    rw [hj, List.take_add_one, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at hx'
    simp only [Option.toList_some, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hx'
    rcases hx' with h | rfl
    · exact hx x h
    · exact hp

theorem has_kms_action_ok (l : Slice acts.Action) (r : Bool) (h : valids.has_kms_action l = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ ∃ a ∈ l.val, a.family = .Kms) := by
  unfold valids.has_kms_action valids.has_kms_action_loop at h
  refine any_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) r h
  unfold valids.has_kms_action_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok ha
    rw [family_eq_ok] at hb
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq, decide_eq_true_eq] at hb
    exact .inl ⟨h1, by rw [h2]; simp_all, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok ha
    rw [family_eq_ok] at hb
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hb
    refine ⟨h1, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
    rw [h2]; intro he; simp_all
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩

theorem is_kms_ok (x : rsrc.Resource) (b : Bool) (h : rsrc.is_kms x = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ isKmsResource x) := by
  unfold rsrc.is_kms at h; cases x <;> simp_all [isKmsResource]

theorem has_kms_resource_ok (l : Slice rsrc.Resource) (o : Bool) (h : valids.has_kms_resource l = ok o) :
    (o = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ l.val, isKmsResource x) := by
  unfold valids.has_kms_resource valids.has_kms_resource_loop at h
  refine any_loop _ _ _ (fun i o _ hbody => ?_) o h
  unfold valids.has_kms_resource_loop.body at hbody
  h5i_invert hbody
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok hr
    have := is_kms_ok _ _ hb
    exact .inl ⟨h1, by rw [h2]; simp_all, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok hr
    have := is_kms_ok _ _ hb
    exact ⟨h1, by rw [h2]; simp_all, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩

theorem resources_ok (l : Slice rsrc.Resource) (o) (h : valids.resources_is_valid l = ok o) :
    (o = .Ok () ↔ ∀ x ∈ l.val, resourceOK x) := by
  unfold valids.resources_is_valid valids.resources_is_valid_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ l.val.length ∧ ∀ x ∈ l.val.take i.val, resourceOK x)
    (fun o => o = .Ok () ↔ ∀ x ∈ l.val, resourceOK x) (fun i : Usize => l.val.length - i.val) ?_ _ o
    ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ h
  rintro i o ⟨hi, hx⟩ hbody
  unfold valids.resources_is_valid_loop.body at hbody
  h5i_invert hbody
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok hr
    have h3 := resource_ok _ _ hr1
    have := add_ok_val hi2
    refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, fun x hx' => ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
    rw [show i2.val = i.val + 1 by scalar_tac, List.take_add_one, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1] at hx'
    simp only [Option.toList_some, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hx'
    rcases hx' with h | rfl
    · exact hx x h
    · rw [h2]; exact h3.1 rfl
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := slice_index_ok hr
    have h3 := resource_ok _ _ hr1
    simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_iff, not_forall] at h3 ⊢
    exact ⟨r, by rw [← h2]; exact List.getElem_mem h1, h3⟩
  · simp only [true_iff]
    rw [List.take_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)] at hx
    exact hx

theorem principal_ok (p : stmts.Principal) (o) (h : valids.principal_is_valid p = ok o) :
    (o = .Ok () ↔ (p.aws.val ≠ [] ∨ p.service.val ≠ [])) := by
  unfold valids.principal_is_valid valids.error at h
  h5i_invert h <;> simp_all [usize_ofNatCore_eq_zero]

theorem len_zero {α} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) : v.len = 0#usize ↔ v.val = [] := by
  constructor
  · intro h; have : v.len.val = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
    simpa using this
  · intro h; apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simp [h]

theorem len_bne {α} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) : (v.len != 0#usize) = !decide (v.val = []) := by
  have := len_zero v
  by_cases hv : v.len = 0#usize <;> simp_all

/-- `h : (do let x ← e; k x) = ok o`: name the value of `e` and continue with `k`. -/
macro "bcase " x:ident " with " hx:ident " at " h:ident : tactic => `(tactic| (
  have hh := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 $h:ident
  clear $h:ident
  obtain ⟨$x, $hx, $h⟩ := hh))

macro "vsimp " h:ident : tactic => `(tactic| (
  simp only [len_zero, len_bne, deref_val, ↓reduceIte, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, decide_true, decide_false,
    Bool.false_eq_true, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok, valids.error, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
    Result.ok.injEq] at $h:ident))

macro "vif " h:ident " [" ls:Lean.Parser.Tactic.simpLemma,* "]" : tactic => `(tactic| (
  simp only [↓reduceIte, decide_true, decide_false, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.false_eq_true,
    Bool.true_eq_false, Result.ok.injEq, $ls,*] at $h:ident))

macro "vclose " h:ident : tactic => `(tactic| (subst $h:ident; first
  | (simp_all; done)
  | (simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_iff]; grind)))

theorem bp_statement_ok (st : stmts.BPStatement) (sid : Slice U8) (o)
    (h : valids.bp_statement_is_valid st sid = ok o) : (o = .Ok () ↔ BPStatementOK st) := by
  unfold valids.bp_statement_is_valid at h
  unfold BPStatementOK
  bcase e1 with he1 at h
  bcase e2 with he2 at h
  bcase p with hp at h
  have hpo := principal_ok _ _ hp
  cases p with
  | Err e =>
    vsimp h
    simp only [from_residual_err, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok, Result.ok.injEq] at h
    subst h; simp_all
  | Ok v =>
    vsimp h
    have hP : st.principal.aws.val ≠ [] ∨ st.principal.service.val ≠ [] := hpo.1 rfl
    clear hpo hp he1 he2
    by_cases ha : st.actions.val = [] <;> by_cases hn : st.not_actions.val = [] <;> vif h [ha, hn]
    all_goals try vclose h
    all_goals
      bcase b with hb at h
      have hb' := has_kms_action_ok _ _ hb
      rw [deref_val] at hb'
      cases b <;> vif h []
    all_goals try vclose h
    all_goals
      bcase b1 with hb1 at h
      have hb1' := has_kms_action_ok _ _ hb1
      rw [deref_val] at hb1'
      cases b1 <;> vif h []
    all_goals try vclose h
    all_goals
      bcase b2 with hb2 at h
      have hb2' := has_kms_resource_ok _ _ hb2
      rw [deref_val] at hb2'
      cases b2 <;> vif h []
    all_goals try vclose h
    all_goals
      bcase b3 with hb3 at h
      have hb3' := has_kms_resource_ok _ _ hb3
      rw [deref_val] at hb3'
      cases b3 <;> vif h []
    all_goals try vclose h
    all_goals (by_cases hr : st.resources.val = [] <;> by_cases hnr : st.not_resources.val = [] <;> vif h [hr, hnr])
    all_goals try vclose h
    all_goals
      bcase x1 with hx1 at h
      bcase x2 with hx2 at h
      bcase r1 with hr1 at h
      have hr1' := resources_ok _ _ hr1
      rw [deref_val] at hr1'
      cases r1 <;> vsimp h <;> try simp only [from_residual_err, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok, Result.ok.injEq] at h
    all_goals try vclose h
    all_goals
      bcase r2 with hr2 at h
      have hr2' := resources_ok _ _ hr2
      rw [deref_val] at hr2'
      cases r2 <;> vsimp h <;> try simp only [from_residual_err, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok, Result.ok.injEq] at h
    all_goals try vclose h

/-- Some action of `l` has family `f`. -/
def Saw (l : List acts.Action) (f : acts.Family) : Bool := decide (∃ a ∈ l, a.family = f)

theorem saw_snoc (l : List acts.Action) (y : acts.Action) (f : acts.Family) :
    Saw (l ++ [y]) f = (Saw l f || decide (y.family = f)) := by
  simp only [Saw, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
  by_cases h1 : ∃ a ∈ l, a.family = f <;> by_cases h2 : y.family = f <;> simp_all

def Saws (l : List acts.Action) : Bool × Bool × Bool × Bool :=
  (Saw l .S3, Saw l .Admin, Saw l .Sts, Saw l .Kms)

theorem action_family_loop_ok (v : alloc.vec.Vec acts.Action) (x : Bool × Bool × Bool × Bool)
    (h : valids.action_family_loop v false false false false 0#usize = ok x) : x = Saws v.val := by
  unfold valids.action_family_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun y : Bool × Bool × Bool × Bool × Usize => y.2.2.2.2.val ≤ v.val.length ∧
      (y.1, y.2.1, y.2.2.1, y.2.2.2.1) = Saws (v.val.take y.2.2.2.2.val))
    (fun x => x = Saws v.val) (fun y => v.val.length - y.2.2.2.2.val) ?_ _ x
    ⟨by simp, by simp [Saws, Saw]⟩ h
  rintro ⟨s0, a0, t0, k0, i⟩ r ⟨hi, hx⟩ hr
  simp only at hi hx
  unfold valids.action_family_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨s1, a1, t1, k1⟩ := x_1
    change (do let i2 ← i + 1#usize; ok (ControlFlow.cont (s1, a1, t1, k1, i2))) = ok r at hr
    obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hr
    subst hr
    have h0 := vec_index_slice_ok_get? ha
    have h1 := add_ok_val hi2
    have hlt : i.val < v.val.length := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
    rw [show i2.val = i.val + 1 by scalar_tac, List.take_add_one, h0]
    simp only [Option.toList_some, Saws, saw_snoc]
    simp only [Saws, Prod.mk.injEq] at hx
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
    cases hf : a.family <;> simp only [hf, Result.ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hx_1 <;>
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := hx_1 <;> simp
  · simp only
    rw [List.take_of_length_le (by scalar_tac)] at hx
    exact hx

def famModel : Bool × Bool × Bool × Bool → Option valids.ActionFamily
  | (s, a, t, k) =>
    if s.toNat + a.toNat + t.toNat + k.toNat ≠ 1 then some .Mixed
    else if s then some .S3 else if a then some .Admin else if t then some .Sts
    else if k then some .Kms else some .Mixed

theorem action_family_ok (st : stmts.Statement) (o) (h : valids.action_family st = ok o) :
    o = if st.actions.val = [] then none else famModel (Saws st.actions.val) := by
  unfold valids.action_family at h
  simp only [len_zero] at h
  by_cases hc : st.actions.val = []
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte, Result.ok.injEq] at h ⊢
    exact h.symm
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at h ⊢
    obtain ⟨x, hx, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    have := action_family_loop_ok _ _ hx
    subst this
    rcases hS : Saws st.actions.val with ⟨s0, a0, t0, k0⟩
    rw [hS] at h
    change (do
      let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast_fromBool .U8 s0)
      let i2 ← lift (UScalar.cast_fromBool .U8 a0)
      let i3 ← i1 + i2
      let i4 ← lift (UScalar.cast_fromBool .U8 t0)
      let i5 ← i3 + i4
      let i6 ← lift (UScalar.cast_fromBool .U8 k0)
      let count ← i5 + i6
      if count != 1#u8 then ok (some valids.ActionFamily.Mixed)
      else if s0 then ok (some .S3) else if a0 then ok (some .Admin) else if t0 then ok (some .Sts)
      else if k0 then ok (some .Kms) else ok (some .Mixed)) = ok o at h
    simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok] at h
    clear hS hx hc
    h5i_invert h
    all_goals
      h5i_ok_facts
      simp only [UScalar.cast_fromBool_val_eq, bne_iff_ne, ne_eq] at *
      have hu : ∀ x : U8, x = 1#u8 ↔ x.val = 1 := fun x => by
        rw [u8_eq_iff]; rfl
      simp only [hu] at *
      try clear h
      clear hi3 hi5 hcount hu
      cases s0 <;> cases a0 <;> cases t0 <;> cases k0 <;>
        simp only [Bool.toNat_true, Bool.toNat_false, Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.true_eq_false] at * <;>
        first | rfl | omega | (exfalso; omega) | simp_all

theorem family_forall {P : acts.Family → Prop} :
    (∀ g, P g) ↔ P .S3 ∧ P .Admin ∧ P .Sts ∧ P .Kms ∧ P .None :=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h _, h _, h _, h _, h _⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ g => by cases g <;> assumption⟩

theorem family_exists {P : acts.Family → Prop} :
    (∃ g, P g) ↔ P .S3 ∨ P .Admin ∨ P .Sts ∨ P .Kms ∨ P .None :=
  ⟨fun ⟨g, h⟩ => by cases g <;> simp_all, fun h => by
    rcases h with h | h | h | h | h <;> exact ⟨_, h⟩⟩

theorem uf_iff (l : List acts.Action) (f : acts.Family) :
    UniformFamily l f ↔ f ≠ .None ∧ Saw l f ∧ ∀ g, g ≠ f → g ≠ .None → Saw l g = false := by
  unfold UniformFamily Saw
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨h1, by simpa using h2, fun g hg hn => ?_⟩
    simp only [decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_exists, not_and]
    intro a ha he
    rcases h3 a ha with h | h <;> simp_all
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨h1, by simpa using h2, fun a ha => ?_⟩
    by_contra hc
    simp only [not_or] at hc
    have := h3 a.family hc.1 hc.2
    simp only [decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_exists, not_and] at this
    exact this a ha rfl

macro "fam_cases" l:term : tactic => `(tactic| (
  simp only [uf_iff, family_forall, family_exists, Saws, ne_eq, reduceCtorEq, not_false_eq_true,
    not_true_eq_false, true_and, false_and, imp_self, forall_const, and_true, true_implies,
    false_implies, IsEmpty.forall_iff, or_false, false_or]
  generalize Saw $l .S3 = s0
  generalize Saw $l .Admin = a0
  generalize Saw $l .Sts = t0
  generalize Saw $l .Kms = k0
  cases s0 <;> cases a0 <;> cases t0 <;> cases k0 <;> simp [famModel]))

theorem fam_mixed (l : List acts.Action) :
    famModel (Saws l) = some .Mixed ↔ ¬ ∃ f, UniformFamily l f := by
  fam_cases l

theorem fam_kms (l : List acts.Action) :
    famModel (Saws l) = some .Kms ↔ UniformFamily l .Kms := by
  fam_cases l

theorem fam_empty_ok (l : List acts.Action) :
    (famModel (Saws l) = some .Admin ∨ famModel (Saws l) = some .Sts ∨ famModel (Saws l) = some .Kms) ↔
      ∃ f, (f = .Admin ∨ f = .Sts ∨ f = .Kms) ∧ UniformFamily l f := by
  rw [family_exists]
  fam_cases l

theorem action_family_mixed (st : stmts.Statement) (o) (h : valids.action_family st = ok o)
    (hne : st.actions.val ≠ []) : (o = some .Mixed ↔ ¬ ∃ f, UniformFamily st.actions.val f) := by
  rw [action_family_ok st o h, if_neg hne]; exact fam_mixed _

def AllowsEmpty (fam : Option valids.ActionFamily) : Prop :=
  fam = some .Admin ∨ fam = some .Sts ∨ fam = some .Kms

theorem allows_empty_ok (fam) (b : Bool) (h : valids.family_allows_empty_resource fam = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ AllowsEmpty fam) := by
  unfold valids.family_allows_empty_resource at h
  unfold AllowsEmpty
  rcases fam with _ | ⟨_ | _ | _ | _ | _⟩ <;> simp_all

theorem family_is_kms_ok (fam) (b : Bool) (h : valids.family_is_kms fam = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ fam = some .Kms) := by
  unfold valids.family_is_kms at h
  rcases fam with _ | ⟨_ | _ | _ | _ | _⟩ <;> simp_all

open Lean Elab Tactic in
/-- Add what `hx : f .. = ok x` says, for the validators read back above. -/
elab "vfact " hx:ident : tactic => withMainContext do
  let thms := [``has_kms_action_ok, ``has_kms_resource_ok, ``resources_ok, ``principal_ok,
    ``allows_empty_ok, ``family_is_kms_ok]
  for thm in thms do
    try
      evalTactic (← `(tactic| have := $(mkIdent thm) (h := $hx)))
      evalTactic (← `(tactic| try simp only [deref_val] at this))
      return
    catch _ => pure ()

/-- One `let x ← f ..` of `h`: name its value, add what it means, split on it. -/
macro "bstep " h:ident : tactic => `(tactic| (
  have hh := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 $h:ident
  clear $h:ident
  obtain ⟨x, hx, $h⟩ := hh
  vfact hx
  first
  | (cases x <;> vif $h [])
  | (cases x <;> vsimp $h <;> try simp only [from_residual_err, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok, Result.ok.injEq] at $h:ident)))

theorem rules_ok (st : stmts.Statement) (fam) (o) (h : valids.statement_resource_rules st fam = ok o) :
    (o = .Ok () ↔ ((st.resources.val = [] → st.not_resources.val = [] → AllowsEmpty fam) ∧
      (st.resources.val = [] ∨ st.not_resources.val = []) ∧
      ((∃ r ∈ st.resources.val ++ st.not_resources.val, isKmsResource r) → fam = some .Kms))) := by
  unfold valids.statement_resource_rules valids.error at h
  by_cases hr : st.resources.val = [] <;> by_cases hnr : st.not_resources.val = [] <;>
    simp only [len_zero, len_bne, hr, hnr] at h <;> vif h []
  all_goals try vclose h
  all_goals repeat (first | vclose h | bstep h)

theorem action_selection_ok (a n : Slice acts.Action) (o)
    (h : valids.action_selection_valid a n = ok o) :
    (o = .Ok () ↔ (a.val ≠ [] ↔ n.val = [])) := by
  unfold valids.action_selection_valid valids.error at h
  have hz (v : Slice acts.Action) : v.len = 0#usize ↔ v.val = [] := by
    constructor
    · intro hh; have := congrArg UScalar.val hh; simpa using this
    · intro hh; apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simp [hh]
  have hn (v : Slice acts.Action) : (v.len != 0#usize) = !decide (v.val = []) := by
    by_cases hv : v.len = 0#usize <;> simp_all
  by_cases ha : a.val = [] <;> by_cases hn' : n.val = [] <;>
    simp_all [hz, hn] <;> subst h <;> simp

theorem family_is_mixed_ok (fam) (b : Bool) (h : valids.family_is_mixed fam = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ fam = some .Mixed) := by
  unfold valids.family_is_mixed at h
  rcases fam with _ | ⟨_ | _ | _ | _ | _⟩ <;> simp_all

theorem checked_family_ok (st : stmts.Statement) (o)
    (h : valids.checked_action_family st = ok o) :
    (∃ fam, o = .Ok fam) ↔
      (st.not_actions.val ≠ [] ∨ st.actions.val = [] ∨ ∃ f, UniformFamily st.actions.val f) := by
  unfold valids.checked_action_family at h
  by_cases hn : st.not_actions.val = [] <;> vsimp h <;> vif h [hn]
  · bcase fam with hf at h
    have hf' := action_family_ok _ _ hf
    bcase b with hb at h
    have hb' := family_is_mixed_ok _ _ hb
    cases b <;> vif h [] <;> try vsimp h
    all_goals
      subst h
      by_cases ha : st.actions.val = [] <;> simp_all [fam_mixed]
  · subst h; simp_all

theorem checked_family_value (st : stmts.Statement) (fam)
    (h : valids.checked_action_family st = ok (.Ok fam)) :
    fam = if st.not_actions.val ≠ [] then none
      else if st.actions.val = [] then none else famModel (Saws st.actions.val) := by
  unfold valids.checked_action_family at h
  by_cases hn : st.not_actions.val = [] <;> vsimp h <;> vif h [hn]
  · bcase f with hf at h
    have hf' := action_family_ok _ _ hf
    bcase b with hb at h
    cases b <;> (try vsimp h) <;> (try vif h [])
    all_goals simp_all
  · simp only [core.result.Result.Ok.injEq] at h
    subst h; simp_all

theorem is_admin_ok (st : stmts.Statement) (r : Bool) (h : valids.is_admin st = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ ∃ a ∈ st.actions.val, a.family = .Admin) := by
  unfold valids.is_admin valids.is_admin_loop at h
  refine any_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) r h
  unfold valids.is_admin_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have h0 := vec_index_slice_ok_get? ha
    have hlt : i.val < st.actions.val.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [family_eq_ok] at hb
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq, decide_eq_true_eq] at hb
    exact .inl ⟨hlt, by rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at h0; simp_all, rfl⟩
  · have h0 := vec_index_slice_ok_get? ha
    have hlt : i.val < st.actions.val.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [family_eq_ok] at hb
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hb
    refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at h0
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h0
    rw [h0]; intro he; simp_all
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩

theorem is_sts_ok (st : stmts.Statement) (r : Bool) (h : valids.is_sts st = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ ∃ a ∈ st.actions.val, a.family = .Sts) := by
  unfold valids.is_sts valids.is_sts_loop at h
  refine any_loop _ _ _ (fun i r _ hr => ?_) r h
  unfold valids.is_sts_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · have h0 := vec_index_slice_ok_get? ha
    have hlt : i.val < st.actions.val.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [family_eq_ok] at hb
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq, decide_eq_true_eq] at hb
    exact .inl ⟨hlt, by rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at h0; simp_all, rfl⟩
  · have h0 := vec_index_slice_ok_get? ha
    have hlt : i.val < st.actions.val.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [family_eq_ok] at hb
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hb
    refine ⟨hlt, ?_, by have := add_ok_val hi2; scalar_tac⟩
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at h0
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h0
    rw [h0]; intro he; simp_all
  · exact .inr ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl⟩

theorem selected_rules_spec (st : stmts.Statement) (fam)
    (hs : st.actions.val ≠ [] ↔ st.not_actions.val = [])
    (hf : valids.checked_action_family st = ok (.Ok fam)) :
    StatementOK st ↔
      ((st.resources.val = [] → st.not_resources.val = [] → AllowsEmpty fam) ∧
      (st.resources.val = [] ∨ st.not_resources.val = []) ∧
      ((∃ r ∈ st.resources.val ++ st.not_resources.val, isKmsResource r) → fam = some .Kms)) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ st.resources.val, resourceOK r) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ st.not_resources.val, resourceOK r) := by
  have hv := checked_family_value _ _ hf
  have hok := (checked_family_ok _ _ hf).1 ⟨fam, rfl⟩
  unfold StatementOK AllowsEmpty
  by_cases hn : st.not_actions.val = []
  · have ha : st.actions.val ≠ [] := hs.2 hn
    simp only [hn, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte, ha] at hv
    subst fam
    have hu : ∃ f, UniformFamily st.actions.val f := by simp_all
    rw [fam_empty_ok, fam_kms]
    simp only [List.mem_append, or_imp, forall_and]
    simp_all
  · have ha : st.actions.val = [] := by by_contra h; exact hn (hs.1 h)
    simp only [hn, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hv
    subst fam
    simp only [List.mem_append, or_imp, forall_and]
    simp_all [UniformFamily]

theorem statement_ok (st : stmts.Statement) (sid : Slice U8) (o)
    (h : valids.statement_is_valid st sid = ok o) : (o = .Ok () ↔ StatementOK st) := by
  unfold valids.statement_is_valid at h
  bcase e with he at h
  bcase id with hid at h
  bcase sel with hsel at h
  have hsel' := action_selection_ok _ _ _ hsel
  simp only [deref_val] at hsel'
  cases sel with
  | Err err =>
    vsimp h
    simp only [from_residual_err, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok, Result.ok.injEq] at h
    subst h
    unfold StatementOK
    simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_iff]
    intro hh; have hx := hsel'.2 hh.1; simp at hx
  | Ok u =>
    have hs := hsel'.1 rfl
    vsimp h
    bcase checked with hc at h
    have hc' := checked_family_ok _ _ hc
    cases checked with
    | Err err =>
      vsimp h
      simp only [from_residual_err, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok, Result.ok.injEq] at h
      subst h
      simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_iff]
      intro hh
      have hh' := hh.2.1
      have hn : st.not_actions.val = [] := by
        by_contra hn
        have hx := hc'.2 (Or.inl hn)
        simpa using hx
      have hx := hc'.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr (hh' hn)))
      simpa using hx
    | Ok fam =>
      rw [selected_rules_spec st fam hs hc]
      vsimp h
      bcase rules with hr at h
      have hr' := rules_ok _ _ _ hr
      cases rules <;> vsimp h <;>
        try simp only [from_residual_err, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok, Result.ok.injEq] at h
      all_goals try vclose h
      bcase a with ha at h
      bcase n with hn at h
      bcase rs with hrs at h
      have hrs' := resources_ok _ _ hrs
      rw [deref_val] at hrs'
      cases rs <;> vsimp h <;>
        try simp only [from_residual_err, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok, Result.ok.injEq] at h
      all_goals try vclose h
      bcase ns with hns at h
      have hns' := resources_ok _ _ hns
      rw [deref_val] at hns'
      cases ns <;> vsimp h <;>
        try simp only [from_residual_err, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok, Result.ok.injEq] at h
      all_goals vclose h

/-- IDs are opaque bytes: emptiness is literal and the view preserves them. -/
theorem id_interface (id : Slice U8) (b : Bool) (view : Slice U8)
    (he : valids.id_is_empty id = ok b) (hv : valids.id_as_slice id = ok view) :
    (b = true ↔ id.val = []) ∧ view = id := by
  unfold valids.id_is_empty at he
  unfold valids.id_as_slice at hv
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at he hv
  subst b; subst view
  constructor
  · simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · intro hh; have := congrArg UScalar.val hh; simpa using this
    · intro hh; apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simp [hh]
  · rfl

/-- The default validator imposes no additional constraint. -/
theorem default_valid : valids.default_is_valid = ok true := by
  simp [valids.default_is_valid]

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsValids

import Verified.RustfsVariableScalars
import Verified.RustfsValids
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
open rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsForceDelete (bytes_eq_ok deref_val)
namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsVariableCustom
 theorem loop_spec (r : varctx.VariableResolver) (key : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (out : Option (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h : varctx.resolve_custom_variable_loop r key 0#usize = ok out) :
    out = CustomValue r.context.custom_variables.val key.val := by
  unfold varctx.resolve_custom_variable_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ r.context.custom_variables.val.length ∧
      ∀ e ∈ r.context.custom_variables.val.take i.val, e.1.val ≠ key.val)
    (fun out => out = CustomValue r.context.custom_variables.val key.val)
    (fun i => r.context.custom_variables.val.length - i.val) ?_ _ out ⟨by simp,by simp⟩ h
  rintro i res ⟨hi,hn⟩ hr
  unfold varctx.resolve_custom_variable_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rcases x with ⟨candidate,value⟩
    change (do
      let b ← bytes.eq candidate.deref key.deref
      if b then do
        let v ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 value
        ok (ControlFlow.done (some v))
      else do
        let j ← i + 1#usize
        ok (ControlFlow.cont j)) = ok res at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · obtain ⟨hlt,he⟩ := vec_index_ok hx
      have hb := bytes_eq_ok _ _ _ (by assumption)
      rw [deref_val,deref_val] at hb
      have hkey : candidate.val = key.val := hb.mp hc_1
      have hf : r.context.custom_variables.val.find? (fun e => decide (e.1.val = key.val)) =
          some (candidate,value) := by
        apply List.find?_eq_some_iff_append.mpr
        refine ⟨by simpa using hkey,r.context.custom_variables.val.take i.val,
          r.context.custom_variables.val.drop (i.val+1),?_,?_⟩
        · rw [← he,← List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt]
          exact (List.take_append_drop _ _).symm
        · intro e hm
          simpa using hn e hm
      simp only [u8vec_clone] at hv
      have hvv := Result.ok.inj hv
      simp only [CustomValue,hf,Option.map_some]

import Verified.Derived
import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit


namespace rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsWildcard

theorem glob_star_last (n : List Nat) : globSpec [42] n = true := by
  induction n with
  | nil => simp [globSpec.eq_1, globSpec.eq_2]
  | cons x n ih => simp [globSpec.eq_3, ih]

theorem glob_lit_nil (c : Nat) (p : List Nat) (h1 : c ≠ 42) (h2 : c ≠ 63) :
    globSpec (c :: p) [] = false := by
  rw [globSpec.eq_def]; split <;> simp_all

theorem glob_lit_cons (c x : Nat) (p n : List Nat) (h1 : c ≠ 42) (h2 : c ≠ 63) :
    globSpec (c :: p) (x :: n) = (decide (c = x) && globSpec p n) := by
  rw [globSpec.eq_def]; split <;> simp_all

theorem nats_drop_cons (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (c : U8) (h : i < l.length) (hc : l[i] = c) :
    nats (l.drop i) = c.val :: nats (l.drop (i+1)) := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons h, hc]; rfl

theorem nats_drop_nil (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : l.length ≤ i) :
    nats (l.drop i) = [] := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le h]; rfl

theorem glob_star_drop (c : Nat) (hc : c = 42) (r : List Nat) (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : i < l.length) :
    globSpec (c :: r) (nats (l.drop i)) = (globSpec r (nats (l.drop i)) || globSpec (c :: r) (nats (l.drop (i+1)))) := by
  subst hc; conv => lhs; rw [nats_drop_cons l i _ h rfl, globSpec.eq_3]
  rw [← nats_drop_cons l i _ h rfl]

theorem deep_spec (p n : Slice U8) (pi ni : Usize) (hp : pi.val ≤ p.length) (hn : ni.val ≤ n.length) :
    wildmatch.deep_match p pi n ni false ⦃ b => b = globSpec (nats (p.val.drop pi.val)) (nats (n.val.drop ni.val)) ⦄ := by
  h5i_measure_induction (p.length - pi.val + (n.length - ni.val)) with ih
  have ih' : ∀ (pi' ni' : Usize), p.length - pi'.val + (n.length - ni'.val) < k → pi'.val ≤ p.length → ni'.val ≤ n.length →
      wildmatch.deep_match p pi' n ni' false ⦃ b => b = globSpec (nats (p.val.drop pi'.val)) (nats (n.val.drop ni'.val)) ⦄ :=
    fun pi' ni' h1 h2 h3 => ih _ h1 p n pi' ni' h2 h3 rfl
  clear ih
  rw [wildmatch.deep_match]
  step*
  · rw [nats_drop_nil _ _ (by scalar_tac), globSpec.eq_1]
    by_cases h : ni.val < n.length
    · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ h rfl]; simp; scalar_tac
    · rw [nats_drop_nil _ _ (by scalar_tac)]; simp; scalar_tac
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [globSpec.eq_4]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ (by scalar_tac) rfl]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [globSpec.eq_5, *]
  · have h1 : pi.val + 1 = p.length := by scalar_tac
    rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑p) (pi.val+1) (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars; simp [glob_star_last]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm]
    clear c_post; subst_vars
    by_cases h : ni.val < n.length
    · rw [nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ h rfl] at *; simp_all [globSpec.eq_3]
    · rw [nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)] at *; simp_all [globSpec.eq_2]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm] at b_post
    rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, glob_star_drop _ (by scalar_tac) _ _ _ (by scalar_tac)]
    clear c_post; subst_vars
    simp_all
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)]
    rw [nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)] at *
    clear c_post; subst_vars
    simp_all [globSpec.eq_2]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_nil (↑n) _ (by scalar_tac)]
    have : c.val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have : c.val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [glob_lit_nil _ _ (by assumption) (by assumption)]
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ (by scalar_tac) i2_post.symm]
    have : c.val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have : c.val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [glob_lit_cons _ _ _ _ (by assumption) (by assumption)]
    have hne' : c.val ≠ i2.val := by
      intro h; have : i2 = c := by scalar_tac
      simp_all
    simp [hne']
  · rw [nats_drop_cons _ _ _ (by scalar_tac) c_post.symm, nats_drop_cons (↑n) _ _ (by scalar_tac) i2_post.symm]
    have : c.val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have : c.val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [glob_lit_cons _ _ _ _ (by assumption) (by assumption)]
    have heq' : i2.val = c.val := by simp_all
    simp [heq', b_post, i3_post, i4_post]

theorem wildcard_is_glob (p n : Slice U8) :
    wildmatch.is_match p n = ok (globSpec (nats p.val) (nats n.val)) := by
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  unfold wildmatch.is_match wildmatch.inner_match
  have hd := deep_spec p n 0#usize 0#usize (by simp) (by simp)
  simp at hd
  step*
  · have : p.val = [] := by rw [← List.length_eq_zero_iff]; scalar_tac
    rw [this, show nats [] = [] from rfl, globSpec.eq_1, nats]
    simp only [decide_eq_decide, ← List.length_eq_zero_iff]
    scalar_tac
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, p.val = [x] := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp (by scalar_tac)
    have : x.val = 42 := by subst_vars; simp_all
    rw [hx]; simp only [nats, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, this, glob_star_last]

end rustfs_kernel.Verified.RustfsWildcard

import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
namespace rustfs_kernel.Solution

def signed (neg : Bool) (a : Nat) : Int := if neg then -(a : Int) else a
def cap (neg : Bool) : Nat := if neg then 2 ^ 63 else 2 ^ 63 - 1
def decimal (ds : List Nat) (a : Nat) : Nat := ds.foldl (fun a d => 10 * a + (d - 48)) a
def digitsModel (ds : List Nat) (a : Nat) (neg : Bool) : Option Int :=
  if ds.all (fun d => 48 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 57) && decide (decimal ds a ≤ cap neg)
  then some (signed neg (decimal ds a)) else none

theorem decimal_ge (ds : List Nat) (a : Nat) : a ≤ decimal ds a := by
  induction ds generalizing a with
  | nil => simp [decimal]
  | cons d ds ih =>
    simp only [decimal, List.foldl_cons]
    have := ih (10 * a + (d - 48))
    unfold decimal at this
    omega

theorem digitsModel_step (d : Nat) (ds : List Nat) (a : Nat) (neg : Bool)
    (hd : 48 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 57) :
    digitsModel (d :: ds) a neg =
      if 10 * a ≤ cap neg then
        if 10 * a + (d - 48) ≤ cap neg then digitsModel ds (10 * a + (d - 48)) neg else none
      else none := by
  have hg := decimal_ge ds (10 * a + (d - 48))
  unfold decimal at hg
  unfold digitsModel decimal
  simp only [List.all_cons, hd, decide_true, Bool.true_and, List.foldl_cons]
  split <;> split <;> simp_all
  all_goals try split <;> simp_all
  all_goals omega

theorem mul_mag (acc : I64) (a : Nat) (neg : Bool) (ha : acc.val = signed neg a) :
    match I64.checked_mul acc 10#i64 with
    | none => cap neg < 10 * a
    | some m => 10 * a ≤ cap neg ∧ m.val = signed neg (10 * a) := by
  have h := I64.checked_mul_bv_spec acc 10#i64
  cases ho : I64.checked_mul acc 10#i64 <;> rw [ho] at h
  all_goals cases neg <;> simp only [signed, cap, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true] at ha ⊢
  all_goals scalar_tac

theorem next_mag (m d : I64) (a delta : Nat) (neg : Bool)
    (hm : m.val = signed neg a) (hd : d.val = delta) :
    match (if neg then I64.checked_sub m d else I64.checked_add m d) with
    | none => cap neg < a + delta
    | some v => a + delta ≤ cap neg ∧ v.val = signed neg (a + delta) := by
  cases neg
  · have h := I64.checked_add_bv_spec m d
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    cases ho : I64.checked_add m d <;> rw [ho] at h
    all_goals simp only [signed, cap, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hm ⊢
    all_goals scalar_tac
  · have h := I64.checked_sub_bv_spec m d
    simp only [if_true]
    cases ho : I64.checked_sub m d <;> rw [ho] at h
    all_goals simp only [signed, cap, if_true] at hm ⊢
    all_goals scalar_tac

end rustfs_kernel.Solution
